s: The first expander cycle engine developed in Russia. It was developed in collaboration with Pratt & Whitney as a high performance upper stage for Proton. It was heavily inspired by the RL10, and some of its design elements were integrated into the RL10.
zh: 俄罗斯研制的第一款膨胀循环发动机。它是与普惠公司（Pratt & Whitney）合作开发的，拟作为“质子”号的高性能上面级。其设计深受<<M0>>的启发，部分设计元素后来也被反哺整合到了<<M0>>中。

s: Between 2002 and 2005, KBKhA teamed up with European industry to develop a reusable staged combustion methane engine with a thrust of 200 tons under the Volga project. In 2006, the company started work on a reusable engine designated RD-0162 for the Russian MRKS-1 reusable space booster.
zh: 在2002年至2005年间，<<M0>>在“伏尔加”（Volga）项目下与欧洲工业界联合研制推力达200吨的可重复使用分级燃烧甲烷发动机。2006年，该公司开始为俄罗斯<<M2>>可重复使用航天助推器研制代号为<<M1>>的可重复使用发动机。

s: Between 2002 and 2005, KBKhA teamed up with European industry to develop a reusable staged combustion methane engine with a thrust of 200 tons under the Volga project. In 2006, the company started work on a reusable engine designated RD-0162 for the Russian MRKS-1 reusable space booster. RD-0164 is higher thrust variant of that engine.
zh: 在2002年至2005年间，<<M0>>在“伏尔加”（Volga）项目下与欧洲工业界联合研制推力达200吨的可重复使用分级燃烧甲烷发动机。2006年，该公司开始为俄罗斯<<M2>>可重复使用航天助推器研制代号为<<M1>>的可重复使用发动机。<<M3>>是该发动机的大推力改型。

s: Between 2002 and 2005, KBKhA teamed up with European industry to develop a reusable staged combustion methane engine with a thrust of 200 tons under the Volga project. In 2006, the company started work on a reusable engine designated RD-0162 for the Russian MRKS-1 reusable space booster. RD-0169 is an upper stage derivative of that engine.
zh: 在2002年至2005年间，<<M0>>在“伏尔加”（Volga）项目下与欧洲工业界联合研制推力达200吨的可重复使用分级燃烧甲烷发动机。2006年，该公司开始为俄罗斯<<M2>>可重复使用航天助推器研制代号为<<M1>>的可重复使用发动机。<<M3>>是该发动机的上面级衍生型号。

s: An atmospheric booster engine used from the 1980s to present, the RD-170 is the most powerful liquid rocket engine ever flown. Originally developed for the Energia launcher's boosters, the engine consists of four combustion chambers fed by a single turbopump. A modified version, the RD-171, is used on the first stage of the Zenit launch vehicle.
zh: 一款从20世纪80年代沿用至今的大气助推器发动机，<<M0>>是有史以来实际飞行过的推力最大的液体火箭发动机。该发动机最初为“能源”号运载火箭的助推器研制，由单台涡轮泵向四个燃烧室供油。其改进型号<<M1>>被用于“天顶”号运载火箭的第一级。

s: A further continuation of the RD-170/171 series, featuring a single combustion chamber and nozzle. The RD-191 powers the Angara family of launchers, while the RD-151 was used on the Naro-1 launch vehicle and the RD-181 will be used on the Antares 200-series.
zh: <<M0>>/171系列的进一步延续型号，采用单燃烧室和单喷管设计。<<M1>>为安加拉系列运载火箭提供动力，<<M2>>曾用于<<M3>>运载火箭，而<<M4>>将用于安塔瑞斯200系列。

s: The first multi-chamber engine developed by Glushko. After Glushko's attempts to scale up existing engines for what would become the R-7 resulted in unresolvable combustion instability (RD-105/106), Glushko instead combined multiple chambers of his ED-140 engine into one to increase thrust. The result, the RD-200, proved successful and, although it never flew, its design formed the basis of the RD-107/108 and RD-214.
zh: 格鲁什科开发的第一款多燃烧室发动机。格鲁什科曾尝试放大现有发动机以用于后来的<<M0>>，但导致了无法解决的燃烧不稳定问题（<<M1>>/106），因此他改为将多个<<M2>>发动机燃烧室组合在一起来提升推力。成果即是<<M3>>，该设计被证明是成功的，尽管从未升空飞行，但其设计构成了<<M4>>/108和<<M5>>的基础。

s: A staged combustion hypergolic rocket engine. Used as a power plant on the first stage of the UR-200 rocket, with 3 RD-0203s and 1 RD-0204 forming a RD-0202 engine module. Features a two-axis gimbal mechanism for attitude control.
zh: 一款分级燃烧自燃推进剂火箭发动机。用作<<M0>>火箭第一级的动力装置，由3台<<M1>>和1台<<M2>>组成<<M3>>发动机模块。具备双轴万向节机构以用于姿态控制。

s: An early Soviet four combustion chamber rocket. Developed from the RD-100 for the R-12 IRBM in the mid 1950s, it provided a significant increase in power over earlier Soviet engines. It was later used for the Kosmos-2 launch vehicle.
zh: 苏联早期研发的四燃烧室火箭发动机。由<<M0>>发展而来，于1950年代中期用于<<M1>>中程弹道导弹，相比苏联早期的发动机提供了显著的动力提升。后来用于宇宙-2号运载火箭。

s: A staged combustion, hypergolic vacuum rocket engine. Used as the power plant on the second stage of the UR-200, and third stage of UR-500/Proton launch vehicle family. Features four integrated vernier engines for three-axis attitude control.
zh: 一款分级燃烧自燃推进剂真空火箭发动机。用作<<M0>>第二级以及<<M1>>/质子号运载火箭家族第三级的动力装置。配备四台集成式游标发动机以提供三轴姿态控制。

s: A staged combustion engine found on the second stage of the UR-200 and third stage of the UR-500/Proton series launcher. It is fixed, and requires its accompanying vernier module for 3-axis control. It uses UDMH & NTO for propellant.
zh: 用于<<M0>>第二级和<<M1>>/质子号系列运载火箭第三级的分级燃烧发动机。该发动机为固定安装，需要搭配专用游标模块来实现三轴控制。使用偏二甲肼与四氧化二氮推进剂。

s: A Soviet dual chamber gas generator engine. It was designed in the late 1950s to use storable propellants for ICBMs because the cryogenic propellants in the current R-7 could not be stored for long periods, requiring lengthy fueling before launch. It was used in clusters of up to three in many Soviet ICBMs, and later in the Kosmos and Tsiklon launch vehicles.
zh: 苏联的双燃烧室燃气发生器循环发动机。设计于1950年代后期，旨在为洲际弹道导弹使用可贮存推进剂，因为当时<<M0>>采用的低温推进剂无法长时间贮存，发射前需要耗费漫长时间加注。它以最多三台并联的方式应用于多种苏联洲际弹道导弹，后来又用于宇宙号和旋风号运载火箭。

s: A staged combustion hypergolic rocket engine. It was used as a power plant on the first stage of the UR-100 rocket, with 3 RD-0216s and 1 RD-0217 forming a 15D2 engine module. Features a two-axis gimbal mechanism for attitude control. It was later modified into an upper stage engine for the UR-100N, and proposed as an upper stage engine for the UR-700/LK-700 complex.
zh: 一款分级燃烧自燃推进剂火箭发动机。曾用作<<M0>>火箭第一级的动力装置，由3台<<M1>>和1台<<M2>>组成15D2发动机模块。配备双轴万向节机构用于姿态控制。后来被改装为用于<<M3>>的上面级发动机，并曾提议作为<<M4>>/<<M5>>综合体的上面级发动机。

s: A Soviet dual chamber gas generator engine. Designed in the late 1950s to use storable propellants for ICBMs because the cryogenic propellants in the current R-7 could not be stored for long periods, requiring lengthy fuelling before launch. It was used on the R-16 and R-36 ICBMs, and Tsiklon-2 and Tsiklon-3 LVs.
zh: 苏联的双燃烧室燃气发生器循环发动机。设计于1950年代末，旨在为洲际弹道导弹使用可贮存推进剂，因为当时<<M0>>采用的低温推进剂无法长期贮存，发射前需要冗长的加注过程。曾用于<<M1>>和<<M2>>洲际弹道导弹，以及旋风-2号和旋风-3号运载火箭。

s: An early Soviet hypergolic staged combustion vacuum engine. Designed for the second stage of the enormous R-20 project, versions were designed using Nitric Acid or Liquid Oxygen as an oxidizer, with UDMH as fuel. Although it was never used, it formed the basis of the much more successful RD-253 used on Proton.
zh: 苏联早期的自燃推进剂分级燃烧真空发动机。为庞大的<<M0>>工程第二级而设计，研发了使用硝酸或液氧作为氧化剂、以偏二甲肼为燃料的多个版本。尽管从未实际使用，但它为质子号上极为成功的<<M1>>奠定了基础。

s: A staged combustion upper stage engine module developed for the R-36M second stage. It consists of an RD-0229 main engine and RD-0230 vernier engine. The R-36M2 used an upgraded version of the engine known as the RD-0255.
zh: 为<<M0>>第二级研制的分级燃烧上面级发动机模块。它由一台<<M1>>主发动机和一台<<M2>>游标发动机组成。<<M3>>采用了该发动机的升级型号，即<<M4>>。

s: A staged combustion upper stage engine developed for the R-36M second stage. This engine cannot gimbal, and should be paired with a set of RD-0230 verniers. The R-36M2 used an upgraded version of the engine known as the RD-0256.
zh: 为<<M0>>第二级研制的分级燃烧上面级发动机。该发动机无法使用万向节摆动，需与一组<<M1>>游标发动机搭配使用。<<M2>>采用了该发动机的升级型号，即<<M3>>。

s: A staged combustion booster engine developed for the UR-100N. The RD-0234 was identical, other than the addition of pressurization equipment. Three RD-0233s and one RD-0234 powered the first stage of the UR-100N, UR-100NU, Strela and Rokot.
zh: 为<<M0>>研制的分级燃烧助推器发动机。除增加了增压设备外，<<M1>>与其实际相同。三台<<M2>>和一台<<M1>>共同为<<M0>>、<<M3>>、箭号和呼啸号的第一级提供动力。

s: Staged combustion booster engine module. Developed as the first stage engine of the R-29RM Submarine-Launched Ballistic Missile, the RD-0243 consists of an RD-0244 main engine and RD-0245 vernier engine. In order to save space, the engine is submerged within the fuel tank of the R-29RM, with the rear bulkhead of the missile welded to the engine nozzle. Also used on the Shtil' launch vehicle, a unique smallsat launcher capable of being deployed from Delta IV submarines.
zh: 分级燃烧助推器发动机模块。作为<<M0>>潜射弹道导弹的第一级发动机研制，<<M1>>由一台<<M2>>主发动机和一台<<M3>>游标发动机组成。为节省空间，发动机浸没安装在<<M0>>的燃料贮箱内，导弹尾部舱壁直接与发动机喷管焊接。该发动机还用于静海号运载火箭——一种能够从德尔塔IV级潜艇发射的独特微小型卫星运载器。

s: A Soviet hypergolic staged combustion engine. Developed as part of an initiative to build a 150-ton-thrust booster engine for the N1, versions were created burning nitric acid, NTO, or LOX with UDMH. Although the NK-15 was ultimately selected to power the N1, the RD-253, using NTO, was chosen to power the UR-500/Proton, becoming the workhorse of the Soviet space program.
zh: 苏联自燃推进剂分级燃烧发动机。作为为N1运载火箭建造150吨级推力助推器发动机计划的一部分而研发，制造了分别使用硝酸、四氧化二氮或液氧搭配偏二甲肼燃烧的版本。尽管最终N1选用了<<M0>>作为动力，但采用四氧化二氮的<<M1>>被选为<<M2>>/质子号的动力装置，并成为了苏联航天工程的绝对主力。

s: A Soviet hypergolic staged combustion engine. Developed as part of an initiative to build a 150-ton-thrust vacuum engine for the N1, versions were created burning nitric acid, NTO, or LOX with UDMH. Although the NK-15V was ultimately selected to power the N1, the RD-254, using NTO, was chosen to power the upper stages of the UR-700. The RD-254 was cancelled with the rest of the UR-700 project and never flew.
zh: 苏联自燃推进剂分级燃烧发动机。作为为N1运载火箭建造150吨级推力真空发动机计划的一部分而研发，制造了分别使用硝酸、四氧化二氮或液氧搭配偏二甲肼燃烧的版本。尽管最终N1选用了<<M0>>作为动力，但采用四氧化二氮的<<M1>>被选为<<M2>>的上面级动力装置。<<M1>>随着<<M2>>项目的下马而取消，从未升空飞行。

s: The largest single-chamber engine ever built in the USSR, and the first full-flow staged combustion engine, the RD-270 was fueled by NTO and UDMH combined under some of the highest pressures ever encountered in an ignition chamber. Extensively tested to power the first and second stages of the UR-700, it was cancelled with the rest of the UR-700 project and never flew, despite efforts to convert it to kerosene for the N1.
zh: 苏联建造过的最大单燃烧室发动机，也是第一款全流量分级燃烧发动机。<<M0>>以四氧化二氮和偏二甲肼为燃料，在极高的燃烧室压力下混合燃烧。该发动机为了给<<M1>>的第一级和第二级提供动力而进行了广泛的测试，但尽管曾尝试将其改用煤油以供N1使用，它最终还是随着<<M1>>工程的下马而取消，从未升空飞行。

s: Modification of the RD-270 to use highly toxic pentaborane as fuel. Although the M variant boasts higher thrust and isp, the fuel mixture is much, much more toxic than even UDMH. Pentaborane has a flash point of 30 degrees Celsius, a tendency to form shock-sensitive explosive compounds, and is classified as "immediately dangerous to life or health" with concentrations at or above one part per million.
zh: <<M0>>的改型，使用剧毒的五硼烷作为燃料。尽管M改型拥有更高的推力和比冲，但其推进剂混合物的毒性甚至远超偏二甲肼。五硼烷的闪点仅为30摄氏度，极易形成对震动敏感的爆炸性化合物，在浓度达到或超过百万分之一（1 ppm）时即被归类为“对生命或健康有即刻危险”。

s: An exotic fuel-rich staged combustion vacuum engine. Developed as a high-energy upper stage for Proton by Glushko, the RD-301 burned liquid fluorine and ammonia, which gave very high performance and density. It was tested extensively, but never flew due to toxicity concerns.
zh: 一款罕见的富燃分级燃烧真空发动机。由格鲁什科为质子号设计的高能上面级发动机，<<M0>> 使用液氟和液氨作为推进剂，拥有极高的性能与推进剂密度。该发动机进行了大量地面测试，但由于剧毒问题从未实际飞行。

s: RD-0410 was a Soviet nuclear thermal rocket engine developed from 1965 through the 1994 using liquid hydrogen propellant. The engine was ground-tested at the Semipalatinsk Test Site, and its use was incorporated in the Kurchatov Mars 1994 manned mission proposal. Its moderator and fuel are quite different from the US designs and Metal Carbide (MC) versions of the fuel are rumoured to have reach as high as 3500K without melting in the early 1990's. Use of Heptane to reduce hydrogen corrosion of the carbides was critical to function (~1%). First run tests occurred in 1985. Some Russian sources list it as dual mode using not only Hydrogen but also liquid Methane without additives. During the SNTP program the US tried to acquire MC fuels from Russian sources but planned purchases fell through. This engine is very heavily built compared to US designs and incorporates a four lobed spiral fuel rod to eliminate risk of fuel being ejected if the rods shattered. This design uses a short regeneratively cooled nozzle and is intended as an upper stage. Design stats Nozzle Ae=46 Chamber Temp=3000 Ideal ISP=972 Reactor Power=173MW(th) TWR=1.73 Chamber Pressure=4000kPa Ignitions =10 Tonnage including integral shadow shield:2tons. In Methane mode the nozzle is slightly expanded by 12cm length and slightly enlarged. Nozzle Ae=46 Chamber Temp=3000 Ideal ISP=467 Reactor Power=173MW(th) TWR=3.56 Chamber Pressure=4800kPa Ignitions =10 Tonnage including integral shadow shield:2tons
zh: <<M0>> 是苏联在 1965 年至 1994 年间开发的核热火箭发动机，使用液氢推进剂。该发动机在塞米巴拉金斯克试验场进行了地面测试，并被列入 1994 年库尔恰托夫火星载人任务方案。其慢化剂和燃料与美国设计大相径庭，据传其碳化物金属（MC）燃料版本在 20 世纪 90 年代初能在高达 3500K 下不发生熔化。添加庚烷（约 1%）以减少氢对碳化物的腐蚀对正常运行至关重要。首次点火测试于 1985 年进行。部分俄罗斯资料显示它具备双模式，不仅能使用液氢，还能使用无添加剂的液态甲烷。在 SNTP 计划期间，美国曾试图从俄罗斯获取 MC 燃料，但采购计划流产。与美国设计相比，该发动机结构非常坚固，并采用四瓣螺旋燃料棒，以消除燃料棒破碎时被喷出的风险。该设计采用短型再生冷却喷管，定位于上面级。设计参数：喷管面积比=46，燃烧室温度=3000，理想比冲=972，反应堆功率=173MW(th)，TWR=1.73，室压=4000kPa，点火次数=10，含一体化屏蔽罩重量：2 吨。在甲烷模式下，喷管长度增加 12cm 并略微扩大。喷管面积比=46，燃烧室温度=3000，理想比冲=467，反应堆功率=173MW(th)，TWR=3.56，室压=4800kPa，点火次数=10，含一体化屏蔽罩重量：2 吨。

s: A Soviet nuclear thermal rocket engine. Developed in parallel with the RD-0410, the RD-0411 was a much larger engine, intended for upper stage use on the UR-700 or N-I. Using the same advanced Metal Carbide (MC) fuels and spiral fuel rods as the RD-0410, it achieves good performance for it's size. Unlike the RD-0410, no test articles were ever built, as the failure of the N1 and cancellation of the UR-700 meant there would be no launch vehicle large enough to use it. It never progressed past the study stage, and much of it's performance is speculative.
zh: 一款苏联核热火箭发动机。与 <<M0>> 平行开发，<<M1>> 尺寸要大得多，原计划用作 <<M2>> 或 N-I 火箭的上面级。它采用了与 <<M0>> 相同的先进碳化物金属（MC）燃料和螺旋燃料棒，在其尺寸规格下实现了优异的性能。与 <<M0>> 不同，由于 N1 的失败和 <<M2>> 的取消意味着不再有足够大的运载火箭来搭载它，因而从未制造过任何测试样机。该项目从未推进到研究阶段之后，其大部分性能数据均为推测值。

s: A staged combustion kerosene and peroxide lander engine, developed for Soviet heavy manned moon landers. Derived from the earlier RD-502 project, the use of hydrogen peroxide with kerosene allowed for a very dense, storable, and non-toxic stage. Although tested extensively, and proposed for various lunar lander designs including the LK-700, it never flew.
zh: 一款分级燃烧煤油/过氧化氢着陆器发动机，专为苏联重型载人登月着陆器开发。衍生自早期的 <<M0>> 项目，使用过氧化氢与煤油使得级段具有极高的密度、可贮存性与无毒特性。尽管进行了广泛的测试，并被提议用于包括 <<M1>> 在内的多种月球着陆器设计，但它从未实际飞行过。

s: A Soviet magnetic confinment open cycle gas core nuclear rocket. After a few experiments with solid-core nuclear thermal rockets, Glushko ordered development transferred to other design bureaus due to low performance, and instead focused on gas core nuclear rockets. The RD-600 was a very complex design, containing a conventional solid core reactor for power generation and startup, and powerful electromagnets to contain the gaseous fissile material in the core powered by a 2 MW magnetoplasmadynamic generator on the nozzle. Designed for manned Mars missions, outer planet probes, and worryingly the sustainer stage of superheavy launch vehicles, development was ultimately abandoned due to high costs, difficulty achieving stable containment of a gaseous core, and the lack of launch vehicles of the required scale for such a large engine.
zh: 一款苏联磁约束开式循环气核核火箭。在对固核核热火箭进行了几次试验后，格鲁什科因其性能过低而下令将开发工作移交至其他设计局，转而专注于气核核火箭。<<M0>> 的设计极其复杂，包含一个用于发电和启动的常规固核反应堆，以及安装在喷管上的 2 MW 磁流体动力发电机供电的强力电磁铁，用以约束堆芯中的气态裂变物质。其设计目标是执行载人火星任务、外行星探测器任务，乃至令人担忧地用作超重型运载火箭的持续级。最终由于成本高昂、难以实现对气态堆芯的稳定约束，以及缺乏相匹配规模的超重型运载火箭，开发工作被彻底放弃。

s: A staged combustion tripropellant liquid fuel engine using kerosene, liquid hydrogen, and liquid oxygen. Originally developed for the MAKS space plane. In the booster phase of the ascent it uses a mixture of kerosene with liquid hydrogen and it switches to pure hydrogen for the sustainer phase.
zh: 一款采用煤油、液氢和液氧的三组元液体燃料分级燃烧发动机。最初为 MAKS 航天飞机开发。在上升助推阶段，它混合燃烧煤油与液氢，而在主级巡航阶段则切换为纯氢燃料。

s: A staged combustion tripropellant liquid fuel engine using kerosene, liquid hydrogen, and liquid oxygen. This is the single chamber version of the RD-701, originally developed for the MAKS space plane. In the booster phase of the ascent it uses a mixture of kerosene with liquid hydrogen and it switches to pure hydrogen for the sustainer phase.
zh: 一款采用煤油、液氢和液氧的三组元液体燃料分级燃烧发动机。这是 <<M0>> 的单燃烧室版本，最初为 MAKS 航天飞机开发。在上升助推阶段，它混合燃烧煤油与液氢，而在主级巡航阶段则切换为纯氢燃料。

s: A single-chamber derivative of the RD-8 engine used on the Zenit second stage. A Yuzhnoye Design Office concept, featuring dual-axis gimbal control and restart capability for use as a standalone upper stage engine.
zh: Zenit 火箭第二级上使用的 <<M0>> 发动机的单燃烧室衍生型号。由南方设计局提出的概念，具备双轴万向节控制和多次重启能力，可用作独立的上面级发动机。

s: A pressure-fed upper stage engine developed for the third stage of R-36MUTTKh. This represents 1/4th of an RD-864. The RD-864 was able to restart many times and had extremely high gimbal authority and limited throttle, to allow it to dodge American missile defenses while deploying multiple warheads. The R-36M2 used an upgraded version of the engine known as the RD-869.
zh: 一款为 <<M0>> 第三级开发的挤压循环上面级发动机。该部件代表 <<M1>> 的四分之一。<<M1>> 能够多次重新点火，并拥有极大的万向节控制范围和有限的节流阀调节能力，使其在释放多个分导核弹头的同时躲避美国的反导防御。<<M2>> 使用了该发动机的升级版本，即 <<M3>>。

s: A restartable expander-cycle hydrolox engine used in multiple upper stages, including Centaur, the Saturn I S-IV, and the Delta Cryogenic Second Stage. It has low thrust, but very high ISP and low mass.
zh: 一款可多次点火的膨胀循环液氢液氧发动机，广泛应用于半人马座、土星 1 号 S-IV 级以及德尔塔低温第二级等多种上面级。它的推力较小，但比冲极高且结构质量低。

s: A next generation cryogenic upper stage engine designed to replace the RL10, providing higher performance while maintaining the same installation envelope. Also available in a lower 180kN thrust Vinci-180 model.
zh: 下一代低温上面级发动机，旨在取代 <<M0>>，在保持相同安装包络的同时提供更高的性能。此外还提供推力较低的 180kN 版本 Vinci-180。

s: A reusable expander-cycle vacuum engine. Also known as the Advanced Expander Cycle engine, it was developed as an engine for a high-performance Space Shuttle upper stage. Although the engine was tested, it was canceled after the Challenger disaster.
zh: 一款可重复使用的膨胀循环真空发动机。亦被称为先进膨胀循环发动机，是作为高性能航天飞机上面级的发动机而开发的。尽管该发动机进行了地面测试，但在挑战者号失事后项目被取消。

s: A 1990s atmospheric engine using technology developed for the Space Shuttle SSME, the RS-68 is a single-use engine. It features a simplified design with fewer parts and an easier construction and uses exhaust from the gas generator for roll control. The RS-68 powers the Delta IV launch vehicle family and is the most powerful LH2/LOX engine ever flown.
zh: 一款 1990 年代的大气发动机，采用了为航天飞机 SSME 发动机开发的技术，<<M0>> 为一次性使用发动机。它简化了设计，零部件更少且制造更简单，利用燃气发生器的排气来实现滚转控制。<<M0>> 为德尔塔 IV 运载火箭家族提供动力，是人类发射过的推力最大的液氢/液氧发动机。

s: An early 2000s atmospheric staged combustion kerolox engine. Developed as the booster engine for the liquid fly-back booster, a reusable space shuttle booster system. Extremely high performance, cancelled during prototype phase.
zh: 一款 2000 年代早期的大气分级燃烧液氧煤油发动机。作为液体滑翔返航助推器（一种可重复使用的航天飞机助推器系统）的助推发动机开发。性能极高，但在原型机阶段被取消。

s: An early 2000s atmospheric staged combustion hydrolox engine. Developed as the main engine for a Space Shuttle replacement as a part of the Space Launch Initiative program. Extremely high performance, cancelled during prototype phase.
zh: 一款2000年代初的大气分级燃烧氢氧发动机。作为“航天发射倡议”计划的一部分，研发用于取代航天飞机的主发动机。性能极高，但在原型阶段被取消。

s: An early 2000s atmospheric staged combustion kerolox engine. Developed as the booster engine for a Space Shuttle replacement as a part of the Space Launch Initiative program. Extremely high performance, cancelled during prototype phase.
zh: 一款2000年代初的大气分级燃烧液氧煤油发动机。作为“航天发射倡议”计划的一部分，研发用于取代航天飞机的助推器发动机。性能极高，但在原型阶段被取消。

s: A high thrust pressure-fed hypergolic engine. Initially designed and built as a part of the NASA Bantam System Technology program, aiming for a low cost, high power propulsion system, it was later modified by Lockheed Martin for use as a launch abort engine. A derivative of the RS-88 is used by the Boeing CST-100 "Starliner" spacecraft for launch aborts under the name "Launch Abort Engine - LAE".
zh: 一款大推力挤压式自燃推进剂发动机。最初作为NASA矮脚鸡系统技术（Bantam System Technology）计划的一部分设计和制造，旨在提供低成本、高功率的推进系统，后来由洛克希德·马丁公司改进用作发射逃逸发动机。<<M0>>的衍生型号被波音<<M1>>“星际客机”飞船用作发射逃逸系统，命名为“发射逃逸发动机（LAE）”。

s: A four segment Reusable Solid Rocket Motor, one of the most powerful rocket motors ever built and flown. Two of them were used by the Space Shuttle for liftoff and the initial part of the flight, providing more than 75% of the overall stack thrust. Manufactured by Thiokol and later by ATK.
zh: 四段式可重复使用固体火箭发动机（RSRM），是有史以来制造并飞行的最强大火箭发动机之一。航天飞机使用两台用于起飞和初始爬升段，提供了整个箭体总推力的75%以上。由Thiokol制造，后由ATK制造。

s: The 5-segment Reusable Solid Rocket Motor (RSRMV) was first studied as an upgrade for the Space Shuttle, and entered full-scale development for Ares I. Development continued for SLS after the cancellation of Ares. Nose Cone 6.50662m tall.
zh: 五段式可重复使用固体火箭发动机（RSRMV）最初作为航天飞机的升级型号进行研究，随后进入战神一号的全面开发阶段。战神计划取消后，该研发转移至SLS。整流锥高6.50662m。

s: The Rutherford engine is the world's first electrically pumped engine. It adopts an entirely new propulsion cycle, making use of brushless DC motors and high performance lithium polymer batteries to drive its pumps. The engine is named after the New Zealand-born physicist Ernest Rutherford.
zh: 卢瑟福（Rutherford）发动机是世界上第一款采用电泵供给的火箭发动机。它采用了全新的动力循环，利用无刷直流电机和高性能锂聚合物电池驱动推进剂泵。该发动机以新西兰出生的物理学家欧内斯特·卢瑟福的名字命名。

s: A pump-fed gas generator hydrolox engine, developed as an upper stage for the Black Knight and Blue Streak. The use of furnace brazing, rather than hand brazing as used in many earlier designs, significantly reduced manufacturing costs. The design was tested, but cancelled in the late 60s due to funding concerns.
zh: 一款泵压式燃气发生器循环氢氧发动机，作为“黑夜”和“蓝光”火箭的上面级研发。采用了炉内钎焊工艺而非以往多种设计中使用的手工钎焊，大幅降低了制造成本。该设计进行了测试，但在60年代末因资金问题被取消。

s: Better known by its western designation, Scud, the S2.253 engine was developed for use in the R-11 Zemlya ballistic missile and sounding rocket. It was originally based on the German Wasserfall engine and later versions were exported extensively to many countries, eventually forming the basis of the Iranian and North Korean space programs.
zh: S2.253发动机更为西方所熟知的名称是“飞毛腿”，专为<<M0>>“大地”弹道导弹和探空火箭研发。它最初基于德国瀑布（Wasserfall）防空火箭的发动机设计，后续型号广泛出口至多个国家，最终构成了伊朗和朝鲜航天计划的基础。

s: A small gas generator vacuum engine, developed as the de-orbit motor for the Vostok spacecraft. It was very reliable, and was also used on the Voskhod and early Zenit spacecraft, before being replaced by a solid rocket motor.
zh: 一款小型燃气发生器循环真空发动机，作为东方号飞船的离轨发动机研发。其工作非常可靠，也被用于上升号和早期的天顶号飞船，后被固体火箭发动机取代。

s: A throttleable rocket engine designed to turn the MiG-21 into a super-high-performance rocket interceptor. It proved successful in tests, but the destruction of the only prototype due to an engine explosion and the increasing performance of jet-powered aircraft led to the project being abandoned.
zh: 一款可节流的火箭发动机，旨在将<<M0>>改装为超高性能的火箭截击机。测试证明其性能优异，但由于发动机爆炸导致唯一的原型机损毁，加之喷气动力飞机的性能不断提升，该项目最终被放弃。

s: The "SNTP-PFE" series is a 1000MW reactor. The reactor is a particle bed using metallic carbide coated uranium granules embedded in a graphite rod that hydrogen is passed through. This allows for power densities of up to 40MW/liter. Its core is capable of starting up five times. An integral Tungsten Boron Lithium Hydride composite shield is included and the whole assembly is regeneratively cooled. A secondary circuit runs the shut down gasses through a small heat engine to minimize fuel loss and provide basic alternator power. This engine should be mounted three to six meters from the closest fuel tank. Fuel should shield any crew and crew positions when running should be ten to fifteen meters from the engine. Additional shielding such as a water tank or high density fuel can somewhat reduce this amount. This rocket has impressive stats for its size (Nozzle Ae=100 Chamber Temp=3000 Ideal ISP=991 Reactor Power=1054MW(th) TWR=13.94 Chamber Pressure=6800kPa Ignitions =5 Tonnage including integral shadow shield:1.504tons ) The nozzle is a fixed ablatively cooled filament wound carbon-carbon design.
zh: “SNTP-PFE”系列是一台1000MW反应堆。该反应堆采用颗粒床设计，将涂覆碳化物的铀颗粒嵌入石墨棒中，氢气流经其中吸收热量，功率密度高达40MW/L。其堆芯具备五次启动能力。配有一体化钨-硼-氢化锂复合辐射屏蔽层，整体总成采用再生冷却。辅助回路可引导关机气体流经一台小型热机，以最大限度减少燃料损失并提供基础交流电。该发动机应安装在距最近燃料储罐3至6米处。燃料可用作乘员屏蔽层，发动机运转时乘员位置应距其10至15米。水箱或高密度燃料等附加屏蔽措施可在一定程度上缩短该距离。该火箭在同尺寸下拥有惊人的性能参数（喷管膨胀比Ae=100，燃烧室温度=3000，理想比冲=991，反应堆功率=1054MW(th)，TWR=13.94，燃烧室压力=6800kPa，点火次数=5次，含一体化阴影屏蔽层自重：1.504吨）。喷管为固定式烧蚀冷却缠绕碳-碳复合材料结构。

s: Derived from the Sprite, the Spectre was a rocket motor designed for the SR.53 interceptor, and to replace the Sprite for higher-performance JATO applications. It was tested extensively, both on the SR.53 prototypes and on the Vickers Valiant and Hadley-Page Victor, but improved jet engine performance and cancellation of the SR.53 and the SR.177 follow-on project resulted in the cancellation of the Spectre.
zh: “鬼怪”（Spectre）由“子弹”（Sprite）衍生而来，是专为SR.53截击机设计的火箭发动机，也用作替代“子弹”的高性能起飞助推器（JATO）。它在SR.53原型机以及维克斯“勇士”和汉德利·佩奇“胜利者”轰炸机上进行了广泛测试，但喷气发动机性能的提升以及SR.53和后续SR.177项目的取消导致“鬼怪”最终下马。

s: A small monopropellant rocket motor, intended for JATO use to improve the takeoff performance of various aircraft. Developed directly from german JATO boosters captured during WW2, the Sprite incorporated improvements such as silver gauze catalyst beds, but was still a low-performance motor. The Super Sprite added a kerosene "afterburner" that injected small amounts of kerosene into the combustion chamber to increase performance.
zh: 一款小型单组元推进剂火箭发动机，用作喷气辅助起飞助推器（JATO）以提升各类飞机的起飞性能。“子弹”直接脱胎于二战中缴获的德国JATO助推器，引入了银丝网催化剂床等改进，但性能依然偏低。超级子弹（Super Sprite）增加了一个煤油“加力燃烧室”，向燃烧室中喷入少量煤油以提高性能。

s: The Titan IVB Solid Rocket Motor Upgrade (also known as the Upgraded Solid Rocket Motor or USRM), was developed with the goal of 25% more capacity than the Titan IVA with the UA1207 SRM. It achieved this through a more energetic propellant and a 3-segment composite case that carried more fuel and weighed less than the UA1207's 7-segment steel case. Burn time 150 seconds.
zh: 大力神IVB固体火箭发动机升级版（也称改进型固体火箭发动机，即USRM），研制目标是比采用<<M0>> SRM的大力神IVA提升25%的运载能力。通过采用能量更高的推进剂和三段式复合材料壳体实现了这一目标，相比<<M0>>的七段式钢制壳体装药更多且重量更轻。工作时间150秒。

s: Developed from the RS-25 SSME, the Space Shuttle Booster Engine (SSBE) was a concept for a kerolox fueled Space Shuttle booster. The engine used three fuel-rich preburners, burning a mixture of LH2 and RP-1 to minimize coking. The LH2 was also used to cool the combustion chamber, allowing unmodified SSME components to be used.
zh: 航天飞机助推器发动机（SSBE）由<<M0>> SSME衍生而来，是一种使用液氧煤油推进剂的航天飞机助推器构想。该发动机使用三个富燃预燃室，燃烧液氢和<<M1>>的混合物以最大限度减少结焦。液氢还用于冷却燃烧室，从而可以直接沿用未经修改的SSME部件。

s: The RS-25, also known as the Space Shuttle Main Engine (SSME), is a LH2/LOX fuel-rich staged combustion engine. Though complex and expensive, these engines provide very high performance and are extremely reliable. Three of these engines powered each Shuttle Orbiter and four power the core stage of the SLS.
zh: <<M0>>，又称航天飞机主发动机（SSME），是一款液氢/液氧富燃分级燃烧发动机。尽管结构复杂且造价高昂，这些发动机提供了极高的性能和极佳的可靠性。每架航天飞机轨道器配备三台，SLS核心级配备四台。

s: The whole family of Merlin 1 rocket engines, made by SpaceX.
zh: 由 <<M0>> 制造的整个 Merlin 1 火箭发动机系列。

s: Aerojet MR-510 series arcjet engines are currently used on Lockheed Martin A2100 satellites using hydrazine as a propellant.
zh: Aerojet <<M0>> 系列电弧喷气发动机目前用于 Lockheed Martin <<M1>> 卫星，使用肼作为推进剂。

s: A 1970s low-TWR vacuum engine, the NERVA (Nuclear Engine for Rocket Vehicle Applications) is designed for orbital tugs and large rocket upper stages.
zh: 一款 20 世纪 70 年代的低 TWR 真空发动机，NERVA（火箭飞行器应用核能）专为轨道拖船和大型火箭上面级设计。

s: A later 1970s atomic engine with relatively low TWR but high ISP and a power generation of 4200 MW. Derived from the Phoebus 2A ground demonstrator, tested in 1968.
zh: 一款 20 世纪 70 年代后期的核动力发动机，TWR 相对较低但比冲很高，功率达到 4200 MW。源自 1968 年测试的 Phoebus 2A 地面演示样机。

s: A first stage solid rocket motor used on many sounding rockets including Nike-Deacon, Nike-Cajun, Nike-Apache, Nike-Aerobee170, Nike-Aerobee350, and more.
zh: 一种第一级固体火箭发动机，用于包括 Nike-Deacon、Nike-Cajun、Nike-Apache、Nike-<<M0>>、Nike-<<M1>> 等众多探空火箭。

s: A staged combustion kerolox booster engine designed by Kuznetsov for the Korolev GR-1 project. It was the basis for the NK-15 used on the N1, and the NK-33 used today.
zh: 由 Kuznetsov 为 Korolev <<M0>> 项目设计的分级燃烧煤油/液氧助推器发动机。它是用于 N1 的 <<M1>> 以及如今使用的 <<M2>> 的基础。

s: A staged combustion kerolox upper/vacuum engine designed by Kuznetsov for the Korolev GR-1 project. It was reused (as NK-19) on the N1 and upgraded for the N1F with restart capability as NK-31.
zh: 由 Kuznetsov 为 Korolev <<M0>> 项目设计的分级燃烧煤油/液氧上面级/真空发动机。它在 N1 上被重新使用（作为 <<M1>>），并升级为具备二次启动能力的 <<M2>> 用于 N1F。

s: Originally designed and built for the N1F, the NK-43 is a derivative of the NK-33 with a longer bell and restart capability for use on upper stages.
zh: <<M0>> 最初为 N1F 设计并制造，是 <<M1>> 的衍生型号，具有更长的喷管延伸段和二次启动能力，用于上面级。

s: The first large gridded ion thruster, the NASA Solar Technology Application Readiness (NSTAR) was used on the Deep Space 1 and Dawn spacecraft to allow for extended operations in the asteroid belt.
zh: 首款大型栅极离子推力器，NASA 太阳能技术应用就绪计划（NSTAR）曾用于 Deep Space 1 和 Dawn 探测器，以支持在小行星带进行长期运营。

s: NuPIT Pulsed Inductive Thruster
zh: <<M0>> 脉冲感应推力器

s: NYRATH Open Cycle Gas Core Atomic Rocket Motor
zh: NYRATH 开式循环气芯核火箭发动机

s: PIT Mk Va Pulsed Inductive Thruster
zh: PIT Mk Va 脉冲感应推力器

s: A Hall-effect ion thruster used on many commercial spacecraft for station keeping.
zh: 一种霍尔效应离子推力器，广泛用于许多商用航天器的轨道保持。

s: A pressure-fed vacuum hypergolic engine used for attitude control on the Space Shuttle.
zh: 一种挤压循环自燃推进剂真空发动机，用于航天飞机的姿态控制。

s: A pressure-fed hypergolic rocket engine, burning either MMH and NTO (R-42) or hydrazine and NTO (R-42DM). Used as an apogee kick motor for geostationary satellites.
zh: 一种挤压循环自燃推进剂火箭发动机，燃烧 MMH 与 NTO（<<M0>>）或肼与 NTO（<<M1>>）。用作地球同步卫星的远地点变轨发动机。

s: The RD-8 is a four-chamber, staged combustion, vacuum kerolox vernier engine. It is used on the second stage of the Zenit launch vehicle family for two-axis attitude control.
zh: <<M0>> 是一款四室分级燃烧真空煤油/液氧游标发动机。它用于 Zenit 系列运载火箭的第二级，提供双轴姿态控制。

s: An upper stage kerolox engine designed for the R-9 ICBM and later used on the Molniya, Voskhod. and Soyuz launchers.
zh: 为 <<M0>> 洲际弹道导弹设计的上面级煤油/液氧发动机，后来用于 Molniya、Voskhod 和 Soyuz 运载火箭。

s: The RD-0110R is a four-chamber, gas generator, surface kerolox vernier engine. It is used on the first stage of the Soyuz-2-1V launch vehicle family for two-axis attitude control.
zh: <<M0>> 是一款四室燃气发生器循环海平面煤油/液氧游标发动机。它用于 Soyuz-2-1V 系列运载火箭的第一级，提供双轴姿态控制。

s: The vernier engine for the RD-0110 power plant. Four of them are used on the Block I upper stage of the Soyuz U and FG launch vehicle variants for attitude control.
zh: 用于 <<M0>> 动力装置的游标发动机。其中四台用于 Soyuz U 和 FG 运载火箭改型的 Block I 上面级，以实现姿态控制。

s: A 1980s medium TWR engine for atmospheric and vacuum use. The RD-0120 is a fuel-rich staged combustion engine developed to power the core stage of the Energia launcher.
zh: 一款 20 世纪 80 年代中等 TWR 的发动机，兼顾大气与真空环境。<<M0>> 是一款富燃分级燃烧发动机，专为 Energia 运载火箭的核心级提供动力而开发。

s: The RD-120 is a staged combustion vacuum kerolox engine used as the main power plant on the Zenit launch vehicle family second stage.
zh: <<M0>> 是一款分级燃烧真空煤油/液氧发动机，用作 Zenit 系列运载火箭第二级的主动力装置。

s: An upper stage Kerosene/LOX engine designed for new versions of the Soyuz-2 launchers. It will also be used with the Angara family of launchers.
zh: 一款为新版 Soyuz-2 运载火箭设计的煤油/液氧上面级发动机。它也将用于 Angara 系列运载火箭。

s: The RD-180 is a two-chamber derivative of the four-chamber RD-170/171 and it powers the first stage of the Atlas V.
zh: <<M0>> 是四室 <<M1>>/171 的双室衍生型号，为 Atlas V 的第一级提供动力。

s: A staged combustion hypergolic vacuum rocket engine used as a power plant on the second stage of the Proton launch vehicle family. Features a one-axis gimbal mechanism for attitude control.
zh: 一款分级燃烧自燃推进剂真空火箭发动机，用作 Proton 系列运载火箭第二级的动力装置。配备单轴万向节机构以实现姿态控制。

s: A gas generator vernier engine cluster found on the second stage of the UR-200 and third stage of the UR-500/Proton series launcher.
zh: 用于 <<M0>> 第二级以及 <<M1>>/Proton 系列运载火箭第三级的燃气发生器循环游标发动机组。

s: A Soviet pressure-fed vacuum engine. A pair of RD-0225s were used as maneuvering engines on the Almaz space stations.
zh: 一款苏联挤压循环真空发动机。一对 <<M0>> 曾用作 Almaz 空间站的机动发动机。

s: A gas-generator upper stage vernier engine developed for the UR-100N second stage, designed to be used alongside the RD-0235. This represents 1/4th of an RD-0236.
zh: 为 <<M0>> 第二级开发的燃气发生器循环上面级游标发动机，设计与 <<M1>> 配合使用。该部件代表 1/4 个 <<M2>>。

s: The RD-0242M2 is a deeply-throttleable derivative of the RD-0242M1 upper stage engine engine. Modified to use monomethyl hydrazine (MMH) instead of unsymmetrical dimethylhydrazine (UDMH).
zh: <<M0>> 是 <<M1>> 上面级发动机的大范围深度变节流衍生型号。经过改装，使用一甲基肼（MMH）替代偏二甲肼（UDMH）。

s: A staged combustion hypergolic booster engine designed to replace the RD-250 engines used on the R-36. It was also used for the MR-UR-100.
zh: 一款分级燃烧自燃推进剂助推器发动机，旨在替代 <<M1>> 上使用的 <<M0>> 发动机。它也用于 MR-<<M2>>。

s: RD-600 Open Cycle Gas Core Atomic Rocket Motor
zh: <<M0>> 开式循环气芯核火箭发动机

s: A pump-fed hypergolic vernier thruster used on the first stage of the R-16, R-36, and Tsyklon rockets.
zh: 一款泵压供压自燃推进剂游标推力器，用于 <<M0>>、<<M1>> 和 Tsyklon 火箭的第一级。

s: A pump-fed hypergolic vernier thruster used on the second stage of the R-16 and R-36 ICBM, and the Tsyklon (Cyclone) launch vehicle series for attitude control.
zh: 一款泵压供压自燃推进剂游标推力器，用于 <<M0>> 和 <<M1>> 洲际弹道导弹的第二级，以及 Tsyklon（旋风）系列运载火箭以实现姿态控制。

s: A gas generator hypergolic engine for the LK lander. It serves as the main engine of the LK lander, used for final descent to the moon, and takeoff to lunar orbit.
zh: 一款用于 LK 登月舱的燃气发生器循环自燃推进剂发动机。作为 LK 登月舱的主发动机，用于月表最终着陆和起飞至月球轨道。

s: A gas generator hypergolic engine for the LK lander. It serves as the backup engine of the LK lander. It has limited throttling capability, and is only to be used for takeoff or abort.
zh: 一款用于 LK 登月舱的燃气发生器循环自燃推进剂发动机。作为 LK 登月舱的备用发动机。它的节流能力有限，仅用于起飞或中止任务。

s: A French solid rocket engine developed for the MSBS M1 ballistic missile, and later used as the second stage of the Diamant BP.4 launch vehicle, replacing the Topaze.
zh: 一款为 MSBS M1 弹道导弹开发的法国固体火箭发动机，后来替代 Topaze 用作 Diamant BP.4 运载火箭的第二级。

s: A reusable fuel-rich staged combustion vacuum engine. Developed in the early 1970s to test technologies for the RS-25 SSME.
zh: 一款可重复使用的富燃分级燃烧真空发动机。开发于 20 世纪 70 年代初，旨在为 <<M0>> SSME 测试相关技术。

s: A low-bypass augmented turbofan used by the MiG-31 and Su-47. 152kN wet, 93.2kN dry. OPR 21.2, SFC 0.72/1.86 lb/lbf-hr static. Temperature limit Mach 2.9.
zh: 一种低涵道比加力涡扇发动机，用于 <<M0>> 和 <<M1>>。加力推力 152 kN，无加力推力 93.2 kN。总压比 21.2，静态比油耗 0.72/1.86 lb/lbf-hr。温度限制 2.9 马赫。

s: Rocketdyne's LH2/LOX full flow staged combustion engine proposal for next generation reusable launch vehicle boosters.
zh: Rocketdyne 为下一代可重复使用运载火箭助推器提出的液氢/液氧全流量分级燃烧发动机方案。

s: Sapphire ASSa.7 Mk.203 Turbojet
zh: 蓝宝石 ASSa.7 Mk.203 涡轮喷气发动机

s: A small French solid rocket motor used as the second stage of the Rubis sounding rocket and third stage on the Diamant A launch vehicle.
zh: 一种小型法国固体火箭发动机，曾用作 Rubis 探空火箭的第二级和 Diamant A 运载火箭的第三级。

s: A small solid fueled booster taken from the AIM-7 Sparrow missile. It was used as the third stage on the Aerobee 300 and 300A sounding rockets.
zh: 一种小型固体燃料助推器，源自 <<M0>> 麻雀导弹。曾用作 Aerobee 300 和 300A 探空火箭的第三级。

s: A small maneuvering engine used on the Soviet 1MV and 2MV spacecraft busses and KAUR-2 comsat bus. Used on early Venera, Mars, Zond, and Molniya satellites.
zh: 一种小型机动发动机，曾用于苏联 1MV 与 2MV 航天器平台以及 <<M0>> 通信卫星平台。曾用于早期的 Venera、Mars、Zond 和 Molniya 卫星。

s: A small but powerful solid fueled booster used as the first stage for the Aerobee line of sounding rockets.
zh: 一种小巧但威力强大的固体燃料助推器，用作 Aerobee 系列探空火箭的第一级。

s: A small gas-generator vacuum engine, developed as an upper stage for the R-14 to create the Kosmos-3 launch vehicle. Also known as the 11D49 or DU-49.
zh: 一款小型燃气发生器循环真空发动机，作为 <<M0>> 的上面级而研制，从而构成了 Kosmos-3 运载火箭。亦称 11D49 或 <<M1>>。

s: A small pressure-fed sustainer for the WAC Corporal and Aerobee sounding rockets. Used after a small solid booster.
zh: 一种用于下士（WAC Corporal）和 Aerobee 探空火箭的小型挤压循环主发动机。在小型固体助推器分离后使用。

s: Agena-D Secondary Propulsion System
zh: 阿金纳-D 辅助推进系统

s: AJ10-137 (Service Propulsion System)
The Aerojet AJ10-137 was used as the Service Propulsion System on the Apollo CSM. It was designed to operate for up to 750 seconds and could restart 50 times.
zh: Aerojet 的 <<M0>>-137 发动机曾用作阿波罗指令/服务舱的服务推进系统。其设计最长工作时间达 750 秒，并可重启 50 次。

s: A low thrust pressure-fed hypergolic engine used on the Space Shuttle for orbital insertion, maneuvering, and deorbiting. Currently used by the Orion MPCV.
zh: 一种低推力挤压循环自燃推进剂发动机，航天飞机曾用其进行入轨、机动和脱轨。目前用于猎户座 MPCV。

s: The AJ-60A is an SRB produced by Aerojet Rocketdyne. They are currently used as strap-on boosters on United Launch Alliance's Atlas V rocket.
zh: <<M0>> 是由 Aerojet Rocketdyne 生产的固体火箭助推器。目前作为捆绑助推器用于联合发射联盟的宇宙神 5 号运载火箭。

s: AJ-260 FL Radial Solid Rocket Booster
zh: <<M0>> FL 径向固体火箭助推器

s: AJ-260 SL Radial Solid Rocket Booster
zh: <<M0>> SL 径向固体火箭助推器

s: A small solid kick motor developed as a braking motor for the Ranger Block II rough lander. Repeated failures of the Ranger spacecraft meant the rough lander was never able to be deployed.
zh: 一种小型固体变轨发动机，专为徘徊者 Block II 硬着陆探测器设计用作制动发动机。由于徘徊者航天器屡次发射失败，硬着陆器从未真正得以部署。

s: A first stage solid rocket motor used on the early X-1 and X-2 Scout launch vehicles.
zh: 一种第一级固体火箭发动机，用于早期 <<M0>> 和 <<M1>> 侦察兵运载火箭。

s: A first stage solid rocket motor developed from Algol I and used on the Scout launch vehicles.
zh: 一种由大陵五 1 型（Algol I）发展而来的第一级固体火箭发动机，用于侦察兵运载火箭。

s: The final development version of the first stage solid rocket motor used on the Scout launch vehicles.
zh: 用于侦察兵运载火箭的第一级固体火箭发动机的最终改进型号。

s: A small solid kick motor. Developed from the Altair, this successor was used on Scout and Delta to circularize at apogee or perform a final payload kick. Average thrust 28.48 kN, burn time 22 seconds.
zh: 一种小型固体变轨发动机。源自牵牛星（Altair），该后续型号用于侦察兵和德尔塔火箭，在远地点完成圆化轨道或执行最终有效载荷变轨。平均推力 28.48 kN，工作时间 22 秒。

s: The Antares solid rocket motor was used as the third stage for the Scout launch vehicle.
zh: 心宿二（Antares）固体火箭发动机曾用作侦察兵运载火箭的第三级。

s: The Antares II solid rocket motor was used as the third stage for the majority of the Scout launch vehicle launches.
zh: 心宿二 2 型（Antares II）固体火箭发动机曾用作绝大多数侦察兵运载火箭的第三级。

s: A German pressure-fed vacuum engine burning Aerozine50 and NTO. It was used on the stage of the same name on the Europa I and II launch vehicles.
zh: 一种德国制造的挤压循环真空发动机，燃烧 <<M0>> 和四氧化二氮（NTO）。曾用于欧罗巴 1 号和 2 号运载火箭的同名级段。

s: A small hypergolic engine developed for the Apollo program and Voyager Mars. Ultimately never used in space, as the R-4D was chosen for the Apollo program and Voyager Mars was cancelled.
zh: 一种为阿波罗计划和旅行者火星计划开发的小型自燃推进剂发动机。由于阿波罗计划最终选用了 <<M0>> 且旅行者火星计划被取消，该发动机从未在太空中使用。

s: A second stage solid rocket motor used on the Nike-Cajun sounding rocket.
zh: 一种第二级固体火箭发动机，用于耐克-卡津（Nike-Cajun）探空火箭。

s: The Castor 1 was first used for a suborbital launch of a Scout X-1 rocket in 1960. Castor 1 stages were also used as strap-on boosters for vehicles with Thor first stages, including the Delta-D.
zh: 卡斯托 1 型（Castor 1）于 1960 年首次用于侦察兵 <<M0>> 火箭的亚轨道发射。卡斯托 1 型级段也曾作为捆绑助推器用于以雷神为第一级的运载火箭，包括德尔塔-D。

s: A strap-on booster, improved from the Castor 4A and first tested May 1992. Its 30% performance increase would improve capacity of Atlas IIAS, H-II, and other vehicles. First flight 2001.
zh: 一种捆绑助推器，由卡斯托 4A 改进而来，于 1992 年 5 月首次测试。其 30% 的性能提升改善了宇宙神 IIAS、H-II 及其他运载火箭的运载能力。2001 年首飞。

s: A steel casing solid rocket motor used in pairs by the Ariane 5 launch vehicle for the initial phases of the flight.
zh: 一种钢制壳体固体火箭发动机，在阿里安 5 号运载火箭的初始飞行阶段成对使用。

s: The massive Rocketdyne F-1 engine. One of the largest, most powerful rocket engines ever built. Ensure you enable roll capability or disable gimbal as required for your application.
zh: 巨大的 Rocketdyne <<M0>> 发动机。有史以来制造的最大、推力最强的火箭发动机之一。请根据应用需求务必开启滚转控制功能或禁用万向节。

s: FARAD Pulsed Inductive Thruster
zh: FARAD 脉冲感应推力器

s: Developed from Altair-III (FW-4S), the FW-5 was a small apogee kick motor used for most Hughes HS-333 satellite busses, including Anik, Westar and Marisat.
zh: <<M1>> 由牵牛星-III（<<M0>>）发展而来，是一种小型远地点变轨发动机，用于休斯公司的大多数 <<M2>> 卫星平台，包括 Anik、Westar 和 Marisat。

s: A small solid kick motor, used as the third stage on all but the last Vanguard launch. Burn time 33 seconds.
zh: 一种小型固体变轨发动机，除最后一次先锋号发射外均用作第三级。工作时间 33 秒。

s: HERMeS (Hall Effect Rocket with Magnetic Shielding) is a an experimental Hall effect ion thruster. It was later developed into AEPS, the planned propulsion system for the Lunar Gateway.
zh: <<M0>>（带磁屏蔽的霍尔效应火箭）是一种实验性霍尔效应离子推力器。后来发展为 AEPS，即月球门户空间站的计划推进系统。

s: The Rocketdyne HG-3 engine, which served as a stepping stone between the J-2 and RS-25. Ensure you enable roll capability or disable gimbal as required for your application.
zh: Rocketdyne <<M0>> 发动机，曾作为 <<M1>> 和 <<M2>> 之间的过渡台阶。请根据应用需求务必开启滚转控制功能或禁用万向节。

s: A hydrolox gas generator upper stage engine, directly descended from the HM4 testbed engine and used on the upper stages of the Ariane launch vehicle family.
zh: 一种氢氧燃气发生器循环上面级发动机，直接源自 HM4 测试发动机，用于阿里安系列运载火箭的上面级。

s: A gridded ion thruster developed for the Transport and Energy Module, Russia's planned nuclear-electric tug.
zh: 一种为运输与能源模块（TEM，俄罗斯计划研制的核电拖船）开发的栅极离子推力器。

s: The Rocketdyne J-2 rocket engine was the first large hydrolox engine. Five powered the S-II stage on the Saturn V and one was used on the S-IVB stage of the Saturn IB and V.
zh: Rocketdyne <<M0>> 火箭发动机是第一种大型氢氧发动机。五台为土星 5 号的 S-II 级提供动力，一台用于土星 1B 和土星 5 号的 S-IVB 级。

s: A aerospike engine using proven technology from the J-2 and introducing an aerospike nozzle to the developing J-2S machinery.
zh: 一种气动塞式发动机，利用来自 <<M0>> 的成熟技术，并将气动塞式喷管引入正在研发的 <<M1>> 机械结构中。

s: A pressure-fed kerosene/LOX engine used in the second stage of the Falcon 1 launcher.
zh: 一种挤压循环煤油/液氧发动机，用于猎鹰 1 号运载火箭的第二级。

s: A methalox derivative of the original pressure-fed Kestrel engine used on the upper stage of the Falcon 1 launch vehicle. Features multi-ignition capability and a limited throttling range.
zh: 猎鹰 1 号运载火箭上面级最初挤压循环茶隼发动机的甲烷/液氧衍生型号。具有多次点火能力和有限的节流范围。

s: A Soviet gas generator hypergolic vacuum engine designed for the return stage of the E-8-5 lunar sample return probes. With only one ignition, a very precise trajectory is required.
zh: 一种苏联研制的燃气发生器循环自燃推进剂真空发动机，专为 <<M0>> 月球采样返回探测器的返回级设计。由于只能点火一次，需要极其精确的飞行弹道。

s: A Soviet pressure-fed hypergolic vacuum engine designed for Salyut-6 and Saylut-7. Also used on Mir and Zvezda.
zh: 一种苏联研制的挤压循环自燃推进剂真空发动机，专为礼炮 6 号和礼炮 7 号设计。亦用于和平号和星辰号核心舱。

s: The vernier and landing engine for the LK-700S. Three were to be used as verniers on the TLI and Lunar injection stages, while another three would enable a controlled final descent for the LK-700S.
zh: 用于 <<M0>> 的游标与着陆发动机。其中三台拟在地月转移和月球捕获阶段用作游标发动机，另有三台用于实现 <<M0>> 的受控最终下降。

s: A Soviet gas generator hypergolic vacuum engine. Designed for use in the propulsion systems of the Mars and Venera 3MV, 4MV and 5MV spacecraft buses.
zh: 一种苏联研制的燃气发生器循环自燃推进剂真空发动机。设计用于火星和金星 3MV、4MV 及 5MV 航天器平台的推进系统。

s: A small pressure-fed hypergolic engine. Developed with the assistance of Rocketdyne to power the upper stage of the N-I rocket.
zh: 一种小型挤压循环自燃推进剂发动机。在 Rocketdyne 的协助下开发，用于为 N-I 火箭的上面级提供动力。

s: Light-Bulb Closed Cycle Gas Core Atomic Rocket Motor
zh: “灯泡”闭合循环气冷核裂变核火箭发动机

s: Lunar Module Ascent Engine (LMAE)
zh: 登月舱上升级发动机（LMAE）

s: A pressure-fed engine used for the ascent module of the Apollo lunar lander.
zh: 一种挤压循环发动机，用于阿波罗登月舱的上升级。

s: Lunar Module Descent Engine (LMDE)
zh: 登月舱下降级发动机（LMDE）

s: A LOX/Kerosene gas generator engine designed for booster applications. Three gimbaled engines would have been used in the Navaho booster.
zh: 一种专为助推级设计的液氧/煤油燃气发生器循环发动机。纳瓦霍（Navaho）助推器曾计划使用三台带万向节的该型发动机。

s: The LR91 powered the second stage of Titan launchers. Exhaust from the gas generator provided roll control.
zh: <<M0>> 为大力神运载火箭的第二级提供动力。燃气发生器的排气用于提供滚转控制。

s: The first stage of the Minuteman ICBM, used in various proposed NASA launch vehicles as a solid booster. Burn time 75 seconds.
zh: 民兵洲际弹道导弹的第一级，在 NASA 提出的多种运载火箭方案中用作固体助推器。工作时间 75 秒。

s: A gas generator cycle hypergolic vacuum engine used on the Fregat upper stage series.
zh: 一种燃气发生器循环自燃推进剂真空发动机，用于“巡航”（Fregat）系列上面级。

s: A staged combustion cycle hypergolic vacuum engine used on the Briz upper stage series.
zh: 一种分级燃烧循环自燃推进剂真空发动机，用于“微风”（Briz）系列上面级。

s: The ullage motor of the Saturn V S-II stage. Attaches to the upper part of the S-II interstage in sets of 4 to 8.
zh: 土星5号S-II级的沉底发动机。以4到8台为一组安装在S-II级间段的上部。

s: Ullage motor for the S-IV and S-IVB. Can be jettisoned after use to save weight.
zh: 用于S-IV和S-IVB的沉底发动机。使用后可抛弃以减轻重量。

s: Los Alamos "Small Engine" Atomic Rocket Motor
zh: 洛斯阿拉莫斯“小型发动机”原子火箭发动机

s: The Los Alamos "Small Engine" was a compact nuclear thermal rocket derived from the PEWEE core. Designed to be used as a Space Shuttle upper stage, it has a unique folding nozzle to reduce length.
zh: 洛斯阿拉莫斯“小型发动机”是一种源自PEWEE堆芯的小型核热火箭。设计用作航天飞机上面级，拥有独特的折叠喷管以缩短长度。

s: SNTP-PFE100 Atomic Rocket Motor
zh: SNTP-<<M0>> 原子火箭发动机

s: An early Soviet Hall Effect thruster, used on Soviet and Russian weather satellites.
zh: 苏联早期的霍尔效应推力器，用于苏联和俄罗斯的气象卫星。

s: The first ever operational ion thruster, the SPT-60 Hall Effect thruster was first used in 1971 on Soviet Meteor weather satellites.
zh: 有史以来第一款实用化离子推力器，<<M0>>霍尔效应推力器于1971年首次应用于苏联“流星”气象卫星。

s: A Hall effect ion thruster used on many commercial spacecraft for station keeping.
zh: 一种霍尔效应离子推力器，广泛用于各类商业航天器的空间站轨道保持。

s: The SPT-140 is an enlarged SPT-100 created to power large, modern communications satellites.
zh: <<M0>>是<<M1>>的放大版，旨在为现代大型通信卫星提供动力。

s: The SR19 is an improved Minuteman second stage developed for the LGM-30F Minuteman II.
zh: <<M0>>是为<<M1>>民兵II型改进的民兵二级发动机。

s: A mid-sized apogee kick motor used on ATS-1/2/3.
zh: 一种用于<<M0>>/2/3的中型远地点变轨发动机。

s: The SR73 is an improved Minuteman third stage developed for the LGM-30F Minuteman II.
zh: <<M0>>是为<<M1>>民兵II型改进的民兵三级发动机。

s: The Star 12A is a stretched Star 12 with improved propellant, for later, heavier satellites in the Keyhole series.
zh: Star 12A是Star 12的加长版，采用了改进型推进剂，用于“锁眼”系列中后期更重的卫星。

s: The Star 13A was developed in the mid-1960s as an apogee motor for Thor-Burner II.
zh: Star 13A开发于20世纪60年代中期，作为“雷神-燃烧室II”（Thor-Burner II）的远地点发动机。

s: A small apogee kick motor used for geosynchronous satellites. It was used on the first geosynchronous satellite, Syncom 1.
zh: 一种用于地球同步卫星的小型远地点变轨发动机。曾用于首颗地球同步卫星辛康1号（Syncom 1）。

s: A single STAR 15G motor, used in a variety of applications. This has a straight nozzle.
zh: 单台STAR 15G发动机，用途广泛。采用直喷管设计。

s: A small apogee kick motor for satellites, introduced in 1968 on Delta 57. Max thrust 12.34kN, burn time 18 seconds.
zh: 一种用于卫星的小型远地点变轨发动机，于1968年随德尔塔57首次亮相。最大推力12.34 kN，工作时间18秒。

s: An apogee kick motor developed by Morton Thiokol. Used by various small commsat busses.
zh: 由莫顿·塞奥科公司研制的远地点变轨发动机。用于多种小型通信卫星平台。

s: The STAR 37 is a vacuum solid rocket motor originally developed as a braking stage for the Surveyor lunar lander program. Later variants were used exclusively as apogee kick stages.
zh: STAR 37是一款真空固体火箭发动机，最初作为“勘测者”月球着陆器计划的制动级研制。后期的衍生型号完全用作远地点变轨级。

s: Developed for SpaceX Starlink satellites, this small but powerful hall effect thruster offers good thrust and moderate specific impulse. Uniquely, it was modified to run on Argon to reduce fuel costs.
zh: 为<<M0>>星链卫星研制的小型但高功率霍尔效应推力器，具有出色的推力和中等的比冲。特别的是，它被改造为使用氩气以降低燃料成本。

s: The Space Transportation Booster Engine (STBE) was a late 1980s to early 1990s booster engine design using JP-4 and liquid oxygen as its propellants.
zh: 航天运输助推器发动机（STBE）是20世纪80年代末至90年代初的一款助推器发动机设计，使用<<M0>>和液氧作为推进剂。

s: The Space Transportation Booster Engine (STBE) was a 1990s proposal for a highly reliable low cost booster engine for both expendable and reusable launch vehicles.
zh: 航天运输助推器发动机（STBE）是20世纪90年代提出的一款用于一次性及可重复使用运载火箭的高可靠性、低成本助推器发动机方案。

s: Space Transportation Main Engine (STME)
zh: 航天运输主发动机（STME）

s: A powerful hypergolic engine used in the launch abort system of the Dragon 2 capsule. Other potential applications include hypersonic deceleration and landing for crew and cargo modules.
zh: 一种强大的自燃推进剂发动机，用于龙飞船2号舱段的发射中止系统。其他潜在应用包括乘员舱和货物舱的高超声速减速与着陆。

s: A small apogee kick motor used for the Intelsat II series of geostationary satellites.
zh: 一种用于国际通信卫星II系列地球静止卫星的小型远地点变轨发动机。

s: A small apogee kick motor used for the Intelsat III series of geostationary satellites.
zh: 一种用于国际通信卫星III系列地球静止卫星的小型远地点变轨发动机。

s: A medium apogee kick motor used for the Intelsat IV and IVA series of geostationary satellites, as well as some early Comstar satellites.
zh: 一种用于国际通信卫星IV和IVA系列地球静止卫星以及早期康斯达卫星的中型远地点变轨发动机。

s: A small apogee kick motor used for early SMS and GOES geostationary weather satellites.
zh: 一种用于早期SMS和GOES地球静止气象卫星的小型远地点变轨发动机。

s: A 100 kW Applied-Field MPD thruster in development at the University of Stuttgart Institute of Space Systems. It set a thruster efficiency record of 61.99% in 2019.
zh: 由斯图加特大学空间系统研究所研制的100 kW外加磁场MPD推力器。它在2019年创下了61.99%的推力器效率纪录。

s: The Mercury retro motor, intended to deorbit the capsule. Place 3 on the Mercury Retropack. These were fired in sequence at five second intervals.
zh: 水星号减速发动机，用于让飞船返回舱脱轨。在水星号减速包上安装3台。它们以5秒间隔依次点火。

s: An early French solid rocket engine used for the first stage of the Topaze sounding rocket and second stage of the Diamant A and B launch vehicles.
zh: 法国早期的固体火箭发动机，用作“黄玉”（Topaze）探空火箭的第一级，以及“钻石”（Diamant）A型和B型运载火箭的第二级。

s: 4 segment strap-on booster for proposed Saturn IB derivatives. Burn time 115s.
zh: 用于土星IB衍生方案的4分段捆绑助推器。工作时间115秒。

s: 5 Segment strap-on booster for Titan IIIC, IIID, IIIE, proposed for Saturn IB derivatives. Burn time 115s.
zh: 用于泰坦IIIC、IIID、IIIE以及拟议中土星IB衍生方案的5分段捆绑助推器。工作时间115秒。

s: 5.5 segment strap-on booster for Titan 34D and Commercial Titan III. Burn time 115s.
zh: 用于泰坦34D和专注效益泰坦III的5.5分段捆绑助推器。工作时间115秒。

s: Speculative 8 segment version of the UA107. Burn time 115s.
zh: <<M0>>的推想型8分段版本。工作时间115秒。

s: A Wasserfall derivative engine developed by German and French engineers after WW2 for the sounding rocket of the same name. It was the first French high altitude sounding rocket.
zh: 二战后由德法工程师基于“瀑布”防空导弹发动机研制的衍生型号，用于同名的探空火箭。这是法国第一枚高空探空火箭。

s: Vulcain is a gas-generator sustainer engine that was previously used on Ariane 5 and is now used on Ariane 6.
zh: 火神（Vulcain）发动机是一种燃气发生器循环持续机，曾用于阿丽亚娜5号，现用于阿丽亚娜6号。

s: The first proper VASIMR engine built by Ad Astra, the VX-200SS (Steady State) is built for long-term operation at a wide range of ISP and thrust, with multiple propellant options.
zh: 由星务公司制造的第一款真正的VASIMR发动机，<<M0>>（稳态型）专为宽比冲和推力范围内的长期运行而打造，支持多种推进剂方案。

s: The Waxwing was a small solid kick motor for circularizing payloads in orbit, used as a third stage on the Black Arrow launch vehicle in 1970-71. 29.4kN average thrust.
zh: “太平鸟”（Waxwing）是一种用于载荷轨道圆化的小型固体变轨发动机，在1970至1971年间用作“黑箭”运载火箭的第三级。平均推力29.4 kN。

s: A very early kerolox gas generator booster engine used on the Vanguard launch vehicle.
zh: 一种极早期的液氧煤油燃气发生器助推器发动机，用于“先锋”运载火箭。

s: A small rocket motor intended to be used on the XF8U-3 for increased performance. Cancelled after the prototype exploded during testing and the XF8U-3 was cancelled in favor of the F4H.
zh: 一种旨在用于<<M0>>-3以提升性能的小型火箭发动机。在原型机测试爆炸且<<M0>>-3项目因F4H方案获选而被取消后终止研制。

s: Americanized version of the V-2 Model 39 (A-4). It was very similar to its predecessor, but was built using American SAE components rather than metric components, and featured several minor upgrades.
zh: <<M0>> Model 39（<<M1>>）的美化改进版。与前型极为相似，但采用美国SAE标准部件而非公制部件制造，并包含数项细微升级。

s: A LOX/Ammonia gas generator engine which powered the X-15 spaceplane. It was the first large rocket engine capable of throttling and restarting.
zh: 一种为<<M0>>航天飞机提供动力的液氧/氨燃气发生器发动机。它是第一款具备节流和二次启动能力的大型火箭发动机。

s: Rocketdyne's pump-fed high performance upper stage engine for perigee/apogee stages, as well as transfer vehicles and lunar and Martian missions. It was tested extensively but has never flown.
zh: 洛克达因公司的泵压式高性能上面级发动机，用于近地点/远地点级，以及转移飞行器、登月和火星任务。经过广泛测试但从未升空飞行。

s: A linear aerospike engine developed for NASA's X-33 sub-scale SSTO technology demonstrator. Like the toroidal J-2T engines, the XRS-2200 used machinery derived from the J-2S.
zh: 一种为NASA的<<M0>>缩比SSTO技术验证机研制的线性气动环形塞喷管发动机。与环形<<M1>>发动机类似，<<M2>>使用了源自<<M3>>的机械结构。

s: A Chinese hypergolic gas generator vacuum engine. Derived from the Isayev S2.1100 Burya booster engine, the YF-3 is a vacuum variant created for the second stage of the DF-4 and Long March 1.
zh: 一款中国自燃推进剂气动发生器真空发动机。衍生自伊萨耶夫S2.1100“风暴”助推器发动机，<<M0>>是专为<<M1>>和长征一号第二级研制的真空型号。

s: A Chinese hypergolic gas generator vacuum engine. A YF-22 engine and YF-23 vernier form the YF-24 engine unit used on the second stage of the DF-5, FB-1, and Long March 2/3/4 rockets.
zh: 一款中国自燃推进剂气动发生器真空发动机。一台<<M0>>主机与一台<<M1>>游机组成了<<M2>>动力单元，用于<<M3>>、<<M4>>以及长征二/三/四号火箭的第二级。

s: A Chinese hypergolic gas generator vacuum engine with verniers. A YF-22 engine and YF-23 vernier form the YF-24 engine unit used on the second stage of the DF-5, FB-1, and Long March 2/3/4 rockets.
zh: 一款带游机的中国自燃推进剂气动发生器真空发动机。一台<<M0>>主机与一台<<M1>>游机组成了<<M2>>动力单元，用于<<M3>>、<<M4>>以及长征二/三/四号火箭的第二级。

s: A Chinese hypergolic gas generator vacuum engine, created for the 3rd stage of the Long March 4. Later versions had restart capability.
zh: 一款中国自燃推进剂气动发生器真空发动机，专为长征四号第三级研制。后续改进型具备多次启动能力。

s: The first operational Chinese hydrolox gas generator vacuum engine. Used on the third stage of the Long March 3. Low performance and unreliable, it was replaced by the YF-75 after 13 flights.
zh: 中国首款投入实用的氢氧气动发生器真空发动机。用于长征三号第三级。因性能较低且可靠性不足，在飞行13次后被<<M0>>取代。

s: An early 50s turbojet which served as the powerplant for the Su-7, Su-9, Su-11, Tu-128, and Be-10 flying boat.
zh: 一款50年代初期的涡轮喷气发动机，曾作为<<M0>>、<<M1>>、<<M2>>、<<M3>>和<<M4>>水上飞机的动力装置。

s: The Atar 101 was one of the first jet engines developed in France following WW2. It was used in many early French jet aircraft, including the Vautour I/II, Gerfaut I, and Mystère II.
zh: 阿塔101（Atar 101）是二战后法国研制的最早的喷气发动机之一。它曾用于许多早期法国喷气机，包括秃鹰I/II（Vautour I/II）、苍鹰I（Gerfaut I）和神秘II（Mystère II）。

s: The Chimera is a combined cycle ramjet tech demonstrator built by Hermeus. Based around retired J85 cores, it is intended to operate over a flight envelope from Mach 0 to Mach 5.
zh: 奇美拉（Chimera）是由赫缪斯（Hermeus）建造的组合循环冲压发动机技术验证机。它以退役的J85核心机为基础，旨在覆盖0至5马赫的飞行包线。

s: The D-18 was the largest high-bypass turbofan developed in the Soviet Union, created in the 1980s for the An-124 and An-225.
zh: <<M0>>是苏联研制的最大涵道比涡扇发动机，于20世纪80年代为<<M1>>和<<M2>>量身打造。

s: A large, 16 kW electric ducted fan. Very powerful for it's size, but fixed pitch propeller blades limit it to low speeds.
zh: 一款大型16 kW电动涵道风扇。就其尺寸而言推力非常强劲，但固定螺距的桨叶限制了其高速性能。

s: The EJ200 is a 1990s low-bypass turbofan, designed as a joint venture between many European companies for the Eurofighter Typhoon.
zh: <<M0>>是一款20世纪90年代的小涵道比涡扇发动机，由多家欧洲公司联合开发，专为台风战斗机设计。

s: The GEnx is a 2000s large, high-bypass turbofan, developed from the GE90 to power the B787. It is used in most 787 variants, as well as in the 747-8.
zh: GEnx是一款21世纪初的大涵道比大推力涡扇发动机，由<<M0>>衍生而来，旨在为<<M1>>提供动力。它被广泛用于波音787的大多数型号以及747-8上。

s: An early 1950s turbojet, developed from the earlier J35 by General Electric. It powered the F-86, FJ-2, B-36, B-45, and B-48.
zh: 一款20世纪50年代早期的涡轮喷气发动机，由通用电气在早期J35的基础上研制。曾为<<M0>>、<<M1>>、<<M2>>、<<M3>>和<<M4>>提供动力。

s: The J57 was a workhorse, designed in the early 1950s and powering the B-52, most of the Century Series fighters, and even the U-2.
zh: J57是一款功勋卓著的中流砥柱，设计于20世纪50年代初，为<<M0>>、多数“世纪系列”战斗机乃至<<M1>>提供了动力。

s: Designed in the late 1950s, the J58 was redesigned and repurposed for one use: Mach 3+ aircraft like the A-12 / SR-71A/B / YF-12A. Also known by it's civilian designation, JT11.
zh: J58设计于20世纪50年代末，后经过重新设计并赋予了专职使命：为<<M0>>/<<M1>>/B/<<M2>>等3马赫以上的高速飞机提供动力。亦因其民用编号<<M3>>而为人所知。

s: Essentially a larger J57, the P&W J75 saw extensive military and civilian use. It was used on the F-105, F-106, F-107, XF8U-3, A-12, U-2, P6M, and the 707 and DC-8 as the JT4A.
zh: 普惠J75本质上是放大版的J57，曾被广泛应用于军用和民用领域。它用于<<M0>>、<<M1>>、<<M2>>、<<M3>>-3、<<M4>>、<<M5>>、P6M，并以<<M7>>的代号用于波音707和<<M6>>。

s: The first US "Mach 2" engine, the J79 saw extensive service, powering the B-58, F-4, A-5, and F-104.
zh: 作为美国第一款“双倍音速”发动机，J79服役极为广泛，曾为<<M0>>、<<M1>>、<<M2>>和<<M3>>提供动力。

s: Derived from the J79, the J93 was developed for Mach 3 performance to power the B-70 and F-108.
zh: J93衍生自J79，专为3马赫的飞行性能而研制，用于为<<M0>>和<<M1>>提供动力。

s: The NK-12 was a large 1950s turboprop. Created to power the Tu-95, it is the largest turboprop to enter production. It powered the A-90, An-22, Tu-95, Tu-114, Tu-116, Tu-126, and Tu-142.
zh: <<M0>>是一款20世纪50年代的大型涡轮螺旋桨发动机。专为<<M1>>打造，是投入量产的最大涡桨发动机。它为<<M2>>、<<M3>>, <<M1>>, <<M4>>、<<M5>>、<<M6>>和<<M7>>提供了动力。

s: The NK-25 was a 1970s low-bypass turbofan, developed from the earlier NK-22. It is the most powerful supersonic jet engine ever flown, and was used to power the Tu-22M3, Tu-160, Tu-160M and Tu-144LL.
zh: <<M0>>是一款20世纪70年代的小涵道比涡扇发动机，由早期的<<M1>>改进而来。它是人类飞行史上推力最强劲的超音速喷气发动机，曾为<<M2>>、<<M3>>、<<M4>>和<<M5>>提供动力。

s: Nord 1500/Atar Combined Cycle Ramjet
zh: 北方1500/阿塔组合循环冲压发动机

s: A late 60s turbojet. Developed to replace the R-11 and R-13, the R-25 added an extremely powerful "extra-power" afterburner, that allowed it to nearly double it's thrust for short periods of time.
zh: 一款60年代末的涡轮喷气发动机。为替代<<M0>>和<<M1>>而开发，<<M2>>增加了极其强劲的“超功率”加力燃烧室，使其能在短时间内将推力提升近一倍。

s: The RD-012 was a supersonic ramjet, designed to power the La-350 Burya cruise missile up to Mach 3.1.
zh: <<M0>>是一款超音速冲压喷气发动机，专为将<<M1>>“风暴”巡航导弹推进至3.1马赫而设计。

s: The RJ47 was a supersonic ramjet, designed to power the SM-64 Navaho cruise missile up to Mach 2.75.
zh: <<M0>>是一款超音速冲压喷气发动机，专为将<<M1>>“纳瓦霍”巡航导弹推进至2.75马赫而设计。

s: An early 1950s turbojet. Derived from the MetroVick F.2, the first axial-flow jet developed in Britain, the Sapphire powered the Hawker Hunter, Handley Page Victor, and Gloster Javelin.
zh: 一款20世纪50年代早期的涡轮喷气发动机。蓝宝石（Sapphire）衍生自英国研制的第一款轴流式喷气机<<M0>> F.2，曾为霍克猎手、汉德利·佩季胜利者和格罗斯特标枪提供动力。

s: A Soviet-built derivative of the Nene used in many early Soviet jet aircraft, including the MiG-15, MiG-17, Tu-14, and Il-28.
zh: 苏联制造的尼恩（Nene）仿制改进型，用于许多早期苏联喷气式飞机，包括<<M0>>、<<M1>>、<<M2>>和<<M3>>。

s: The Welland was an early 1940s turbojet, developed from Frank Whittle's original jet engine, the W.1. It was used on the Meteor F.1, but was quickly replaced by later, more powerful jet engines.
zh: 韦兰德（Welland）是一款20世纪40年代早期的涡轮喷气发动机，由弗兰克·惠特尔最初的喷气发动机W.1发展而来。它曾用于流星F.1，但很快就被更晚期、更强劲的喷气发动机所取代。
