s: This shock cone intake works best between Mach 1.5 and Mach 3.0. This one is similar to the intake used on the X-7.
zh: 该锥形进气道在 1.5 马赫至 3.0 马赫之间工作效果最佳。与<<M0>>所用的进气道相似。

s: This shock cone intake works best between Mach 1.5 and Mach 3.0.
zh: 该锥形进气道在 1.5 马赫至 3.0 马赫之间工作效果最佳。

s: 1.25m Fuselage (Diverterless Intake)
zh: 1.25m 机身（无附面层隔道进气道）

s: This diverterless supersonic intake works best between Mach 0 and Mach 2.0.
zh: 该无附面层隔道超音速进气道在 0 马赫至 2.0 马赫之间工作效果最佳。

s: Realism Overhaul completely changes parts, so it itself only supports Sandbox play. RP-1 provides Realism Overhaul with a career mode, please install that if you wish to play career or science mode.
zh: Realism Overhaul 彻底重构了部件，因此其自身仅支持沙盒模式。<<M0>> 为 Realism Overhaul 提供了生涯模式支持，若想体验生涯或科学模式，请安装该模组。

s: Used on the UR-100 second stage. One 15D13 and one 15D14 make up a DU-419/8D419 propulsion unit.
zh: 用于<<M0>>二级。一台 15D13 和一台 15D14 构成一个<<M1>>/8<<M2>>推进单元。

s: Modified 15D13, intended for use as the ascent/return engine on the LK-700S. More reliable, with restart capability.
zh: 15D13 的改进型，旨在用作<<M0>>的上升/返回发动机。可靠性更高，具备再点火能力。

s: Sustainer engine of A-350Zh Anti-Ballistic Missile. Capable of rapid restart under high dynamic pressure for rapid upper atmosphere manuevers.
zh: <<M0>>反导拦截弹的巡航级发动机。具备在高动压下快速再点火的能力，用于高层大气的迅速机动。

s: Interim mass-production version of the Model 39 for the A-4 Series B/V-2
zh: Model 39 的过渡性量产版本，用于<<M0>> B 系列/<<M1>>

s: "Interkontinental" version of the Model 39c, for the A-9/A-10 upper stage. Decreased thrust and increased Isp for upper stage use, and special engine modifications to allow air-starting.
zh: Model 39c 的“洲际”版本，用于<<M0>>/<<M1>>上面级。降低了推力并提高了比冲以适应上面级使用，并经过特殊改装以支持空中点火。

s: Prototype engine, used on the Hermes A-3A (RV-A-8) test vehicle.
zh: 原型发动机，用于赫尔墨斯<<M0>>（RV-<<M1>>）测试飞行器。

s: Uprated engine for the Hermes A-3B (SSM-A-16) missile.
zh: 用于赫尔墨斯<<M0>>（SSM-<<M1>>）导弹的升推改进型发动机。

s: A RATO booster modified to be used on the WAC-Corporal for the US Army
zh: 经过改装供美国陆军“下士”火箭（WAC-Corporal）使用的火箭助推起飞（RATO）助推器

s: Developed for the Aerobee X-8, an improved WAC-Corporal for upper atmosphere research to replace the limited stocks of captured V-2s
zh: 为“火箭气象探测仪”（Aerobee）<<M0>>研制，该火箭是改进型 WAC-Corporal，用于高层大气研究以替代数量有限的缴获<<M1>>

s: Improved XASR-1 with helium pressurization to improve performance.
zh: 改进型<<M0>>，采用氦气增压以提高性能。

s: Developed as an upgrade to the XASR-1. Continued to be used until the 1980s for meteorlogical studies.
zh: 作为<<M0>>的升级型号研制。一直使用至 20 世纪 80 年代用于气象研究。

s: Developed privately in collaboration with Rocketdyne. Turbopump system from XLR-32 added, allowing much higher performance. A.K.A RS-72
zh: 与洛克达因（Rocketdyne）合作私下研制。增加了源自<<M0>>的涡轮泵系统，大幅提升了性能。亦称<<M1>>

s: Upgrade for the Agena SPS developed by TRW, using an electric pump system to allow it to draw directly from the Agena fuel tanks.
zh: 由 TRW 研制的阿金娜（Agena）SPS 升级型号，采用电动泵系统使其能直接从阿金娜燃料箱抽取推进剂。

s: Upgrade for the Agena SPS developed by TRW, using an electric pump system to allow it to draw directly from the Agena fuel tanks. HDA version.
zh: 由 TRW 研制的阿金娜（Agena）SPS 升级型号，采用电动泵系统使其能直接从阿金娜燃料箱抽取推进剂。HDA（高密度酸）版本。

s: Derived from the XLR67 used on the RASCAL missile, the Model 117 was intended to power an improved air to surface missile for the B-58 Hustler.
zh: 衍生自“拉斯考”（RASCAL）导弹上使用的<<M0>>，Model 117 旨在为<<M1>>“盗贼”轰炸机配备的改进型空对地导弹提供动力。

s: Model 8001, Agena A Prototypes. Effectively a Model 117 with gimbal added, this engine was poorly optimized for upper stage use and only flew twice on the earliest Agena launches.
zh: Model 8001，阿金娜 A（Agena A）原型。实际上是增加了万向节的 Model 117，该发动机针对上面级工况的优化较差，仅在最早的两次阿金娜发射中飞行过。

s: Model 8048, Agena A. Switched to higher performance hypergolic fuels and featured an larger nozzle for better vacuum performance. Cavitating venturis improved thrust regulation.
zh: Model 8048，阿金娜 A（Agena A）。改用更高性能的自燃推进剂，并具有更大的喷管以获得更好的真空性能。空化文丘里管改善了推力调节。

s: Model 8081, Agena B. Increase burn time and a short nozzle extension increased performance for Agena B. Also featured a restart cartridge to allow restart in space.
zh: Model 8081，阿金娜 B（Agena B）。延长的燃烧时间和短喷管延伸段提高了阿金娜 B 的性能。还配备了再点火启动药筒以支持在轨重启。

s: Model 8096, Agena D. Improved injectors and a larger nozzle extension improved performance for Agena D. This was the most-produced variant of Agena, flying hundreds of times.
zh: Model 8096，阿金娜 D（Agena D）。改进的喷注器和更大的喷管延伸段提升了阿金娜 D 的性能。这是阿金娜产量最高的改型，飞行了数百次。

s: A.K.A. XLR81-BA-13, or Model 8247. Add reusable start tanks, developed for GATV, to allow for up to 14 restarts of the XLR81.
zh: 亦称<<M0>>-<<M1>>，或 Model 8247。增加了为 GATV 研制的可复用启动箱，使<<M0>>最多可进行 14 次再点火。

s: Agena D HDA. Converted to use high density acid oxidizer to increase performance. Cannot restart between 15 minutes and 3 hours after shutdown.
zh: 阿金娜 D（Agena D）HDA。改用高密度酸氧化剂以提高性能。关机后 15 分钟至 3 小时之内无法再点火。

s: Add reusable start tanks, developed for GATV, to allow for up to 14 restarts of the XLR81.
zh: 增加了为 GATV 研制的可复用启动箱，使<<M0>>最多可进行 14 次再点火。

s: Improved Model 8096 for Titan-Agena, including longer life and higher performance injectors developed for Shuttle-Agena. Cannot restart between 15 minutes and 3 hours after shutdown.
zh: 用于大力神-阿金娜（Titan-Agena）的改进型 Model 8096，包括为航天飞机-阿金娜研制的长寿命和更高性能喷注器。关机后 15 分钟至 3 小时之内无法再点火。

s: Add reusable start tanks, developed for GATV, to allow for up to 14 restarts of the XLR81. Cannot restart between 15 minutes and 3 hours after shutdown.
zh: 增加了为 GATV 研制的可复用启动箱，使<<M0>>最多可进行 14 次再点火。关机后 15 分钟至 3 小时之内无法再点火。

s: Higher expansion ratio nozzle prototype. Cannot restart between 15 minutes and 3 hours after shutdown.
zh: 大面积比喷管原型。关机后 15 分钟至 3 小时之内无法再点火。

s: Reusable Agena for STS, featuring much larger nozzle, a large number of restarts, and higher performance. Cannot restart between 15 minutes and 3 hours after shutdown.
zh: 用于航天飞机（STS）的可复用阿金娜，拥有更大的喷管、多次再点火能力和更高性能。关机后 15 分钟至 3 小时之内无法再点火。

s: Improved reusable Agena for STS. Reduced weight, fuel mix modified for better compatibility with shuttle, and turbopump material modified to remove restart limits.
zh: 用于航天飞机（STS）的改进型可复用阿金娜。减轻了重量，修改了燃料配比以更好地适配航天飞机，并改进了涡轮泵材料以消除再点火限制。

s: Ultimate reusable Agena for STS. Reduced weight and thrust to increase Isp, nearly unlimited restarts, and extremely long life.
zh: 用于航天飞机（STS）的终极可复用阿金娜。降低了重量和推力以提高比冲，几乎不受限的再点火次数，以及极长的工作寿命。

s: Agena upgrade for proposed Atlas V upper stage. Tested, but cancelled when studies showed it would be more economical to use single engine centaur instead.
zh: 为拟议中的宇宙神 V（Atlas V）上面级设计的阿金娜升级版。经过测试，但随后研究表明使用单发半人马座（Centaur）更为经济，因而被取消。

s: Liquid Fluorine based design, proposed for use on the GE D-2 Apollo vehicle, and later high performance Agena tugs.
zh: 基于液氟的设计，曾提议用于通用电气（GE）<<M0>>阿波罗飞行器，以及后续的高性能阿金娜拖船。

s: Upper Stage engine used on the Titan Transtage
zh: 用于大力神过渡级（Transtage）的上面级发动机

s: Improved Transtage Injector Program, upgraded AJ10-138 used for later Transtage launches.
zh: 改进型过渡级喷注器计划（ITIP），用于后期过渡级发射的升级版<<M0>>-138。

s: Upper stage engine for the Delta-K
zh: 用于德尔塔-K（Delta-K）的上面级发动机

s: AJ10 variant burning liquid hydrogen and oxygen, proposed for use on the Hylas upper stage. Extremely low chamber pressure and autogeneous pressurization system allows conventional tanks to be used.
zh: 燃烧液氢液氧的<<M0>>改型，提议用于海拉斯（Hylas）上面级。极低的燃烧室压力和自生增压系统允许其使用常规贮箱。

s: AJ10 variant burning liquid hydrogen and oxygen, proposed for use on the GE D-2 Apollo vehicle.
zh: 燃烧液氢液氧的<<M0>>改型，曾提议用于通用电气（GE）<<M1>>阿波罗飞行器。

s: Developed for the upper stage of the Vanguard launch vehicle.
zh: 为先锋号（Vanguard）运载火箭上面级研制。

s: The final version of the J-2 that flew on the Saturn, the 230k variant flew starting with Apollo 8, SA-208 and all subsequent flights.
zh: 土星运载火箭所用 <<M0>> 的最终型号，230k 改型自阿波罗 8 号、<<M1>> 及之后的所有飞行任务开始采用。

s: J93-GE-3, as used on the XB-70. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 3.35.
AL-31F, as used on the Su-27, Su-30M/MKI, and J-11A. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 2.7.
AL-31FM with thrust vectoring, as used on the Su-27SM, Su-30 and Su-34. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 2.7.
zh: 带推力矢量的 <<M0>>，用于 <<M1>>、<<M2>> 及 <<M3>>。15 km 处温度马赫数限制：2.7。

s: AL-41F-1S with thrust vectoring, as used in the Su-35 and Su-30SM2. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 2.67.
zh: 带推力矢量的 <<M0>>，用于 <<M1>> 和 <<M2>>。15 km 处温度马赫数限制：2.67。

s: Early afterburning AL-7, as used on the Su-7. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 2.48.
zh: 早期加力型 <<M0>>，用于 <<M1>>。15 km 处温度马赫数限制：2.48。

s: Afterburning AL-7, as used on Su-7B/BM/BMK and Su-9. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 2.75.
zh: 加力型 <<M0>>，用于 <<M1>>/BM/BMK 和 <<M2>>。15 km 处温度马赫数限制：2.75。

s: Afterburning AL-7, used on Tu-128 and Su-11. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 2.74.
zh: 加力型 <<M0>>，用于 <<M1>> 和 <<M2>>。15 km 处温度马赫数限制：2.74。

s: Early Atar 09, as used on the Mirage IIIA. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 2.62.
zh: 早期阿塔 09，用于幻影 IIIA。15 km 处温度马赫数限制：2.62。

s: Ultimate Atar 09, as used on the Mirage 5S, Mirage 50, Mirage IVA/P/R, and Mirage F1C. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 2.79.
zh: 终极阿塔 09，用于幻影 5S、幻影 50、幻影 IVA/P/R 及幻影 F1C。15 km 处温度马赫数限制：2.79。

s: Atar 101, as used on the Vautour IA and early Vautour IIB. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 1.99.
zh: 阿塔 101，用于秃鹰 IA 及早期秃鹰 IIB。15 km 处温度马赫数限制：1.99。

s: Atar 101, as used on the Vautour IIA/B/N, Etendard IV, and as the turbojet half of the Griffon combined cycle ramjet. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 2.57.
zh: 阿塔 101，用于秃鹰 IIA/B/N、超军旗 IV，并作为格里芬组合循环冲压发动机的涡喷部分。15 km 处温度马赫数限制：2.57。

s: Avon RA.4 Mk.107. Early Avon, as used on the Hunter Prototype. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 2.05.
zh: 埃文 RA.4 Mk.107。早期埃文，用于猎鹰原型机。15 km 处温度马赫数限制：2.05。

s: Avon RA.7R Mk.114R. Early afterburning Avon, as used on the Super Mystère B1 and Hunter Mk.3. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 2.42.
zh: 埃文 RA.7R Mk.114R。早期加力型埃文，用于超神秘 B1 和猎鹰 Mk.3。15 km 处温度马赫数限制：2.42。

s: Avon RA.24R Mk.200R. Afterburning Avon, as used on the Lightning F.1. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 2.6.
zh: 埃文 RA.24R Mk.200R。加力型埃文，用于闪电 F.1。15 km 处温度马赫数限制：2.6。

s: Avon RB.146 Mk.302. Ultimate afterburning Avon, as used on the Lightning F.6. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 2.8.
zh: 埃文 RB.146 Mk.302。终极加力型埃文，用于闪电 F.6。15 km 处温度马赫数限制：2.8。

s: Early TF34, as used on the A-10A.
TF34, as used on the S-3B and S-72.
Early CF34, as used on the Challenger 601.
zh: 早期 <<M0>>，用于挑战者 601。

s: CF34, as used on the Challenger 604/605.
CF6-6, as used on the DC-10-10.
CF6-50A, as used on the DC-10-30.
CF6-80A, as used on the A310 and 767.
Early CFM56, A.K.A. F108-CF-102, as used on the E-3D and E-6B.
CFM56, as used on the A320-111/211.
CFM56, as used on the A321-200.
Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 3.16.
zh: 15 km 处温度马赫数限制：3.16。

s: D-18T, as used on the An-125 and An-225.
Afterburning D-30, as used on MiG-31. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 3.35.
zh: 加力型 <<M0>>，用于 <<M1>>。15 km 处温度马赫数限制：3.35。

s: Derwent V RD.7. Centrifugal Nene derivative, as used on Meteor F.4 and Nord 1601. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 1.83.
zh: 德温特 V RD.7。离心式尼恩衍生型，用于流星 F.4 和北方 1601。15 km 处温度马赫数限制：1.83。

s: OKB-300 (Tumansky) license-built copy of the Derwent V, used on the Yak-23/25/30 and La-15. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 1.83.
zh: <<M0>>（图曼斯基）特许生产的德温特 V 仿型，用于 <<M1>>/25/30 和 <<M2>>。15 km 处温度马赫数限制：1.83。

s: Very powerful electric ducted fan. Optimized for 80 m/s airspeed.
zh: 超强力电动涵道风扇。针对 80 m/s 空速优化。

s: Very powerful electric ducted fan. Optimized for static thrust
zh: 超强力电动涵道风扇。针对静推力优化。

s: Mk.100, used on the Typhoon Tranche 1. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 2.81.
zh: Mk.100，用于台风第 1 批次（Tranche 1）。15 km 处温度马赫数限制：2.81。

s: Mk.101, mildly improved for the Typhoon Tranche 2. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 2.99.
zh: Mk.101，为台风第 2 批次（Tranche 2）进行了轻微改进。15 km 处温度马赫数限制：2.99。

s: Early F100, as used in the F-15A/B. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 2.8.
zh: 早期 <<M0>>，用于 <<M1>>/B。15 km 处温度马赫数限制：2.8。

s: Upgrade of F100-PW-100, as used in the F-15C/D/E, F-16C/D Block 25, and YA-7F. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 2.83.
zh: <<M0>>-<<M1>> 的升级型号，用于 <<M2>>/D/E、<<M3>>/D Block 25 及 <<M4>>。15 km 处温度马赫数限制：2.83。

s: F100 redesign with larger, more powerful core, as used in the F-15E/I/S, F-16C/D Block 52/52+, F-16I Block 52, and F-16V Block 70. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 2.99.
zh: <<M0>> 重新设计型号，拥有更大且推力更强的核心机，用于 <<M1>>/I/S、<<M2>>/D Block 52/52+、<<M3>> Block 52 及 <<M4>> Block 70。15 km 处温度马赫数限制：2.99。

s: Modified F100 with thrust vectoring Pitch/Yaw Balance Beam Nozzle for the F-15 ACTIVE technology demonstrator. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 2.99.
zh: 改型 <<M0>>，配备用于 <<M1>> ACTIVE 技术验证机的俯仰/偏航平衡梁推力矢量喷管。15 km 处温度马赫数限制：2.99。

s: F100 Engine Enhancement Package, integrating technology from the F119 and F135 programs, as used in the F-16V Block 70. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 3.11.
zh: <<M0>> 发动机增强套件（EEP），整合了来自 <<M1>> 和 <<M2>> 项目的技术，用于 <<M3>> Block 70。15 km 处温度马赫数限制：3.11。

s: F119, as used on the F-22A. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 2.89.
zh: <<M0>>，用于 <<M1>>。15 km 处温度马赫数限制：2.89。

s: F135, as used on the F-35A/C. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 3.11.
zh: <<M0>>，用于 <<M1>>/C。15 km 处温度马赫数限制：3.11。

s: More reliable version of the AJ10-37 used on the Able Upper Stage.
zh: 用于 Able 上级的 <<M0>>-37 的更高可靠性版本。

s: F135 with gimbal, as used on the F-35B. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 3.11.
zh: 带万向节的 <<M0>>，用于 <<M1>>。15 km 处温度马赫数限制：3.11。

s: Used on the improved version of the Able upper stage for Thor-Able and Atlas-Able.
zh: 用于雷神-Able（Thor-Able）和宇宙神-Able（Atlas-Able）改进型 Able 上级。

s: Early F404, as used in F/A-18A/B. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 2.79.
zh: 早期 <<M0>>，用于 F/<<M1>>/B。15 km 处温度马赫数限制：2.79。

s: Used as the upper stage engine on the very late Thor-Able and very early Thor-Delta launch vehicles.
zh: 用作雷神-Able 极后期和雷神-德尔塔（Thor-Delta）极早期运载火箭的上级发动机。

s: F404, as used in F/A-18C/D. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 2.75.
zh: <<M0>>，用于 F/<<M1>>/D。15 km 处温度马赫数限制：2.75。

s: Second stage engine for the Thor-Delta A.
zh: 雷神-德尔塔 A（Thor-Delta A）的二级发动机。

s: F404 variant developed by Volvo, as used in the JAS-39 Gripen. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 2.83.
zh: 沃尔沃开发的 <<M0>> 改型，用于 <<M1>> 鹰狮。15 km 处温度马赫数限制：2.83。

s: The AJ10-104 was used on the Thor-Able-Star and it was the first upper stage engine with the ability to restart.
zh: <<M0>>-104 用于雷神-艾布尔星（Thor-Able-Star），是首款具备二次启动能力的上级发动机。

s: GE4/J5P afterburning turbojet, intended to power the B2707. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 3.55.
zh: GE4/J5P 加力涡喷发动机，计划用于驱动 <<M0>>。15 km 处温度马赫数限制：3.55。

s: Upgrade to the AJ10-118 used on the Delta E-N upper stages.
zh: <<M0>>-118 的升级版，用于德尔塔 E-N 型上级。

s: GEnx, with a smaller fan to allow it to be installed on the B747-8.
zh: GEnx，采用较小涵道风扇以适配 <<M0>>-8。

s: Planned upgrade for space shuttle OMS, cancelled after Challenger disaster
zh: 航天飞机 OMS 的计划升级型号，在挑战者号失事后取消。

s: J35, as used on the B-45A and D558-1. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 1.77.
zh: J35，用于 <<M0>> 和 <<M1>>-1。15 km 处温度马赫数限制：1.77。

s: Engine for Transtar I, a high performance upper stage. Later renamed to Titan Launch Dispenser and used to deploy NRO SIGINT satellites, and may have powered other classified NRO payloads.
zh: 用于 Transtar I 高性能上级的发动机。后更名为大力神发射分配器（Titan Launch Dispenser），用于部署 NRO 的电子侦察卫星，也可能曾为其他机密 NRO 载荷提供动力。

s: J35, as used on the F-84D, XF4D-1, and X-5. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 1.76.
Hydrolox engine, for high performance reusable space shuttle upper stages
zh: 液氢液氧发动机，用于高性能可重复使用航天飞机上级。

s: J47 with water injection, as used on the RB-45C. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 1.68.
zh: 带注水系统的 J47，用于 <<M0>>。15 km 处温度马赫数限制：1.68。

s: Engine for Transtar III, reusable upgrade of Transtar I
zh: Transtar III 发动机，为 Transtar I 的可重复使用升级版。

s: J47, as used on the F-86E/F. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 1.62.
zh: J47，用于 <<M0>>/F。15 km 处温度马赫数限制：1.62。

s: This was the test version that used the nozzle for the Full Length design.
zh: 采用全尺寸喷管设计的测试版本。

s: Late J47 with water injection, as used on the B-47E. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 1.84.
zh: 带注水系统的后期 J47，用于 <<M0>>。15 km 处温度马赫数限制：1.84。

s: A.K.A FW-4S, SR57-UT-1 or Star 20
Early afterburning J48, as used in the F-94C. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 1.81.
zh: 早期加力型 J48，用于 <<M0>>。15 km 处温度马赫数限制：1.81。

s: AR-1. Experimental pressure-fed super-performance booster for FJ-4F Fury.
zh: <<M0>>。用于 <<M1>>“狂怒”的实验性挤压循环超高性能助推器。

s: Afterburning J48, as used in the F9F-6 and most F9F-7s (F-9F and F-9H). Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 1.99.
zh: 加力型 J48，用于 F9F-6 和大部分 F9F-7（<<M0>> 和 <<M1>>）。15 km 处温度马赫数限制：1.99。

s: Improved model, with throttle capability. Tested, but never flew.
zh: 具备节流阀能力的改进型号。经过地面测试，但未曾飞行。

s: Early J57 with water injection, as used on the XB-52 and XB-60. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 2.18.
zh: 带注水系统的早期 J57，用于 <<M0>> 和 <<M1>>。15 km 处温度马赫数限制：2.18。

s: AR2-3. Pump-fed model, able to share fuel tanks with jet engine. Used on the FJ-4F, F-86F(R), and NF-104A for astronaut training.
zh: AR2-3。泵压式型号，可与喷气发动机共用油箱。用于 <<M0>>、<<M1>>(R) 和 <<M2>> 进行宇航员训练。

s: Early afterburning J57, as used on the F4D and F5D. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 2.01.
zh: 早期加力型 J57，用于 F4D 和 F5D。15 km 处温度马赫数限制：2.01。

s: Used on Europa I. Extremely unreliable
zh: 用于欧罗巴 1 号（Europa I）。可靠性极低。

s: Afterburning J57, as used on the F100C/D/F. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 2.45.
zh: 加力型 J57，用于 F100C/D/F。15 km 处温度马赫数限制：2.45。

s: Upgrade developed for Europa II. Cancelled after first launch following continued failures and lack of funding
zh: 为欧罗巴 2 号（Europa II）研制的升级型号。在经历接连失败与资金匮乏后，于首次发射后取消。

s: J57 with high-altitude nozzle, as used on the U-2A. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 2.44.
zh: 带高空喷管的 J57，用于 <<M0>>。15 km 处温度马赫数限制：2.44。

s: Derived from the Sergeant ballistic missile, for use as an upper stage to the Juno-C to test high velocity re-entry.
zh: 由“士官”（Sergeant）弹道导弹衍生而来，用作丘诺 C（Juno-C）的上级以测试高速再入。

s: J57 with water injection, as used on the B-52E/F. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 2.48.
zh: 带注水系统的 J57，用于 <<M0>>/F。15 km 处温度马赫数限制：2.48。

s: Improved fuel mix created by JPL
zh: JPL 配制的改进型推进剂配方。

s: Civilian J57 with water injection, as used on the B707-120 and DC-8-10. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 2.48.
zh: 民用注水型 J57，用于 <<M0>>-120 和 <<M1>>。15 km 处温度马赫数限制：2.48。

s: LOX/RP1 powered pressure-fed engine.
zh: 液氧/煤油挤压循环发动机。

s: Afterburning J57, as used on the F-8E/J. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 2.5.
zh: 加力型 J57，用于 <<M0>>/J。15 km 处温度马赫数限制：2.5。

s: LOX/RP1 powered engine using a Gas Generator Cycle.
zh: 采用燃气发生器循环的液氧/煤油发动机。

s: Ultimate afterburning J57, remanufactured J57-P-20 as used on upgraded F-8H/J. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 2.58.
zh: 终极加力型 J57，翻新型 J57-<<M0>>，用于升级型 <<M1>>/J。15 km 处温度马赫数限制：2.58。

s: LOX/Ethanol powered engine using a Gas Generator Cycle.
zh: 采用燃气发生器循环的液氧/乙醇发动机。

s: JT11D-20, as used on the SR-71A/B and YF-12A. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 3.6.
LOX/LCH4 powered engine using a Gas Generator Cycle.
zh: 采用燃气发生器循环的液氧/液态甲烷发动机。

s: J58, uprated for NASA to allow for increased payload. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 3.75.
zh: J58，为 NASA 进行增推以提高有效载荷能力。15 km 处温度马赫数限制：3.75。

s: Pressure Fed LOX/RP1 powered engine.
zh: 挤压循环液氧/煤油发动机。

s: J75, as used on the F-106A/B. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 2.65.
zh: J75，用于 <<M0>>/B。15 km 处温度马赫数限制：2.65。

s: Uprated E-1 intended for use with the Dyna Soar project. This version is without boostback hardware.
zh: 拟用于动力滑翔者（Dyna Soar）计划的增推版 <<M0>>。此版本未安装返航硬件。

s: J75, as used on the F-105B. Temperature Mach limit at 15 km: 2.65.
zh: J75，用于 <<M0>>。15 km 处温度马赫数限制：2.65。

s: Speculative E-1 upgrade, uprated to target thrust level of original E-1 study.
zh: 推测的 <<M0>> 升级版，推力提升至原 <<M0>> 研究的目标水平。

s: Speculative E-1 upgrade, uprated to maximum possible thrust.
zh: 推测的 <<M0>> 升级版，推力提升至极限水平。

s: Speculative upgrade configuration for the E-1 intended for use with the Dyna Soar project. This version is without boostback hardware.
zh: 拟用于动力滑翔者（Dyna Soar）计划的 <<M0>> 推测升级构型。此版本未安装返航硬件。

s: Speculative upgrade configuration using late 1960s technology.
zh: 采用 1960 年代末技术的推测升级构型。

s: E-1A as found in 'Kolyma's Shadow'.
zh: 《科雷马的阴影》中出现的 <<M0>>。

s: Modified 457M thruster with a krypton propellant, keeping the voltage at 650V. Even higher specific impulse due to lower molecular weight of the gas. Efficiency 58%, 2.19 kg/kW.
zh: 改用氪推进剂的 457M 推力器改型，工作电压保持在 650V。因气体分子量更低，比冲更高。效率 58%，2.19 kg/kW。

s: The successful test campaign with the laboratory model NASA-457M led to the development of a higher fidelity version of this thruster, labeled the NASA-457M v2. Efficiency 63%, 2.38 kg/kW.
zh: 实验室模型 <<M0>> 的成功测试促成了该推力器更高工程保真度版本的研制，定名为 <<M0>> v2。效率 63%，2.38 kg/kW。

s: 25 kW, optimized for earth-moon trips. Efficiency 70%, 2.67 kg/kW.
zh: 25 kW，专为地月航线优化。效率 70%，2.67 kg/kW。

s: 25 kW, optimized for earth-mars trips. Efficiency 72%, 2.67 kg/kW.
zh: 25 kW，专为地火航线优化。效率 72%，2.67 kg/kW。

s: 25 kW, optimized for gas giant probes. Efficiency 75%, 3.00 kg/kW.
zh: 25 kW，专为气体巨行星探测器优化。效率 75%，3.00 kg/kW。

s: 50 kW, optimized for earth-mars trips. Efficiency 72%, 2.67 kg/kW.
zh: 50 kW，专为地火航线优化。效率 72%，2.67 kg/kW。

s: 50 kW, optimized for gas giant probes. Efficiency 75%, 3.00 kg/kW.
zh: 50 kW，专为气体巨行星探测器优化。效率 75%，3.00 kg/kW。

s: 400 pulses per second, 32.44 kW total. Efficiency 61.6%, 1.58 kg/kW.
zh: 每秒 400 次脉冲，总功率 32.44 kW。效率 61.6%，1.58 kg/kW。

s: Advanced Electric Propulsion System, propulsion system for Lunar Gateway. Efficiency 61.5%, 1.88 kg/kW.
zh: 先进电力推进系统（AEPS），用于深空门户（Lunar Gateway）的推进系统。效率 61.5%，1.88 kg/kW。

s: NEXT-Commercial, scaled down for decreased power consumption. Efficiency 70%, 2.67 kg/kW.
zh: NEXT-专注效益，缩小尺寸以降低功耗。效率 70%，2.67 kg/kW。

s: 50 pulses per second, 205.3 kW total. Efficiency 72%, 2.68 kg/kW.
zh: 每秒 50 次脉冲，总功率 205.3 kW。效率 72%，2.68 kg/kW。

s: 50 pulses per second, 205.3 kW total. Efficiency 75%, 2.68 kg/kW.
zh: 每秒 50 次脉冲，总功率 205.3 kW。效率 75%，2.68 kg/kW。

s: 10 pulses per second, 40 kW total. Efficiency 55%, 4.53 kg/kW.
zh: 每秒 10 次脉冲，总功率 40 kW。效率 55%，4.53 kg/kW。

s: 300 pulses per second, 1200 kW total. Efficiency 55%, 0.24 kg/kW.
zh: 每秒 300 次脉冲，总功率 1200 kW。效率 55%，0.24 kg/kW。

s: 10 pulses per second, 40 kW total. Efficiency 46%, 4.53 kg/kW.
zh: 每秒 10 次脉冲，总功率 40 kW。效率 46%，4.53 kg/kW。

s: 300 pulses per second, 1200 kW total. Efficiency 46%, 0.24 kg/kW.
zh: 每秒 300 次脉冲，总功率 1200 kW。效率 46%，0.24 kg/kW。

s: Lab-tested version of the X3 thruster. Efficiency 63%, 2.30 kg/kW.
zh: 经过实验室测试的 X3 推力器版本。效率 63%，2.30 kg/kW。

s: Uprated X3 thruster operated at 800V and 200kW. Efficiency 63%, 1.25 kg/kW.
zh: 在 800V 和 200kW 下运行的增推版 X3 推力器。效率 63%，1.25 kg/kW。

s: X3 variant using Krypton for increased Isp, at the expense of thrust. Efficiency 60%, 1.25 kg/kW.
zh: 使用氪以牺牲推力换取更高比冲的 X3 改型。效率 60%，1.25 kg/kW。

s: Later model, with redesigned injectors
zh: 后期型号，重新设计了喷注器。

s: Uprated and simplified F-1 developed for post-Apollo launch vehicles. Tested extensively, but cancelled following the cancellation of Apollo
zh: 为后阿波罗时代运载火箭研制的增推简化型 <<M0>>。经过广泛测试，但随阿波罗计划终止而取消。

s: Original Gamma-2 used on all Black Arrow launches
zh: 用于所有黑箭（Black Arrow）发射的初代 Gamma-2。

s: Speculative vacuum Larch based on Gamma-2
zh: 基于 Gamma-2 的推测性真空版 Larch。

s: Early Gamma used on first 14 Black Knight launches, developed from Walter 109-509
zh: 用于前 14 次黑骑士（Black Knight）发射的早期 Gamma，衍生自瓦尔特 109-509。

s: Substantially upgraded Gamma based on Stentor sustainer chamber, used on last 8 Black Knight launches and Black Arrow
zh: 基于 Stentor 持续推力燃烧室大幅升级的 Gamma，用于最后 8 次黑骑士发射和黑箭。

s: Improved engine developed by Bristol Siddeley as a replacement for Gamma
zh: 布里斯托尔·西德利公司研制的改进型发动机，用于替代 Gamma。

s: Original Gamma-8 used on flown Black Arrows
zh: 用于实际飞行的黑箭火箭上的初代 Gamma-8。

s: Improved version of the H-1 Engine for the Saturn I, Block II. It is rated at 188k lbf sea level thrust.
zh: 用于土星 1 号 Block II 的 <<M0>> 发动机改进型。标称海平面推力 188k lbf。

s: H-1 Engine that flew on the first 5 Saturn IB launches. It is rated at 200k lbf sea level thrust.
zh: 用于土星 1B 前 5 次飞行的 <<M0>> 发动机。标称海平面推力 200k lbf。

s: Final version of the H-1 Engine for the Saturn IB that flew on the 4 flights of Skylab and ASTP. It is rated at 205k lbf sea level thrust.
zh: 用于土星 1B 的 <<M0>> 发动机最终版本，曾执行天空实验室和 ASTP 的 4 次飞行。标称海平面推力 205k lbf。

s: Remanufactured H-1 for use with Delta
zh: 翻新再造的 <<M0>>，用于德尔塔火箭。

s: RS-27 with a higher expansion nozzle for Delta II
zh: 配备更大膨胀比喷管的 <<M0>>，用于德尔塔 2 号（Delta II）。

s: Speculative upgrade, using lessons learned from experience with HG-3 in service and development of RS-25 to improve reliability.
zh: 推测的升级型号，利用 <<M0>> 服役经验和 <<M1>> 的研制经验以提高可靠性。

s: Sea-level variant of HG-3A upgrade
zh: <<M0>> 升级版的海平面改型。

s: Sea-level version of HG-3B-2 upgrade and modification. The improved specific impulse now means that this version produces more vacuum thrust than previous vacuum versions of the engine.
zh: <<M0>> 升级改进的海平面版本。比冲的提升使其真空推力超越了该发动机先前的真空版。

s: Improved version of the HM-7 used for Ariane 3 and 4.
zh: 用于阿里安 3 型和 4 型的 <<M0>> 改进版本。

s: Upgraded for higher performance on Ariane 4.
zh: 为阿里安 4 型提升性能的升级版本。

s: Upgraded for higher performance for later Ariane 4s and Ariane 5
zh: 为后期阿里安 4 型和阿里安 5 型提升性能的升级版本。

s: Five minutes minimum between restarts.
zh: 两次启动之间至少间隔五分钟。

s: This was the earliest variant of the J-2 that flew on the first 3 Saturn IB flights AS-201 to AS-203.
zh: 这是 <<M0>> 的最早改型，曾参与土星 1B 的前三次飞行 <<M1>> 至 <<M2>>。

s: Adds CVS propellant management system and O2/H2 burner preheater, to allow for on-orbit engine conditioning and restarts. One hour minimum between restarts.
zh: 增加了 CVS 推进剂管理系统和氢氧燃烧预热器，支持在轨发动机工况调节和二次启动。两次启动之间至少间隔一小时。

s: The uprated 225k variant was flown starting with SA-501 Saturn V.
zh: 增推至 225k 的改型，从 <<M0>> 土星 5 号开始飞行。

s: Upgraded Engine with 9% higher thrust and 100kg decrease in dry mass
zh: 升级型发动机，推力提高 9%，干重减轻 100kg。

s: Vacuum Version for use on the Zhuque-3 Launch Vehicle
zh: 真空版，用于朱雀三号运载火箭。

s: Isayev engine that powered the Soviet MR-1 sounding rocket.
zh: 伊萨耶夫发动机，曾为苏联 <<M0>> 探空火箭提供动力。

s: Speculative upgrade for the U-1250
zh: <<M0>> 的推想升级型。

s: Sustainer engine for the R-112 SAM. Tested, but never entered service.
zh: <<M0>> 地空导弹的续航发动机。经过测试，但从未服役。

s: Turpentine fuel for increased performance
zh: 松节油燃料，用于提升性能。

s: Used for the "Super-Veronique" Vesta sounding rocket. Has no gimbal
zh: 用于“超级维罗妮卡”灶神星探空火箭。无万向节。

s: First stage engine for the "precious stones" series of sounding rockets, culminating in the Diamant Launch Vehicle.
zh: 用于“宝石”系列探空火箭的第一级发动机，该系列最终发展出了钻石号运载火箭。

s: Modified Valois, modified for vacuum use and converted to 4 chambers for use on the 2nd stage of the Europa rocket.
zh: 瓦卢瓦的改型，针对真空环境进行了优化并改为四燃烧室构型，用于欧罗巴运载火箭的第二级。

s: Upgraded version of Vexin, used in the first stage of the Amethyste sounding rocket and Diamant-B launch vehicle.
zh: 韦克辛的升级版，用于紫水晶探空火箭的第一级和钻石-B 运载火箭。

s: License built copy of the European Viking-5 engine.
zh: 欧洲维京-5 发动机的许可证生产版本。

s: Uprated version of the Vikas-1.
zh: 维卡斯-1 的推力升级版。

s: Uprated version of the Vikas-1, designed for air-start.
zh: 维卡斯-1 的推力升级版，专为空中点火设计。

s: License built copy of the Viking-4 vacuum engine.
zh: 维京-4 真空发动机的许可证生产版本。

s: Uprated version of the Vikas-2.
zh: 维卡斯-2 的推力升级版。

s: Prototype, used for Ariane 1 ground stage tests.
zh: 原型机，用于阿里安 1 号地面级间测试。

s: First stage engine for Ariane 1.
zh: 阿里安 1 号第一级发动机。

s: Second stage engine for Ariane 1.
zh: 阿里安 1 号第二级发动机。

s: First stage engine for Ariane 2/3. Uses UH25 for extra performance.
zh: 阿里安 2/3 的第一级发动机。使用 <<M0>> 以获得更高性能。

s: First stage engine for Ariane 4.
zh: 阿里安 4 号第一级发动机。

s: Second stage engine for Ariane 4. Uses UH25 for extra performance.
zh: 阿里安 4 号第二级发动机。使用 <<M0>> 以获得更高性能。

s: Upgrade, utilizing flim cooling and new turbopumps for higher thrust.
zh: 升级型，采用膜冷却和新型涡轮泵以实现更高推力。

s: The engine of the Wasserfall anti-aircraft missile. Also used in a modified form on the R-101.
zh: 瀑布防空导弹的发动机。其改型亦用于 <<M0>>。

s: The engine for a proposed Vega stage for NASA's Atlas-Vega LV. It was superceded by Atlas-Agena once NASA became aware of the USAF's Agena stage.
zh: NASA 曾为宇宙神-织女星运载火箭提议的织女星级发动机。在 NASA 获悉美国空军的阿金纳级后，该方案被宇宙神-阿金纳取代。

s: X-405H with restart capability. Although restart was eliminated from the Atlas-Vega test vehicles due to the presence of the JPL 3rd stage, the capability was retained for potential future missions.
zh: 具备二次点火能力的 <<M0>>。尽管由于 JPL 第三级的加入，宇宙神-织女星测试载具取消了二次点火，但该能力仍被保留用于未来的潜在任务。

s: Speculative upgrade configuration with increased expansion ratio
zh: 推想升级构型，增大了喷管膨胀比。

s: Speculative upgrade configuration with increased chamber pressure and upgrades with late 1960s technology.
zh: 推想升级构型，提高了燃烧室压力，并采用了 20 世纪 60 年代末的技术进行了升级。

s: RMI 20k engine developed for Viking.
zh: 为维京火箭研制的 RMI 20k 发动机。

s: Initial pressure-fed version used on X-1 #1 and #2
zh: 最初的挤压循环版本，用于 <<M0>> 1 号和 2 号机。

s: Pump-fed version used on X-1 #3 and later aircraft
zh: 泵压循环版本，用于 <<M0>> 3 号及后续飞行器。

s: Uprated XLR11 used on early X-15 flights before the XLR99 was ready
zh: <<M0>> 的增推改型，在 <<M2>> 就绪前曾用于早期的 <<M1>> 飞行。

s: Uprated for use on X-24B flights
zh: 增推版，用于 <<M0>> 飞行任务。

s: Modified XLR11 used on RTV-A-2 Hiroc missile in Project MX-774. Higher performance. Includes gimbal assembly.
zh: <<M0>> 的改型，用于 <<M2>> 计划中的 RTV-<<M1>> 广岛导弹。性能更高。包含万向节总成。

s: Early YF-1, used on DF-3 Batch 01.
zh: 早期型 <<M0>>，用于 <<M1>> 第 01 批次。

s: Used on DF-3 Batch 02, DF-4, and CZ-1.
Used on DF-3A, DF-4A, and CZ-1D.
YF-20, used on FB-1, DF-5 and CZ-2A.
Used on CZ-2C/D/E/F, CZ-3B and CZ-4.
Used on CZ-3B strap-on boosters. No gimbal.

s: YF-22, used on FB-1, DF-5 and CZ-2A.
Used on CZ-2D/E/F, CZ-3B and CZ-4.
YF-23, used on FB-1, DF-5 and CZ-2A.
Used on DF-5A CZ-2C/D/E/F, CZ-3B, and CZ-4.

s: LMDE upgraded for J-class missions. Improved performance and more fuel allowed the LEM to carry rovers and extra scientific equipment to the surface.
zh: 为 J 级任务升级的 LMDE。性能的提升和更多的推进剂使登月舱能将月球车和额外的科研设备运送至月面。

s: First production version. Used on Thor and Atlas as vernier engines
zh: 首个量产版本。在雷神和宇宙神上用作游标发动机。

s: Developed for later, larger Thor variants, with improved performance
zh: 为后期更大尺寸的雷神改型开发，性能有所提升。

s: Downrated for later Atlas variants when studies showed much lower thrust could be used to maintain control
zh: 由于研究表明可用低得多的推力维持控制，因此针对后期的宇宙神改型降低了推力额定值。

s: The SC-10k may be just a fancy cupboard and some 'science' stuff but, hey, it's cheap and it'll keep your Kerbals occupied while you file the space program's tax returns. Recommended for ages 12-16. Cheap production makes it unsuitable for concerned parents.
zh: <<M0>>可能只是个花哨的橱柜加一点“科学”玩意儿，但是，嘿，它便宜啊！而且能在你为航天计划报税时让你的坎巴拉人有事可做。推荐年龄 12-16 岁。低廉的造价使其不适合忧心忡忡的家长。

s: Studies conducted by Probodobodyne Inc have found that today's youth consider mono-propellent engines to be quote 'totally main-stream, uncool, and Grandpa Bill always talks about how Mono-propellent engines saved his butt in the first Mun landing, ugh what is with all of these questions?!'. Upon being bribed for further information, the participants revealed that xenon-powered ion engines were the current trending item. So, in an effort to reach out to the youth and more importantly increase sales, the JKSS has had a tank of xenon crammed inside of it. Solar panels and ion engine sold separately.
zh: 探测动力有限公司的一项调查发现，当今年轻人认为单组元推进剂发动机引用原话是“完全落入俗套、一点都不酷，而且比尔爷爷老是念叨单组元推进剂发动机在第一次坎星着陆时怎么救了他的命，呃，怎么净是这种问题？！”在被塞了好处以获取更多情报后，受访者透露氙动力离子发动机才是当下的潮流单品。因此，为了迎合年轻人，更为了提高销量，JKSS 内部被硬塞进了一罐氙气。太阳能电池板和离子发动机需另购。

s: You'll want to add a TR-2C or TR-2V miniture stack decoupler to the top of this. The Descent stage's primary job is to support a powered landing and surface extravehicular activity. When the excursion is over, it serves as the launch pad for the ascent stage. It also carries a Surface Experiment Package and has some room for KIS storage.
zh: 你需要在其顶部安装一个 <<M0>> 或 <<M1>> 微型堆叠分离器。下降级的主要任务是支持动力着陆和地表舱外活动（EVA）。当考察结束时，它将充当上升级的发射台。它还搭载了一个地表实验包，并留有一些 KIS 储物空间。

s: The Ascent stage houses the crew cabin with instrument panels and flight controls. It contains its own Ascent Propulsion System (APS) engine and propellant tanks for return to munar orbit and rendezvous with the Command/Service Module. It also contains a Reaction Control System (RCS) for attitude and translation control. A forward EVA hatch provides access to and from the munar surface, while an overhead docking port provides access to and from the Command Module.
zh: 上升级包含带仪表板和飞行控制系统的乘员舱。它自带用于返回坎星轨道并与指令/服务舱交会对接的上升级推进系统（APS）发动机与推进剂储罐。它还包含用于姿态和移动控制的反应控制系统（RCS）。前进方向的 EVA 舱口可供进出坎星表面，顶部的对接口则用于进出指令舱。

s: A long time ago a Kerbal said “Give me a place to stand and with a lever I will move the whole world” - while he turned out to be frothing mad, the principle still applies. STEADLER have mounted a RV-105 RCS block on a boom to provide a larger moment for rotation.
zh: 很久以前，一个坎巴拉人曾说：“给我一个支点，用一根杠杆我能撬动整个世界”——虽然事实证明他已经疯得口吐白沫，但原理依然适用。STEADLER 将一个 <<M0>> RCS 模块安装在吊臂上，以提供更大的旋转力矩。

s: Developed in partnership with the Kerbodyne, the SC-XL10 project ran into no difficulties and proceeded entirely without incident. There was no fraud, no explosions and everything went fine. STEADLER would like to remind anyone that might say otherwise that STEADLER is currently working on an organic super-computer and is in need of 'spares'.
zh: SC-<<M0>> 项目是与坎巴拉动力合作开发的，期间没有遇到任何困难，进展完全一帆风顺。没有欺诈，没有爆炸，一切都很顺利。STEADLER 谨此提醒任何持不同意见的人：STEADLER 目前正在研发生物超级计算机，急需“备件”。

s: Initially built due to a mis-read procurement form, the TVR-1600XXL units now take up a large portion of O.M.B.'s storage floor-space. It is now being sold under a variety of names, including 'My First Quad Adapter' and 'Self assembly pool', in order to clear the stock. Converts a single 5m stack into four 2.5m stacks.
zh: 由于看错了采购单，最初建造的 <<M0>> 单元如今占用了 O.M.B. 大量的仓储地面空间。为了清库存，它现在以各种名称出售，包括“我的第一个四联适配器”和“拼装式泳池”。可将单个 5m 堆叠转换为四个 2.5m 堆叠。

s: A fuelled nosecone for Kerbodyne's experimental ultra-heavy fuel tank. While the KDB argues that Kerbodyne stole the design from them, Kerbodyne has reminded them that they can de-orbit space stations; and are getting very good at calculating where they land.
zh: 专为坎巴拉动力的实验型超重型燃料箱设计的带燃料机鼻锥。虽然 KDB 指责坎巴拉动力窃取了他们的设计，但坎巴拉动力提醒他们：自己有能力让空间站离轨，而且越来越擅长计算它们的着陆点了。

s: The airlock was designed shortly after the term 'Explosive Decompression' was coined. It allows Kerbals to move from the interior of the vessel to the exterior without a great change in internal pressure.
zh: 该气闸舱是在“爆炸性减压”一词诞生后不久设计的。它允许坎巴拉人在舱内压力不发生巨大变化的情况下，从载具内部转移到外部。

s: The QUBC is the first and final project of the Synergistic Integration Sub-Committee of Probodobodyne Inc. While lacking SAS and reaction wheels, it does feature integrated solar panels and antenna systems. The SISC was shutdown after key figures were found to be 'Synergising' company funds with their personal expense accounts.
zh: QUBC 是探测动力有限公司协同集成小组委员会的第一个也是最后一个项目。虽然缺少 SAS 和动量轮，但它确实集成了太阳能电池板和天线系统。在该委员会核心成员被发现将公司资金与个人报销账户进行“协同”后，该委员会被关闭。

s: Although far more delicate and with slightly less fuel capacity for its size than the X200-32, it does boast a lower dry mass per fuel tonne. Perfect for orbital missions. Not recommended for landings.
zh: 虽然相比于 <<M0>>-32 更为脆弱且单位体积燃料容量稍低，但它拥有更低的单位燃料干重。非常适合轨道任务。不建议用于着陆。

s: Although far more delicate and with slightly less fuel capacity for its size than the X200-32, it does boast a lower dry mass per fuel tonne. This version, while it can be configured for different fuels, only has a single tank. Perfect for orbital missions. Not recommended for landings.
zh: 虽然相比于 <<M0>>-32 更为脆弱且单位体积燃料容量稍低，但它拥有更低的单位燃料干重。该版本虽可配置不同燃料，但只有一个储罐。非常适合轨道任务。不建议用于着陆。

s: Pip pip, old boy! Light, cheap and packing a not inconsiderable punch, the Black Adder-8 certainly offers 'bang for buck', as the chaps over at the KSC say. Perfect for a budding space program, although quickly outclassed by more high-tech engines.
zh: 你好啊，老兄！正如 KSC 的家伙们所说，“黑adder-8”轻巧、便宜且威力不容小觑，绝对物超所值。对于刚起步的航天计划来说非常完美，不过很快就会被更先进的高科技发动机所淘汰。

s: Built with spares from the BA-8. Well, we had to do something, they really were just cluttering the place up. Does make it cheaper than pesky Rockomax's 48-7S. And we have two nozzles, more is always better.
zh: 使用 <<M0>> 的备件制造。好吧，我们总得做点什么，它们堆在那儿实在是太占地方了。这确实让它比讨厌的洛克玛克斯 48-7S 更便宜。而且我们有两个喷嘴，多就是好。

s: Built with completely peaceful motives, nothing else. Features a rear seat to allow for a scientist or engineer to accompany the pilot and a top of the range 'hole in the floor'. That's for taking pretty pictures, not aiming anything explosive. Honest.
zh: 完全出于和平目的建造，绝无他意。设有后座，可让科学家或工程师陪同飞行员，底部还配备了顶级的“地板孔洞”。那是用来拍漂亮照片的，绝不是用来瞄准任何爆炸物的。老实说。

s: A top of the line habitat meant for long-term operations. Typically after the initial 'colonists' made their situation more 'permanent' with a bit of lithobreaking. Features cabins, food preparation areas, sofas, space loos, and even a home gym.
zh: 用于长期运营的顶级居住舱。通常是在最初的“殖民者”通过一点点“岩石制动”让他们的处境变得更加“永久”之后使用。配备舱室、备餐区、沙发、太空厕所，甚至还有一个家庭健身房。

s: Made from the finest materials at hand, these flight surfaces are guaranteed to operate while attached to the craft. However, studies have shown that a lack of atmosphere *may* slightly impede function. No refunds.
zh: 由手头最好的材料制成，这些飞行操纵面保证在安装到飞行器上时可以正常工作。然而，研究表明缺乏大气层*可能*会稍微影响其功能。概不退款。

s: Lets face it, we've all tried ditching a plane in the water. Doesn't always go too well, does it? That's where the LF-01B comes in. Big and empty, the LF-01B is excellent at displacing fluids and bobbing around in the water.
zh: 面对现实吧，我们都尝试过将飞机迫降在水面上。结果并不总是很理想，对吧？这就是 <<M0>> 大显身手的地方了。体积大且内部空旷，<<M0>> 非常擅长排水并在水中漂浮。

s: Less 'high tech spaceship part', more 'we spent the budget on food and this was the only thing we could find lying around'. The designers did manage to add a smaller sub-tank for oxidiser, although the words 'plastic bag - Oxidiser goes here' can be seen on the blueprints.
zh: 与其说是“高科技航天器部件”，不如说是“我们把预算花在买吃的上了，这是我们唯一能在周围找到的闲置东西”。设计师确实设法添加了一个较小的氧化剂副罐，尽管图纸上能看到“塑料袋——氧化剂放这里”的字样。

s: The NK15 is a cheaper, down-graded of the NK-15V. While this would normally make things far more boring, we've strapped a whole load of them together; although the engine block has been varyingly described as "Dangerously unstable", "A disaster waiting to happen" and "Sheer munacy".
zh: <<M0>> 是 <<M1>> 的廉价降级版。虽然这通常会让事情变得极其无聊，但我们把一大堆发动机绑在了一起；尽管这个发动机组曾被不同人描述为“极度不稳定”、“注定要发生的灾难”和“纯粹的坎星疯癫”。

s: A young kerbal by the name of Flashheart's idea, splended young chap, bit boisterous, but he'll go far. Said that the problem with probes is that they're boring, don't go fast enough. Or 'hard enough' apparently, whatever he meant by that.
zh: 来自一位名叫 Flashheart 的年轻坎巴拉人的点子，挺棒的小伙子，虽然有点闹腾，但前途无量。他说探测器的问题在于太无聊，飞得不够快。据说还不够“硬核”，天知道他是啥意思。

s: It was initially a 455, it got dropped. Now it's better, it fulfils a niche and probably also leverages synergies. The responsible kerbals were still fired of course. To our knowledge, they haven't landed yet.
zh: 最初它是个 455 型，后来掉地上了。现在它更好了，填补了市场空白，可能还发挥了协同效应。当然，相关负责人还是被开除了。据我们所知，他们到现在还没着陆。

s: This wheel for the little yellow trucks; with a tiny combined power unit, retardation device and very limited vector control it gives just enough movement for you not to have to push....much [Make sure the wheel is oriented correctly. The arrows should be down and the shocks vertical.]
zh: 用于小型黄色卡车的车轮；配备微型动力单元、减速装置和极其有限的矢量转向，提供的动力刚好够你不用死命去推……太费劲。[请确保车轮朝向正确。箭头应朝下，减震器应垂直。]

s: While the Kerbals at Mission Control were still figuring out how to get their rockets back down to Kerbin safely, the research engineers at FLOOYD were quickly realising that protecting parts on ascent was just as important. Heavy research into two-dimensional-input driven procedural construction was then funded with the hopes of making protective shells for important payloads and interstage areas of the crafts. The protective shells also have the benefit of making the craft more aerodynamic, hopefully saving on precious rocket fuel! The AE-FF0 is the smallest size available from FLOOYD.
zh: 当任务控制中心的坎巴拉人还在琢磨如何让火箭安全返回 Kerbin 时，FLOOYD 的研究工程师们就已意识到在上升段保护部件同样重要。为此投入巨资深入研究由二维输入驱动的程序化构建技术，希望能为重要载荷和飞船级间区域制作保护外壳。保护壳还能改善飞船的气动外形，有望节省宝贵的火箭燃料！AE-FF0 是 FLOOYD 提供的最小尺寸型号。

s: While the Kerbals at Mission Control were still figuring out how to get their rockets back down to Kerbin safely, the research engineers at FLOOYD were quickly realising that protecting parts on ascent was just as important. Heavy research into two-dimensional-input driven procedural construction was then funded with the hopes of making protective shells for important payloads and interstage areas of the crafts. The protective shells also have the benefit of making the craft more aerodynamic, hopefully saving on precious rocket fuel! The AE-FF5 is the largest size available from FLOOYD.
zh: 当任务控制中心的坎巴拉人还在琢磨如何让火箭安全返回 Kerbin 时，FLOOYD 的研究工程师们就已意识到在上升段保护部件同样重要。为此投入巨资深入研究由二维输入驱动的程序化构建技术，希望能为重要载荷和飞船级间区域制作保护外壳。保护壳还能改善飞船的气动外形，有望节省宝贵的火箭燃料！AE-FF5 是 FLOOYD 提供的最大尺寸型号。

s: Originally set up to spite Rockomax and Kerbodyne, the KDB has since build a number of 'interesting' rockets. While now a shadow of its former self, the KDB still possesses vast stores of rocket parts and a desire to re-gain their former glory.
zh: KDB 最初成立是为了与 Rockomax 和坎巴拉动力叫板，此后制造了许多“有趣”的火箭。尽管如今已风光不再，但 KDB 仍拥有庞大的火箭部件储备，并渴望重现昔日的辉煌。

s: AS&R Engineering are perhaps more concerned with the consumption of intoxicating beverages and discussig how good things used to be, rather than actually doing rocket science. However, their easy going attitude and complete obliviousness to losses has allowed several promising young kerbals to rise to prominence.
zh: AS&R 工程公司似乎更热衷于畅饮酒精饮料并感叹往昔的美好时光，而不是正经搞火箭科学。然而，他们随性的态度和对损失的彻底无视，反而让几位前途无量的年轻坎巴拉人崭露头角。

s: Not to be out-done by Rockomax's Mainsail, the decision was made within the KDB to build a yet bigger engine. Finding that the explosion to launch ratio of a single combustion chamber was uncomfortably close to 1:0; a shift to a 4 combustion chamber design and a sadly more stable and less efficient liquid fuel was required.
zh: 为了不被极限火箭集团的“主帆”比下去，KDB 决定制造一款更庞大的发动机。在发现单燃烧室的爆炸与发射比令人尴尬地接近 1:0 之后，设计被迫转向四燃烧室方案，并遗憾地换用了更稳定但比冲更低的液体燃料。

s: The largest tank ever built by the KDB, and the ultimate outcome of their 'Not One Step Smaller' design philosophy. Although this later turned out to be intended as a front to channel ever increasing funds towards the snack-related habits of the Bureau's board, the damage had already been done and vast warehouses have been left filled with rockets, rather than snacks.
zh: KDB 有史以来建造的最大储罐，也是其“绝不缩小一步”设计理念的终极产物。尽管事后证明这不过是个幌子，目的是为局董事会与点心相关的嗜好筹集越来越多的资金，但大错已经铸成，巨大的仓库里堆满了火箭，而不是点心。

s: The Ke-111 is billed as a 'high-visibility' cockpit for tourist carrying craft; some observers have, however, questioned the purpose of the 'Gravity Assisted Ordinance Delivery Scope' mounted near the co-pilot's seat.
zh: <<M0>> 被宣传为载客飞行器的“高能见度”座舱；然而，一些观察家对副驾驶座椅旁安装的“重力辅助弹药投放瞄准镜”的用途提出了质疑。

s: The KDB's contender for a 2.5m orbital rocket engine. While less powerful that Rockomax's "Poodle", its lower profile and strengthened casing does make it easier to land on if you happen to forget your landing legs.
zh: KDB 进军 2.5 米轨道火箭发动机领域的竞争作品。虽然功率不及极限火箭集团的“贵宾犬”，但其更低矮的外形和加固的外壳，能让你在碰巧忘记装着陆支架时更容易直接用它着陆。

s: The L.A.N.C.E.R. is the result of the continuing joint venture between C7 Aerospace and the Rockomax Conglomerate. Designed to fill a gap in the design requirements for large, sustainable single-stage-to-orbit aircraft, this engine combines the best of rocket and air-breathing thrust technology.
zh: L.A.N.C.E.R. 是 C7 Aerospace 与极限火箭集团持续合作的结晶。为填补大型、可持续单级入轨飞行器的设计需求空白而生，该发动机融合了火箭与吸气式推力技术的精髓。

s: While similar to the Mk2 Lander Can internally, it offers a ruggedised casing and better crash resistance, plus handy EVA handgrips (pun intended). However, smaller and less powerful reaction wheels had to be mounted to compensate.
zh: 虽然内部与 Mk2着陆舱 相似，但它提供了加固外壳和更好的耐撞性，外加方便的 EVA 扶手（字面意思上的好上手）。不过，为了平衡重量，只能安装更小、功率更弱的动量轮。

s: The TT06-A Stability Enhancer uses ground-breaking fastening technology to significantly increase the stability of spacecraft during the pre-launch phase. While OMB Demolition has been criticized in the past for using "big fancy words for a rocket holder" in their description of their device, none can say the TT18 series doesn't deliver rock-solid clamping action, as advertised. The owner's manual strongly suggests these devices be placed on the bottommost section of the spacecraft, and activated as soon as the engines are lit, for optimal de-clamping performance.
zh: <<M0>>-A 稳定性增强器采用突破性的紧固技术，可显著提高航天器在发射前的稳定性。虽然 OMB Demolition 过去曾因在设备描述中使用“火箭支架的华丽辞藻”而饱受批评，但不可否认的是，<<M1>> 系列确实如宣传的那样提供了坚如磐石的夹持效果。使用手册强烈建议将这些装置安装在航天器的最底部，并在发动机点火时立即启动以实现最佳的脱钩分离性能。

s: A generic Mk1 to Mk2 adapter that was almost sheared in two. We had to weld some intakes to it so it wouldn't fall apart. Erm, ahem, I mean we added intakes for extra utility and its structural integrity is second to none.
zh: 一个几乎被剪切成两半的通用 Mk1 转 Mk2 适配器。我们不得不给它焊上一些进气道以免它彻底散架。呃，咳咳，我的意思是，我们添加进气道是为了增加多功能性，其结构强度更是无与伦比。

s: A linear aerospike consists of a tapered wedge-shaped plate, with exhaust exiting on either side at the "thick" end. This design has the advantage of being stackable, allowing several smaller engines to be placed in a row to make one larger engine while allowing steering through the use of individual engine throttle control.
zh: 线性气动塞式发动机由一块锥形楔形板构成，排气从“厚”端的两侧喷出。该设计的优点在于可堆叠性，允许将多台较小的发动机排成一排组成一台大发动机，同时可通过控制各发动机的节流阀实现转向。

s: While lacking the specialised pitch authority of the drone core, these wheels do provide more lateral and roll control. The lack of an AI also makes this 95% less murderous. We're still investigating what's causing that other 5%.
zh: 虽然缺乏无人机核心专用的俯仰控制权限，但这些动量轮确实提供了更强的偏航与滚转控制能力。由于没有 AI，它的杀伤倾向也降低了 95%。我们目前仍在调查剩下 5% 的原因。

s: Repeat after me tovarisch, 'This is not to make giant waffles; this is for rockets'. The grid fin is an array of small aerodynamic surfaces, arranged in a lattice, reducing the torque placed on the control mechanism at high-speeds and allowing for a more compact control system. They perform well at sub- and super-sonic speeds, but poorly at the tran-sonic region
zh: 跟我念，同志：“这不是用来做巨型华夫饼的，这是给火箭用的”。网格舵是由小面积空气动力面排列而成的晶格结构，可减少高速下施加在控制机构上的扭矩，从而使控制系统更加紧凑。它们在亚音速和超音速下表现优异，但在跨音速区域性能较差。

s: The original, slightly 'explody' prototype NERVA rocket. While this design was successfully miniaturised to make the popular LV-N "Nerv", the prototype boasts a marginally higher ISP due to a larger engine nozzle.
zh: 最初略带“易爆”属性的原型 NERVA 火箭。虽然该设计后来成功小型化为广受欢迎的 LV-N“涅槃”，但原型机由于拥有更大的发动机喷管，其比冲略高一筹。

s: The "Fat Mun" series is based off the dozens of spare nuclear reactors the KSC has recently acquired. This not related to a report stating that nuclear reactors are 'not a suitable alternative central heating'.
zh: “胖坎”系列是基于 KSC 最近获得的数十台备用核反应堆开发的。这绝不代表某份声称核反应堆“不适合替代集中供暖”的报告属实。

s: The LV-NRJ is a Nuclear Ram-Jet, utilizing an unshielded nuclear reactor to heat incoming air. While it does not require fuel, it will need boosting to a suitable velocity before becoming effective. Despite being the result of many years of very expensive research, we're not entirely certain of the side-effects of using the engine - every scientist on the project has since turned a slightly more luminescent shade of green and expired.
zh: LV-NRJ 是一款核冲压发动机，利用无屏蔽核反应堆加热吸入的空气。虽然它不需要燃料，但需要助推到合适的速度后才能生效。尽管这是多年昂贵研究的成果，但我们并不完全确定使用该发动机的副作用——该项目中的每位科学家后来都变成了略带发光的绿色，然后就去世了。

s: You know that moment when you realise the design for the new centrifuge didn't have that zero in. Yeah, that. Genuinely surprised no-one got fired. An uncharacteristic foray into long-term habitation modules from C7 Aerospace, this centrifuge is most certainly the result of years of careful planning and analysis...definitely, not the result of an accidental bulk order of Mk2 crew cabins.
zh: 你知道意识到新离心机图纸上少了个零的那一刻是什么感觉吗。对，就是那样。真惊讶居然没人被开除。作为 C7 Aerospace 在长期居住舱领域的罕见尝试，这款离心机绝对是多年精心规划和分析的产物……绝不是不小心批量订购了 Mk2 乘员舱的结果。

s: Kerbodyne's experimental ultra-heavy fuel tank. Do not smash a champagne bottle against the side. We did that once when launching a ship; it made a dent that would later lead to a catastrophic unplanned disassembly.
zh: 坎巴拉动力的实验性超重型燃料罐。千万别把香槟瓶砸在侧面。我们发射飞船时就干过一次；砸出的凹痕后来导致了灾难性的意外解体。

s: Initially built due to a mis-read procurement form, the TVR-1600XXL units now take up a large portion of O.M.B.'s storage floor-space. It is now being sold under a variety of names, including 'My First Quintuple Adaptor' and 'Self Assembly Pool', in order to clear the stock. Converts a single 5m stack into four 2.5m stacks. #LOC.SXT_SXTSaturnV2Engine_manufacturer = SXT
zh: 最初因看错采购单而制造的 <<M0>> 部件，如今占据了 O.M.B. 大量的仓储地面空间。为了清库存，它现在以“我的第一个五重适配器”和“拼装式泳池”等各种名字出售。将单根 5 米柱段转换为四根 2.5 米柱段。#LOC.<<M1>> = SXT

s: The J-414 "Jaguar" is a innovative (i.e. massively over budget) derivation of the J-404; featuring the ability to pivot 90 degrees to provide either excellent VTOL capability or put the craft into a massive tumble.
zh: <<M0>>“美洲虎”是 <<M1>> 的创新（即严重超支）衍生型号；具备旋转 90 度的能力，既能提供出色的垂直起降能力，也能让飞行器陷入剧烈的翻滚。

s: UR-500/Proton third stage main engine, used with RD-0214 verniers to form the RD-0212 engine module. AKA 8D48
zh: <<M0>>/质子号三级主发动机，与 <<M1>> 游标发动机组合构成 <<M2>> 发动机舱。亦称 8D48

s: UDMH/LOX version of RD-0213. Much higher performance, but requires cryogenic fuels.
zh: <<M0>> 的偏二甲肼/液氧版本。性能大幅提升，但需要低温燃料。

s: Uprated RD-0213 to allow Proton to launch Salyut 6/7 and Mir.
zh: <<M0>> 的升级型号，使质子号能够发射礼炮 6/7 号和和平号空间站。

s: UDMH/LOX version of RD-0213 Mk-2. Much higher performance, but requires cryogenic fuels.
zh: <<M0>> <<M1>> 的偏二甲肼/液氧版本。性能大幅提升，但需要低温燃料。

s: UDMH/LOX version of RD-0213 Mk-3. Much higher performance, but requires cryogenic fuels.
zh: <<M0>> <<M1>> 的偏二甲肼/液氧版本。性能大幅提升，但需要低温燃料。

s: UR-200 second stage verniers, used with RD-0206 main engine to form the RD-0205 engine module. AKA 8D67
zh: <<M0>> 二级游标发动机，与 <<M1>> 主发动机组合构成 <<M2>> 发动机舱。亦称 8D67

s: UDMH/LOX version of RD-0207. Much higher performance, but requires cryogenic fuels.
zh: <<M0>> 的偏二甲肼/液氧版本。性能大幅提升，但需要低温燃料。

s: UR-500/Proton third stage verniers, used with RD-0213 main engine to form the RD-0212 engine module. AKA 8D811
zh: <<M0>>/质子号三级游标发动机，与 <<M1>> 主发动机组合构成 <<M2>> 发动机舱。亦称 8<<M3>>

s: UDMH/LOX version of RD-0214. Much higher performance, but requires cryogenic fuels.
zh: <<M0>> 的偏二甲肼/液氧版本。性能大幅提升，但需要低温燃料。

s: Used on the UR-100 first stage. Three RD-0216 and one RD-0217 make up a 15D2 engine block.
zh: 用于 <<M0>> 一级。三台 <<M1>> 和一台 <<M2>> 组成 15D2 发动机组。

s: Used on Blok I and II of the LK-700, alongside KTDU-416 verniers.
zh: 用于 <<M0>> 的 Blok I 和 Blok II 级，配合 <<M1>> 游标发动机使用。

s: Used on the UR-100N second stage, with a RD-0236 vernier engine. A.K.A. 15D113
zh: 用于 <<M0>> 二级，配合一台 <<M1>> 游标发动机使用。亦称 15<<M2>>

s: Second stage engine module of R-36M and R-36MUTTKh, consisting of a RD-0229 main engine and RD-0230 vernier. AKA 15D84
zh: <<M0>> 和 <<M1>> 的二级发动机舱，由一台 <<M2>> 主发动机和 <<M3>> 游标发动机组成。亦称 15D84

s: Second stage engine module of R-36M2 and Dnepr, consisting of a RD-0256 main engine and RD-0257 vernier.
zh: <<M0>> 和第聂伯号的二级发动机舱，由一台 <<M1>> 主发动机和 <<M2>> 游标发动机组成。

s: Second stage main engine of R-36M and R-36MUTTKh. AKA 15D79
zh: <<M0>> 和 <<M1>> 的二级主发动机。亦称 15D79

s: Second stage main engine of R-36M2 and Dnepr.
zh: <<M0>> 和第聂伯号的二级主发动机。

s: Second stage verniers of R-36M and R-36MUTTKh. AKA 15D83

s: The SC-10k may be just a fancy cupboard and some 'science' stuff but, hey, it's cheap and it'll keep your Kerbals occupied while you file the space program's tax returns. Recommended for ages 12-16. Cheap production makes it unsuitable for concerned parents.
zh: <<M0>>可能只是个花哨的橱柜加上一些“科学”小玩意，但是，嘿，它便宜啊！而且能在你为航天计划报税时代替你给坎巴拉人找点事做。建议适用年龄：12-16岁。低成本生产使其不太适合谨小慎微的家长。

s: Studies conducted by Probodobodyne Inc have found that today's youth consider mono-propellent engines to be quote 'totally main-stream, uncool, and Grandpa Bill always talks about how Mono-propellent engines saved his butt in the first Mun landing, ugh what is with all of these questions?!'. Upon being bribed for further information, the participants revealed that xenon-powered ion engines were the current trending item. So, in an effort to reach out to the youth and more importantly increase sales, the JKSS has had a tank of xenon crammed inside of it. Solar panels and ion engine sold separately.
zh: 探测动力有限公司的研究表明，当今年轻人认为单组元推进剂发动机“太主流了，一点也不酷，比尔爷爷总在念叨第一次Mun着陆时单组元推进剂发动机怎么救了他的小命，呃怎么总问这些烦人问题？！”。在收受好处后，受访者透露氙动力离子发动机才是当下的流行风向。因此，为了迎合年轻人，更为了提升销量，JKSS内部被硬塞进了一个氙气罐。太阳能电池板和离子发动机单独出售。

s: You'll want to add a TR-2C or TR-2V miniture stack decoupler to the top of this. The Descent stage's primary job is to support a powered landing and surface extravehicular activity. When the excursion is over, it serves as the launch pad for the ascent stage. It also carries a Surface Experiment Package and has some room for KIS storage.
zh: 你需要在其顶部安装一个<<M0>>或<<M1>>微型层叠分离器。下降级的主要任务是支持动力着陆以及地表舱外活动。野外考察结束后，它将作为上升级的发射台。它还携带了地面试验组件，并留有一些KIS储存空间。

s: The Ascent stage houses the crew cabin with instrument panels and flight controls. It contains its own Ascent Propulsion System (APS) engine and propellant tanks for return to munar orbit and rendezvous with the Command/Service Module. It also contains a Reaction Control System (RCS) for attitude and translation control. A forward EVA hatch provides access to and from the munar surface, while an overhead docking port provides access to and from the Command Module.
zh: 上升级包含带有仪表盘和飞行控制系统的乘员舱。它配有独立的上升推进系统（APS）发动机与推进剂储罐，用于返回Mun轨道并与指令/服务舱交会。它还配备了用于姿态和平移控制的反应控制系统（RCS）。前部EVA舱口提供往返Mun表面的通道，顶部的对接口提供往返指令舱的通道。

s: A long time ago a Kerbal said “Give me a place to stand and with a lever I will move the whole world” - while he turned out to be frothing mad, the principle still applies. STEADLER have mounted a RV-105 RCS block on a boom to provide a larger moment for rotation.
zh: 很久以前，一位坎巴拉人曾说：“给我一个支点，一根杠杆，我就能撬起整个世界”——虽然他后来被证实彻底疯了，但原理依然成立。STEADLER将一个<<M0>> RCS喷口块安装在桁架末端，以提供更大的旋转力矩。

s: Developed in partnership with the Kerbodyne, the SC-XL10 project ran into no difficulties and proceeded entirely without incident. There was no fraud, no explosions and everything went fine. STEADLER would like to remind anyone that might say otherwise that STEADLER is currently working on an organic super-computer and is in need of 'spares'.
zh: 与坎巴拉动力合作开发的SC-<<M0>>项目没有遇到任何困难，全程毫无意外。没有欺诈，没有爆炸，一切都很顺利。STEADLER想提醒任何可能持有异议的人：STEADLER目前正在研发一台有机超级计算机，并且急需“备件”。

s: Initially built due to a mis-read procurement form, the TVR-1600XXL units now take up a large portion of O.M.B.'s storage floor-space. It is now being sold under a variety of names, including 'My First Quad Adapter' and 'Self assembly pool', in order to clear the stock. Converts a single 5m stack into four 2.5m stacks.
zh: 由于看错了采购单，最初制造出来的<<M0>>部件如今占用了O.M.B.大量的仓储地面空间。为了清库存，它现在以各种名称出售，包括“我的第一个四联适配器”和“自装式泳池”。可将单路5m层叠结构转换为四路2.5m层叠结构。

s: A fuelled nosecone for Kerbodyne's experimental ultra-heavy fuel tank. While the KDB argues that Kerbodyne stole the design from them, Kerbodyne has reminded them that they can de-orbit space stations; and are getting very good at calculating where they land.
zh: 专为坎巴拉动力的实验型超重型燃料箱设计的带燃料鼻锥。尽管KDB指责坎巴拉动力剽窃了他们的设计，但坎巴拉动力提醒他们：自己有能力让空间站离轨，而且越来越擅长计算它们的坠落着陆点了。

s: The airlock was designed shortly after the term 'Explosive Decompression' was coined. It allows Kerbals to move from the interior of the vessel to the exterior without a great change in internal pressure.
zh: 该气闸舱是在“爆发性减压”一词诞生后不久设计的。它允许坎巴拉人从飞船内部进出飞船外部，而不会引起内部压力的剧烈变化。

s: The QUBC is the first and final project of the Synergistic Integration Sub-Committee of Probodobodyne Inc. While lacking SAS and reaction wheels, it does feature integrated solar panels and antenna systems. The SISC was shutdown after key figures were found to be 'Synergising' company funds with their personal expense accounts.
zh: QUBC是探测动力有限公司协同集成小组委员会的第一个也是最后一个项目。虽然缺少SAS和动量轮，但它确实集成了太阳能电池板和天线系统。在主要核心人员被发现将公司资金与个人报销账户“协同化”之后，该委员会被关停。

s: Although far more delicate and with slightly less fuel capacity for its size than the X200-32, it does boast a lower dry mass per fuel tonne. Perfect for orbital missions. Not recommended for landings.
zh: 虽然比<<M0>>-32精细脆弱得多，且同等体积下的燃料容量略低，但它确实拥有更低的每吨燃料干重。非常适合轨道任务。不建议用于着陆。

s: Although far more delicate and with slightly less fuel capacity for its size than the X200-32, it does boast a lower dry mass per fuel tonne. This version, while it can be configured for different fuels, only has a single tank. Perfect for orbital missions. Not recommended for landings.
zh: 虽然比<<M0>>-32精细脆弱得多，且同等体积下的燃料容量略低，但它确实拥有更低的每吨燃料干重。该版本虽然可以配置不同的燃料，但仅包含一个储罐。非常适合轨道任务。不建议用于着陆。

s: Pip pip, old boy! Light, cheap and packing a not inconsiderable punch, the Black Adder-8 certainly offers 'bang for buck', as the chaps over at the KSC say. Perfect for a budding space program, although quickly outclassed by more high-tech engines.
zh: 加油，老兄！黑蝰-8轻便、廉价且动力相当可观，正如KSC的那帮家伙所说，绝对“物超所值”。非常适合起步阶段的航天计划，尽管很快就会被更先进的高科技发动机淘汰。

s: Built with spares from the BA-8. Well, we had to do something, they really were just cluttering the place up. Does make it cheaper than pesky Rockomax's 48-7S. And we have two nozzles, more is always better.
zh: 由<<M0>>的剩余备件拼凑而成。好吧，我们总得做点什么，它们堆在那里实在太碍事了。这确实让它比搞乱市场的Rockomax 48-7S更便宜。而且我们有两个喷嘴，多总是更好的。

s: Built with completely peaceful motives, nothing else. Features a rear seat to allow for a scientist or engineer to accompany the pilot and a top of the range 'hole in the floor'. That's for taking pretty pictures, not aiming anything explosive. Honest.
zh: 完全出于和平目的制造，绝无其他。后座可容纳一名科学家或工程师协助飞行员，机底还配备了顶级的“地板孔洞”。那是用来拍漂亮风景照的，不是用来瞄准爆炸物的。说实话。

s: A top of the line habitat meant for long-term operations. Typically after the initial 'colonists' made their situation more 'permanent' with a bit of lithobreaking. Features cabins, food preparation areas, sofas, space loos, and even a home gym.
zh: 用于长期运营的顶级居住舱。通常是在最初的“殖民者”通过一点点撞地减速使他们的处境变得更“永久化”之后派上用场。配有卧舱、备餐区、沙发、太空厕所，甚至还有一个家庭健身房。

s: Made from the finest materials at hand, these flight surfaces are guaranteed to operate while attached to the craft. However, studies have shown that a lack of atmosphere *may* slightly impede function. No refunds.
zh: 这些飞行操纵面采用手头能找到的最好材料制成，保证在安装到飞行器上时正常运作。不过研究表明，缺乏大气层“可能”会稍微影响其性能。概不退款。

s: Lets face it, we've all tried ditching a plane in the water. Doesn't always go too well, does it? That's where the LF-01B comes in. Big and empty, the LF-01B is excellent at displacing fluids and bobbing around in the water.
zh: 面对现实吧，我们都试过把飞机迫降在水面上。结果往往不尽如人意，对吧？这就是<<M0>>大显身手的地方了。<<M0>>又大又空，排水性能极佳，非常适合在水里浮浮沉沉。

s: Less 'high tech spaceship part', more 'we spent the budget on food and this was the only thing we could find lying around'. The designers did manage to add a smaller sub-tank for oxidiser, although the words 'plastic bag - Oxidiser goes here' can be seen on the blueprints.
zh: 比起“高科技飞船部件”，它更像是“我们把预算全花在吃上了，这是身边唯一能翻出来的废料”。设计师们确实设法塞进了一个较小的氧化剂副油箱，尽管蓝图上还清楚写着“塑料袋——氧化剂装在这里”。

s: The NK15 is a cheaper, down-graded of the NK-15V. While this would normally make things far more boring, we've strapped a whole load of them together; although the engine block has been varyingly described as "Dangerously unstable", "A disaster waiting to happen" and "Sheer munacy".
zh: <<M0>>是<<M1>>的低配降级版本。虽然这通常会让事情变得极其无聊，但我们把一大捆这玩意绑在了一起；尽管这个发动机组曾被不同人描述为“危险的不稳定源”、“行走的灾难”以及“纯粹的疯狂”。

s: A young kerbal by the name of Flashheart's idea, splended young chap, bit boisterous, but he'll go far. Said that the problem with probes is that they're boring, don't go fast enough. Or 'hard enough' apparently, whatever he meant by that.
zh: 一位名叫 Flashheart 的年轻坎巴拉人的点子，真是个出色的小伙子，虽然有点闹腾，但前途无量。他说探测器的问题在于太无聊，飞得不够快。或者显然是“不够硬核”，管他到底是什么意思。

s: It was initially a 455, it got dropped. Now it's better, it fulfils a niche and probably also leverages synergies. The responsible kerbals were still fired of course. To our knowledge, they haven't landed yet.
zh: 它最初是个 455 型，后来掉地上摔了。现在它变得更棒了，填补了一处利基市场，大概还能发挥协同效应。当然，相关负责人还是被开除了。据我们所知，他们目前还没着陆。

s: This wheel for the little yellow trucks; with a tiny combined power unit, retardation device and very limited vector control it gives just enough movement for you not to have to push....much [Make sure the wheel is oriented correctly. The arrows should be down and the shocks vertical.]
zh: 用于黄色小卡车的车轮；配备了微型一体化动力单元、减速装置和极其有限的矢量转向控制，动力刚好够你不用使劲推……太久。[请确保车轮朝向正确。箭头应朝下，减震器应垂直。]

s: While the Kerbals at Mission Control were still figuring out how to get their rockets back down to Kerbin safely, the research engineers at FLOOYD were quickly realising that protecting parts on ascent was just as important. Heavy research into two-dimensional-input driven procedural construction was then funded with the hopes of making protective shells for important payloads and interstage areas of the crafts. The protective shells also have the benefit of making the craft more aerodynamic, hopefully saving on precious rocket fuel! The AE-FF0 is the smallest size available from FLOOYD.
zh: 当任务控制中心的坎巴拉人还在琢磨如何让火箭安全返回 Kerbin 时，FLOOYD 的研究工程师们很快意识到上升段保护部件同样重要。随后他们资助了关于二维输入驱动程序化构建的大量研究，希望能为飞行器的关键有效载荷和级间段打造保护外壳。保护外壳还能改善飞行器的空气动力学性能，有望节省宝贵的火箭燃料。AE-FF0 是 FLOOYD 提供的最小尺寸规格。

s: While the Kerbals at Mission Control were still figuring out how to get their rockets back down to Kerbin safely, the research engineers at FLOOYD were quickly realising that protecting parts on ascent was just as important. Heavy research into two-dimensional-input driven procedural construction was then funded with the hopes of making protective shells for important payloads and interstage areas of the crafts. The protective shells also have the benefit of making the craft more aerodynamic, hopefully saving on precious rocket fuel! The AE-FF5 is the largest size available from FLOOYD.
zh: 当任务控制中心的坎巴拉人还在琢磨如何让火箭安全返回 Kerbin 时，FLOOYD 的研究工程师们很快意识到上升段保护部件同样重要。随后他们资助了关于二维输入驱动程序化构建的大量研究，希望能为飞行器的关键有效载荷和级间段打造保护外壳。保护外壳还能改善飞行器的空气动力学性能，有望节省宝贵的火箭燃料。AE-FF5 是 FLOOYD 提供的最大尺寸规格。

s: Originally set up to spite Rockomax and Kerbodyne, the KDB has since build a number of 'interesting' rockets. While now a shadow of its former self, the KDB still possesses vast stores of rocket parts and a desire to re-gain their former glory.
zh: KDB 最初成立是为了与洛克马克斯和坎巴拉动力赌气，自那以后制造了许多“有趣”的火箭。尽管如今辉煌不再，KDB 依然拥有庞大的火箭部件库存，并渴望重现往日荣光。

s: AS&R Engineering are perhaps more concerned with the consumption of intoxicating beverages and discussig how good things used to be, rather than actually doing rocket science. However, their easy going attitude and complete obliviousness to losses has allowed several promising young kerbals to rise to prominence.
zh: AS&R Engineering 似乎更热衷于饮酒狂欢并回忆往昔多么美好，而不是认真做火箭科学研究。然而，他们随和的态度以及对损失的完全漠视，反而让几位前途无量的年轻坎巴拉人脱颖而出。

zh: 这将监视当前活动飞行轨迹以检测下一次 SOI 变更。

s: Not to be out-done by Rockomax's Mainsail, the decision was made within the KDB to build a yet bigger engine. Finding that the explosion to launch ratio of a single combustion chamber was uncomfortably close to 1:0; a shift to a 4 combustion chamber design and a sadly more stable and less efficient liquid fuel was required.
zh: 为了不被极限火箭集团的“主帆”比下去，KDB决定建造一款尺寸更大的发动机。但他们发现单燃烧室的爆炸与发射比例令人不安地接近1:0；于是只得转向四燃烧室构型，并遗憾地换用了更稳定但比冲较低的液体燃料。

s: The largest tank ever built by the KDB, and the ultimate outcome of their 'Not One Step Smaller' design philosophy. Although this later turned out to be intended as a front to channel ever increasing funds towards the snack-related habits of the Bureau's board, the damage had already been done and vast warehouses have been left filled with rockets, rather than snacks.
zh: KDB有史以来建造的最大储罐，也是其“绝不缩减一分”设计理念的终极成果。尽管后来证明该项目只是个幌子，旨在为局董事会与点心相关的恶习筹集更多资金，但木已成舟，如今巨大的仓库里塞满的只有火箭，而不是点心。

s: The Ke-111 is billed as a 'high-visibility' cockpit for tourist carrying craft; some observers have, however, questioned the purpose of the 'Gravity Assisted Ordinance Delivery Scope' mounted near the co-pilot's seat.
zh: <<M0>>被称为面向载客飞行器的“高视野”座舱；然而，一些观察者对副驾驶座位旁安装的“重力辅助弹药投放瞄准镜”之用途提出了质疑。

s: The KDB's contender for a 2.5m orbital rocket engine. While less powerful that Rockomax's "Poodle", its lower profile and strengthened casing does make it easier to land on if you happen to forget your landing legs.
zh: KDB用于竞争2.5米轨道火箭发动机市场的选手。虽然推力不如极限火箭集团的“贵宾犬”，但其低矮的外形和加固的外壳让你在偶然忘记带上着陆腿时，能更容易直接用它着陆。

s: The L.A.N.C.E.R. is the result of the continuing joint venture between C7 Aerospace and the Rockomax Conglomerate. Designed to fill a gap in the design requirements for large, sustainable single-stage-to-orbit aircraft, this engine combines the best of rocket and air-breathing thrust technology.
zh: L.A.N.C.E.R.是C7航空与极限火箭集团持续合资的产物。旨在填补大型可持续单级入轨飞行器的设计需求空白，该发动机融合了火箭与吸气式推力技术的顶尖优势。

s: While similar to the Mk2 Lander Can internally, it offers a ruggedised casing and better crash resistance, plus handy EVA handgrips (pun intended). However, smaller and less powerful reaction wheels had to be mounted to compensate.
zh: 虽然内部与Mk2着陆舱相似，但它提供了加固外壳和更强的耐撞击性，并配备了方便的EVA扶手。不过作为代价，只能安装尺寸更小、控制力更弱的动量轮。

s: The TT06-A Stability Enhancer uses ground-breaking fastening technology to significantly increase the stability of spacecraft during the pre-launch phase. While OMB Demolition has been criticized in the past for using "big fancy words for a rocket holder" in their description of their device, none can say the TT18 series doesn't deliver rock-solid clamping action, as advertised. The owner's manual strongly suggests these devices be placed on the bottommost section of the spacecraft, and activated as soon as the engines are lit, for optimal de-clamping performance.
zh: <<M0>>-A稳定性增强器利用开创性的紧固技术，可显著提升航天器在发射前的稳定性。虽然OMB爆破公司过去曾因在设备描述中“把火箭固定架说得天花乱坠”而受到批评，但没人能否认<<M1>>系列确实如广告宣传的那样提供了坚如磐石的夹持效果。使用手册强烈建议将这些设备安装在航天器的最底部，并在发动机点火的瞬间将其激活脱开，以获得最佳解脱性能。

s: A generic Mk1 to Mk2 adapter that was almost sheared in two. We had to weld some intakes to it so it wouldn't fall apart. Erm, ahem, I mean we added intakes for extra utility and its structural integrity is second to none.
zh: 一个几乎断成两截的通用Mk1转Mk2适配器。我们不得不给它焊了几个进气口以防散架。呃，咳咳，我的意思是，我们添加进气口是为了拓展功能，其结构强度绝对首屈一指。

s: A linear aerospike consists of a tapered wedge-shaped plate, with exhaust exiting on either side at the "thick" end. This design has the advantage of being stackable, allowing several smaller engines to be placed in a row to make one larger engine while allowing steering through the use of individual engine throttle control.
zh: 线性气动塞式发动机由一块锥形楔板构成，废气在“厚”端两侧排出。该设计的优势在于可堆叠性，允许多个较小的发动机排成一列组合成一台更大的发动机，同时通过单独的发动机节流阀控制来实现转向。

s: While lacking the specialised pitch authority of the drone core, these wheels do provide more lateral and roll control. The lack of an AI also makes this 95% less murderous. We're still investigating what's causing that other 5%.
zh: 虽然缺乏无人机核心专用的俯仰控制权，但这些动量轮能提供更强的偏航与滚转控制。没有AI也使它的弑主几率降低了95%。我们目前仍在调查剩下5%的成因。

s: Repeat after me tovarisch, 'This is not to make giant waffles; this is for rockets'. The grid fin is an array of small aerodynamic surfaces, arranged in a lattice, reducing the torque placed on the control mechanism at high-speeds and allowing for a more compact control system. They perform well at sub- and super-sonic speeds, but poorly at the tran-sonic region
zh: 跟我念，同志：“这不是用来做巨型华夫饼的；这是给火箭用的。”网格舵是一组排列成网格状的小型气动面，能减少高速飞行时施加在控制机构上的扭矩，并允许采用更紧凑的控制系统。它们在亚音速和超音速下表现优异，但在跨音速区域性能较差。

s: The original, slightly 'explody' prototype NERVA rocket. While this design was successfully miniaturised to make the popular LV-N "Nerv", the prototype boasts a marginally higher ISP due to a larger engine nozzle.
zh: 最初略带“易爆”属性的原型NERVA火箭。虽然该设计后来成功小型化为广受欢迎的LV-N“涅槃”，但该原型由于拥有更大的发动机喷管，其比冲略胜一筹。

s: The "Fat Mun" series is based off the dozens of spare nuclear reactors the KSC has recently acquired. This not related to a report stating that nuclear reactors are 'not a suitable alternative central heating'.
zh: “肥胖坎球”系列基于KSC最近获得的数十个闲置核反应堆。这与一份声称核反应堆“不适合替代集中供热系统”的报告完全无关。

s: The LV-NRJ is a Nuclear Ram-Jet, utilizing an unshielded nuclear reactor to heat incoming air. While it does not require fuel, it will need boosting to a suitable velocity before becoming effective. Despite being the result of many years of very expensive research, we're not entirely certain of the side-effects of using the engine - every scientist on the project has since turned a slightly more luminescent shade of green and expired.
zh: LV-NRJ是一款核冲压发动机，利用无屏蔽核反应堆加热进入的空气。虽然它无需携带燃料，但需要助推至合适速度后才能发挥效能。尽管它是多年昂贵研究的成果，但我们并不完全确定使用该发动机的副作用——参与该项目的每位科学家后来肤色都泛出更显眼的荧光绿并撒手人寰。

s: You know that moment when you realise the design for the new centrifuge didn't have that zero in. Yeah, that. Genuinely surprised no-one got fired. An uncharacteristic foray into long-term habitation modules from C7 Aerospace, this centrifuge is most certainly the result of years of careful planning and analysis...definitely, not the result of an accidental bulk order of Mk2 crew cabins.
zh: 你肯定明白，当意识到新离心机的设计图上少画了一个零时的心情。没错，就是那样。真的惊讶居然没人被炒鱿鱼。作为C7航空向长期居住模块领域一次罕见的跨界尝试，这台离心机绝对是多年精心规划和分析的结晶……肯定不是手滑大批量误购Mk2乘员舱的产物。

s: Kerbodyne's experimental ultra-heavy fuel tank. Do not smash a champagne bottle against the side. We did that once when launching a ship; it made a dent that would later lead to a catastrophic unplanned disassembly.
zh: 坎巴拉动力的实验性超重型燃料罐。切勿在侧面砸香槟庆祝。我们在某次发射飞船时干过一次；它砸出的凹痕随后导致了一次灾难性的计划外解体。

s: Initially built due to a mis-read procurement form, the TVR-1600XXL units now take up a large portion of O.M.B.'s storage floor-space. It is now being sold under a variety of names, including 'My First Quintuple Adaptor' and 'Self Assembly Pool', in order to clear the stock. Converts a single 5m stack into four 2.5m stacks. #LOC.SXT_SXTSaturnV2Engine_manufacturer = SXT
zh: 最初因看错采购单而建造的<<M0>>单元，如今占据了O.M.B.仓库地面的大片空间。为了清理库存，它现在以各种名称出售，包括“我的第一个五向适配器”和“拼装式泳池”。可将单个5米构型转换为四个2.5米构型。#LOC.<<M1>> = SXT

s: The J-414 "Jaguar" is a innovative (i.e. massively over budget) derivation of the J-404; featuring the ability to pivot 90 degrees to provide either excellent VTOL capability or put the craft into a massive tumble.
zh: <<M0>>“美洲豹”是<<M1>>的一款创新（即严重超支）衍生型号；具备旋转90度的能力，既能提供卓越的VTOL能力，也能让飞行器陷入剧烈的翻滚翻覆之中。

s: A heavily modified version of an enthusiast grade pulse jet engine, it provides a surprisingly high thrust to weight ratio in addition to a lightning quick spool up time. Unfortunately, it drains your fuel faster than any other jet.
zh: 这款脉冲喷气发动机由爱好者级别的原型深度改装而来，不仅提供了惊人的高推重比，而且提速响应极快。遗憾的是，它的耗油速度比其他任何喷气发动机都要夸张。

s: After discovering the success of the RE-M3 and the RE-I5 rocket engines, the Rockomax Conglomerate created a new engine to bridge the gap between the two lines. This engine features a unique thrust vector system; instead of gimballing all of the engine nozzles, smaller thrust vectoring engines provide control while the larger sustainer's provide the rest of the thrust.
zh: 在见证了RE-M3和RE-I5火箭发动机的成功之后，极限火箭集团打造了一款全新引擎以弥补两大产品线之间的空白。该发动机采用了独特的推力矢量系统：并非摆动所有的发动机喷管，而是通过较小的推力矢量引擎提供姿态控制，较大的主发动机则提供主要推力。

s: Rejoice! The glorious Rockomax Conglomerate has created the biggest and safest Nuclear rocket motor in existence! With a revolutionary design that passes the fuel over the reactor, instead of through it, the risk of radioactive exhaust is now (nearly) non-existent! Now no Kerbal has to worry about that pesky radiation!
zh: 欢呼吧！光荣的极限火箭集团造出了现存最大、最安全的核火箭发动机！凭借革命性的设计让推进剂从反应堆外部掠过而非穿过堆芯，排出放射性废气的风险现已（几乎）不复存在！现在再也没有坎巴拉人需要担心那恼人的辐射了！

s: One of the smaller crew storage solutions available to any space program, the IKU-02 is able to inflate to nearly triple it's initial size, letting it pack in a total of 2 kerbals. If it isn't inflated, however... let's just say that they'll have very little to no room to do anything.
zh: 作为各大航天计划中体积较小的乘员储存方案之一，<<M0>>充气后可膨胀至接近初始体积的三倍，足以容纳总计2名坎巴拉人。然而，如果不给它充气……只能说他们几乎没有任何活动空间。

s: A smaller version of Kerbodyne's mobile processing plant, this module can take raw materials containing even trace amounts of oxygen and hydrogen, and crack them into useful fuel products. When operated by a skilled engineer, you will be able to operate with better efficiency. This oddly shaped processor manufactures mono-propellant and nothing else, but is much lighter and smaller than the more versatile Convert-O-Tron 125.
zh: 作为坎巴拉动力移动加工厂的微缩版本，该模块可以提取含有微量氧和氢的原材料，并将其裂解为有用的燃料产物。由熟练的工程师操作时，生产效率将大幅提升。这种异形加工器仅能制造单组元推进剂，但比功能更全面的转化炉125轻巧得多。

s: This product is the result of a traveling vacuum saleskerbal's bright idea. By removing most of the structural supports and thermal insulation, the tanks is much lighter and cheaper, but it can be torn in two by a single drifting Kerbal who's out of EVA propellant.
zh: 该产品源自一位走街串巷的真空设备推销员的灵光一现。通过剥除大部分结构支撑和绝热层，储罐更加轻巧廉价，但一名耗尽EVA推进剂漂移撞上来的坎巴拉人就能将它撞成两半。

s: The LV-900 is an earlier retrofitted variant of the LV-909, which has significantly higher thrust-to-weight ratio, but is less efficient than it's younger brother. In order to sell the excess stock, we have mounted a fuel tank that'll extend the range of your rocket (slightly). Due it it's status as a mid range lifting engine, it is is able to operate semi-efficiently in thin atmospheres.
zh: <<M0>>是<<M1>>早期改装而来的变体，推重比大幅提高，但效率略逊于其后辈。为了清空积压库存，我们加装了一个能（稍微）延长火箭射程的燃料箱。鉴于其中程起飞升空发动机的定位，它在稀薄大气中能够保持尚可的运作效率。

s: An uncharacteristic foray into airliner control systems from Probodobodyne, the Kossak provides a reliable avionics base and a 3 person crew for longer range flights and extra nap time.
zh: 作为探测动力有限公司罕见涉足客机控制系统的产物，“哥萨克”提供了可靠的航电基座以及3名乘员位，适合超远距离飞行，并附赠额外的小憩时间。

s: Despite having being dubbed the 'Kerlington Kerbal Killer', due to a few 'high-flying' kerbals not flying quite high enough, the Bonny remains a popular choice for sub-orbital transport.
zh: 尽管因少数“高飞”坎巴拉人飞得不够高而被戏称为“柯林顿坎巴拉杀手”，“邦尼”仍是亚轨道运输的热门选择。

s: The TK-M1 axle makes the truck ready to roll. Just add wheels
zh: TK-M1车桥让卡车随时准备出发。装上轮子即可。

s: The TK-W1 boasts a wider wheelbase since kept flipping the M1s. Just add wheels
zh: 鉴于M1总是在翻车，TK-W1拥有更宽的轮距。装上轮子即可。

zh: sxt 舱段 实验 实验室 材料 研究

s: An innovative multi-purpose design. Allows for selection of multiple fuel types to suit most mission parameters.
zh: 创新的多用途设计。允许选择多种燃料类型，以适应绝大多数任务参数。

zh: 尾翼连接器B的老大哥，但比起3.75米尾翼连接器还是小巫见大巫。

s: Technically no different from the 'Economy', but twice a higher ticket price keeps all of the riff-raff out.
zh: 技术上与“经济舱”毫无区别，但贵上一倍的票价成功将所有闲杂人等拒之门外。

s: The more the merrier! Sure we had to cut a few corners during construction, but as long as you don't crash it, jump in it or cough too loudly, you'll be fine.
zh: 人越多越热闹！建造时我们确实偷了点工减了点料，但只要你不撞机、不在里面乱蹦、不大声咳嗽，就不会有事。

s: A large radial turboprop intake, perfect for jet aircraft that just need that bit of extra air.
zh: 大型径向涡桨进气口，非常适合只需少量额外空气的喷气式飞机。

s: A smaller version of the SM1600. To be honest, the 1600 is basically just 3 of these stacked on top of each other.
zh: <<M0>>的小型版本。老实说，1600基本上就是把这玩意儿叠了三层。

zh: 电池和单组元推进剂是这款精美服务舱的当家看点。表面还配有抓手，方便EVA作业。

zh: 探测动力有限公司首次也是唯一一次涉足乘员居住舱。虽显笨重，但并不局促，甚至还配备了一组实用的外部扶手。

s: Developed as a direct competitor to Rockomax's X-200 series of tank. Largely identical, this has been covered in fancy paint and tubes to appeal to the more discerning engineer.
zh: 作为乐科墨克斯<<M0>>系列贮箱的直接竞争对手而研发。大体上完全相同，只是刷上了花哨涂装并加装了管道，以吸引更有品味的工程师。

zh: 虽然与坎巴拉动力产品目录中的其他贮箱相比显得微不足道，但奥斯卡-C非常适合常规小型卫星发射所需的极简火箭。

s: Slows you down. Like a bit, just a wee bit. You're basically still going to be travelling really fast. And will probably still crash. But you'll get about 2 extra seconds beforehand. So that's nice.
zh: 能让你减速。就一点点，真的就一点点。你基本上还是在飞速前进，而且大概率仍会坠毁。但至少能多苟活2秒钟。还算不错啦。

s: Slows you down. Well, providing you're in an atmosphere. It won't help on the Mun, unlike parachutes which definitely work there. Honest guv. Also doubles as a handy surfboard.
zh: 能让你减速。当然，前提是你得在气层内。这玩意儿在坎石星可派不上用场——不像降落伞，降落伞在那儿绝对管用。骗你是小狗。它还能兼作冲浪板。

s: Used for slowing planes down, can handily be placed next to control surfaces on wings.
zh: 用于飞机减速，便于安装在机翼控制面旁边。

s: The Kommunotronski 16 is a versatile and lightweight antenna suitable for moderate-range communication, long-range backup communication, eavesdropping on secret government operations.
zh: 通灵机16是一款多功能轻型天线，适用于中程通信、远程备用通信，以及窃听政府秘密行动。

zh: 缺乏适当的结构支撑使得这种燃料囊极其脆弱，无法多层叠放。最好连靠都别靠在上面。

s: Ever wanted to deploy slightly larger items into space such as SRBs and landers? This is just the part for you!
zh: 想过把更大的物品部署到太空吗？比如固体助推器和着陆器？这正是为你量身打造的部件！

s: sxt cargo contain convey equipment freight hold hollow payload
zh: sxt 货舱 容纳 输送 设备 货运 舱 中空 载荷

s: Designed as upper stage motor to kick smaller payloads to orbital velocities, the RT-3 does have a slight habit of kicking things into escape velocities.
zh: 作为将小型有效载荷送入轨道速度的上面级发动机，<<M0>>偶尔会顺手把东西一脚踹进逃逸轨道。

s: This unit is a modified RV-105 RCS thruster, with the horizontal nozzles angled to 45 degrees. This new development has revolutionized the field of RCS systems, netting its inventor the coveted Kerbel prize.
zh: 该部件是修改版的 <<M0>> RCS推进器，将水平喷嘴偏转了45度。这项新研发彻底革新了RCS系统领域，为其发明者赢得了梦寐以求的坎贝尔奖。

s: A compact and lightweight 0.625 meter engine, the M82 produces plenty of thrust for smaller rockets in atmosphere, butnot enough to out-run 1.25m class engines, especially at higher altitudes. The M82 was originally developed for several of C7 Industries C-planes' experimental supersonic trials, but was later dropped due to availability concerns after a Rockomax Conglomerate import ban in the early 2240's. Most of the remaining prototypes have been mothballed and need extensive modification to avoid our current mix of LFO from eating away at several critical components.
zh: 作为一款紧凑轻巧的0.625米发动机，M82在大气层内能为小型火箭提供充足的推力，但不足以匹敌1.25米级别的发动机，尤其是在高空。M82最初是为C7航天工业C型飞机的几项实验性超音速试飞而研发的，但由于2240年代早期极限火箭集团实施进口禁令引发了供应担忧，该项目随后被搁置。剩余的原型机大部分已被封存，需要进行大量改装以防止我们现用的液氧煤油混合物腐蚀几个关键部件。

s: After many late night snack binges, we've developed a new control surface: the Basic Canard! Perfectly sized for smaller craft or ships that don't need the extra control. Crafted out of the finest second-hand aluminum, the Basic Canard is light but lacks the duribility for atmospheric re-entry.
zh: 在熬夜狂炫零食之后，我们研发出了一款全新的控制面：基础鸭翼！其尺寸非常适合小型航天器或不需要额外控制力的船只。基础鸭翼采用最优质的二手铝材精制而成，虽然轻便，但缺乏应对大气层再入的耐久度。

s: The Communotron 88-88-V directional antenna allows for far more reliable communication at longer ranges than previous models. This is thanks in part to its patented parabolic folding design. ISPE's research team maintains it was not inspired by an umbrella, but clearly this one is based on an umbrella. Looks like the manufacturer forgot to put the protective fairing on it. Still, it's a little lighter and they're willing to discount the price as well.
zh: 通信者88-88-V定向天线比以往型号能在更远距离上实现更可靠的通信。这在一定程度上归功于其专利的抛物线折叠设计。ISPE的研究团队坚称其灵感并非来自雨伞，但很显然这一款就是以雨伞为基础制作的。看起来制造商似乎忘了给它装上保护整流罩。不过，它更轻了一点，而且他们也愿意为此打折出售。

s: The largest tank available from Rockomax, the Jumbo-64 holds a vast amount of fuel in a large metal tube. After deciding that the tank was too light, Rockomax decided to paint the Jumbo-64, bringing its appearance in-line with the rest of its fuel tanks.
zh: 作为极限火箭集团旗下最大的储罐，巨无霸-64在一个大型金属管道中容纳了巨量的燃料。在认定储罐太轻后，极限火箭集团决定对巨无霸-64进行涂装，使其外观与旗下其他燃料罐保持一致。

s: A stretched variant of the FL-T400, the FL-T800 holds twice the fuel in a slightly stronger container. There were black stripes along the side to make the rocket go faster, but the rocket actually went so fast, that they wore off.
zh: 作为FL-<<M0>>的加长型号，FL-<<M1>>在略微坚固的罐体中容纳了两倍的燃料。侧面原本画有能让火箭飞得更快的黑色条纹，但火箭飞得实在太快，以至于条纹全被磨掉了。

s: One of the biggest crew storage solutions available to any space program, the IKU-03 is able to inflate to nearly double it's initial size, letting it hold a total of 10 kerbals comfortably. If it isn't inflated, however... let's just say that they'll have very little to no room to do anything.
zh: 作为任意航天计划中可用的最大乘员容纳方案之一，<<M0>>能够膨胀至接近初始尺寸的两倍，可让总共10名坎巴拉人舒适地容纳其中。然而，如果不给它充气……这么说吧，他们将几乎没有任何活动空间。

zh: sxt 驾驶舱 mk3 大型 巨大 Marble

zh: 这个轴向RCS块原本是老旧MK1乘员舱的一部分，但管理层认定成本过高后便将其移除。该组件为你的指令舱和火箭提供四向姿态控制，甚至还附带少量单组元推进剂储备。

zh: 级间桁架，非常适合安装六向连接节点等设备。

s: With the introduction of the MK3 spaceplane line, C7 Aerospace partnered with Reaction Systems Ltd to create a heavy, more vacuum oriented variant of the fledgling O-XX series. The O-40 also features an impressive gimbal range for most of your manoeuvring needs.
zh: 随着MK3航天飞机系列的推出，C7宇航与反应系统有限公司合作，为初生的O-XX系列打造了一款重型、更加面向真空环境的衍生型号。<<M0>>还拥有令人瞩目的万向节摆动范围，足以满足你绝大多数的机动需求。

zh: 很大——非常大。可用于承载较小的投放飞行器，甚至是燃料箱。

s: After receiving complaints that their previous product was far too tall, Rockomax Conglomerate created a shorter variant, letting the Rockomax Conglomerate avoid the inevitable lawsuits from rocket builders everywhere.
zh: 在收到关于之前产品过高的投诉后，极限火箭集团制造了一款更短的型号，从而让极限火箭集团避免了来自各地火箭建造者不可避免的诉讼。

zh: LV-NX3 "福玻斯" 核火箭发动机

zh: 一款高效、便宜且紧凑的三级发动机——虽然动力并不是特别强劲。

zh: sxt 原子发动机 核动力 冲压发动机 航空学
