zh: LV-NRJ "阿伽门农" 核动力冲压发动机

s: A monster of an engine for heavy lifting purposes, the Mainsail's power rivals that of entire small nations. Now equipped with a stylish aerodynamic shroud, the Mainsail cuts through the air with ease while keeping your rocket looking as stylish as ever.
zh: 作为一款用于重型起重任务的巨无霸发动机，主帆的威力足以匹敌几个小型国家的总和。现在它配备了时尚的空气动力学整流罩，主帆能够轻松切开空气，同时让你的火箭一如既往地保持帅气。

s: A powerful RCS thruster, designed to stabalise the largest of rockets and shuttles.
zh: 一款强力的 RCS 推进器，专为稳定超大型火箭和航天飞机而设计。

s: O-40 "Puff" Orbital Manoeuvering System
zh: <<M0>> "喷气" 轨道机动系统

s: A true monster, the 225 is a high-end cargo transporter fitted with a front-opening cargo loading door. Ramp sold separately
zh: 一个名副其实的庞然大物，225 是一款高端货运运输机前端，配有前开式货物装载门。坡道需另行购买

s: The LV-T15 Dachshund is one of the earliest rocket engines on our records, breaking altitude records and bones alike. Even today, the old stinker is still competitive after all this time by having the highest TWR of the LV-T series, but at the cost of the engines nozzle being blasted away over time, not to mention it's slow throttle time. In an attempt to avoid a catastrophic explosion, We've installed a auto-shut-off when there's no ablative material left. What? At least we figured out how to cool our engines by now.
zh: LV-T15“腊肠犬”是我们记录中最早的火箭发动机之一，打破高度纪录的同时也摔断过不少骨头。即使在今天，这个老古董凭借LV-T系列中最高的TWR，依然具有竞争力，但代价是发动机喷管会随着时间推移而被冲刷剥蚀，更不用说它那缓慢的节流阀响应了。为了避免发生灾难性爆炸，我们安装了烧蚀材料耗尽时的自动关机装置。怎么了？至少我们现在已经搞懂怎么冷却发动机了。

zh: sxt 驾驶舱 大型 货物 机头 3 osaul

s: A specialised cargo hold. Some say it can even hold itself. Sadly, the laws of Euclidean geometry forbid this.
zh: 专用货舱。有人说它甚至能装下自己。不幸的是，欧几里得几何定律禁止这样做。

s: sxt cargo hull large fuselage 3 osaul
zh: sxt 货舱 船体 大型 机身 3 osaul

s: A radial version of the ergonomic cockpit from the Osaul. Commonly mounted on top of Mk3 fuselages.
zh: 源自 Osaul 人体工程学驾驶舱的径向版本。通常安装在 Mk3 机身顶部。

s: Structural accompaniment for the radial MkP-Yavka cockpit.
zh: 专为 MkP-Yavka 径向驾驶舱配套的结构部件。

s: An otherwise stock LV-1 with the tank support structure removed, which allows you to attach the engine radially. We have designated this new engine the "Fire Ant", due to an early prototype that burned down our test bulding. The Fire Ant is an otherwise stock Ant engine stripped of all of its structural supports, so use at your own risk!
zh: 除了拆除了储罐支撑结构外，这就是一台原本原装的 <<M0>>，这允许你径向安装该发动机。我们把这台新发动机命名为“火蚁”，因为早期的一台原型机烧毁了我们的测试大楼。火蚁本质上就是剥离了所有结构支撑的原装蚂蚁发动机，使用后果自负！

s: sxt cockpit large radial osaul hull yavka
zh: sxt 驾驶舱 大型 径向 osaul 船体 yavka

s: A neatly tapered end for the radial MkP-Yavka cockpit. You'd barely notice it was there.
zh: 专为 MkP-Yavka 径向驾驶舱设计的整齐锥形收尾段。装上后几乎感觉不到它的存在。

s: Big, heavy, and with room for both liquid fuel and oxidiser tanks.
zh: 体积大、重量重，并有足够的空间容纳液体燃料和氧化剂箱。

zh: sxt 大型 机尾 osaul 船体 yavka 燃料

s: This little beaut' is a beefed up and insulated version of an actual octagonal strut that now serves as a service bay for things that you want to keep safe. No locks are provided, so it won't protect your valuables from being stolen from space pirates.
zh: 这个小宝贝是真正八角钢架的强化隔热版本，现在可用作服务舱来存放你想保护的物品。这里没有提供锁具，所以它无法防止你的贵重物品被太空海盗偷走。

s: sxt beam build connect girder structur pipe
zh: sxt 梁 建造 连接 桁架 结构 管道

zh: 一根长管道，可用于将物品从一处输送到另一处

s: A short pipe, useful for moving stuff from one place to another
zh: 一根短管道，可用于将物品从一处输送到另一处

s: A pipe bend, familiar to plumbers the world over
zh: 弯管，全世界管道工都非常熟悉

s: No different from the radial goo container, we just squeezed the goo enough that we could fit it in. Interestingly, the data readouts mostly spell out insults to our Customer Services department.
zh: 与径向神秘黏液罐没什么两样，我们只是把黏液用力挤了进去。有趣的是，传回的数据读数大部分都是在侮辱我们的客服部门。

s: After a borrowing some plans from Jebediah Kerman's Junkyard and Spacecraft Parts Co., the Rockomax Conglomerate has entered the field of nuclear propulsion with this tiny little rocket nicknamed the "Shiba". The NT-5R Shiba has a much smaller profile than its predecessor, but is less efficient due to its smaller power source. Because the reactor is always active, it will constantly produce electricity as long as the engine isn't being fired.
zh: 在借鉴了杰伯迪亚·坎曼废品与航天器部件公司的部分图纸后，极限火箭集团凭借这款昵称为“柴犬”的小型火箭步入了核动力推进领域。<<M0>>“柴犬”的外形尺寸比其前代小得多，但由于动力源较小，其效率也有所降低。由于反应堆始终处于运行状态，只要发动机不点火，它就会源源不断地产生电能。

s: A heavily modified version of an enthusiast grade pulse jet engine, it provides a surprisingly high thrust to weight ratio in addition to a lightning quick spool up time. Unfortunately, it drains your fuel faster than any other jet.
zh: 由爱好者级脉冲喷气发动机深度改装而来，不仅提供了惊人的高推重比，而且转速提升响应极快。遗憾的是，它的耗油速度比其他任何喷气发动机都要快。

s: After discovering the success of the RE-M3 and the RE-I5 rocket engines, the Rockomax Conglomerate created a new engine to bridge the gap between the two lines. This engine features a unique thrust vector system; instead of gimballing all of the engine nozzles, smaller thrust vectoring engines provide control while the larger sustainer's provide the rest of the thrust.
zh: 在见证了RE-M3与RE-I5火箭发动机的成功后，极限火箭集团打造了一款全新发动机来填补两条产品线之间的空白。该发动机采用了独特的推力矢量系统：并非让所有喷管整体偏转，而是通过小型矢量喷管提供姿态控制，大型主巡航发动机则负责提供剩余推力。

s: Rejoice! The glorious Rockomax Conglomerate has created the biggest and safest Nuclear rocket motor in existence! With a revolutionary design that passes the fuel over the reactor, instead of through it, the risk of radioactive exhaust is now (nearly) non-existent! Now no Kerbal has to worry about that pesky radiation!
zh: 欢呼吧！光荣的极限火箭集团造出了现存最大、最安全的核火箭发动机。凭借让燃料从反应堆外掠过而非穿过内部的革命性设计，放射性废气的风险现已（几乎）不复存在。现在坎巴拉人再也不用担心那恼人的辐射了。

s: One of the smaller crew storage solutions available to any space program, the IKU-02 is able to inflate to nearly triple it's initial size, letting it pack in a total of 2 kerbals. If it isn't inflated, however... let's just say that they'll have very little to no room to do anything.
zh: 作为航天计划中尺寸较小的乘员容纳方案之一，<<M0>>充气后容积可扩大至初始尺寸的近三倍，可容纳共2名坎巴拉人。然而要是未充气……只能说他们几乎没有任何活动空间。

s: A smaller version of Kerbodyne's mobile processing plant, this module can take raw materials containing even trace amounts of oxygen and hydrogen, and crack them into useful fuel products. When operated by a skilled engineer, you will be able to operate with better efficiency. This oddly shaped processor manufactures mono-propellant and nothing else, but is much lighter and smaller than the more versatile Convert-O-Tron 125.
zh: 作为坎巴拉动力移动加工厂的微型版本，该模块可以提取含有微量氧和氢的原材料，并将其裂解为有用的燃料产物。由熟练的工程师操作时，生产效率会显著提高。这款形状奇特的处理器仅能制造单组元推进剂，但比起多功能的转化炉125要轻便小巧得多。

s: This product is the result of a traveling vacuum saleskerbal's bright idea. By removing most of the structural supports and thermal insulation, the tanks is much lighter and cheaper, but it can be torn in two by a single drifting Kerbal who's out of EVA propellant.
zh: 该产品源自一位巡回真空吸尘器销售员的绝妙点子。通过移除大部分结构支撑和隔热层，该储罐重量大幅减轻且成本更低，但一个耗尽EVA推进剂漂移撞上的坎巴拉人就能直接将它撞成两半。

s: The LV-900 is an earlier retrofitted variant of the LV-909, which has significantly higher thrust-to-weight ratio, but is less efficient than it's younger brother. In order to sell the excess stock, we have mounted a fuel tank that'll extend the range of your rocket (slightly). Due it it's status as a mid range lifting engine, it is is able to operate semi-efficiently in thin atmospheres.
zh: <<M0>>是<<M1>>的早期改装型号，推重比显著更高，但比冲效率不及后起之秀。为了清空积压库存，我们加装了一个能（稍微）延长火箭射程的燃料箱。鉴于其中程起飞升空发动机的定位，它在稀薄大气中能够维持尚可的运行效率。

s: This unit is a modified RV-105 RCS thruster, with the horizontal nozzles angled to 45 degrees. This new development has revolutionized the field of RCS systems, netting its inventor the coveted Kerbel prize.
zh: 该部件是修改版的 <<M0>> RCS推进器，其水平喷嘴呈45度角。这项新突破彻底革新了RCS系统领域，为其发明者赢得了梦寐以求的坎贝尔奖。

s: A compact and lightweight 0.625 meter engine, the M82 produces plenty of thrust for smaller rockets in atmosphere, butnot enough to out-run 1.25m class engines, especially at higher altitudes. The M82 was originally developed for several of C7 Industries C-planes' experimental supersonic trials, but was later dropped due to availability concerns after a Rockomax Conglomerate import ban in the early 2240's. Most of the remaining prototypes have been mothballed and need extensive modification to avoid our current mix of LFO from eating away at several critical components.
zh: 作为一款紧凑轻巧的0.625米级发动机，M82在大气层内能为小型火箭提供充足推力，但不足以匹敌1.25米级发动机，在高空更是如此。M82最初是为C7航天的C系列飞机进行超音速试飞而研制的，但在2240年代初极限火箭集团颁布进口禁令后，因供应链担忧而被废弃。现存的大多数原型机都已封存，需要进行大量改装，以防止我们现有的LFO混合燃料腐蚀几个关键部件。

s: After many late night snack binges, we've developed a new control surface: the Basic Canard! Perfectly sized for smaller craft or ships that don't need the extra control. Crafted out of the finest second-hand aluminum, the Basic Canard is light but lacks the duribility for atmospheric re-entry.
zh: 在无数个熬夜狂吃零食的夜晚后，我们开发出了一种全新的控制面：基础鸭翼！其尺寸完美适配小型飞行器，或不需要过多控制力度的飞船。基础鸭翼采用最优质的二手铝材精心打造，重量极轻，但缺乏抵御大气层再入的耐久度。

s: The Communotron 88-88-V directional antenna allows for far more reliable communication at longer ranges than previous models. This is thanks in part to its patented parabolic folding design. ISPE's research team maintains it was not inspired by an umbrella, but clearly this one is based on an umbrella. Looks like the manufacturer forgot to put the protective fairing on it. Still, it's a little lighter and they're willing to discount the price as well.
zh: 通信者88-88-V定向天线比以往型号能在更远距离上实现更可靠的通信。这在一定程度上归功于其专利的抛物面折叠设计。ISPE的研究团队坚称其灵感并非源自雨伞，但这玩意儿显然就是把伞。看起来制造商似乎忘了给它套上保护整流罩。不过，它更轻了一些，而且他们也愿意打折出售。

s: The largest tank available from Rockomax, the Jumbo-64 holds a vast amount of fuel in a large metal tube. After deciding that the tank was too light, Rockomax decided to paint the Jumbo-64, bringing its appearance in-line with the rest of its fuel tanks.
zh: 作为极限火箭集团旗下面积最大的燃料箱，巨无霸-64在一个巨大的金属圆柱体内装载了海量燃料。由于觉得该箱体以前太轻，极限火箭集团决定为巨无霸-64刷上涂装，使其外观与其麾下其他燃料箱保持一致。

s: A stretched variant of the FL-T400, the FL-T800 holds twice the fuel in a slightly stronger container. There were black stripes along the side to make the rocket go faster, but the rocket actually went so fast, that they wore off.
zh: FL-<<M1>> 是 FL-<<M0>> 的加长改型，在稍显结实的容器内装有两倍的燃料。侧面曾画有让火箭“飞得更快”的黑色条纹，但实际上火箭飞得实在太快，以至于把条纹都给磨掉了。

s: One of the biggest crew storage solutions available to any space program, the IKU-03 is able to inflate to nearly double it's initial size, letting it hold a total of 10 kerbals comfortably. If it isn't inflated, however... let's just say that they'll have very little to no room to do anything.
zh: 作为各大航天计划能获得的最大乘员容纳方案之一，<<M0>> 可以膨胀至接近初始尺寸的两倍，能够让总共10名坎巴拉人舒适地容身。然而，如果不给它充气膨胀……只能说他们几乎没有任何活动空间。

s: This inline RCS block was originally part of the ageing MK1 pod, but was removed when management decided that it was too expensive. This block provides four way altitude control for your command pods and rockets, even includes a small mono-propellant supply to boot.
zh: 该轴向内嵌RCS块最初是老旧MK1乘员舱的一部分，但在管理层认为其成本过高后被移除。该模块可为你的指令舱和火箭提供四向姿态控制，甚至还附带少量单组元推进剂储备。

s: With the introduction of the MK3 spaceplane line, C7 Aerospace partnered with Reaction Systems Ltd to create a heavy, more vacuum oriented variant of the fledgling O-XX series. The O-40 also features an impressive gimbal range for most of your manoeuvring needs.
zh: 随着MK3空天飞机系列的推出，C7航天与反应系统有限公司合作，基于初具雏形的O-XX系列开发出了更偏向真空环境的重型改型。<<M0>> 还具有令人印象深刻的万向节偏转范围，可满足你大部分机动需求。

s: After receiving complaints that their previous product was far too tall, Rockomax Conglomerate created a shorter variant, letting the Rockomax Conglomerate avoid the inevitable lawsuits from rocket builders everywhere.
zh: 在收到先前产品过高的投诉后，极限火箭集团打造了一款较矮的改型，使极限火箭集团得以避免来自各地火箭制造者不可避免的诉讼。

s: A monster of an engine for heavy lifting purposes, the Mainsail's power rivals that of entire small nations. Now equipped with a stylish aerodynamic shroud, the Mainsail cuts through the air with ease while keeping your rocket looking as stylish as ever.
zh: 作为一款用于重型运载的怪兽级发动机，“主帆”的动力足以匹敌数个小国之和。如今配备了时尚的空气动力学整流外壳，“主帆”可以轻松划破空气，同时让你的火箭一如既往地保持帅气。

s: The LV-T15 Dachshund is one of the earliest rocket engines on our records, breaking altitude records and bones alike. Even today, the old stinker is still competitive after all this time by having the highest TWR of the LV-T series, but at the cost of the engines nozzle being blasted away over time, not to mention it's slow throttle time. In an attempt to avoid a catastrophic explosion, We've installed a auto-shut-off when there's no ablative material left. What? At least we figured out how to cool our engines by now.
zh: LV-T15“腊肠犬”是我们记录中最早的火箭发动机之一，既打破过高度记录，也摔断过不少骨头。即使在今天，这个老家伙依然颇具竞争力，拥有LV-T系列中最高的TWR，但代价是发动机喷管会随时间推移被烧蚀剥落，更不用说它那缓慢的节流阀响应了。为了防止灾难性的爆炸，我们安装了在烧蚀材料耗尽时自动关闭的装置。怎么，至少我们现在懂得怎么冷却发动机了。

s: An otherwise stock LV-1 with the tank support structure removed, which allows you to attach the engine radially. We have designated this new engine the "Fire Ant", due to an early prototype that burned down our test bulding. The Fire Ant is an otherwise stock Ant engine stripped of all of its structural supports, so use at your own risk!
zh: 这原本是一台原装的 <<M0>>，但去掉了燃料箱支撑结构，允许你将其径向安装。我们将这款新发动机命名为“火蚁”，因为早期的原型机曾烧毁了我们的测试大楼。火蚁本质上就是剥离了所有结构支撑的原版“蚂蚁”发动机，使用风险自负！

s: This little beaut' is a beefed up and insulated version of an actual octagonal strut that now serves as a service bay for things that you want to keep safe. No locks are provided, so it won't protect your valuables from being stolen from space pirates.
zh: 这个小宝贝是实际八角钢架的强化隔热版本，现在可用作存放贵重物品的服务舱。本品不配锁具，因此无法防止太空海盗窃取你的贵重物品。

s: After a borrowing some plans from Jebediah Kerman's Junkyard and Spacecraft Parts Co., the Rockomax Conglomerate has entered the field of nuclear propulsion with this tiny little rocket nicknamed the "Shiba". The NT-5R Shiba has a much smaller profile than its predecessor, but is less efficient due to its smaller power source. Because the reactor is always active, it will constantly produce electricity as long as the engine isn't being fired.
zh: 在从坎曼杰布杂货与航天部件公司“借”来一些图纸后，极限火箭集团凭借这款昵称为“柴犬”的小火箭进军了核动力推进领域。与前代产品相比，<<M0>> 柴犬的轮廓要小得多，但由于动力源较小，其效率有所降低。由于反应堆始终处于运行状态，只要发动机不点火，它就会源源不断地产生电力。

s: The CH-R1 Fly-By-Wire Radial Avionics Hub is the first, and likely last, joint venture between C7 Aerospace and The STEADLER Engineering. This little box lets you poor little Engineer/Scientist Kerbals attend to things other than flying your ship, Because the last thing you want is one of those eggheads trying to fly straight.
zh: CH-R1电传操纵径向航电设备插槽是C7航天与施泰德工程公司的首次，也可能是最后一次合作。这个小盒子可以让可怜的工程师/科学家坎巴拉人专注于飞行以外的事情，毕竟你最不希望看到的就是那些书呆子试图去开飞船保持平飞。

s: A rather strange addition to the arsenal, the RE-M7 is a high end rocket engine that's, being frank, absurdly heavy and bends easily but manages to outclass other engines of its size in the sheer amount of thrust it can produce.
zh: RE-M7是军械库中一个相当奇特的补充，它是一款高端火箭发动机，坦白地说，它奇重无比且极易弯折，但在纯粹的推力输出方面却能碾压同尺寸的其他发动机。

s: After reports of Kerbodyne's LES leaving unsettling scorch marks on command pods, O.M.B. Demolition Enterprises created the Escape Cover. Taking the heat so you don't have to. It even has a little hatch that your Kerbals can crawl through after a crash, how adorable.
zh: 在有报告指出坎巴拉动力的逃逸塔（LES）在指令舱上留下令人不安的灼痕后，O.M.B.爆破企业开发了这款逃逸保护罩。替你承受高温，为你遮风挡雨。它甚至还有一个小舱门，坎巴拉人在坠毁后可以从中爬出来，真是太可爱了。

s: Large size General Launch Base, a node-attached launch clamp platform. Has different shapes for 6m and 8m exhaust hole widths. The base frame has 9 color options, and the sides have 3 color options. Optional support pads for hold-downs cane be configured in various ways. The ladder can be toggled in 2 height variants, and the ladder and railings are available in 5 colors. Has manually operated Electric Charge and Fuel Generators, these must be turned on to operate, but can be switched off as well.
zh: 大型通用发射基座，一种通过节点连接的发射支架平台。具有适配6m和8m排气口宽度的不同形状。基座框架提供9种颜色选项，侧边提供3种颜色选项。可配置用于压紧装置的多种可选支撑垫。爬梯可在2种高度构型间切换，且爬梯和栏杆提供5种颜色。配有手动操作的电能与燃料发生器，须手动开启运行，亦可随时关闭。

s: Medium size General Launch Base, a node-attached launch clamp platform, with mobile wheel style. Has three different shapes for 4m and 6m exhaust hole widths. The base frame has 9 color options. Optional support pads for hold-downs cane be configured in various ways. The ladders can be toggled in various configurations, and are available in 5 colors. Has manually operated Electric Charge and Fuel Generators, these must be turned on to operate, but can be switched off as well.
zh: 中型通用发射基座，一种通过节点连接的发射支架平台，采用移动式轮组外观。具有适配4m和6m排气口宽度的三种不同形状。基座框架提供9种颜色选项。可配置用于压紧装置的多种可选支撑垫。爬梯支持多种构型切换，并提供5种颜色。配有手动操作的电能与燃料发生器，须手动开启运行，亦可随时关闭。

s: Micro size General Launch Base, a node-attached launch clamp platform. Has a two 1.5m wide exhaust holes with square and rectangular shapes, and a 2.5m wide square shape. The base frame has 8 color options. The ladders can be toggled on or off, and are available in 5 colors. Has manually operated Electric Charge and Fuel Generators, these must be turned on to operate, but can be switched off as well.
zh: 微型通用发射基座，一种通过节点连接的发射支架平台。配有方形和矩形两种1.5m宽排气口，以及一个2.5m宽的方形排气口。基座框架提供8种颜色选项。爬梯可自由开关显示，并提供5种颜色。配有手动操作的电能与燃料发生器，须手动开启运行，亦可随时关闭。

s: Mini size General Launch Base, a node-attached launch clamp platform, with mobile wheels or fixed footing styles. Has a 3 shapes of exhaust holes in 1.5m and 2.5m widths, and a 3.5m square hole. The base frame has 8 color options. Optional support pads for hold-downs cane be configured in various ways. The ladders can be toggled in various configurations, and are available in 5 colors. Has manually operated Electric Charge and Fuel Generators, these must be turned on to operate, but can be switched off as well.
zh: 迷你型通用发射基座，一种通过节点连接的发射支架平台，具有移动轮式或固定支脚外观。配有1.5m和2.5m宽度的3种形状排气口，以及一个3.5m的方形排气口。基座框架提供8种颜色选项。可配置用于压紧装置的多种可选支撑垫。爬梯支持多种构型切换，并提供5种颜色。配有手动操作的电能与燃料发生器，须手动开启运行，亦可随时关闭。

s: Small size General Launch Base, a node-attached launch clamp platform, with mobile wheel style. Has two special exhaust hole variants for the BDB Atlas V and KNES Ariane 5, plus other shapes in 2m, 3m and 4m widths. The base frame has 9 color options, and the side panels have 2 color options. Optional support pads for hold-downs cane be configured in various ways. The ladders can be toggled in various configurations, and are available in 5 colors. Has manually operated Electric Charge and Fuel Generators, these must be turned on to operate, but can be switched off as well.
zh: 小型通用发射基座，节点连接式发射架平台，采用移动轮式风格。包含适用于 BDB Atlas V 和 KNES Ariane 5 的两种特殊排气孔变体，以及 2m、3m 和 4m 宽度的其他形状。基座框架有 9 种颜色可选，侧板有 2 种颜色可选。固定夹具的可选支撑垫支持多种配置。爬梯可切换多种配置，且有 5 种颜色可选。配备手动操作的电能与燃料生成器，必须手动开启方可工作，也可随时关闭。

s: BIG Extra Large size General Launch Base, a node-attached launch clamp platform. Wider than the Sandbox/Tier 3 launch pad static, the support columns will sit in the ground. Has different shapes for 10m, 14m and 18m exhaust hole widths. The base frame has 9 color options. Optional support pads for hold-downs cane be configured in various ways. The ladders and railings are available in 5 colors. Has manually operated Electric Charge and Fuel Generators, these must be turned on to operate, but can be switched off as well.
zh: 特大型通用发射基座，节点连接式发射架平台。宽度超过沙盒/3级发射台建筑，支撑柱会立于地面。具备 10m、14m 和 18m 排气孔宽度的不同形状。基座框架有 9 种颜色可选。固定夹具的可选支撑垫支持多种配置。爬梯和栏杆有 5 种颜色可选。配备手动操作的电能与燃料生成器，必须手动开启方可工作，也可随时关闭。

s: A specialized rectangular launch plate for the new TantaresLV Energia rocket. It sits flush with the launch pad; put the dark lower section under the VAB floor to ensure proper positioning. The Plate has two manual generators that output electric charge and fuel resources.
zh: 专为新型<<M0>>能源号火箭设计的矩形发射底盘。与发射台齐平；请将深色下段置于 VAB 地板下方以确保正确对齐。底盘配有两个手动发电机，可输出电能和燃料资源。

s: A specialized rectangular launch plate designed for Falcon 9 and Falcon Heavy-style rockets. Insert sections can be turned off for Falcon Heavy/tri-core rockets. The plate can accomodate the Large General Fallback Tower, attached to the node on the wider side of the plate. Use the Medium General Drop-Arm Hold-Downs for Falcon 9-sized (2.5m) rockets. There is also a special tower attach node for the Shuttle FSS Tower with Rodan Crew Arm. The plate also has rotattion options, to enable proper rotation of a non-square launch clamps. The plate has two manual generators that output electric charge and fuel resources.
zh: 专为 Falcon 9 和 Falcon Heavy 构型火箭设计的矩形发射底盘。用于 Falcon Heavy/三芯级火箭时可关闭嵌入段。底盘可容纳安装在较宽侧节点的通用大型倒伏塔。Falcon 9 尺寸（2.5m）火箭建议搭配中型通用落臂式固定夹具。此外还设有一个专用塔架连接节点，用于搭配配备 Rodan 乘员臂的航天飞机 FSS 塔架。底盘提供旋转选项以正确旋转非正方形发射架。底盘配有两个手动发电机，可输出电能和燃料资源。

s: A specialty launch stand for the Delta IV rocket, both the single and triple-core versions. By default it is set up for the Delta IV from Bluedog Design Bureau, which has 3.125m diameter core tanks. By adjusting the positions and width of the umbilical masts and hold-down posts with the deploy limit sliders, tank sizes of 2.5m can be accomodated as well. The stand is designed to sit flush on the launch pad surface, so move the stand down until the dark band on the bottom of the large corner support columns is on or slightly extending into the floor of the VAB. The stand has two manual generators that output electric charge and fuel resources. Use with the Delta IV Service Tower for the full LC-37 Delta IV recreation.
zh: 专为德尔塔IV号（Delta IV）火箭设计的专用发射台，同时支持单芯级和三芯级构型。默认配置适用于Bluedog Design Bureau的Delta IV（芯级贮箱直径3.125m）。通过展开限制滑块调节脐带塔和固定柱的位置与宽度，亦可适配2.5m直径贮箱。发射台设计为与发射台表面齐平，因此在VAB中请向下移动发射台，直至大型角撑柱底部的深色条纹贴齐或略微陷入地面。发射台配备两台手动发电机，可输出电能和燃料资源。配合Delta IV勤务塔使用，可完整复刻<<M0>>Delta IV。

s: A general rectangular node-attached launch clamp, intended for early career, that can accomodate rockets of 2.5m, 1.875m, 1.5m, 1.25m, 0.9375m and 0.625m diameters with two small side boosters. Center and optional outer hold-down support plates can be adjusted in length with their deploy limit sliders. There are different combinations of integrated hold-down bolts and clamp arms, each of which can be adjusted inwards with their deploy limit slider to align with the bottom of a tank or engine mount. The bolts can also be switched between short, tall and extended heights. The extended height bolts have an additional height adjust slider. The stand also has two manual generators that output electric charge and fuel resources.
zh: 一种通用的矩形节点连接式发射支架，适用于生涯早期，可适配直径为2.5m、1.875m、1.5m、1.25m、0.9375m及0.625m且带有两个小型侧向助推器的火箭。中心及可选的外侧固定支撑板可通过展开限制滑块调节长度。集成有多种组合形式的固定螺栓和压紧臂，均可通过展开限制滑块向内调节，以对齐贮箱底部或发动机安装架。螺栓还可在短、高以及加长高度之间切换。加长高度螺栓带有一个额外的高度调节滑块。支架还配备两台手动发电机，可输出电能和燃料资源。

s: A specialized giant-sized round launch plate for the new TantaresLV N1 rocket. It sits flush with the launch pad; put the dark lower section under the VAB floor to ensure proper positioning. The Plate has two manual generators that output electric charge and fuel resources.
zh: 专为全新<<M0>> N1火箭设计的巨型圆形发射底座。其表面与发射台齐平；请将深色下半部分埋入VAB地面以下以确保正确对齐。底板配有两个手动发电机，可输出电能和燃料资源。

s: A very low profile minimalist round launch clamp base, the launch plate sits flush with the launch pad; put the dark lower section under the VAB floor to ensure proper positioning. The Plate has two manual generators that output electric charge and fuel resources.
zh: 极低剖面的极简圆形发射稳定支架底座，发射底板与发射台齐平；请将深色下半部分埋入VAB地面以下以确保正确对齐。底板配有两个手动发电机，可输出电能和燃料资源。

s: A very low profile minimalist square launch clamp base, the launch plate sits flush with the launch pad; put the dark lower section under the VAB floor to ensure proper positioning. Square or rectangular exhust hole configurations can be selected. The Plate has two manual generators that output electric charge and fuel resources.
zh: 极低剖面的极简方形发射稳定支架底座，发射底板与发射台齐平；请将深色下半部分埋入VAB地面以下以确保正确对齐。可选择方形或矩形排气孔配置。底板配有两个手动发电机，可输出电能和燃料资源。

s: A modified version of the Atlas Launch Stand without a frame and with separately adjustable center and side section. The stand has 8 color options, and the clamp arms and side umbilicals have 2 color options. The side umbilicals and Atlas pipe connectors can be toggled off for use with other 1.875m diameter rockets. The stand also has two manual generators that output electric charge and fuel resources.
zh: 宇宙神发射台的改进版本，无外框架且中心与侧面部分可单独调节。支架拥有8种配色方案，固定臂和侧面脐带管拥有2种配色方案。侧面脐带管与宇宙神管路连接器可关闭，以便适配其他1.875m直径的火箭。支架还配有两个手动发电机，可输出电能和燃料资源。

s: A specialized launch stand for the Atlas SLV and derivatives from Bluedog Design Bureau, based on the real launch mount that the Atlas used. The stand has 8 color options, and the clamp arms and side umbilicals have 2 color options. The side umbilicals and Atlas pipe connectors can be toggled off for use with other 1.875m diameter rockets. The stand also has two manual generators that output electric charge and fuel resources.
zh: 专用于Bluedog Design Bureau的宇宙神SLV及其衍生型的专用发射台，基于宇宙神实际使用的发射台架设计。支架拥有8种配色方案，固定臂和侧面脐带管拥有2种配色方案。侧面脐带管与宇宙神管路连接器可关闭，以便适配其他1.875m直径的火箭。支架还配有两个手动发电机，可输出电能和燃料资源。

s: A general round node-attached launch clamp, intended for early career, that can accomodate rockets of 2.5m, 1.875m, 1.5m, 1.25m, 0.9375m and 0.625m diameters. The stand can be configured as the base flat ring or with a conical extension. Support plates for the integrated hold-downs are configured separately, allowing a mix of bolts and clamp arms. The hold-down bolts are non-animated and have 4 configurations and 3 heights, and can be adjusted inwards with their deploy limit slider to align with the bottom of a tank or engine mount. The extended height bolts have an additional height adjust slider. There are optional integrated side clamps available in different configurations, and are also adjusted with their deploy limit slider. The stand also has two manual generators that output electric charge and fuel resources.
zh: 一种通用的节点连接式圆形发射支架，适用于生涯早期，可容纳2.5m、1.875m、1.5m、1.25m、0.9375m和0.625m直径的火箭。支架可配置为基础平环或锥形延伸段。内置压紧装置的支撑板可单独配置，支持螺栓与夹臂混用。压紧螺栓为无动画部件，提供4种配置与3种高度，可通过开启限制滑块向内调整，以对齐贮箱底部或发动机安装座。加高螺栓附带额外的高度调节滑块。可选的内置侧边夹臂有多种构型可选，同样可通过开启限制滑块进行调节。支架还配备两台手动发电机，可输出电能与燃料资源。

s: A tall node-attached launch clamp for raising tiny rockets up from the ground. Has two height variants and 8 color options. The hold-down bolts at the top can be configured for 0.3125m or 0.625m diameter rockets, with vertical or horizontal styles; the bolts can also be turned off. The stand has two manual generators that output electric charge and fuel resources.
zh: 一种高耸的节点连接式发射支架，用于将微型火箭架离地面。具有两种高度变体和8种配色方案。顶部的压紧螺栓可配置为适配0.3125m或0.625m直径的火箭，支持垂直或水平样式，亦可完全关闭螺栓。支架配备两台手动发电机，可输出电能与燃料资源。

s: A tall node-attached launch clamp for raising small rockets up from the ground. Has two height variants and 8 color options. The hold-down bolts at the top can be configured for 0.9375, 1.25m or 1.5m diameter rockets, with vertical or horizontal styles; the bolts can also be turned off. The stand has two manual generators that output electric charge and fuel resources.
zh: 一种高耸的节点连接式发射支架，用于将小型火箭架离地面。具有两种高度变体和8种配色方案。顶部的压紧螺栓可配置为适配0.9375m、1.25m或1.5m直径的火箭，支持垂直或水平样式，亦可完全关闭螺栓。支架配备两台手动发电机，可输出电能与燃料资源。

s: A tall node-attached launch clamp for raising medium rockets up from the ground. Has three height variants and 8 color options. The hold-down bolts at the top can be configured for 1.875m or 2.5m diameter rockets, with vertical or horizontal styles; the bolts can also be turned off. The stand has two manual generators that output electric charge and fuel resources.
zh: 一种高耸的节点连接式发射支架，用于将中型火箭架离地面。具有三种高度变体和8种配色方案。顶部的压紧螺栓可配置为适配1.875m或2.5m直径的火箭，支持垂直或水平样式，亦可完全关闭螺栓。支架配备两台手动发电机，可输出电能与燃料资源。

s: A specialty round node-attached launch clamp designed for the Redstone rocket from Bluedog Design Bureau, but also with optional hold-down bolt positions for standard 1.25m and 1.5m fuel tanks. There is also an integrated version of the Redstone Umbilical Pole, available in 6 heights at either 1.25m and 1.5m tank positions. The pole is dropped with the launch clamp release. The stand has two manual generators that output electric charge and fuel resources.
zh: 一款专为 Bluedog Design Bureau 的红石（Redstone）火箭设计的节点连接式圆形发射支架，但同时也为标准 1.25m 和 1.5m 燃料箱提供了可选的压紧螺栓位置。该支架还集成了红石脐带塔，可在 1.25m 和 1.5m 燃料箱位置提供 6 种高度选择。脐带塔会在发射支架释放时脱落。发射台配备了两个手动发电机，可输出电能和燃料资源。

s: Node-attached launch clamp styled after various hold-down assemblies used by the Thor/Delta/Delta II rockets, sized for 1.5m diameter rockets. It is designed to sit flush with the ground, so move it down so the bottom sits slightly below the VAB floor. It has three style variants: Thor type, Delta II type and a mini type with just the hold-down mounts, and 8 color options. Each style has three hold-down bolt height options: short, tall and extra-tall, the latter two for use with SRB-using Thor/Delta variants. The bolts have two position options, either for the BDB LR-79 engine (early Thors and Deltas) or the RS-27 engine (later Deltas and all Delta IIs). The stand has two manual generators that output electric charge and fuel resources.
zh: 仿照雷神（Thor）/德尔塔（Delta）/德尔塔 II（Delta II）火箭所用各种压紧组件风格设计的节点连接式发射支架，适用于 1.5m 直径火箭。其设计为与地面齐平，因此请将其向下移动，使底部略低于 VAB 地面。包含三种外观变体：雷神型、德尔塔 II 型以及仅含压紧底座的迷你型，并提供 8 种颜色选择。每种外观都有三种压紧螺栓高度可选：低矮、高和超高，后两种用于搭载固体助推器的雷神/德尔塔型号。螺栓有两个位置选项，分别适配 BDB <<M0>> 发动机（早期雷神与德尔塔）或 <<M1>> 发动机（后期德尔塔与所有德尔塔 II）。发射台配备了两个手动发电机，可输出电能和燃料资源。

s: A specialty launch stand for the Titan III and Titan IV, inspired by the real one. The center section can be switched between Titan II style (flat) and Titan IV style (elevated). Integrated hold-down bolts in short and tall variants for both the core and side boosters can be adjusted with the deploy limit sliders or separately turned off. The 4-corner support columns and the side wheels can be separately turned on/off. Special attach nodes for the Titan III Auxiliary Mast and Service Tower are located on the stand proper; other attach nodes are also available. The stand also has two manual generators that output electric charge and fuel resources, and 8 color options are available.
zh: 一款专为大力神 III（Titan III）和大力神 IV（Titan IV）设计的专用发射台，灵感源自现实原型。中心部分可在 Titan II 样式（平坦）和 Titan IV 样式（抬高）之间切换。芯级和侧边助推器均集成了矮版与高版的压紧螺栓，可通过开启限制滑块进行调节或单独关闭。四角的支撑柱和侧轮可单独开启/关闭。发射台主体上设有用于 Titan III 辅助桅杆和服务塔的专用连接节点；此外还提供了其他连接节点。发射台还配有两个可输出电能和燃料资源的手动发电机，并提供 8 种颜色选项。

s: This is the free-standing base for the Saturn Mobile Launcher. The base attaches to a free node in the center of a rocket's lower or core stage using the size 5 node at the top of the exhaust hole opening. The tower base section attaches to the size 5 node on the other end of the launcher base. Includes a built-in decoupler and an elevator for crew access from the ground to the top deck. For best results, put the front legs so that they are inside the white part of the big circle on the VAB floor. No launch clamps are necessary. Includes a manually-activated generator for electric charge. The base's exhaust hole can be configured for three sizes of rockets: Saturn V (6.4/5.625m), SLS (5m) and the Saturn IB (4.25/3.75m), with various square and rectangular shapes for either single-core or tri-core rockets. A variety of switchable hold-down arm support configurations are available, along with optional center-mount hold-down and Saturn V tail service mast attach nodes.
zh: 这是土星移动发射台的独立底座。底座通过排气口顶部的5号节点连接到火箭下级或芯级中心的空闲节点。发射塔底座段连接至发射台底座另一端的5号节点。内置分离器以及供乘员从地面到达顶层甲板的电梯。为获得最佳效果，请将前支腿放置在VAB地面大圆圈的白色区域内。无需发射稳定支架。包含手动启用的电能发电机。底座排气口可配置为适配三种尺寸的火箭：土星五号（6.4/5.625m）、SLS（5m）和土星1B（4.25/3.75m），并提供适配单芯级或三芯级火箭的多种正方形与长方形规格。提供多种可切换的压紧臂支撑配置，以及可选的中心安装压紧装置与土星五号尾部服务桅杆连接节点。

s: This is the base for the Saturn Mobile Launcher. The base attaches to a free node in the center of a rocket's lower or core stage using the size 5 node at the top of the exhaust hole opening. The tower base section attaches to the size 5 node on the other end of the launcher base. Includes an elevator for crew access from the ground to the top deck. For best results, put the front legs so that they are inside the white part of the big circle on the VAB floor. Includes manually-activated generators for electric charge and fuel resources. The base's exhaust hole can be configured for three sizes of rockets: Saturn V (6.4/5.625m), SLS (5m) and the Saturn IB (4.25/3.75m), with various square and rectangular shapes for either single-core or tri-core rockets. A variety of switchable hold-down arm support configurations are available, along with optional Saturn V tail service mast attach nodes.
zh: 这是土星移动发射台的底座。底座通过排气口顶部的5号节点连接到火箭下级或芯级中心的空闲节点。发射塔底座段连接至发射台底座另一端的5号节点。内置供乘员从地面到达顶层甲板的电梯。为获得最佳效果，请将前支腿放置在VAB地面大圆圈的白色区域内。包含手动启用的电能和燃料资源发生器。底座排气口可配置为适配三种尺寸的火箭：土星五号（6.4/5.625m）、SLS（5m）和土星1B（4.25/3.75m），并提供适配单芯级或三芯级火箭的多种正方形与长方形规格。提供多种可切换的压紧臂支撑配置，以及可选的土星五号尾部服务桅杆连接节点。

s: Soyuz Launch Base, a node-attached launch clamp pad styled after the actual Soyuz launch pad facility at Baikonur. Three color options are available. It attaches via the upper larger node in the central hole to a center node at the bottom of a rocket. The clamp arms, service gantry, large fuel arm, and small fuel arm are separately attached. The clamp arm pads can be switched among several options. 8 auxiliary nodes for the fuel arms or other tower are on the deck. Has two manual fuel and electric charge generators.
zh: 联盟号发射台底座，一种节点连接式发射固定架底座，样式仿照拜科努尔的真实联盟号发射场设施。提供三种配色选项。它通过中心孔内上方较大的节点连接至火箭底部的中心节点。夹抱臂、勤务塔架、大加注臂和小加注臂均为独立安装。夹臂垫块可在多个选项间切换。甲板上配有 8 个用于安装加注臂或其他塔架的辅助节点。配有两个手动燃料和电能发生器。

s: A specialty round quad-tripod node-attached launch clamp designed for the Titan II rocket from Bluedog Design Bureau. It's meant to sit flush with the top of the static launch pad, so move the stand down until the bottom edge is just below the floor of the VAB. The hold-down bolts on the top blocks have configurations for the BDB LR-87 engine or standard 1.875m tanks. The stand has two manual generators that output electric charge and fuel resources. Use with the Titan II Service Tower and Titan II Crew Elevator for the full LC-19 recreation.
zh: 专为 Bluedog Design Bureau 的大力神 II（Titan II）火箭设计的特制圆形四脚架节点附着发射架。设计上与静态发射台顶面平齐，因此请向下移动支架，直至底边刚好位于 VAB 地板下方。顶部构件上的压紧螺栓配有适用于 BDB <<M0>> 发动机或标准 1.875m 贮箱的构型。支架带有两个可输出电能和燃料资源的手动发电机。搭配大力神 II 勤务塔和乘员电梯使用，可完整复现 <<M1>>。

s: A specialty square node-attached launch clamp designed for the Vanguard and Scout rockets from Bluedog Design Bureau. The hold-down structure in the center has configurations for the BDB Vanguard shrouded engine (2 types), bare engine/0.9375m tank and 1.25m tank; the structure can also be turned off so other hold-downs can be used instead. Optional nodes for the separate Redstone Umbilical Pole can be turned on. The stand has two manual generators that output electric charge and fuel resources. Use with the Vanguard Service Tower for the full LC-18A recreation.
zh: 专为 Bluedog Design Bureau 的先锋号（Vanguard）和侦察兵（Scout）火箭设计的特制方形节点附着发射架。中心的压紧结构配有适用于 BDB 先锋号带整流罩发动机（2种）、裸露发动机/0.9375m 贮箱以及 1.25m 贮箱的构型；该结构亦可关闭以使用其他压紧装置替代。可开启独立红石脐带柱的可选节点。支架带有两个可输出电能和燃料资源的手动发电机。搭配先锋号勤务塔使用，可完整复现 <<M0>>。

s: MR-104 Monopropellant Engine family originally provided in-space propulsion for the Voyager 1 and 2 and Magellan missions. Subsequent MR-104 variants provided propulsion for Landsat and NOAA as well as for other U.S. government programs. A variation of this engine (MR-104G) is to be used on the Orion Deep Space Exploration Vehicle. [Uses RCS Configuration]
zh: <<M0>> 单组元推进剂发动机系列最初为旅行者 1 号、2 号以及麦哲伦号任务提供在轨推进。随后的 <<M0>> 衍生型还为陆地卫星（Landsat）和美国国家海洋和大气管理局（NOAA）以及其他美国政府项目提供推进动力。该发动机的一款变型（<<M1>>）计划用于猎户座深太空探索飞船。[使用 RCS 配置]

s:
Program: Early Commercial Applications
Type: Required

A Molniya orbit is a type of highly elliptical orbit with an inclination of 63.4 degrees, an argument of perigee of -90 (270) degrees, and an orbital period of one half of a sidereal day. This keeps the satellite mostly to the northern hemisphere of the Earth. Place a satellite into a Molniya orbit.

There will be an orbit showing in the map view and tracking station. You do not have to place the satellite into this orbit, but it is instead meant to show you where your perigee and apogee should approximately be located, but more importantly, it shows the proper shape of the orbit.

Historical example: Molniya 1-1 (1,600kg, Molniya)

NOTE: The satellite will be destroyed upon completion of the contract. This simulates transfer of the payload back to the customer.
zh: 项目：早期专注效益应用 <> 类型：必要 <> <> 闪电轨道是一种高椭圆轨道，其倾角为 63.4 度，近地点幅角为 -90（270）度，轨道周期为半个恒星日。这使得卫星大部分时间都位于地球北半球上空。将一颗卫星送入闪电轨道。 <> <> 地图视图和跟踪站中会显示一条目标轨道。你无需将卫星完全送入此轨道，它的作用是向你大致展示近地点和远地点应处的位置，更重要的是展示轨道的正确形态。 <> <> 历史参考：闪电 1-1（1,600 kg，闪电号运载火箭） <> <> 注意：合同完成后卫星将被销毁。这是为了模拟将载荷移交给客户。

s:
Program: Early Commercial Applications
Type: Required

By measuring the Doppler shift of radio signals from a satellite in a known orbit, it is possible for a receiver on the ground to establish their location, which would have many applications both civilian and military. To test the principle and develop receiver equipment, it is necessary to have a test navigational satellite in orbit.
Historical example: Transit 1B (119 kg, Thor-Ablestar).

NOTE: The satellite will be destroyed upon completion of the contract. This simulates transfer of the payload back to the customer.
zh: 项目：早期专注效益应用 <> 类型：必要 <> <> 通过测量已知轨道上卫星发射无线电信号的多普勒频移，地面接收机可以确定自身位置，这在民用和军用领域都有广泛的应用。为了验证这一原理并研发接收设备，需要发射一颗试验导航卫星进入轨道。 <> 历史参考：子午仪 1B（119 kg，雷神-爱布尔星）。 <> <> 注意：合同完成后卫星将被销毁。这是为了模拟将载荷移交给客户。

s: Level II Service Module Tanks are similar to ones used by Mercury and Vostok. These are heavy tanks with poor utilization to simulate the supporting structures and systems needed for the specialized payloads. Max Utilization: 50% Can Hold Satellite Payload, Electric Charge, and Life Support Supplies These are 23% lighter than level I service module tanks while costing 50% more to tool and 8% more once tooled.
zh: II 级服务舱储罐类似于水星号和东方号所使用的类型。这类重型储罐的容积利用率较低，用于模拟专业有效载荷所需的支撑结构和系统。最大容积利用率：50% 可容纳卫星载荷、电能和生命保障补给 它的重量比 I 级服务舱储罐轻 23%，但工装成本增加 50%，工装后的制造成本增加 8%。

s: Level III Service Module Tanks are similar to ones used by Gemini and Voskhod. These are heavy tanks with poor utilization that simulates the supporting structures and systems needed for the specialized payloads. Max Utilization: 60% Can Hold Satellite Payload, Electric Charge, and Life Support Supplies These are 40% lighter than level II service module tanks while costing 15% more to tool and the same once tooled.
zh: III 级服务舱储罐类似于双子座号和上升号所使用的类型。这类重型储罐的容积利用率较低，用于模拟专业有效载荷所需的支撑结构和系统。最大容积利用率：60% 可容纳卫星载荷、电能和生命保障补给 它的重量比 II 级服务舱储罐轻 40%，工装成本增加 15%，工装后的制造成本相同。

s: Level IV Service Module Tanks are similar to ones used by Apollo. These are heavy tanks with poor utilization that simulates the supporting structures and systems needed for the specialized payloads. Max Utilization: 75% Can Hold Satellite Payload, Electric Charge, and Life Support Supplies These are 45% lighter than level III service module tanks while costing 14% more to tool and 7% more once tooled.
zh: IV 级服务舱储罐类似于阿波罗号所使用的类型。这类重型储罐的容积利用率较低，用于模拟专业有效载荷所需的支撑结构和系统。最大容积利用率：75% 可容纳卫星载荷、电能和生命保障补给 它的重量比 III 级服务舱储罐轻 45%，但工装成本增加 14%，工装后的制造成本增加 7%。

s: Take Command enhances the External Command Seat so you can now assign crew to it from within the VAB/SPH just like any other command module. Just add one or more command seats to your ship, assign crew as usual, and launch! Your Kerbal crew will automatically spawn and jump into their assigned seats.
zh: Take Command 增强了外部指挥座椅的功能，使你现在可以像对其他指令舱一样，直接在 VAB/SPH 内为其分配乘员。只需在飞船上添加一个或多个指挥座椅，照常分配乘员并启动发射，坎巴拉乘员就会自动生成并坐上指定的座椅。

s: Freshly imported from an interstellar race with no Prime Directive, Prakasa is a pack aimed at aircraft and spaceplanes, namely with the objective of filling the 2.5 meter void between the diminutive Mk2 and massive Mk3. The parts are themed towards a somewhat more distant future than stock, offering greater interior space and a cleaner, spaceship-er aesthetic.
zh: 刚从一个没有最高指导原则的星际种族那里进口，Prakasa 是一个面向飞机和空天飞机的部件包，主要目的是填补小巧的 Mk2 与庞大的 Mk3 之间 2.5 米规格的空白。这些部件的设计风格比原版更偏向遥远的未来，提供更大的内部空间和更简洁、更具飞船感的审美。

s: Like Malahx's StockPlugins mod, this allows you to have life support without adding a bunch of parts that will break the next time KSP is updated.
zh: 类似 Malahx 的 <<M0>> 模组，该模组使你无需添加一堆可能在下次 KSP 更新时失效的部件即可实现生命保障功能。

s: Modpack featuring from Mig-21 parts (including Gun with real sound), 7 cockpits with full EVA's, 6 engines(inc. Triebflugel and Heinkel Lerche), 3 intakes, 5 guns and MORE! Download includes Gigabytes of fun.
zh: 整合包包含来自 <<M0>> 的部件（含真实音效机炮）、7 个支持完整 EVA 的座舱、6 台发动机（含 Triebflugel 与 Heinkel Lerche）、3 个进气道、5 门机炮以及更多内容。下载内容包含数 GB 的乐趣。

s: The Space Station Parts Pack contains everything needed to construct big, beautiful space stations. The pack includes the Kosmos VA capsule and TKS functional cargo block, a rugged and reliable vehicle for orbital operations, trusted by Kerbalnauts everywhere. Also included are the Salyut series of space station modules, which are split into customizable segments to build any station configuration. Using Kosmos parts, you can control your station without manning it by using the Pravilo computer system, or dock to it using the androgynous APAS-69 or KCBS docking rings.
zh: 空间站部件包包含建造宏大而美观的空间站所需的一切。该包内含 Kosmos VA 乘员舱与 TKS 功能货舱段——一种坚固可靠的轨道运营飞行器，深受各地 Kerbal 宇航员信赖。此外还包含礼炮系列空间站模块，这些模块被拆分为可自定义的舱段，便于搭建任意空间站构型。使用 Kosmos 部件，你可以通过 Pravilo 计算机系统在无需人员驻守的情况下控制空间站，或使用雌雄同体式 <<M0>> 或 KCBS 对接环与之对接。

s: Based primarily on GregroxMun's recent suit mod release with a smattering of Scart91 and fast_de_la_speed's work on class suits for the standard and USI expanded classes.  A current interpretation of the suits for KSP 1.5.1
zh: 主要基于 <<M0>> 近期发布的宇航服 mod，并少量借鉴了 <<M1>> 与 fast_de_la_speed 为标准职业及 USI 扩展职业制作的职业宇航服。这是面向 KSP 1.5.1 的现行宇航服诠释。

s: Provides access to Astrogator functionality from within kOS scripts using the addons interface. Either generate the same transfer nodes directly from within your scripts using Astrogator's powerful functionality, or get information about transfers that can be used to aid your kOS scripts.
zh: 通过 addons 接口在 kOS 脚本中访问 Astrogator 功能。可直接在脚本中使用 Astrogator 的强大功能生成相同的转移节点，或获取可用于辅助 kOS 脚本的转移信息。

s:
This mod is a collection of part modules that are frequently used by multiple mods.  It was created to avoid the frequent copying of modules between mods which made maintaining the modules more difficult and sometimes resulted in incompatibility between mods' modules. This mod by itself will not have any effects, it is meant to be used as a dependency for other mods.
This mod is meant as community project, so feel free to propose additional module ideas by opening an issue, or contribute with a pull request on GitHub.
zh:
本 mod 汇集了多个 mod 常用的部件模块。其目的是避免模块在 mod 之间频繁复制，这种复制会增加模块维护难度，有时还会导致不同 mod 的模块不兼容。本 mod 本身不会产生任何效果，仅作为其他 mod 的依赖使用。
本 mod 定位为社区项目，欢迎通过提交 issue 提出更多模块想法，或在 <<M0>> 上提交 pull request 参与贡献。

s: An in-game console for KSP provides in-game access to Windows CMD for running kRPC programs in FullScreen mode
zh: KSP 的游戏内控制台，可在游戏内访问 Windows CMD，以 <<M0>> 模式运行 kRPC 程序

s: additional payment for a simulation, and you will need to plan your vessel before a real launch. A very Simplified KRASH-and-KerbalConstructionTime alike mod.
zh: 模拟需额外付费，且需在真实发射前规划好飞行器。一个高度简化的 KRASH 与 <<M0>> 类似 mod。

s: This mod adds the SpaceX Landing Zones and will eventually include all 3 droneships.
zh: 此 mod 添加 <<M0>> 着陆区，最终将包含全部 3 艘无人船。

s: Reshuffleing of the Kerbol System as well as an upscale of 3.5x
zh: 重新排布 Kerbol 星系，并放大 3.5 倍

s: A collection of realistic missile systems for BDArmory Plus.
zh: 为 BDArmory Plus 提供的写实导弹系统合集。

s: Implements wind and a continuous-gusts model for Ferram Aerospace Research. Provides GUI with settings for wind direction, speed and turbulence magnitude.
zh: 为 Ferram Aerospace Research 实现风与连续阵风模型。提供 GUI，可设置风向、风速与湍流强度。

s: Grannus Expansion Pack rescaled 2.5x to provide compatibility with the JNSQ planet pack
zh: Grannus 扩展包按 2.5 倍重新缩放，以兼容 JNSQ 行星包

s: Kerbal Civilization Project (KCP) is a mod for Sol (future plans to integrate into Kerbol) that adds cities, roads, buildings, etc. With plans to expand to even more things.
zh: Kerbal Civilization Project (KCP) 是面向 Sol 的 mod（未来计划整合进 Kerbol），添加城市、道路、建筑等，并计划扩展更多内容。

s: The mod displays trajectory predictions, accounting for atmospheric drag, lift, etc. Works with the stock aerodynamic model, and also with Ferram Aerospace Research (FAR).
zh: 该 mod 显示轨迹预测，考虑大气阻力、升力等。支持原版气动模型，也支持 Ferram Aerospace Research (FAR)。

s: This awesomely acronymed mod does exactly what it says it will do: Drops a maneuver node at various places in your orbit.
zh: 这个拥有炫酷缩写的 mod 名副其实：在轨道的各个位置放置机动节点。

s: I introduce to you the most high-tech scrap, THE SHUTTLE WINGS B9 STYLE
zh: 隆重介绍最高科技的废铁——B9 风格航天飞机机翼

s: Reveals important statistics about your ship and its orbit during building and flight
zh: 在建造与飞行时显示飞船及其轨道的重要统计数据

s: The world that was thought to be a myth is now back!!
zh: 曾被视为传说的世界现已回归。

s: Small parts pack to fill in some gaps and introduce some specialty engines
zh: 小型部件包，填补部分空缺并引入一些特殊发动机

s: KSPI-E is a plugin designed to encourage bootstrapping toward ever more advanced levels of technology as well as utilizing In-Situ resources to expand the reach of Kerbal civilization
zh: KSPI-E 是一个插件，旨在鼓励逐步攀登更高的技术水平，并利用原位资源扩展坎巴拉文明的疆域

s: A TUFX config based on the visual theme of KSRSS
zh: 基于 KSRSS 视觉主题的 TUFX 配置

s: Stock + OPM configs to make the Kerbol system more closely match our real solar system
zh: 原版 + OPM 配置，使 Kerbol 星系更接近真实太阳系

s: Give stock parts a new coat of paint! Gives 80+ stock parts an optional black themed texture.
zh: 给原版部件换新装。为 80 多个原版部件提供可选黑色主题贴图。

s: Cloud Aerospace and Rocket Technologies is a startup Aerospace Company seeking to provide affordable access to space for Cubesats and Small Sats
zh: Cloud Aerospace and Rocket Technologies 是一家初创航天公司，致力于为立方星与小卫星提供经济可负担的太空进入途径

s: A small cosmetic kopernicus mod that gives kerbin a green ring system.
zh: 一个小型外观类 Kopernicus mod，为 Kerbin 添加绿色环形。

s: Visual enhancement mod that makes objects realistically visible over large distances
zh: 视觉增强 mod，使远距离物体真实可见

s: Shared station parts used by N3h3miah's KLS and OMS mod.
zh: <<M0>> 的 KLS 与 OMS mod 共用的空间站部件。

s: Phoenix Industries Agencies, needed by the other Phoenix Industries mods
zh: Phoenix Industries 机构，其他 Phoenix Industries mod 所需

s: a trio of hotrod wheels to pimp your ride
zh: 三款热改车轮，装点你的座驾

s: Deployable Emergency Reentry Pod (DERP)
zh: 可展开式应急再入舱 (DERP)

s: The Green Rolf Moca is a vehicle for KSP. It was built to accept the RoveMax Model M1 wheels.
zh: Green Rolf Moca 是 KSP 中的一款载具，设计用于安装 <<M0>> Model M1 车轮。

s: The Block II program further develops with Shuttle with a focus on crew safety and improved capability for both the orbiter and launch stack.
zh: Block II 计划进一步发展航天飞机，重点提升乘员安全以及轨道器和发射组合体的能力。

s: Adds the ability to recover all landed vessels in one go.
zh: 添加一次性回收所有已着陆飞行器的功能。

s: Persistent rotation, persistent momentum and more!
zh: 持续旋转、持续动量以及更多功能

s: A plugin to manage extending/retracting engine nozzles. This package is merely a resource and does nothing by itself.
zh: 用于管理发动机喷管伸缩的插件。此包仅为资源包，本身不执行任何功能。

s: This is a simple plugin to allocate extra space on the heap to help minimize the frequency of garbage collection.
zh: 这是一个简单插件，用于在堆上分配额外空间，以减少垃圾回收的频率。

s: A useful set of three parts which are building bricks for offworld landing pads and roads.
zh: 一套实用的三个部件，是地外着陆场与道路的建造基础。

s: The Mod plays an alarm sound everytime you are close to the burn start (1/2 burn time) and stops the timewarp. If the burn is close to completion it plays another alert. It requires KerbalEngineerRedux because it has better predictions than stock and I use the KER predictions.
zh: 该 Mod 会在接近点火开始（1/2 燃烧时间）时播放警报音并停止时间加速。若燃烧接近完成，会播放另一条提示。它需要 <<M0>>，因为其预测比原版更好，且我使用 KER 的预测。

s: SolarSailNavigator is a new plugin (ALPHA: you have been warned) to navigate continuous thrust spacecraft with sunlight-propelled solar sails and ion engines. The sail model and force models are derived from KSP Interstellar. The goal of this plugin is to make solar sailing and continuous thrust engines a practical means of travel throughout the KSP solar system.
zh: <<M0>> 是一个新插件（ALPHA：已警告过你），用于操控由阳光驱动的太阳帆和离子发动机的连续推力航天器。帆模型和力模型源自 KSP 星际。该插件的目标是使太阳帆航行和连续推力发动机成为在 KSP 太阳系中旅行的实用方式。

s: The Science Report and Checklist for KSP.  [x] Science! keeps track of the science experiments you have completed and recovered to Kerbal Space Center. It also tracks science you have gathered which is held on vehicles and kerbals.  No matter what game scene you are in, what you current vehicle is, [x] Science! always reports on all science held anywhere.
zh: [x] Science! 为 KSP 提供科学报告与检查清单。它会记录你已完成并回收至 Kerbal 航天中心的科学实验，也会追踪你已采集、仍存放在载具和 Kerbal 身上的科学数据。无论你处于哪个游戏场景、当前驾驶什么载具，[x] Science! 都会报告所有位置的科学数据。

s: Adds cool and unique planets to your game! Pictures: http://imgur.com/a/d7zNF  dont forget to join my discord to nearly INSTANTLY contact me! https://discord.gg/RJDppmT Requirements: A brain, patience and Kopernicus!
zh: 为你的游戏添加酷炫而独特的行星！图片：<<M0>> 别忘了加入我的 Discord，几乎能瞬间联系到我！<<M1>> 需求：一个大脑、耐心和 Kopernicus！

s: Extends the CommunityTechTree, which is an extension of the Stock Tech tree and radically reassigns parts for a much better progression experience (start with simple unmanned rockets, early airplanes and rovers).
zh: 扩展 <<M0>>，它是对原版科技树的扩展，并大幅重新分配部件，带来更好的进度体验（从简单的无人火箭、早期飞机和漫游车开始）。

s: Another 4k Skybox i made with SpaceEngine 0.980. It takes place in the Carina Nebula, or NGC 3372, in the Milky way. The Large Magellanic Cloud is also visible in the Skybox. (it looks way better in game than it looks in the header)
zh: 这是我又一个用 <<M0>> 0.980 制作的 4k 天空盒。它位于银河系的船底座星云（NGC 3372）。天空盒中也能看到大麦哲伦云。（游戏内的效果比头图好得多）

s: Kernius System is a mod that adds 1 star, 1 gas giant with a mini gas giant, 4 oceanic planets. the nearest has an ocean of lava and a toxic atmosphere, the second and third owns an ocean and has an atmosphere similar to that of Kerbin. the farthest one also has an ocean only that much of its surface is frozen. Kernius is the closest star to Oasis, and can be seen in the night sky of the Oasis planets.
zh: Kernius 星系是一个添加了 1 颗恒星、1 颗气态巨行星（附一颗迷你气态巨行星）和 4 颗海洋行星的 mod。最近的一颗拥有熔岩海洋和有毒大气，第二颗和第三颗拥有海洋，大气与 Kerbin 相似。最远的一颗同样有海洋，只是表面大部分已冻结。Kernius 是距 Oasis 最近的恒星，在 Oasis 行星的夜空中可以看到。

s: This is a welding tool to allow you to merge KSP parts together in order to reduce your part count and increase performance. You will now be able to create big space station or vessel without killing your CPU. The mass, price, resource quantity are kept as if you had all the part separated. Please read forum thread for known limitations and issues.
zh: 这是一个焊接工具，可让你把 KSP 的部件合并在一起，以减少部件数量并提升性能。现在你可以建造大型空间站或飞船，而不必拖垮 CPU。质量、价格和资源数量都保持与部件分开时相同。已知限制与问题请阅读论坛帖。

s: Have you ever needed a set of spherical tanks of various capacities, to use for a refueling depot? an interplanetary mothership? A resource extraction base? Have you ever wanted a different tank options? DaMichel's Spherical Tanks might just be for you.
zh: 你是否曾需要一组容量各异的球形贮箱，用于燃料补给站？星际母船？资源采集基地？你是否想要不同的贮箱选择？<<M0>> 的球形贮箱也许正适合你。

s: Extensive Engineer Report is a Kerbal Space Program mod that extends the Engineer's Report in the Vehicle Assembly Building and the Spaceplane Hanger with additional checks to ensure that your vessel has everything you need.
zh: Extensive Engineer Report 是一个 KSP mod，它在载具组装车间和航天飞机机库中扩展工程师报告，增加额外检查，确保你的飞行器一应俱全。

s: Displays a table of all of the bodies reachable from the current location, along with the time till burn and delta V needed to reach them. These values can be used to time warp or generate maneuver nodes. Supports prograde and retrograde orbits, nested ejection trajectories, transfers to satellites of the current parent body, and transfers to other vessels.
zh: 显示一张表格，列出从当前位置可到达的所有天体，以及距点火时间和到达它们所需的 Δv。这些数值可用于时间加速或生成机动节点。支持顺行与逆行轨道、嵌套逃逸轨迹、转移至当前母天体的人造卫星，以及转移至其他飞行器。

s: This mod makes sounds feel more realistic by muffling your audio to lower and lower frequencies as the air around your vessel gets less and less dense. This is a continuation of the work of SerTheGreat and NovaSilisko.
zh: 该 mod 让声音更真实：随着飞行器周围空气越来越稀薄，音频会被闷至越来越低的频率。这是 <<M0>> 与 <<M1>> 工作的延续。

s: Freshly imported from an interstellar race with no Prime Directive, Prakasa is a pack aimed at aircraft and spaceplanes, namely with the objective of filling the 2.5 meter void between the diminutive Mk2 and massive Mk3. The parts are themed towards a somewhat more distant future than stock, offering greater interior space and a cleaner, spaceship-er aesthetic.
zh: Prakasa 从一场没有最高指导原则的星际竞赛中新鲜引进，是一个面向飞机与航天飞机的部件包，目标是填补小巧的 Mk2 与庞大的 Mk3 之间 2.5 米的空白。部件风格比原版更偏向稍远的未来，提供更大的内部空间和更干净、更像飞船的美感。

s: A.K.A. MPE. This one's for the little guys! Originally by Exo, this planet pack adds 18 new bodies to the Kerbol system to explore based on real-world asteroids and dwarf planets. Features hand-drawn maps, biomes, and precious, PRECIOUS science.
zh: 又名 MPE。这个是为小家伙们准备的。最初由 Exo 制作，这个行星包基于现实中的小行星和矮行星，为 Kerbol 星系添加 18 个新天体供探索。包含手绘地图、生物群系，以及珍贵的、珍贵的科学。

s: Attempting to land on the Mun or any other body in IVA mode was down right ridiculous when the lander is set to its normal top up orientation. This part, when installed on the surface of the lander correctly, allows the user to fly the lander with the proper IVA configuration by selecting "control for here" on the LOI part. Just make sure you surface mounted the part so that it says FORWARD above the main viewing window and you should be all se
zh: 当着陆器处于正常的顶部朝上姿态时，尝试在 IVA 模式下登陆 Mun 或任何其他天体简直荒谬。正确安装于着陆器表面后，该部件允许用户通过在 LOI 部件上选择“从此处控制”，以正确的 IVA 配置驾驶着陆器。只要确保该部件表面安装后，主观察窗上方显示前进即可。

s: This is a collection of ribbons that you can assign to your Engineers to differentiate their qualifications and expertise for Role-Playing purposes. PLEASE NOTE: Final Frontier is required for this ribbon pack.
zh: 这是一组绶带，可分配给你的工程师，用于区分他们的资历与专长，供角色扮演之用。请注意：此绶带包需要 Final Frontier。

s: Hangars are parts that can store whole ships inside. Stored ships are not docked but unloaded, which reduces part count considerably, improving framerate and memory footprint while allowing to carry out missions of great complexity.
zh: 机库是可在内部存放整艘飞船的部件。存放的飞船并非对接，而是被卸载，这大幅减少部件数量，改善帧率与内存占用，同时仍能执行极为复杂的任务。

s: Dynamic, flowing EVA tethers and ship-to-ship cables for Kerbal Space Program. A simulated rope that floats in zero-g, drapes over hulls and wraps around ships, with a reel, a lifeline for power and life support, and a toolbar app for cable styles.
zh: 为 KSP 提供动态、飘动的 EVA 系绳和船对船缆绳。模拟绳索可在零重力下漂浮、垂搭在船壳上并缠绕飞船，配有卷盘、用于供电与生命保障的救生索，以及一个用于切换缆绳样式的工具栏应用。

s: System Heat revamps the Core Heat system used in stock KSP to drive drills and harvesters with a new, more powerful system. This core package does not make changes to the base game - install other SystemHeat packs to change drills, converters and the like to use System Heat
zh: System Heat 改造了原版 KSP 中用于驱动钻机和采集器的核心热系统，换用一套更强大的新系统。本核心包不会改动原版游戏——请安装其他 <<M0>> 包，让钻机、转换器等使用 System Heat。

s: Race Kerbol (the sun) in a series of scenarios from start to finish while trying to keep as close to the ground as possible to get a higher score! Your craft is solar powered, so make sure to keep your panels exposed to the sun as much as possible.
zh: 在一系列场景中与 Kerbol（太阳）赛跑，从起点到终点，同时尽量贴近地面以获得更高分数。你的飞行器由太阳能供电，所以要尽量让太阳能板朝向太阳。

s: A package of textures for Procedural Parts designed to blend with the colors, shading and layout of existing textures in other packages.
zh: 为程序化部件提供的纹理包，旨在与其他纹理包中现有纹理的颜色、明暗和布局相融合。

s: A rocky red planet located in orbit close to Duna
zh: 一颗位于 Duna 附近轨道的红色岩石行星

s: This mod adds several star systems, some of which are binary pairs.
zh: 本 mod 添加若干恒星系统，其中一些为双星系统。

s: A planet pack for Kerbal Space Program. Launch from an unforgivingly cold world into a massive new star system and uncover the secrets of the Precursor civilization.
zh: KSP 行星包。从一颗严寒无情的星球出发，进入庞大的新恒星系，揭开先驱者文明的秘密。

s: Configure maximum control surface deflection to vary with dynamic pressure
zh: 配置操纵面最大偏转量随动压变化

s: Integrates JSI Radar and JSI External Camera with stock and SSTU Docking Ports
zh: 将 JSI 雷达与 JSI 外部摄像机集成到原版及 SSTU 对接口

s: A lightweight modular system to build walkable tubes to connect your vessels.
zh: 轻量模块化系统，用于建造可通行的管道以连接你的飞船。

s: Allows ridiculous scales, surpassing Tweakscale Unlimited. Really just for fun, or for building Megastructures/ISV's in KSP. (Forked from Unlimited) Requires Tweakscale
zh: 允许荒谬的缩放比例，超越 Tweakscale Unlimited。纯粹为了好玩，或用于在 KSP 中建造巨型结构/星际飞船。（分支自 Unlimited）需要 Tweakscale

s: Removes SSPXr's requirement to have engineers on board to inflate habs and centrifuges
zh: 移除 SSPXr 需要船上工程师才能充气居住舱和离心机的限制

s: Support for Wooting Keyboards (e.g. Wooting One/Two)
zh: 支持 Wooting 键盘（如 Wooting One/Two）

s: This is a bright-style TUFX configuration
zh: 这是一个明亮风格的 TUFX 配置

s: Expands the Kerbol system with new planets and moons based on Saturn, Uranus, Neptune and their moons
zh: 以土星、天王星、海王星及其卫星为蓝本，为 Kerbol 星系添加新行星和卫星

s: Get your parts list under control
zh: 让部件列表井然有序

s: This add-on for the formidable "Chatterer" mod by Athlonic will currently add 178 new kerbalized chatter-files for your hearing pleasure.
zh: 这个为 Athlonic 的强大 "Chatterer" mod 制作的附加组件目前会添加 178 个新的小绿人化语音文件，供你聆听。

s: Adds a GUI menu to stack separators to optionally destroy them when they are decoupled. this feature is disabled by default and will not work with omni-directional decouplers.
zh: 为堆叠分离器添加 GUI 菜单，可选择在分离时将其销毁。此功能默认禁用，且不适用于全向分离器。

s: Saturable Reaction Wheels makes stock reaction wheels more realistic by adding momentum management
zh: 可饱和动量轮通过加入动量管理，使原版动量轮更加真实

s: Orbital Payload Calculator is a utility mod for Kerbal Space Program designed to help players calculate rocket payload capacity for various target orbits.
zh: Orbital Payload Calculator 是 KSP 的实用 mod，帮助玩家计算火箭在各类目标轨道下的运载能力。

s: Small pack with all my ModuleManager tweaks for KSP and mods. Full list on my homepage.
zh: 包含我为 KSP 及各类 mod 所做的全部 <<M0>> 调整的小型整合包。完整列表见我的主页。

s: A lightweight, random launch failure mod. You might want to start using that Launch Escape System with this installed.
zh: 轻量的随机发射故障 mod。装了它，你也许该开始用发射逃离系统了。

s: Set of parts for help in long range ship building
zh: 用于远程飞船建造的部件套装

s: A plugin for Kerbal Space Program which adds some SSTV, beeps, and nonsensical radio chatter between your command pods and Mission Control.
zh: 为 KSP 添加 SSTV、哔声以及指令舱与任务控制中心之间无意义无线电通话的插件。

s: Harvesting Carbon Dioxide for Fun and Profit
zh: 收集二氧化碳，娱乐与盈利两不误

s: Foldable radial mounted Antennas to complement RemoteTech's needs
zh: 可折叠的径向安装天线，满足 <<M0>> 的需求

s: Textures for Raptor Aerospacial heatshields (for Super 100 and Super 69 command pods), you shouldn't need to install this on its own.
zh: Raptor Aerospacial 隔热罩（用于 Super 100 和 Super 69 指令舱）的纹理，通常无需单独安装。

s: Use Waterfall effects to mimic transonic vapor cone effects
zh: 使用 Waterfall 效果模拟跨声速蒸汽锥

s: This KSP mod adds extended support for AJE to other mods and also adds a number of engines not represented in existing configs.
zh: 此 KSP mod 为其他 mod 扩展 AJE 支持，并添加若干现有配置中未包含的发动机。

s: A huge and challenging tech tree. 197 technologies.
zh: 庞大而富有挑战的科技树。197 项科技。

s: A small plugin to change a bunch of parameters related to career, science, the buildings upgrade cost and when various features are unlocked. Build for Realism Overhaul
zh: 小型插件，可修改与生涯、科学、建筑升级费用以及各项功能解锁时机相关的众多参数。为 Realism Overhaul 打造。

s: A next-gen, Restock-alike replacement for the original Buffalo mod
zh: 面向原版 Buffalo mod 的次世代 Restock 风格替代品

s: A single part mod that adds in a separator that doesnt leave any bits behind with separated.and now it will separate from both sides
zh: 单部件 mod，添加一种分离时不会留下任何残余的分离器。现在它会从两侧分离

s: Plays an alarm when flying downwards below a set altitude, to increase panic.
zh: 在低于设定高度向下飞行时播放警报，以增加恐慌。

s: Gives Kerbin the beginning of a runaway greenhouse effect
zh: 让 Kerbin 开始出现失控温室效应

s: Overhaul of the stock Exploration contracts
zh: 重做原版探索合同

s: Beautiful gas giant for the Kerbol System
zh: 为 Kerbol 星系添加的美丽气态巨行星

s: Night vision mod for Kerbal Space Program — monochrome/green NV with brightness, vignette, grain and scanline controls
zh: KSP 夜视 mod — 单色/绿色夜视，可调亮度、暗角、颗粒与扫描线

s: Dwarf fortress meets RP-1 (KSP/RSS/RO). Focusing on reputation and crew members. In development and changes often.
zh: 《矮人要塞》遇上 <<M0>>（KSP/RSS/RO）。侧重声望与乘员。开发中，频繁变动。

s: Build racetracks with checkpoints and compete in races against time

s:
Nehemiah Engineering Orbital Science is a collection of orbital science experiments aimed at prolonged station keeping. It consists of three distinct sets of experiments:
* Kemini Research Program (KRP) - early-game experiments run from within a capsule based on real-life experiments run during the Gemini program.
* Kerbal Environmental Effects Study (KEES) - mid-game experiments for attaching to the outside of a small station based on real-life material exposure experiments run on the MIR station.
* Orbital Station Science (OSS) - Kerbal Life Science (KLS) and Orbital Material Science (OMS) - late-game large-scale station experiments based on real-life ISS experiments. These require modular station construction and maintenance.

All of the experiments are designed to be run in the background while the player performs other missions.
zh:
Nehemiah Engineering Orbital Science 是一组面向长期空间站驻留的轨道科学实验合集，包含三套彼此独立的实验：
* Kemini 研究计划（KRP）——游戏前期实验，在舱内运行，基于双子座计划中进行的真实实验。
* Kerbal 环境影响研究（KEES）——游戏中期实验，安装于小型空间站外部，基于和平号空间站上进行的真实材料暴露实验。
* 轨道空间站科学（OSS）——Kerbal 生命科学（KLS）与轨道材料科学（OMS）——游戏后期的大型空间站实验，基于国际空间站的真实实验。这些需要模块化空间站建造与维护。

所有实验均设计为在玩家执行其他任务时于后台运行。

s: Photon Sailor aims to create a realistic photon-sailing experience in KSP. A photonsail, also known as solar sail or laser sail, allows a spacecraft to propel itself using radiation pressure from the sun, removing the need to carry any reaction mass, and simply using the deflection of photon energy to provide thrust.
zh: Photon Sailor 旨在为 KSP 打造逼真的光子帆航行体验。光子帆又称太阳帆或激光帆，使航天器能够利用太阳辐射压推进，无需携带任何反作用质量，仅靠光子能量的反射提供推力。

zh: 飞行中在右下角每个 Kerbal 头像上方显示其类型与等级
