s: This mod is a standalone version of the Promised Worlds sunflare by Sushut, allowing you to enjoy the beautiful sunflare without installing the full Promised Worlds mod. Full credit goes to Sushut and the Promised Worlds team.
zh: 本 mod 是 Sushut 制作的 Promised Worlds 太阳耀斑的独立版本，让你无需安装完整的 Promised Worlds 即可欣赏美丽的太阳耀斑。全部功劳归于 Sushut 与 Promised Worlds 团队。

s: This is my second planet mod, this one adds a moon between minmus and the mun. It is a one stop shop for gravity assists and science farming, it has all levels of the stock shader integrated Its Icy blue texture and giant SOI make it a kerbal's choice for a challenge It has 0.35 gees of gravity, and a relatively high orbital velocity It has a size of 330, is compatible with Sigma Binary
zh: 这是我的第二个行星 mod，它在 Minmus 与 Mun 之间加入了一颗卫星。它集引力助推与科学刷取于一身，集成了原版着色器的所有级别。其冰蓝色纹理与巨大的 SOI 使其成为 Kerbal 挑战的首选。它的重力为 0.35 G，轨道速度相对较高。大小为 330，兼容 Sigma Binary。

s: While the World Cup kicks off in Brazil, Squad is launching festivities up in the stars with an official mod and community competition centered around the familiar planet of Kerbin. It’s time to celebrate the Kerbin Cup!
zh: 当世界杯在巴西开赛之际，Squad 在星空中启动了庆祝活动，推出一项围绕熟悉的 Kerbin 星球的官方 mod 与社区竞赛。是时候庆祝 Kerbin 杯了！

s:
With Archipelago for KSP, you start with a small selection of random parts and must perform missions to unlock additional parts to get closer to your goal. Any time you achieve something for the first time such as orbiting a planet, taking a surface sample, planting a flag, etc., you will unlock new parts for yourself or other players in their games.
Goals are selected by the player when they generate a new game, and things like flying to Duna and back, planting a flag on all bodies, returning a surface sample from every body are default goals players can chose from.
zh:
借助 Archipelago for KSP，你从一小批随机部件开始，必须执行任务来解锁更多部件，逐步接近目标。每当你首次达成某项成就，例如环绕行星、采集地表样本、插旗等，你都会为自己或其他玩家在其游戏中解锁新部件。
目标由玩家在生成新游戏时选择，诸如往返 Duna、在所有天体上插旗、从每个天体带回地表样本等，均为玩家可选的默认目标。

s: Kerems TUFX is a realistic, cinematic TUFX profile that gives KSP a NASA-like look. With ACES tone mapping, soft bloom, subtle chromatic aberration, and light ambient occlusion, you get bright daylight scenes, beautiful re-entry glow, and true-to-life colors without exaggeration. Perfect for players who want a clean, professional, and realistic look during launches, orbit, and landings.
zh: Kerems TUFX 是一款写实、电影感的 TUFX 配置文件，赋予 KSP 类似 NASA 的观感。凭借 ACES 色调映射、柔和泛光、细微色差与轻度环境光遮蔽，你能获得明亮的日照场景、优美的再入辉光与真实自然的色彩，毫不夸张。非常适合追求干净、专业、写实观感的玩家，用于发射、轨道与着陆阶段。

s: This mod is intended to be a branch-off of Birth of time, setting you on Ceti, an equatorial water planet with 3 planets to explore. This mod standalone isn't big, and is intended to be used in cooperation with interstellar modification.
zh: 本 mod 是《Birth of time》的分支，将你置于 Ceti——一颗赤道水域行星，另有 3 颗行星可供探索。本 mod 独立版本体量不大，设计上建议与星际类 mod 配合使用。

s: Rover Science Continued - Kerbalism Edition is a compatibility mod that brings RSC experiments to Kerbalism. It preserves the RSC gameplay loop while fully integrating its Science Experiments and resulting samples with Kerbalism.
zh: Rover Science Continued - Kerbalism Edition 是一款兼容性 mod，将 RSC 实验引入 Kerbalism。它保留 RSC 的玩法循环，同时将其科学实验与产出的样本完整接入 Kerbalism。

s: The stock ISRU system is missing a critical part: The ventral (in-line) drill. This simple mod fixes that. It adds a ventral drill that in all other ways (Tech tree node, mass, usefulness) is the same as the stock radial drills.
zh: 原版 ISRU 系统缺少一个关键部件：腹侧（串联）钻头。这个简单的 mod 弥补了这一空缺。它新增一款腹侧钻头，其余方面（科技树节点、质量、实用性）均与原版径向钻头相同。

s: KSP Interstellar Extended is a plugin for Kerbal Space Program, designed to encourage bootstrapping toward ever more advanced levels of technology as well as utilizing In-Situ resources to expand the reach of Kerbal civilization. KSP Interstellar Extended aims to continue in Fractals original KSPI vision in providing a realistic road to the stars.
zh: KSP Interstellar Extended 是 Kerbal Space Program 的一款插件，旨在鼓励玩家逐步迈向更先进的科技水平，并利用原位资源扩展 Kerbal 文明的疆域。KSP Interstellar Extended 力求延续 Fractals 原版 KSPI 的愿景，提供一条通往星辰的真实之路。

s: A re-imagining of the stock R.A.P.I.E.R. engine, with brand new art to match the fantastic style Porkjet has created. It's a separate part from the stock version, but it has the same stats and is the same size.
zh: 对原版 R.A.P.I.E.R. 发动机的重新演绎，配有全新美术，以契合 Porkjet 创造的出色风格。它与原版为独立部件，但属性相同、尺寸一致。

s: This pack adds 5 EVA handrails for space stations and science vessels, more suitable than ladders in weightlessness.  Handrails are usable and can be grabbed by a kerbal while on EVA and used to walk around your space station/spaceship.
zh: 本包新增 5 个用于空间站与科学飞船的 EVA 扶手，在失重环境下比梯子更适用。扶手可正常使用，Kerbal 在 EVA 时能抓握，并借此在空间站/飞船外移动。

s: Science revisited was originally created by CaptRobau as a subtle rebalance of the stock science system. Science Revisited Revisited is an adaptation and update of this mod, in accordance with the original licence.
zh: Science revisited 最初由 <<M0>> 制作，是对原版科学系统的轻度再平衡。Science Revisited Revisited 是该 mod 的改编与更新版本，遵循原始许可协议。

s: RemoteTech allows you to construct vast relay networks of communication satellites and remotely controlled unmanned vehicles. Your unmanned vessels require an uplink to a command station to be controlled. This adds a new layer of difficulty that compensates for the lack of live crew members.
zh: <<M0>> 让你能够构建庞大的通信卫星中继网络与遥控无人载具。你的无人飞船需要与指挥站保持上行链路才能被控制。这增加了一层新的难度，以弥补缺少在船乘员的不足。

s: Provides a GUI for planning a transfer to a satellite (natural, artificial, or a specified orbit) while on the surface of a celestial body. (planet, moon, gas giant, star, black hole, etc.) Consider this to be a vast upgrade of RCrockford's Lunar Transfer Planner.
zh: 提供图形界面，用于在天体表面规划前往卫星（天然卫星、人造卫星或指定轨道）的转移。（行星、卫星、气态巨行星、恒星、黑洞等）可视为对 RCrockford 的 Lunar Transfer Planner 的大幅升级。

s: I keep looking for variable RCS sizes, and while there's mods with small RCS, or large RCS, there never seems to be both, and rarely without a bunch of extra stuff.  This mod will basically just have a bunch of RCS blocks, and inline modules, plus some hypergolic motors (read main engines running on monoprop)
zh: 我一直在寻找不同尺寸的 RCS，虽然有些 mod 提供小型 RCS，也有些提供大型 RCS，但似乎从来没有两者兼备的，而且很少有不附带一堆额外内容的。这个 mod 基本上只包含一批 RCS 喷口、串联模块，以及一些自燃推进发动机（即使用单组元推进剂的主发动机）。

s: Customizable fuel resources added to Stock, B9, and Procedural Wings by Tortoise. The intention of this is to allow better weight & balance, reduce craft length, and provide more aesthetic pleasure.  Supports all stock fuel types, ability to modify in VAB/SPH.
zh: 由 Tortoise 为原版、B9 与 Procedural Wings 机翼添加的可自定义燃料资源。目的在于改善重量与平衡、缩短飞行器长度，并提升美观度。支持所有原版燃料类型，可在 VAB/SPH 中修改。

s: Kerbal Environmental Effects Study is a mid-game set of material exposure experiments aimed at small orbital stations. To run an experiment, you have to attach an Experiment Carrier to the outside of your station (using KIS), then add an experiment to it. The idea is to run experiments in the background while doing other missions.
zh: Kerbal Environmental Effects Study 是一套面向小型轨道空间站的中期材料暴露实验。要运行实验，需使用 KIS 将实验载具安装在空间站外部，然后为其添加实验。其理念是在执行其他任务的同时于后台运行实验。

s: NT Chinese Aerospace Pack or NCAP is a mod created for Kerbal Space Program to add Chinese rockets and spacecraft to the game. So far, this mod including: longmarch 2F, longmarch6, longmarch6A, longmarch7 and Chinese Tianhe Space station.
zh: NT Chinese Aerospace Pack（NCAP）是为坎巴拉太空计划制作的 mod，为游戏添加中国火箭与航天器。目前该 mod 包含：长征二号F、长征六号、<<M0>>、长征七号以及中国天和空间站。

s: Spaceman’s Global Flags is a comprehensive collection of real-world national, regional, and historical flags, made for the use with the Conformal Decals mod in KSP. Whether you are recreating real missions, making an Alt-history, or just adding personality to your spacecraft, this mod gives you the tools to represent the world!
zh: Spaceman’s Global Flags 是一套收录现实世界各国、各地区及历史旗帜的合集，供 KSP 的 Conformal Decals mod 使用。无论你是在复刻真实任务、构建架空历史，还是只想为飞船增添个性，这个 mod 都能提供展现世界的工具。

s: Contains a ION RCS thrusters and Pulsed Plasma Thrusters RCS pack of parts. These parts used to be distributed as part of my AmpYear mod. But due to popular demand I have split them off to a separate parts pack.
zh: 包含一套离子 RCS 推进器与脉冲等离子推进器 RCS 部件包。这些部件过去作为我的 <<M0>> mod 的一部分发布，但因需求众多，已拆分独立为部件包。

s: Birth of time takes place in a universe before life, where Kerbals have escaped their dying universe and crash land on their new homeworld, Esmuth. With a bounty of moons within reach, they set off to the stars once again.
zh: 《Birth of Time》的故事发生在一个生命尚未出现的宇宙中，坎巴拉人逃离了垂死的宇宙，坠毁在他们的新家园 Esmuth 上。在触手可及的众多卫星环绕下，他们再次启程前往星辰。

s: A newly discovered mineral that has hydrocarbon-like properties and is perfect for processing into a fuel. It's easily mined from the surface, and can be found in liquid or gaseous forms on certain planets.
zh: 一种新发现的矿物，具有类似烃类的性质，非常适合加工成燃料。它易于从地表开采，在某些行星上以液态或气态存在。

s: Kerbal remake of Dr. White's concept design of a warp capable space vessel using Dr. Alcubierre's theory on bending space-time, effectively circumventing Einstein's law of relativity. This mod continues the work RoverDude, Stevie_D and Sophia. This mod requires RoverDude's Alcubierre Drive (standalone) and Community Resource Pack. Suggested additional mod: Spacedocks (by Fenrir)
zh: 对 White 博士基于 Alcubierre 博士扭曲时空理论（有效规避爱因斯坦相对论定律）设计的曲速飞船概念方案所做的坎巴拉化重制。本 mod 延续了 <<M0>>、Stevie_D 与 Sophia 的工作。本 mod 需要 <<M0>> 的 Alcubierre Drive（独立版）与 Community Resource Pack。推荐附加 mod：Spacedocks（作者 Fenrir）。

s: This mod limits the number of times an engine may restart. Configuration is provided for stock/Squad engines and a few popular mods' engines, and may be extended through the use of ModuleManager patches.
zh: 此模组限制发动机可重启的次数。为原版/Squad 发动机及少量流行模组的发动机提供配置，并可通过 <<M0>> 补丁扩展。

s: This pack currently adds 541... yes you read correctly... 541 contracts to the base game following the historic progression of both NASA and its Russian counterparts, each mission has been made into a contract for the game. This version is for RSS/RO KSP
zh: 此包目前为基础游戏添加 541... 是的你没看错... 541 个合同，遵循 NASA 及其俄罗斯对应机构的历史进程，每个任务都被制作成游戏合同。此版本适用于 RSS/RO KSP

s: This add-on serves as an example on how to use Infernal Robotics's API. With this mod you can create and play sequences of servo movement commands and special commands, like GoTo, Toggle ActionGroup, Delay and Wait.
zh: 此附加组件示范如何使用 Infernal Robotics 的 API。借助此模组，你可以创建并播放伺服运动命令与特殊命令的序列，例如 GoTo、开关 <<M0>>、Delay 和 Wait。

s: Want to play RSS but not use RO or other extensive rescaling mods? This patch allows you to use stock parts in a bare RSS install by ballancing ISP/Thrust on stock part to work in the RSS scaled world.
zh: 想玩 RSS 但不使用 RO 或其他大幅重缩放模组？此补丁允许你在裸露的 RSS 安装中使用原版部件，通过平衡原版部件的比冲/推力，使其在 RSS 缩放世界中正常工作。

s: This very basic mod is a patch for Ven's Stock Part Revamp, that allows the new parts added to be implemented into Community Tech Tree (CTT). Doesn't add anything new, or change anything, besides the order the newly added parts are unlocked in Career or Science modes (repsectively).
zh: 这个非常基础的模组是 Ven's Stock Part Revamp 的补丁，使新增部件可纳入 Community Tech Tree (CTT)。除生涯或科学模式中新增部件的解锁顺序外，不添加或更改任何内容。

s: LazTek Temporal Anomalies is pleased to announce the availability of our SpaceX Launch Pack, including the new SpaceX Dragon V2 capsule and trunk, SpaceX Falcon 9 v1.1 and Falcon Heavy launch platforms
zh: <<M0>> Temporal Anomalies 荣幸宣布推出我们的 <<M1>> 发射包，包括新的 <<M1>> Dragon V2 乘员舱与货舱、<<M1>> Falcon 9 v1.1 和 Falcon Heavy 发射平台

s: Want to play RSS but not use RO or other extensive rescaling mods? This patch allows you to use stock parts in a bare RSS install and raises ISP/Thrust to make ships behave like in the real solar system.
zh: 想玩 RSS 但不使用 RO 或其他大幅重缩放模组？此补丁允许你在裸露的 RSS 安装中使用原版部件，并提高比冲/推力，使飞船表现如同在真实太阳系中。

s: Essentially, this is a 2.5 meter heat shield, with only a thin ablative coating, to which can be fitted with (through KAS, KIS, or in the VAB) eight additional panels that expand it to a 5-meter radius.
zh: 本质上，这是一个 2.5 米隔热罩，仅有一层薄烧蚀涂层，可通过 KAS、KIS 或在 VAB 中加装八块附加面板，将其扩展到 5 米半径。

s: ModuleManager Script to allow mining and converting Ore without storage tanks. It does this by adding a small amount of Ore storage to all ISRUs. Supports Stockalike Mining Extension by SuicidalInsanity
zh: <<M0>> 脚本允许在没有储罐的情况下开采并转化矿石。它通过为所有 ISRU 添加少量矿石储存来实现。支持 <<M1>> 的 Stockalike Mining Extension

s: This part addon contains over one hundred and twenty (120) parts and twenty (20) unique IVA's, all with rusty aesthetics. For Kerbal Space Program.
zh: 此部件包包含一百二十（120）个以上部件与二十（20）个独特 IVA，均为锈蚀风格。适用于 Kerbal Space Program。

s: Optional ModuleManager patch by Felger to re-enable probe control when a link is not present.  You will still need a link to transmit science data.
zh: Felger 制作的可选 <<M0>> 补丁，在无通信链路时重新启用探测器控制。传输科学数据仍需链路。

s: This mod adds a nosecone with a black tip that looks nice on the Mk3 cockpit.
zh: 此 mod 添加一个黑色尖端的锥头，装在 Mk3指令舱上效果不错。

s: a small mod for those who feel the need. the need for kerbal pudding in their space capsules
zh: 一个小 mod，献给有此需求的人——在太空舱里来点坎巴拉布丁的需求。

s: Canadarm for Infernal Robotics Next
zh: 用于 Infernal Robotics Next 的加拿大机械臂

s: The overhauled terrain textures for Parallax Continued
zh: Parallax Continued 的重制地形贴图

s: Automatic constant-speed variable-pitch propeller governor for Breaking Ground rotors
zh: 用于 Breaking Ground 旋翼的自动恒速变距螺旋桨调速器

s: A mod which reimpliments the old parts, for all your nostalgic needs.
zh: 重新实现旧版部件的 mod，满足你的怀旧需求。

s: A minor cfg tweak to extend strut length from 10 to 1000, so now your struts will reach just about anywhere, but "better engineering" is still recommended.
zh: 小幅 cfg 调整，将支柱长度从 10 延长至 1000，现在支柱几乎能伸到任何地方，但仍建议“更好的工程设计”。

s: An (almost) complete overhaul of the fuels in game.
zh: 对游戏内燃料的（几乎）全面重制。

s: Standalone and optional antenna package of RemoteTech Redev for Kerbal Space Program's stock CommNet
zh: <<M0>> Redev 的独立可选天线包，适用于 Kerbal Space Program 原版 <<M1>>

s: Get more science from orbit. Adds science experiments for your space station and for early space material science, inspired by real space experiments.
zh: 从轨道获得更多科学。为你的空间站与早期空间材料科学添加科学实验，灵感来自真实的太空实验。

s: mod adds tombstones for your deceased kerbals
zh: 为已故坎巴拉人添加墓碑的 mod

s: Life Support from Thunder Aerospace Corporation
zh: Thunder Aerospace Corporation 的生命保障系统

s: Mk2 parts, split into left & right, not upper and lower.
zh: Mk2 部件，按左右而非上下分割。

s: Jack-O'-Lantern by Porkjet. Jack-O'Lantern themed probe cores in five sizes. All the modcons. Now supports Chucking.
zh: Porkjet 制作的 Jack-O'-Lantern。五种尺寸的南瓜灯主题探测器核心。配置齐全。现支持 Chucking。

s: A config for Niven's Ringworld mod that places the scaled-down version of the Canon Ringworld around Kerbol
zh: Niven 的 Ringworld mod 配置，将缩小版的 Canon Ringworld 置于 Kerbol 周围

s: Graphotron is a plugin and part for KSP, that tracks and plots sensor and flight data into a nice graph.
zh: Graphotron 是 KSP 的插件与部件，可追踪传感器与飞行数据并绘制成美观的图表。

s: Automatically resizes ProceduralParts fuel tanks to fit a specified thrust to weight ratio
zh: 自动调整 <<M0>> 燃料箱尺寸，以匹配指定的推重比

s: Adds ground stations to launch sites in Real Solar System. Manually remove RemoteTech/RemoteTech_Settings.cfg first
zh: 为 Real Solar System 的发射场添加地面站。请先手动移除 <<M0>>

s: ScreenMessageHider is a very simple mod that hides ScreenMessages that don't normally get hidden when pressing F2
zh: <<M0>> 是一个非常简单的 mod，用于隐藏按 F2 时通常不会隐藏的 <<M1>>

s: Automatically enables auto-strut&skips mechanical parts
zh: 自动启用自动加固并跳过机械部件

s: This mod uses Module Manager patches to add an assortment of B9fuelswitch tank types to stock and DLC fuel tanks.
zh: 此 mod 使用 Module Manager 补丁，为原版与 DLC 燃料箱添加多种 <<M0>> 罐体类型。

s: kOS extension for RasterPropMonitor
zh: 用于 <<M0>> 的 kOS 扩展

s: A milkyway skybox from Space Engine for Kerbal Space Program.
zh: 来自 Space Engine 的银河天空盒，适用于 Kerbal Space Program。

s: An addon for Kerbal Space Program designed to improve the user interface for loading save games.
zh: 为 Kerbal Space Program 设计的插件，改进读取存档的用户界面。

s: Featuring an entirely new roster of planets, and an entirely different solar layout, experience a challenge the Kerbol system has never provided before!
zh: 拥有全新的一组行星与完全不同的星系布局，体验 Kerbol 星系从未有过的挑战。

s: CRP mode provides an extensive set of resource converter templates and parts that make use of the Community Resource Pack (CRP).
zh: CRP 模式提供大量资源转化炉模板与部件，均使用 Community Resource Pack（CRP）。

s: Adds reocurring revenue that rewards you for building bases, stations, and generally doing what you want to do.
zh: 添加周期性收入，奖励你建造基地、空间站，以及总体上做你想做的事。

s: Surface mounted stock-alike lights for self-illumination
zh: 表面安装的原版风格灯具，用于自照明

s: Project Casey is a Carcopter unmanned pod for Kerbal space program, with one seat available for the crew. This has been tested on KSP V1.1
zh: Project Casey 是 Kerbal Space Program 的 Carcopter 无人舱，可为乘员提供一个座位。已在 KSP V1.1 上测试。

s: Built-in cameras in every docking ports and standalone Camera for any place. Allows usage modes: "standart camera",  "follow me", "look at current target" "look from target", "look at me" (from any point)
zh: 每个对接口内置摄像机，另有可放置于任意位置的独立摄像机。支持使用模式："标准摄像机"、"跟随我"、"看向当前目标"、"从目标视角观察"、"看着我"（可从任意位置）

s: Orbital Material Science is a collection of multi-step experiments inspired by real-world ISS science experiments. To run experiments, you have to launch laboratories, equipment, and the experiments themselves and perform some assembly in-orbit before the experiments can be run. The idea is to run the experiments in the background while you do other missions.
zh: Orbital Material Science 是一组受现实国际空间站科学实验启发的多步骤实验。要运行实验，需先发射实验室、设备以及实验本身，并在轨道上完成部分组装后才能开始实验。设计理念是让你在执行其他任务时于后台运行实验。

s: AsteroidCometCleaner is a simple KSP mod that automatically removes excess untracked asteroids and comets from the game, keeping the number of each under control to reduce save bloat and improve performance. Tracked objects are not deleted.
zh: <<M0>> 是一个简单的 KSP mod，可自动移除游戏里多余的未追踪小行星和彗星，将各自数量控制在合理范围内，以减少存档膨胀并提升性能。已被追踪的物体不会被删除。

s: Features some essential textures in Procedural Parts that I thought were missing. Stock KSP station texture, Chaka Monkey (in addon dev) station texture, Chinese Tank Decals, KOSMOS station textures, Shuttle Engine mod textures, Castor SRB texture, Shuttle SRB textures
zh: 为 Procedural Parts 补充了一些我认为缺失的必要贴图：原版 KSP 空间站贴图、Chaka Monkey（附加开发中）空间站贴图、中国贮箱贴花、KOSMOS 空间站贴图、Shuttle Engine mod 贴图、Castor 固体助推器贴图、航天飞机固体助推器贴图

s: KerbNoteLite is a comprehensive note-taking and alarm system mod for Kerbal Space Program that helps you manage your missions with in-game notes, mini-notes, and location-based alarms. Features include multi-tab notebooks, rich text formatting, location-based alarms, mini-notes, customizable UI with texture support, and per-save data persistence.
zh: <<M0>> 是 KSP 的综合笔记与闹钟系统 mod，可通过游戏内笔记、迷你笔记和基于位置的闹钟来管理任务。功能包括多标签笔记本、富文本格式、基于位置的闹钟、迷你笔记、支持贴图的自定义界面，以及按存档持久保存数据。

s: Adds a new "fly by wire" SAS mode. When enabled, pitch and yaw inputs don't control the vessel directly anymore, but instead control the position of a custom navball direction marker that the SAS will follow automatically.
zh: 新增一种"线传飞行"SAS 模式。启用后，俯仰与偏航输入不再直接控制飞行器，而是控制一个自定义导航球方向标记的位置，由 SAS 自动跟随该方向。

s:
Interstellar Fuel Switch is mend for mod makers which want to add resource/mesh/texture switching to their tanks
Interstellar Fuel Switch is an improved version of FSFuelSwitch, FSMeshSwitch and FSTextureSwitch, FSTextureSwitch2 made by Snjo
zh:
Interstellar Fuel Switch 面向希望为自己的贮箱添加资源/网格/贴图切换功能的 mod 作者
Interstellar Fuel Switch 是 Snjo 制作的 <<M0>>、<<M1>>、<<M2>>、<<M3>> 的改进版本

s: This pack includes 18 MBAs with diameter < 100km and 6 moons: Lutetia | Virginia | Antiope, S/2000 (90) 1 | Rosa | Ida, Dactyl | Mathilde | Nike | Gaspra | Masursky | Šteins | Balam, S/2002 (3749) 1, S/2007 (3749) 1 | Annefrank | Bro | Scottmanley | Donaldjohanson | APL | Dinkinesh, Selam | 2006 VW139, S/2011 (300163) 1.
zh: 本包包含 18 颗直径 < 100km 的主带小行星和 6 颗卫星：Lutetia | Virginia | Antiope, S/2000 (90) 1 | Rosa | Ida, Dactyl | Mathilde | Nike | Gaspra | Masursky | Šteins | Balam, S/2002 (3749) 1, S/2007 (3749) 1 | Annefrank | Bro | Scottmanley | Donaldjohanson | APL | Dinkinesh, Selam | 2006 <<M0>>, S/2011 (300163) 1。

s: Custom Asteroids is a mod for KSP that expands the stock asteroid functionality. Under Custom Asteroids most asteroids will not be on a flyby course for Kerbin. Instead, the mod places asteroids in specific populations throughout the stock kerbol system.
zh: Custom Asteroids 是一个扩展原版小行星功能的 KSP mod。在 Custom Asteroids 下，大多数小行星不再处于掠过 Kerbin 的轨道上，而是由该 mod 将其分布到原版 Kerbol 星系中的各个特定族群中。

s: its Here!!! i am finally releasing a small WIP version of my Real launch sites mod that adds all the real launch sites we have in real life.. in KSP. currently this pack includes OLD Atlas and gemini pads, and the Space Shuttle launch pad with gantry. more will come in the future!! so stay tuned for updates!
zh: 它来了。我终于发布了 Real launch sites mod 的一个小型 WIP 版本，把现实中的真实发射场加入 KSP。目前本包包含旧式 Atlas 与 Gemini 发射台，以及带龙门架的航天飞机发射台。后续还会加入更多内容，敬请关注更新。

s: Old rocket parts from the dawn of the rocket age, back during kerbals Komplete Konflict II.  Wernher von Kerben's legacy. Old Aggregate rockets including those that were never built. For Kerbal Space Program.
zh: 来自火箭时代初期的老式火箭部件，可追溯到 kerbals Komplete Konflict II 时期。Wernher von Kerben 的遗产。包括那些从未建造过的 Aggregate 系列老式火箭。适用于 Kerbal Space Program。

s: This pack includes 18 NEOs with diameter < 2km and 6 moons: Amor | Icarus | Apollo, S/2005 (1862) 1 | Talos | Itokawa | YORP | Didymos, Dimorphos | Bennu | 1994 CC, S/2009 (136617) 1, S/2009 (136617) 2 | 2001 WN5 | Ryugu | Kamoʻoalewa | 2005 HC4 | Aten | Moshup, Squannit | Apophis | Duende | Zoozve | ꞌAylóꞌchaxnim.
zh: 本包包含 18 颗直径 < 2km 的近地天体和 6 颗卫星：Amor | Icarus | Apollo, S/2005 (1862) 1 | Talos | Itokawa | YORP | Didymos, Dimorphos | Bennu | 1994 CC, S/2009 (136617) 1, S/2009 (136617) 2 | 2001 WN5 | Ryugu | Kamoʻoalewa | 2005 HC4 | Aten | Moshup, Squannit | Apophis | Duende | Zoozve | ꞌAylóꞌchaxnim。

s: On Demand Fuel Cells (ODFC) is a plugin to simulate fuel cells in Kerbal Space Program (KSP), and do a better job of it than stock's use of a resource converter.  The main difference is it only generates electricity when it's really needed (batteries almost empty), and otherwise lets electricity of a craft float up and down, as it might in a solar powered vehicle when the sun is eclipsed by another celestial body.  It also allows fuel cells to generate byproducts, aimed at supporting life support mods like TACLS.
zh: 按需燃料电池（ODFC）是一个在坎巴拉太空计划（KSP）中模拟燃料电池的插件，效果比原版使用资源转化炉更好。主要区别在于：它只在真正需要时（电池几乎耗尽）才发电，其余时间则让飞船电量自然浮动，就像太阳能飞行器在太阳被其他天体遮挡时的情形。它还允许燃料电池产生副产物，用于支持 TACLS 之类的生命维持 mod。

s: A contract pack recreating almost all real-life missions that were actually flown, currently up until 1967 and the most exciting missions going into the 70s. This version is for users of RSS and fits well with RP-0/RP-1.
zh: 一个合约包，重现了几乎所有实际执行过的真实任务，目前涵盖至 1967 年，并延伸至 70 年代最激动人心的任务。此版本面向 RSS 用户，与 <<M0>>/<<M1>> 配合良好。

s: This is the fulcrum for the SETI meta mod pack. Only select this mod in CKAN, then click ApplyChanges and accept all recommendations and optionally the suggestions you like, to get a more balanced and challenging KSP experience!
zh: 这是 SETI 元 mod 包的核心。在 CKAN 中只勾选此 mod，然后点击 <<M0>> 并接受所有推荐项以及你喜欢的可选建议，即可获得更平衡、更具挑战性的 KSP 体验。

s: Updated  version of Thomassino's "Astroniki Sunflare for Scatterer" made to work with Real Solar System. Please note that this mod is NOT for stock KSP. Thanks to Astroniki for providing the textures for this mod!
zh: Thomassino 的“Astroniki Sunflare for Scatterer”的更新版本，已适配真实太阳系（RSS）。请注意本 mod 不适用于原版 KSP。感谢 Astroniki 为本 mod 提供贴图。

s: This is the SETI Rebalance MaterialsBay and MysteryGoo MM patch, so that those 2 experiments can not be collected by scientists anymore, which makes them much more balanced in terms of mass/science payout.
zh: 这是 SETI Rebalance 的 <<M0>> 与 <<M1>> MM 补丁，使这两个实验不再能由科学家收集，从而在质量与科学收益方面更加平衡。

s: DCK Future Tech contains Stealth Coating parts (YCSM - You Can't See Me) that reduces the radar cross section of the craft it is attached to  DCK Shields help protect your invisible armor (in DCKinc) from getting scratched ... They regenerate HitPoints over time using EC  DCK Active Camo makes your craft invisible and hides you from enemy radar when activated  DCK NanoTech regenerates the HitPoints of all non engine parts when active ... The Nanites use GLUE (Galvanized Liquid Universal Epoxy) to generate HP (master control part included)
zh: DCK Future Tech 包含隐身涂层部件（YCSM - You Can't See Me），可降低所附着飞船的雷达截面积。DCK 护盾可保护你的隐形装甲（位于 DCKinc）不被刮伤……它们会随时间消耗 EC 再生 <<M0>>。DCK 主动伪装激活后可使飞船隐形并躲避敌方雷达。DCK <<M1>> 激活时会再生所有非引擎部件的 <<M0>>……纳米机器使用 GLUE（镀锌液态通用环氧树脂）生成 HP（含主控部件）

s: HalfRSS is a mod that uses the great work from NathanKell and creates our Real Solar System at half the size. HalfRSS is still 5 times larger than stock KSP and provides a huge challenge to players, but can be achieved with stock parts.
zh: <<M0>> 是一个 mod，它基于 <<M1>> 的优秀成果，以一半尺寸构建了我们的真实太阳系。<<M0>> 仍比原版 KSP 大 5 倍，对玩家构成巨大挑战，但使用原版部件即可完成。

s: Telemachus 2.0 is a updated version of the masterpiece created by RICHARD BUNT that allows you to track vital vehicle systems in a separate web browser on your computer or on other computers via your local network.  This allows you to run a "Mission Control" style setups to help govern your mission.  With Telemachus, you will be able to not only see the data, but you can also control your ship via the web browser as well!
zh: Telemachus 2.0 是 RICHARD BUNT 杰作的更新版本，可让你在电脑上的独立网页浏览器中，或通过局域网在其他电脑上跟踪飞船的关键系统。借此你可以搭建“任务控制中心”式的配置来辅助指挥任务。使用 Telemachus，你不仅能查看数据，还能通过网页浏览器控制飞船。

s: This pack includes 14 MBAs with diameter > 100km and 15 moons: Pallas | Juno | Hygiea | Psyche | Kalliope, Linus | Eugenia, Petit-Prince, S/2004 (45) 1 | Cybele | Sylvia, Romulus, Remus | Minerva, Aegis, Gorgoneion | Camilla, S/2001 (107) 1, S/2016 (107) 1 | Hermione, S/2002 (121) 1 | Elektra, S/2003 (130) 1, S/2014 (130) 1, S/2014 (130) 2 | Kleopatra, Alexhelios, Cleoselene | Interamnia.

zh: 新增两种核火箭，并支持在燃料箱中切换 LFO/LF/O 燃料

zh: 以坎巴拉人的视角观察世界

s: An R2D2 like Droid, like in Star Wars.
zh: 一种类似《星球大战》中机器人的 <<M0>>。

zh: 我制作的一个小 mod，为 Mun 增加一颗环绕它的小卫星

zh: <<M0>> 配置脚本，新增可使用液体燃料和氧化剂的 Universal Storage 燃料电池，以替代其他资源。

zh: 新增便捷的窗口/RPM 标签页，含载具 3D 模型与彩色读数。

zh: <<M0>> Impact Puffs 为发射与着陆添加发动机尾焰地面扬尘效果，并在较硬的着陆中产生一次性触地扬尘。需要 <<M0>> Core。

zh: Kerbal Space Program 1.3.1 波兰语化（Alpha 1.46）

s: Adds liquid fuel storage to all the stock wing pieces. Requires ModuleManager.
zh: 为所有原版机翼部件添加液体燃料储存。需要 <<M0>>。

s: A contract pack to replace the default Squad build a Space Station missions
zh: 替换 Squad 默认建造空间站任务的合同包

zh: KSP 着色器、纹理与建模工具

zh: 基于 NASA 航天器研究建造飞行器

zh: 此配置包为 Near Future Propulsion 部件添加 <<M0>> 支持。它不会影响原版部件；如有需要请安装原版 <<M0>> 配置。

zh: 适用于所有生命支持系统的类 SSPX 温室

zh: 为 Dres 添加一颗名为 Spud 的 Kopernicus 卫星

s: The cockpit and props from QuizTech Aero Pack
zh: 来自 <<M0>> Aero Pack 的座舱与螺旋桨

zh: MPR 是一个飞机部件 mod，遵循原版/AirplanePlus 的美术风格，计划部件没有强制的特定分类

s: Greenhouses (Snacks-LS), More Command Pods/Station Parts, Nuclear Engines + Reactors and, Old KSP Parts with new uses.

zh: 本 mod 在 KSP 1.1 及更高版本中已弃用。请在这些版本的 KSP 中使用 <<M0>> - <<M1>> - <<M2>>。添加一次性回收所有已着陆飞行器的功能。

s: Space Launch System Parts Pack is a modification that adds to the basic game section dedicated to the SLS program.
zh: Space Launch System Parts Pack 是一个在原版游戏中添加 SLS 计划专属分类的修改。

s: Part Pack based on streamlining builds, and adding engine configurations
zh: 以精简建造流程并添加发动机配置为核心的部件包

s: Uncharted Lands is a procedurally created planet overhaul for KSP, designed to change things up in the stock system for a whole new game.
zh: Uncharted Lands 是为 KSP 程序化生成的星球大改，旨在改变原版星系，带来全新的游戏体验。

s: A heatshield for the Super 100 Shooting Star Command Pod
zh: Super 100 Shooting Star 指令舱的隔热罩

s: Allows the use of any airlock on a vessel in conjunction with any crew part on the vessel, without requiring manual crew transfer.
zh: 允许飞行器上的任意气闸与任意载员部件配合使用，无需手动转移乘员。

s: Plasma smoothly blocks the signal of RemoteTech antennas depending on the intensity.
zh: 等离子体根据强度平滑地屏蔽 <<M0>> 天线的信号。

s: Low RAM Stock-a-like expansion using squad models for reference.
zh: 低内存占用的类原版扩展，以 Squad 模型为参考。

s: Something that'll make your mod look cool
zh: 让你的 mod 显得更酷的东西

zh: 将 <<M0>> Wyvern 5 Crew Capsule mod 中的罗马尼亚舱体加入 <<M1>> 科技树。

zh: 此 mod 是 BDB 的独立扩展，可让你建造 ULA Vulcan 火箭

s: Two TUFX profiles made by me. Maybe more to come

s: Lightweight TestFlight replacement for KSP-RO
zh: 为 KSP-RO 提供的轻量级 <<M0>> 替代品

s: A mod-focused, longer-campaign tech tree
zh: 面向 mod 的长期战役科技树

s: A standalone EVA resource transfer system
zh: 独立的 EVA 资源转移系统

s: This mod adds a tool that you can use to achieve various camera angles.  It's helpful for getting cool shots for cinematics.
zh: 此 mod 添加一个可用于获得各种摄像机角度的工具，便于拍摄炫酷的电影镜头。

s: Custom Kerbal hero + a more dynamic start
zh: 自定义坎巴拉英雄 + 更具动态的起点

s: Custom Flags made for my SSTOs, among other things.
zh: 为我的 SSTO 等制作的定制旗帜。

s: Custom Launch sites for Cape Canaveral in RSS
zh: RSS 中卡纳维拉尔角的自定义发射场

s: Adds a deploy limit to service bays.
zh: 为服务舱添加开启限位。

zh: 可从追踪站将 KSC 移动到坎星的其他位置。

s: The sunflare component of scatterer
zh: Scatterer 的太阳耀斑组件

s: Adds a button for heatshields to decouple whatever is connected below them, removing the need for an extra decoupler under the heatshield. Requires Module Manager.
zh: 为隔热罩添加按钮，可分离其下方连接的任意部件，无需在隔热罩下额外安装分离器。需要 Module Manager。

s: HotRockets (does not include plugins) - REQUIRES SMOKESCREEN AND MODULEMANAGER TO WORK.
zh: <<M0>>（不含插件）——需 Smokescreen 和 ModuleManager 才能运行。

s: With this mod you can create and play sequences of servo movement commands and special commands, like GoTo, Toggle ActionGroup, Delay and Wait.
zh: 使用此 mod 可创建并播放伺服运动指令与特殊指令的序列，如 GoTo、开关 <<M0>>、延时和等待。

zh: Kerbalism 与 Near Future Electrical 之间的后台反应堆桥接。

s: The Bulb Mod, with few bug fixes
zh: The Bulb Mod，附带少量错误修复

s: Update of my IVA/EVA colored suits pack for the new 1.5 suit models.
zh: 我的 IVA/EVA 彩色宇航服包针对 1.5 新版宇航服模型的更新。

s: Low dry mass, low cost. Get rid of staging with self-consuming rockets !
zh: 干质量低，成本低。用自耗式火箭摆脱分级。

s: Adds an alignment indicator to the navball
zh: 为导航球添加对准指示器

s: Extendible tethers & other parts based on the movie 'Stowaway'
zh: 基于电影《Stowaway》的可伸展系绳及其他部件

s: A Kopernicus Planet Pack that adds a Barnard's Star analog
zh: 添加巴纳德星类比的 Kopernicus 行星包

s: KSP mod that enables automatic loading of saved games at start.
zh: 使游戏启动时自动加载存档的 KSP mod。

s: Provides Space Suits in a Steampunky flavour
zh: 提供蒸汽朋克风格的宇航服

s: This mod adds 1 new planet with 4 interesting moons.
zh: 此 mod 添加 1 颗新行星及 4 颗有趣的卫星。

s: Adds a planet called Dlrow and a moon.
zh: 添加一颗名为 Dlrow 的行星和一颗卫星。

zh: 用于 RSB 原版化的可选补丁，重新缩放并平衡部件以配合原版风格游玩。

zh: Skunkworks 原版针对最新 1.12.1 的升级版

s: I made a unique moon for kerbin.
zh: 我为坎星制作了一颗独特的卫星。

zh: 让你可以自定义坎巴拉人的姓名生成，正如你一直梦想的那样。可添加或删除随机名字前缀、后缀和姓氏，或完全更改姓名生成的参数。

s: A set of Kerbal Space Program PartModules designed to control animations in B9 Aerospace.
zh: 一组用于控制 B9 Aerospace 动画的 KSP <<M0>>。

s: Tank you very much. Do come again
zh: 万分油谢，欢迎再来

zh: 选择与发展路线更清晰的修改版科技树

zh: Stock Waterfall Effects、Waterfall Restock 与 Jet Sounds Continued 的定制版本，完整覆盖 Restock 和 Restock Plus 中的所有发动机。

zh: 为 Lack Luster Labs 添加额外部件，并增加对 TAC Life Support 与 Connected Living Space 的兼容性。

s: Advanced console for in-game logging system. Supports persistense, filtering, records grouping, and many more.
zh: 游戏内日志系统的高级控制台。支持持久化、过滤、记录分组等多项功能。

s: A mod that eliminates phasing in KSP and improves the accuracy of collisions.
zh: 消除 KSP 中穿模现象并提高碰撞精度的 mod。

s: This pack includes 1 object for the Hayabusa mission: Itokawa.
zh: 此包包含 1 个用于隼鸟号任务的天体：Itokawa。

s: Adds 3 fuel tanks to help with rover creation.
zh: 添加 3 个燃料罐，便于制作漫游车。

zh: 技术上基于 Pawskers Inc，本 mod 旨在添加我希望游戏拥有的功能，并填补其他 mod 之间的空白。不过可能存在重叠。

zh: KGEx 通用 B9 罐体类型与供 mod 使用的 <<M0>> 缩放类型文件。

zh: 供各类 Spacetux mod 使用的共享资源（旗帜与机构）

s: The first, land-able, Ring World megastructure in KSP from Larry Niven's Ring World.
zh: KSP 中首个可着陆的环形世界巨型结构，源自 Larry Niven 的《环形世界》。

s: Calculates approximate landing velocity for current parachutes on board
zh: 计算当前机上降落伞的大致着陆速度

s: A series of ten ribbons based on Battlestar Galactica's Officer Rank system.
zh: 基于《太空堡垒卡拉狄加》军官军衔体系的一系列十条绶带。

s: RSE sounds for stock engines, wheels, decouplers, and more
zh: 为原版发动机、车轮、分离器及更多部件提供 RSE 音效

s: Adds stockalike Angara and Post-Soviet launch Vehicles.
zh: 添加原版风格的安加拉及后苏联运载火箭。

s: Procedural Parts textures in modern (a little bit sci-fi) look
zh: 现代（略带科幻）风格的程序化部件纹理

s: The True Continuation of Big Blue by yours truly.
zh: 由本人制作的 Big Blue 正统延续版。

zh: 这是社区制作的一组补丁，使 KW 兼容至 1.0.4。

s: Addon for Spectra. Adds Scatterer config to enhance sunsets. Causes artifacting in orbit.
zh: Spectra 的附加组件。添加 Scatterer 配置以增强日落效果。会在轨道上产生画面伪影。

zh: 为现代 BD 复活并重制 Malfunc 与 PEW

zh: 将经典的 Mk1驾驶舱 设计重新带回游戏，作为独立部件，属性略有提升，在科技树中拥有新位置，窗户灯可正常工作，等等。

zh: 该 ModuleManager 补丁使 Breaking Ground 的涡轮轴发动机耗油更少，并在科技树中更早解锁，以鼓励在生涯模式中制造更慢的飞机。

s: This mod rearranges bodies from other mods to reproduce the Solar System but with a Kerbal style.
zh: 此 mod 重新排列其他 mod 中的天体，以 Kerbal 风格重现太阳系。

zh: 为 Neried 的 Final Frontier mod 提供九枚勋带，主题取自美国海军士兵军衔体系。

s: Switch between fired missiles of DBArmory.
zh: 在 DBArmory 已发射的导弹之间切换。

s: Medium quality diamond sunflare for Scatterer
zh: 适用于 Scatterer 的中画质菱形太阳耀斑

s: A simple continuation from the popular 1.1.3 mod, Jet Sounds.
zh: 人气 1.1.3 版 mod Jet Sounds 的简单延续。

s: A small collection of KSP Flags
zh: 一小套 KSP 旗帜合集

s: Small mod to control retractable/foldable lifing surfaces
zh: 用于控制可收回/可折叠升力面的小型 mod

s: CubeSat inspired probes that allow internally stacked parts! MechJeb and TweakScale compatible.
zh: 受 <<M0>> 启发的探测器，支持部件内部堆叠！兼容 <<M1>> 与 <<M2>>。

s: A mod to help planning complex missions
zh: 辅助规划复杂任务的 mod

s: API for third-party plugins to provide toolbar buttons
zh: 供第三方插件提供工具栏按钮的 API

s: Want to land your rockets in the ocean with extreme difficulty?
zh: 想让你的火箭以极高难度在海上着陆吗？

s: Contracts are great, but not as good as that sweet sweet reoccurring revenue.
zh: 合同固然不错，却比不上源源不断的收入。

zh: 为 KSP 提供低推力发动机导航功能的插件。原 mod 作者 mrsolarsail。

s: A plugin for Kerbal Space Program which provides a simple framework for simulating propellant mixtures across fuel tanks, engines and RCS thrusters.
zh: 为 KSP 提供简易框架的插件，可在燃料箱、发动机与 RCS 推进器之间模拟推进剂混合。

s: This mod adapted from silversilver's The Blue Scoop adds an intake capable on filtering xenon gas from atmospheres.
zh: 此 mod 改编自 silversilver 的 The Blue Scoop，新增可从大气中过滤氙气的进气道。

s: The Jool texture taken from Revamped Stock Solar System.
zh: 取自 Revamped Stock Solar System 的 Jool 纹理。

s: Adds a set of stockalike parachutes based on those from Estes model rocket kits in the 1990's.
zh: 新增一套原版风格降落伞，基于 1990 年代 Estes 模型火箭套件中的降落伞。

s: VaporCones adds a vapor cone effect to high-speed flight in Kerbal Space Program.
zh: <<M0>> 为 KSP 中的高速飞行添加蒸汽锥效应。

s: Aircraft routes all around the Kerbin! Contracts to perform various flights between majority of Kerbin Side bases.
zh: 环绕 Kerbin 的航空路线！在大多数 Kerbin Side 基地之间执行各类飞行的合同。

zh: 一款 KSP mod 制作工具，使用 Module Manager 计算部件的一些实用数值与属性。

s: A simple and easy way to display the current game fps
zh: 一种简单便捷的方式，用于显示当前游戏帧率

s: A redistribution of Extraplanetary Launchpads without the bloat
zh: 去除冗余内容的 Extraplanetary Launchpads 重分发版本

s: Everyone's favorite life support in everyone's favorite shapes. The Mk2 and Mk3 body.
zh: 备受欢迎的生命维持系统，搭配备受欢迎的造型。Mk2 与 Mk3 机身。

s: Adds Dune Inspired Hand-Made Star Systems, Also my first mod pack.
zh: 添加受《沙丘》启发的手工恒星系，也是我的第一个 mod 包。

s: Docking ports that can't be undocked, but are much more rigid.
zh: 无法解除对接的对接端口，但结构刚性大幅提升。

s: A continuation of the venerable NovaPunch launcher pack.  This is mostly Engines and Tanks, with a few Command Modules, and a small lander setup.
zh: 经典 <<M0>> 运载火箭包的后继版本。主要内容为发动机与储罐，另有少量指令舱和一套小型着陆器。

s: Core Firespitter.dll. Install `Firespitter` for the whole shebang
zh: <<M0>> 核心。安装 <<M1>> 以获得完整内容

s: Shared resources for Ven's Stock Revamp and Ven's New Parts
zh: Ven's Stock Revamp 与 Ven's New Parts 的共享资源

s: A plugin that allows the creation of good looking, easy to use, single part payload farings.
zh: 一个插件，可创建外观精美、易于使用的单部件有效载荷整流罩。

s: This config pack adds TestFlight support for Kerbal Atomics parts. It does not affect stock parts; install a stock TestFlight config if desired.
zh: 本配置包为 Kerbal Atomics 部件添加 <<M0>> 支持。不会影响原版部件；如需请安装原版 <<M0>> 配置。

s: Kontainers, Reactors and shared tools for USI mods
zh: Kontainers、反应堆以及 USI 系列 mod 的共享工具

s: Lets solar panels, radiators and antennae all work together
zh: 让太阳能板、散热器与天线协同工作

s: Mapping tool for craft sharing site with Auto Mod Detection and Search-By-Mod feature
zh: 用于飞行器分享网站的映射工具，具备自动 mod 检测与按 mod 搜索功能

s: A simple addon to provide DeltaV and related info while in the VAB/SPH
zh: 一个简单的附加组件，在 VAB/SPH 中提供 <<M0>> 及相关信息

s: Allows engineers to fix wheels at lower levels
zh: 让工程师在较低等级即可修理车轮

s: A simple-to-understand, yet powerful life support mod
zh: 一个易于理解且功能强大的生命维持 mod

s: Retired parts and expansion pack
zh: 已退役的部件与扩展包

s: Plugin that creates blue-print-like images (into your <KSP Root>Screenshots/ directory) from the KSP Editor (VAB/SPH).
zh: 该插件可在 KSP 编辑器（VAB/SPH）中生成蓝图风格的图片（保存至 <<M0>>Screenshots/ 目录）。

s: Adds the possibility to use the SCANsat mod without the additional parts.
zh: 无需额外部件即可使用 SCANsat mod。

s: An extension for the stock technology tree designed to support many mods
zh: 原版科技树的扩展，旨在支持众多 mod

s: Nuclear reactors, capacitors and more batteries that fit right in with stock
zh: 核反应堆、电容器以及更多与原版风格相符的电池

s: A Kerbal Space Program mod that adds an avionics-style telemetry panel: local time, day/night phase, sun position, atmosphere, and position.
zh: 一款 KSP mod，添加航空电子风格的遥测面板：当地时间、昼夜相位、太阳位置、大气与位置。

s: Rocket parts shouldn't be 100% reliable, especially if Jeb built them.
zh: 火箭部件不该 100% 可靠，尤其是 Jeb 造的那些。

s: Re-parent parts without changing their position.
zh: 在不改变位置的前提下重新指定部件的父级。

s: Internet Relay Chat (IRC) Plugin for KSP
zh: KSP 的 Internet Relay Chat（IRC）插件

s: This mod adds the planet Frigus between Duna and Dres. It's a smaller ice planet with a small moon (Tresden) in a sort of elliptical orbit. The moon provides great views and photos.
zh: 本 mod 在 Duna 与 Dres 之间添加行星 Frigus。它是一颗较小的冰行星，拥有一颗沿近椭圆轨道运行的小卫星（Tresden）。这颗卫星提供了绝佳的景观与摄影素材。

s: Keep track of your fleet of launch vehicles and get suggestions on which would be best to lift your newest satellite into orbit
zh: 记录你的运载火箭队伍，并获得关于哪一枚最适合将最新卫星送入轨道的建议

s: A mod that replaces the bland old stock loading screens with vibrant, colorful ones from the KASA project.
zh: 将原版单调的载入画面替换为来自 KASA 项目的鲜艳多彩画面的 mod。

s: Provides dedicated parts. Some are demos for concept tech. Some are niche ISRU parts.
zh: 提供专用部件。部分为概念技术的演示，部分为特定用途的 ISRU 部件。

s: This mods allows to lock moving parts in place when they should not be moved.
zh: 本 mod 可在活动部件不应移动时将其锁定到位。

s: KSP: Graphics enhancement for Kerbol
zh: KSP：Kerbol 图形增强

s: "Kerbal Mods Overhaul" (KMO) is a set of patches that simplify/modify a number of very popular mods (MKS, EL, USI-LS, etc) and create a new customized gameplay experience.
zh: “Kerbal Mods Overhaul”（KMO）是一组补丁，用于简化/修改多个非常流行的 mod（MKS、EL、USI-LS 等），并创造全新的定制游戏体验。

s: Adjust navball markers scale, collapse behavior, afraid mouse cursor.
zh: 调整导航球标记的缩放、折叠行为以及鼠标指针避让。

s: Contains a Duna + Ike binary system.
zh: 包含由 Duna 与 Ike 组成的双星系统。

s: Fixes the "estimated burn time" indicator on the navball. No more "N/A"!  Compensates for fuel consumption. Includes time-to-impact indicator for landing.
zh: 修复导航球上的“预计点火时间”指示器。不再显示“N/A”！会补偿燃料消耗。包含着陆用的撞击倒计时指示器。

s: StockRT is a ModuleManager config file which adds the possibility to use the RemoteTech mod without the additional parts.
zh: <<M0>> 是一个 <<M1>> 配置文件，可让你无需额外部件即可使用 <<M2>> mod。

s: A single Kerbal Engineer Redux companion plugin containing two rendezvous advisory instruments, one for atmospheric orbital plane matching during SSTO climbout, and one for determining the most optimal launch windows to for rendezvous.
zh: 一个 Kerbal Engineer Redux 的配套插件，包含两个交会辅助仪表：一个用于 SSTO 爬升阶段的大气层内轨道面匹配，另一个用于确定最佳交会发射窗口。

s: The patch utilizes the Waterresource from Community Resource Pack, adding a module to stock Fuel Cellsthat ​​reverses Nertea's cryogenic hydrogen-oxygen fuel cell logic​​ (originally added to Cryo Tanks). Instead of consuming hydrogen, it now ​​takes in Water and ElectricCharge to produce liquid hydrogen and oxidizer​​.
zh: 该补丁利用 Community Resource Pack 中的 Water 资源，为原版燃料电池添加一个模块，反转 Nertea 的低温氢氧燃料电池逻辑（最初加入 Cryo Tanks）。它不再消耗氢，而是消耗水和 <<M0>>，产出液氢与氧化剂。

s: This add contracts for base construction and maintenance. This can be done in any planet or moon that you want, it even supports planet packs. Also the bases doesn't need to dock just to land very close to the main base
zh: 此插件添加基地建设与维护合同。你可以在任意行星或卫星上进行，甚至支持行星包。基地也无需对接，只需降落在主基地附近即可。

s:
Contrails adds condensation trails behind air-breathing engines at high
altitude, so your jets leave the white streaks you see in the real sky.

The trail is attached to every engine that breathes air, which means
turbojets, ramjets, piston engines and rotors work too, including those
from Advanced Jet Engine. Rockets get nothing, and electric propellers are
skipped on purpose.

Two modes, switched in settings.cfg:

  arcade     - a bold, War Thunder style trail;
  realistic  - thin crisp lines right behind the nozzles that spread within
               a few seconds into a wide, lumpy band, matching real photos.

Everything is tunable in GameData/Contrails/settings.cfg: altitude limits
and the fade band around them, trail lifetime, growth, opacity, nozzle gap,
fade-in time, shadow strength and emission rate. With "Vapour as particles"
enabled the trail is drawn as volumetric cloud puffs instead of a ribbon,
and the puffs themselves have quality, spacing and layer count settings.

An in-game settings window (via Toolbar Controller) applies changes while
you fly and can save your favourite setups as presets. The window is
available in Russian and English.
zh:
Contrails 为高空中的吸气式发动机添加凝结尾迹，让你的喷气机在天空中留下真实照片里那样的白色条纹。

尾迹会附加到每一台吸气式发动机上，因此涡喷、冲压、活塞发动机和旋翼同样适用，包括 Advanced Jet Engine 的部件。火箭不会产生尾迹，电动螺旋桨则刻意跳过。

两种模式，在 <<M0>> 中切换：

  街机     - 醒目的 War Thunder 风格尾迹；
  真实     - 喷口后方纤细清晰的线条，几秒内扩散成宽阔而起伏的带状，与真实照片一致。

所有内容均可在 <<M1>> 中调整：高度限制及其周围的淡出带、尾迹寿命、扩散、不透明度、喷口间隙、淡入时间、阴影强度和发射率。启用“蒸汽作为粒子”后，尾迹会以体积云团而非带状绘制，云团本身也有质量、间距和层数设置。

游戏内设置窗口（通过 Toolbar Controller）可在飞行中应用更改，并可将喜爱的配置保存为预设。窗口支持俄语和英语。

s: Starship Expansion Project (SEP) is a mod being developed by me, Kari, and our amazing team. Our project aims to bring our intepretation of the Starship vehicle by SpaceX into Kerbal Space Program. While a lot of the design choices are based on the actual vehicle sitting on Boca Chica, creative freedom is used to expand our mod even further.
zh: Starship Expansion Project（SEP）是由我 Kari 和我们出色的团队共同开发的 mod。本项目旨在将我们对 <<M0>> 星舰的理解带入 Kerbal Space Program。虽然许多设计选择基于博卡奇卡的真实飞行器，但我们也在发挥创意自由，进一步扩展这个 mod。

s: These are a pair of animated augers (one large, one small) for the Extraplanetary Launchpads mod by skykooler and taniwha.  They do not overwrite any parts from the mod and aren't officially part of the mod, just my own addon for them.
zh: 这是为 skykooler 和 taniwha 的 Extraplanetary Launchpads mod 制作的一对动画螺旋钻（一大一小）。它们不会覆盖该 mod 的任何部件，也并非该 mod 的官方组成部分，只是我为其制作的自定义附加内容。

s: Explore hundreds of real-world asteroids, comets and moons in KSP. The next generation of RSS-Origin, an addon for Sol. This is the core config, texture and plugin pack of RSS-Origin 2, install this first.
zh: 在 KSP 中探索数百颗真实世界的小行星、彗星和卫星。这是 RSS-Origin 的下一代版本，是 Sol 的附加内容。这是 RSS-Origin 2 的核心配置、贴图和插件包，请先安装此包。

s: Lionhead Aerospace Circular Solar Panels. They come in default Black, but can be changed to Blue.   To change color, go in: VAB or SPH, when a solar panel is placed on a craft, right-click and you will get options to change colors. Make sure the solar panel is extend, so you can see the color change.
zh: Lionhead Aerospace 圆形太阳能板。默认颜色为黑色，可改为蓝色。要更改颜色：在 VAB 或 SPH 中，将太阳能板放置在飞行器上后右键单击，即可看到更改颜色的选项。请确保太阳能板处于展开状态，以便看到颜色变化。

s: A mod for KSP that adds 22 camouflage patterns, 19 solid colors and 1 Waldoto Stock, Aviator Arsenal. BD Armory Continued, BDMk22, SM_AFVs, Mk2 Expansion, QuizTech, KAX, Airplane Plus, BAD T Props and Procedural Parts as well as rims and tires for the M1 and TR-2L wheels  DCK contains Stealth Coating parts (YCSM - You Can't See Me) that reduces the radar cross section of the craft it is attached to when using the YCSM part in conjunction with BDAc as well as Transparent/Invisible Aircraft Armor (FAR compatibility MM patch included for those who use DCK Aircraft Armor with FAR) to protect your shiny new paintjob  DCK also has Z-90 'Oval', Z-90 'Round' and Z-4190 'Bubble' shields to help protect your invisible armor from getting scratched
zh: 一个为 KSP 添加 22 种迷彩图案、19 种纯色和 1 种 Waldoto 的 mod，适用于 Stock、Aviator Arsenal、BD Armory Continued、<<M0>>、SM_AFVs、Mk2 Expansion、<<M1>>、KAX、Airplane Plus、BAD T Props 和 Procedural Parts，以及 M1 和 <<M2>> 车轮的轮毂与轮胎。DCK 包含隐身涂层部件（YCSM - You Can't See Me），当 YCSM 部件与 BDAc 配合使用时，可降低所附着飞行器的雷达截面积；还包含透明/隐形飞行器装甲（为使用 DCK 飞行器装甲与 FAR 的玩家提供了 FAR 兼容 MM 补丁），以保护你闪亮的新涂装。DCK 还提供 <<M3>>“椭圆”、<<M3>>“圆形”和 <<M4>>“气泡”护盾，帮助保护你的隐形装甲免遭刮伤。

s: This pack includes 22 extra moons for Saturn: Hyperion | Phoebe | Janus | Epimetheus | Helene | Telesto | Calypso | Atlas | Prometheus | Pandora | Pan | Ymir | Paaliaq | Kiviuq | Albiorix | Siarnaq | Methone | Pallene | Polydeuces | Daphnis | Anthe | Aegaeon.
zh: 此包为土星添加 22 颗额外卫星：Hyperion | Phoebe | Janus | Epimetheus | Helene | Telesto | Calypso | Atlas | Prometheus | Pandora | Pan | Ymir | Paaliaq | Kiviuq | Albiorix | Siarnaq | Methone | Pallene | Polydeuces | Daphnis | Anthe | Aegaeon。

s: Ship Manifest is a tool to manage your ship's "things".  Ship Manifest moves crew, Science and Resources around from part to part within your ship or station.  It also manages Hatches, Solar Panels, Antennas and Lights.
zh: Ship Manifest 是一款管理飞船“物品”的工具。Ship Manifest 可在飞船或空间站内于各部件之间转移乘员、科学和资源。它还能管理舱门、太阳能板、天线和灯光。

s: Lots of new suits, from spies to cops to parties to just lookin' kool. Includes: cadet suit, badass suit, formal suit, police suit, golden suit, spy suit, army suit, casual suit, HAZMAT suit,  job suits, and more!
zh: 大量新制服，从间谍、警察到派对装束，也有纯粹耍帅的款式。包括：学员制服、酷炫制服、正装、警服、金色制服、间谍制服、军装、休闲装、危险品防护服、职业制服等！

s: Tired of playing "sniper" trying to access a part's right-click menu while hurtling through space? Ever wish you could access those options while in IVA or Map View? Don't feel like setting up action groups for everything? Then Part Commander is for you! Part Commander consolidates all the right-click menus from parts on the active vessel into a single interface (with the optional ability to "pop off" selected parts into their own windows if you wish).
zh: 厌倦了在太空中高速飞行时还要像“狙击手”一样去瞄准部件的右键菜单？是否希望在 IVA 或地图视角下也能访问这些选项？不想为所有功能都设置动作组？那么 Part Commander 就是为你准备的！Part Commander 将当前飞行器上所有部件的右键菜单整合到单一界面中（还可选择将指定部件“弹出”为独立窗口）。

s: HyperEdit is the ultimate cheat plugin for KSP.  Teleport your ship, refill your tanks, change any orbit, move the planets around, and edit things like speed, gravity, atmospheric pressure, time, and more.
zh: <<M0>> 是 KSP 的终极作弊插件。可传送飞船、补满燃料箱、修改任意轨道、移动行星，还能编辑速度、重力、大气压力、时间等。

s: Skybox that presents the Kerbal Solar System within a sparse Nebula. Features a subtle Galaxy star-line and patches of Pink/Blue Nebula proto-Star fields. To the polar South a very energetic solar nursery can be seen.
zh: 将 Kerbal 太阳系置于稀薄星云之中的天空盒。包含一条隐约的银河星带，以及片片粉/蓝色星云原恒星区。在南天极可看到一片极为活跃的恒星孕育区。

s: Skybox of our night sky made using reference images from the Bright Star, Tycho-2, and UCAC3 star catalogs. This provides a very nice constant star coverage across the whole 360 degrees in the x, y and z planes.
zh: 依据 Bright Star、Tycho-2 和 <<M0>> 星表参考图像制作的夜空天空盒。在 x、y、z 三个平面上实现覆盖完整 360 度的均匀恒星分布，效果十分出色。

s:
Add 6 new antennas for CommNet, filling a niche in the transmission ranges: direct 5M, relay 25M, relays 7G and 25G, direct and relay 500G.
Also include a little plugin, what shows a combinability exponent in the parts' panel (VAB/SPH).
zh:
为 <<M0>> 添加 6 个新天线，填补传输距离区间的空白：直连 5M、中继 25M、中继 7G 与 25G、直连与中继 500G。
还附带一个小插件，可在部件面板（VAB/SPH）中显示组合指数。

s: Ship Manifest is a tool to manage your ship's "things".  Ship Manifest moves Crew, Science & Resources around your vessel.  It manages docked vessel resources too!.  It also manages Hatches, Solar Panels, Antennas & Lights.
zh: Ship Manifest 是一个管理飞船上“各类物资”的工具。Ship Manifest 可在飞行器内调配乘员、科学与资源，也能管理已对接飞行器的资源！此外还可管理舱门、太阳能板、天线与灯光。

s: TCA is a plugin that enhances the attitude control of a ship by dynamically changing the output of its engines and RCS thrusters. Even with most unbalanced designs TCA maintains stable flight and quick precise response to user or autopilot input. TCA also provides many sophisticated autopilot programs based on this core functionality, including waypoint navigation and automatic landing. It is also fast enough to simultaneously control a whole squadron of ships without much overhead.
zh: TCA 是一个通过动态调整发动机与 RCS 推进器输出来增强飞船姿态控制的插件。即便面对大多数不平衡设计，TCA 也能保持稳定飞行，并对玩家或自动驾驶输入做出快速精确响应。基于这一核心功能，TCA 还提供多种高级自动驾驶程序，包括航点导航与自动着陆。其运行效率足以同时控制整支飞船编队而开销甚微。

s:
Day and night modes in the VAB/SPH.

Based on RealGecko's May 6, 2016 recompile for KSP 1.1.2, but changes the hangar hotkey from L to P to avoid conflicts with RCS Build Aid and RPM JSI Camera, and also includes a patch to ignore hotkeys when the cursor is in a text field (e.g. parts search).
zh:
VAB/SPH 中的昼夜模式。

基于 <<M0>> 于 2016 年 5 月 6 日为 KSP 1.1.2 重新编译的版本，但将机库热键由 L 改为 P，以避免与 RCS Build Aid 和 RPM JSI Camera 冲突；同时包含一个补丁，使光标位于文本框（如部件搜索）时不响应热键。

s: This is a collection of ribbons that you can assign to your Scientists to differentiate their qualifications and expertise for Role-Playing purposes. PLEASE NOTE: Final Frontier is required for this ribbon pack.
zh: 这是一组绶带，可授予你的科学家，以区分其资历与专长，用于角色扮演。请注意：本绶带包需要 Final Frontier。

s: Next Star Industries has several divisions in its ranks from basic ship building parts, to a highly developed mining division, plus a well rounded military division. This mod also brings a military style career mode to BDAc(wip).
zh: Next Star Industries 旗下设有多个部门，涵盖基础飞船建造部件、高度发达的采矿部门，以及门类齐全的军事部门。本 mod 还为 BDAc 带来了军事风格的生涯模式（开发中）。

s: This contract pack is designed to take you through the history of the human space program. It will take you from the first sounding rockets to New Horizons and into the future. You will be tasked with recreating some of the most ambitious missions like the Apollo Program, Voyager and the International Space Station. It is up to you to guide the Kerbals into the cosmos through a historical progression.
zh: 该合同包旨在带你走过人类航天计划的历史。从最早的探空火箭，到新视野号，再一路走向未来。你将受命重现一些最雄心勃勃的任务，例如阿波罗计划、旅行者号和国际空间站。由你引导 Kerbal 沿着历史进程迈向宇宙。

s:
Atmosphere autopilot is a modular atmospheric flight control system library.
It features a Fly-By-Wire System that replaces the stock SAS, and cruise control with heading/altitude/velocity setpoints. All without tuning PID parameters!

If you're using Stock Bug Fix Modules, turn off ModuleControlSurfacePlus and ModuleGimbalPlus modules in its manager.
zh:
Atmosphere autopilot 是一个模块化的大气飞行控制库。
它提供替代原版 SAS 的电传操纵系统，以及可设定航向/高度/速度的巡航控制，全程无需调整 PID 参数！

如果你使用了 Stock Bug Fix Modules，请在其管理器中关闭 <<M0>> 和 <<M1>> 模块。

s: Freshly imported from an interstellar race with no Prime Directive, Prakasa is a pod and engine focused pack aimed at aircraft and spaceplanes, namely with the objective of filling the 2.5 meter void between the diminutive Mk2 and massive Mk3. 13 cockpits total as of 0.7, all featuring RPM IVAs. The parts are themed towards a somewhat more distant future than stock, offering greater interior space and a cleaner, spaceship-er aesthetic.
zh: Prakasa 新近引入自一个没有最高指导原则的星际种族，是一个以座舱和发动机为核心的部件包，面向飞机与空天飞机，主要目标是填补小巧的 Mk2 与庞大的 Mk3 之间 2.5 米的空缺。截至 0.7 版本共 13 个座舱，均配备 RPM IVA。部件风格偏向比原版更遥远的未来，提供更宽敞的内部空间与更整洁、更具飞船感的外观。

s: Adds one electric charge per second alternators to all liquid fuel engines. Includes optional config files to add alternators to solid fuel engines or monopropellant engines. Perfect for small probes without other power generation capabilities.  Does not effect xenon engines or engines with modded fuels. Is compatible with any mod adding engines using the default engine module.  Requires ModuleManager (not included).
zh: 为所有液体燃料引擎添加每秒产生 1 单位电能的交流发电机。附带可选配置文件，可为固体燃料引擎或单组元推进剂引擎添加交流发电机。非常适合没有其他发电能力的小型探测器。不影响氙气引擎或使用 mod 燃料的引擎。与任何使用默认引擎模块添加引擎的 mod 兼容。需要 <<M0>>（未包含）。

s: Universal storage is a modular parts pack that allows you to build custom service modules.  The pack contains a number of wedges that fit around a core hub.  This allows you to build a 1.25 meter stack with 4 wedges or a 2.5 meter stack with 8 wedges.  Of course these stacks can be placed on top of each other to provide whatever resources or machine the mission requires.
zh: Universal Storage 是一个模块化部件包，可用于构建自定义服务舱。该包包含多种楔形部件，可围绕核心枢纽安装。由此可搭建带 4 个楔形部件的 1.25 米堆栈，或带 8 个楔形部件的 2.5 米堆栈。这些堆栈当然可以上下叠放，以提供任务所需的任意资源或设备。

s: I was searching for a mod that would allow you to have technicians and scientists on the ground for role playing purposes.  Lets face it, Astronauts don't drive the fuel trucks and astronauts are not soldiers in the the war games.  So here is a mod that will allow you to have those guys in the game.  THIS MOD REQUIRES TEXTUREREPLACERREPLACED
zh: 我一直在寻找一个能让地面上有技术人员和科学家的 mod，用于角色扮演。说实话，宇航员不会去开燃料卡车，宇航员也不是战争游戏里的士兵。所以有了这个 mod，让你能在游戏里拥有这些人。本 MOD 需要 TEXTUREREPLACERREPLACED

s: Do more science!  Receive contracts for performing a variety of experiments under different situations.  Use it to drive the science in your space program, or use it to collect every last bit of science.
zh: 做更多科学。在不同情况下执行各种实验以获取合同。用它来推动你的航天计划中的科学进度，或用它来收集每一丝科学。

s: Part Wizard is a vehicle design utility plugin that adds a few conveniences when building your next strut/booster carrier.  It provides a list of parts with part highlighting for easier identification, allows deleting of parts from the list on eligible parts, allows complete control of symmetry on eligible parts, allows selecting parts for Action Group assignment, shows either all parts or only those that are hidden from the editor's Parts List. (Helpful in finding obsolete parts when mod authors make updates.) and shows unavailable parts in career modes with options to buy one or all necessary parts for launch.
zh: Part Wizard 是一个载具设计辅助插件，在你建造下一个支柱或助推器载具时提供一些便利功能。它提供带高亮的部件列表以便识别，允许从列表中删除符合条件的部件，允许对符合条件的部件完全控制对称，允许选择部件以分配动作组，可显示全部部件或仅显示在编辑器部件列表中隐藏的部件（有助于在 mod 作者更新后找出过时部件），并在生涯模式中显示不可用部件，并提供购买单个或全部发射所需部件的选项。

s: Several modifications to make RCS thrusters mandatory to have authority on your vessel orientation. Nerf reaction wheels so they provide only stabilization and don't respond to pilot or SAS input. Also make angular velocity and SAS orientation hold persistent trough timewarps and reloads.
zh: 若干改动使 RCS 推进器成为控制飞船姿态的必要手段。削弱动量轮，使其仅提供稳定作用，不响应飞行员或 SAS 输入。同时使角速度和 SAS 姿态在时间加速与存档重载后保持持久。

s: This pack includes 18 extra moons for Uranus: Cordelia | Ophelia | Bianca | Cressida | Desdemona | Juliet | Portia | Rosalind | Belinda | Puck | Caliban | Sycorax | Francisco | Margaret | Ferdinand | Perdita | Mab | Cupid.
zh: 本包为天王星添加 18 颗额外卫星：Cordelia | Ophelia | Bianca | Cressida | Desdemona | Juliet | Portia | Rosalind | Belinda | Puck | Caliban | Sycorax | Francisco | Margaret | Ferdinand | Perdita | Mab | Cupid。

s: Provides support to make creating and using custom tech trees easier. Allows part unlocks to be listed in the TechTree ConfigNode rather than having to edit every Part ConfigNode. Adds support for using custom textures to create icons for the tech tree. Adds a tree selection window to let the player select a tree for each new game.
zh: 提供支持，使创建和使用自定义科技树更加容易。允许在 <<M0>> <<M1>> 中列出部件解锁，而无需编辑每个部件的 <<M1>>。支持使用自定义贴图创建科技树图标。添加科技树选择窗口，让玩家在每局新游戏时选择科技树。

s: Probes Before Crew does what it says on the box; it places remote technologies far ahead of crewed alternatives on the tech tree while also placing greater significance and reward on crewed actions and achievements as a result.
zh: Probes Before Crew 名副其实：它将遥控技术置于科技树上远早于载人方案的位置，同时也因此赋予载人行动与成就更大的意义和奖励。

s: Pood's OPM-VO is a graphical overhaul modification for Kerbal Space Program's additional planet/moon mod, Outer Planets Mod, that builds upon the OPM mod by adding additional atmospheric and cloud effects using original artwork.
zh: Pood's OPM-VO 是 KSP 附加行星与卫星 mod——Outer Planets Mod 的图形重制 mod，基于 OPM 通过原创美术资源添加额外的大气与云层效果。

s: A mission-driven career overhaul. Complete milestones to unlock parts, spend science from bonus missions on optional upgrades. Free parts, tight building limits, no stock strategies. Alpha — feedback welcome! Requires Module Manager, Contract Configurator, and Custom Barn Kit.
zh: 以任务为导向的生涯模式重制。完成里程碑以解锁部件，用奖励任务获得的科学点投入可选升级。部件免费、建造限制严格、无原版策略。Alpha 版本，欢迎反馈。需要 Module Manager、Contract Configurator 和 Custom Barn Kit。

s: This is a collaboration with forum user Cyrus Playz and we have put our best effort to make the mod look as good. This mod is compatible with any visual mod of your choice, but not every Kopernicus mod
zh: 这是与论坛用户 Cyrus Playz 的合作成果，我们尽了最大努力让 mod 看起来足够好。本 mod 与你选择的任何视觉 mod 兼容，但并非所有 Kopernicus mod。

s: KSP Interstellar Extended (KSPI-E) is a plugin for Kerbal Space Program, designed to encourage bootstrapping toward ever more advanced levels of technology as well as utilizing In-Situ resources to expand the reach of Kerbal civilization. KSP Interstellar Extended aims to continue in Fractals original KSPI vision in providing a realistic road to the stars. Note: requires CTT 3.0.1
zh: KSP Interstellar Extended (KSPI-E) 是 KSP 的插件，旨在鼓励玩家逐步迈向更高技术水平，并利用原位资源扩展 Kerbal 文明的影响范围。KSP Interstellar Extended 旨在延续 Fractals 原版 KSPI 的愿景，提供一条通往星辰的现实之路。注意：需要 CTT 3.0.1

s: A huge tech tree which radically reassigns parts for a different progression experience (start with unmanned rockets, early airplanes and rovers). It is thus very different from the CTT and stock trees on which it was based historically.
zh: 一棵庞大的科技树，大幅重新划分部件位置，带来全新的进程体验（从无人火箭、早期飞机和漫游车起步）。因此它与其历史上所基于的 CTT 和原版科技树差别很大。

s: An overwrite mod for the Astronaut complex default hiring systems. THIS MOD IS IN BETA! But should work fine, just be aware that I am trying to modify the layout still and it does not come with an AVC checker so you will have to check back once it is out of beta. I will not put it on CKAN until it is ready.
zh: 覆盖宇航员中心默认招募系统的模组。本模组仍处于 Beta 阶段，但应该可以正常工作；请注意我仍在调整界面布局，且它不附带 AVC 检查器，因此在脱离 Beta 前你需要自行回来查看更新。在准备就绪之前我不会将其上传至 CKAN。

s: Modular Fuel Tanks allows any supported tank to be filled with exactly how much or how little fuel you want, of whatever type you want (though different tanks may allow or disallow certain fuels; jet fuel tanks won't take oxidizer for instance).
zh: 模块化燃料罐允许任何受支持的燃料罐按你想要的任意数量、任意类型加注燃料（不过不同燃料罐可能允许或禁止某些燃料；例如喷气燃料罐不能装氧化剂）。

s: This Contract Pack brings the narrative-driven "For Science!" exploration missions from KSP 2 into KSP 1. It utilizes Contract Configurator to port the fictitious manufacturers, verbatim and semi-verbatim mission briefings, and the complete and exact progression of the KSP 2 exploration mode into KSP 1.
zh: 该合同包将 KSP 2 中叙事驱动的“为了科学！”探索任务引入 KSP 1。它借助 Contract Configurator 将虚构的制造商、逐字与半逐字的任务简报，以及 KSP 2 探索模式的完整精确进度移植到 KSP 1。

s: this mod adds 4 new missiles to the game that are extreamly overpowered to avoid having more than 8 missiles on a fighter and to avoid missile spam. Translation: haha heavy missile go frrrrrrrrrrrrrr boooooom wooosh! Required mods: "BDArmory" or "BDArmory for Runway Project". ---------------------------------------------  this mod is for ksp 1.9.1 and 1.8.1
zh: 本模组为游戏添加 4 种性能极为强大的新导弹，以避免战斗机挂载超过 8 枚导弹，并避免导弹刷屏。翻译：哈哈重型导弹呼呼呼呼呼，轰，嗖。所需模组：“BDArmory”或“BDArmory for Runway Project”。--------------------------------------------- 本模组适用于 KSP 1.9.1 与 1.8.1

s: So you got that first rescue contract but where to put your passenger? If you like to play stock, but need a 2 person command pod Duopods is for you. It consists of three 2 kerbal command pods: the mk1a is an extruded version of the MK1-2 bringing it to 1.25m. The mk1b is a larger version of the mk1 pod that measures 1.825 meters. Finally the mk1c is a restored version of StarVisions' legacy pod. Rebalanced and reworked cfg for KSP 1.2.2 Also included is a 1.825m heat shield. Requires Module Manager 2.7.5 or higher.
zh: 你接到了第一个救援合同，但乘客该安置在哪里？如果你喜欢原版玩法，却需要一个双人指令舱，Duopods 正适合你。它包含三个双乘员指令舱：mk1a 是 MK1-2 的拉伸版，直径 1.25m；mk1b 是 mk1 舱的放大版，直径 1.825m；最后 mk1c 是 <<M0>> 旧式舱的复原版。已针对 KSP 1.2.2 重新平衡并重做 cfg。另附一块 1.825m 隔热罩。需要 Module Manager 2.7.5 或更高版本。

s: This pack currently adds over 600... yes you read correctly... over 600 contracts to the base game following the historic progression of both NASA and its Russian counterparts, each mission has been made into a contract for the game. This version is for RSS/RO KSP
zh: 该合同包目前已为原版游戏添加超过 600……你没看错……超过 600 个合同，遵循 NASA 及其苏联对应机构的历史进程，每一次任务都被制作成游戏中的合同。本版本适用于 RSS/RO 的 KSP。

s: A.K.A. MPE. Originally by Exo, this planet pack adds 16 new bodies to the Kerbol system to explore based on real-world asteroids and dwarf planets. Features hand-drawn maps, biomes, and precious, PRECIOUS science.
zh: 又名 MPE。该行星包最初由 Exo 制作，以现实中的小行星和矮行星为原型，为 Kerbol 星系添加 16 个可供探索的新天体。包含手绘地图、生态区，以及珍贵、极其珍贵的科学。

s: This plugin sends/receives data packets over the serial port, which should make it much easier for people wanting to build hardware (like arduino stuff) for KSP but can't be bothered with making plugins as well.
zh: 该插件通过串口收发数据包，让那些想为 KSP 制作硬件（比如 Arduino 之类）却不愿再费心编写插件的人轻松许多。

s: Expand your resource harvesting capabilities of celestial bodies from Galaxies Unbound, OPM, and even stock with your favorite (now larger!) list of resources from base Space Dust and common ones from the Community Resource Pack.
zh: 借助来自基础 Space Dust 的你喜爱的资源列表（现已扩充）以及 Community Resource Pack 中的常见资源，扩展你在 Galaxies Unbound、OPM 乃至原版天体上的资源采集能力。

s: The Mach Gauge Measures the Mach number of the current craft, taking into account of altitude. The gauge will not work without the part, it's a stock radial ladder. Just look at the names and you'll know which one it is.
zh: 马赫表用于测量当前飞行器的马赫数，并计入高度影响。该仪表需依赖对应部件才能工作，那个部件就是原版的径向梯。看看部件名字就知道是哪一个了。

s: Starship Launch Expansion is a mod that collects Starbase real life launch pads, towers, stands and all the stuff necessary to support your Starship launches in KSP. All the parts are designed to withstand the power of every launch without exploding (hopefully).
zh: Starship Launch Expansion 是一个收集 Starbase 现实发射台、塔架、支架以及支持你在 KSP 中进行星舰发射所需一切物件的模组。所有部件都经过设计，可承受每次发射的威力而不爆炸（但愿如此）。

s: Ship Manifest is a tool to manage your ship's "things".  Ship Manifest moves crew, Science & Resources around from part to part within your ship or station.  It also manages Hatches, Solar Panels, Antennas & Lights.
zh: Ship Manifest 是一个管理飞船“家当”的工具。Ship Manifest 可在飞船或空间站内的部件之间转移乘员、科学与资源，还可管理舱门、太阳能板、天线与灯光。

s: Gives your tracking station less work! Blows away seperated stages on a timer to keep your space sparkly clean of debris! They can also be used as selfdestruct devices for useless sats, rockets, kerbals,...
zh: 让追踪站减轻负担。按定时引爆已分离的级段，让太空远离碎片、保持洁净。也可用作无用的卫星、火箭、小绿人的自毁装置。

s: Place both files in: Steam\steamapps\common\Kerbal Space Program\GameData\TextureReplacer\Default  Original texture by: russe166 found here: http://mods.curse.com/ksp-mods/kerbal/232411-kerbin-planet-texture  Modified to show Country Borders by me.
zh: 将两个文件放入：Steam\steamapps\common\Kerbal Space Program\<<M0>>\<<M1>>\Default  原始贴图作者：russe166，来源见 <<M2>>  由我修改为显示国界。

s: V2 Industries presents a parts pack consists of a variety of rover parts that seeks to fill a kerbal's need for thrill and adventure in the way of exploration and little to no safety guidelines. Included are both the HoneyBadger and Puma platforms
zh: V2 Industries 推出的部件包，包含多种漫游车部件，旨在满足小绿人对刺激与冒险的探索需求，几乎不考虑安全规范。内含 <<M0>> 与 Puma 平台。

s: Puts Kerbalism's eight resources (and if present, NFE's Uraninite) where they should be, using Rational Resources tagging system, without all the  b l o a t  of the original mod. Also provides tools and rules for auto-sorting your inventory, using VABorganizer and CCK. Many more compatibility patches.
zh: 利用 Rational Resources 的标签系统，将 Kerbalism 的八种资源（若已安装，还包括 NFE 的沥青铀矿）放到它们该在的位置，且没有原 mod 的臃肿。还提供借助 VABorganizer 与 CCK 自动整理物品栏的工具与规则。另有大量兼容补丁。

s: This is a collaboration with fourm user Cyrus Playz and we have put our best effort to make the mod look as good. This mod is Compatible with any Visual Mod of your choice, But not every Kopernicus mod
zh: 本 mod 由我与论坛用户 Cyrus Playz 合作完成，我们尽力让它看起来足够出色。本 mod 兼容你选择的任意视觉 mod，但并非兼容所有 Kopernicus mod。

s: Sensible Tech Tree is a mod similar to things like Historical Progression, and Unmanned before manned. The purpose of this mod is to completely rebuild the stock tech tree into something more sensible. Things such as planes from the start, probes before manned, and other such things that just flat make sense.
zh: Sensible Tech Tree 是类似 Historical Progression 与 Unmanned before manned 的 mod。其目的是彻底重建原版科技树，使其更加合理。例如一开始就有飞机、探测器先于载人，以及其他完全合乎常理的内容。

s: [High Resolution] LazTek Temporal Anomalies is pleased to announce the availability of our SpaceX Launch Pack, including the new SpaceX Dragon V2 capsule and trunk, SpaceX Falcon 9 v1.1 and Falcon Heavy launch platforms
zh: [高分辨率] <<M0>> Temporal Anomalies 荣幸宣布推出 <<M1>> 发射包，包含全新的 <<M1>> Dragon V2 乘员舱与货舱、<<M1>> Falcon 9 v1.1 与 Falcon Heavy 发射平台

s: A simple ModuleManager plugin that eliminates crew requirements for manned vessels and/or the need to attach an unmanned probe to your spacecraft. Useful for automatic launches and docking of space station modules, rescue missions etc. Requires ModuleManager.
zh: 一个简单的 <<M0>> 插件，可免除载人飞船的乘员要求，和/或无需为飞船加装无人探测器。适用于空间站舱段的自动发射与对接、救援任务等。需要 <<M0>>。

s: This is the  Hermes Interplanetary Spacecraft from the movie "The Martian" made by kerbalspaceprogram forum users xxhansonmaxx & OrbitalEscape.  Development of the mod has recently ceased.  xxhansonmaxx and OrbitalEscape have given permission for anyone to pick up on the development of the mod as long as credit is given.   This version includes a WIP version of the MAV. I have also organized all the files and folders included with this mod pack.
zh: 这是电影《火星救援》中的 Hermes 星际飞船，由 KSP 论坛用户 xxhansonmaxx 与 <<M0>> 制作。该 mod 的开发最近已停止。xxhansonmaxx 与 <<M0>> 已允许任何人在注明出处的前提下接手开发。本版本包含 MAV 的开发中版本。我还整理了本 mod 包中所有的文件与文件夹。

s: A plugin for Kerbal Space Program from SQUAD, which adds some SSTV, beeps, and nonsensical radio chatter between your crewed command pods and Mission Control. There is also some environmental sounds as : wind in atmosphere, breathing on EVA and background noises inside space-crafts.
zh: SQUAD 出品的一款 KSP 插件，为载人指令舱与任务控制中心之间加入 SSTV、提示音以及无意义的无线电杂音。还包含一些环境音效，例如大气中的风声、EVA 时的呼吸声以及飞船内部的背景噪声。

s: A mod for Kerbal Space Program that grants a funding allowance per month based on reputation. The funds can be spent on vessels, science points, building reputation (PR), or even saved for a big mission -- all with various benefits and limitations. Play the game like a real Space Program!
zh: 一款 KSP mod，根据声望每月发放资金额度。资金可用于建造飞行器、购买科学点数、提升声望（PR），甚至存起来用于大型任务——各有不同的收益与限制。像真正的航天计划一样玩游戏。

s: Skybox that presents the Kerbol system within a sparse Nebula. Features a subtle Galaxy star-line and patches of Pink/Blue Nebula proto-Star fields. To the polar South a very energetic solar nursery can be seen.
zh: 将 Kerbol 星系置于稀薄星云中的天空盒。带有淡淡的银河星带以及粉、蓝色星云原恒星区的斑块。在南极方向可看到一片极为活跃的恒星孕育区。

s: This mod adds Arc reactors in to the game, they are currently using the RTG model as I don't have time right now for modelling and stuff, nor the time to teach myself how to do it, if you have models you want me/allow me to use, I'd be happy to take them, you will be credited
zh: 本 mod 为游戏加入 Arc 反应堆。目前它们沿用 RTG 的模型，因为我眼下没时间做建模之类的工作，也没时间自学。如果你有模型愿意提供或授权我使用，我很乐意采用，并会注明出处。

s: RoverScience is a KSP plugin that attempts to add more interactive functionality to the science system FOR rovers. You drive rovers to search for science spots which you may then decide to investigate and analyze for science gain.
zh: <<M0>> 是一款 KSP 插件，旨在为漫游车的科学系统加入更多交互功能。驾驶漫游车寻找科学点，之后你可决定对其调查与分析以获取科学值。

s: Dynamic IVA Sound Effects, add drama to your IVAs and hear your ship's fuselage Shake, Rattle and Rumble!  Note this has the exact same functionality as version 1.0.5, but was recompiled for the KSP 1.2 prerelease.
zh: 动态 IVA 音效，为你的 IVA 增添戏剧感，让你听到飞船机身的摇晃、咔嗒与轰鸣。注意：本版本功能与 1.0.5 版完全相同，只是为 KSP 1.2 预发布版重新编译。

s: Originally planned as the Kerbal Out of Space Economically, the name was changed to Kerbal Orbital Operations Safety Equipment.  The pod is a minimal reentry vehicle for a single Kerbal.  A small deorbit charge is included as four small SRBs.  RCS is available, and can be used to extend the deorbit deltaV if needed.  A small radio beacon is included for no extra charge.  Use with matching heatshield and parachute unit to maintain warranty.
zh: 最初计划命名为 Kerbal Out of Space Economically，后更名为 Kerbal Orbital Operations Safety Equipment。该舱是供单个小绿人使用的极简再入飞行器。自带四枚小型固体火箭作为离轨装药。配有 RCS，必要时可用于延长离轨 <<M0>>。还免费附带一个小型无线电信标。与配套的隔热罩和降落伞组件搭配使用以维持保修。

s: KerbalFX BlastFX adds separator and decoupler visual effects, including sparks, fragments, smoke, softer ordinary decoupler puffs, docking-port gas venting, lingering debris fields, and vacuum replacement effects for eligible parts destroyed in space.
zh: <<M0>> <<M1>> 为分离器与解耦器添加视觉效果，包括火花、碎片、烟雾、更柔和的普通解耦器喷烟、对接端口排气、滞留的碎片场，以及太空中被摧毁的合适部件在真空中的替代效果。

s: Flight Testing of your space hardware in KSP!  Fly your parts to gain flight data and make them more reliable and less likely to fail.  THIS IS THE PLUGIN ONLY.  You will need a TestFlight Config pack in order for any parts to actually be controlled by TestFlight.
zh: 在 KSP 中对你的航天硬件进行飞行测试。让你的部件飞起来以获取飞行数据，使其更可靠、更不易失效。本包仅为插件。你需要 <<M0>> 配置包，部件才会真正受 <<M0>> 控制。

s: This addon provides training for your kerbalnauts by adding a Field Training Facility (FTF) (school) into all science labs. You can train your kerbalnaut(s) over time with space stations and planetary bases.
zh: 本插件为你的坎巴拉宇航员提供训练：在所有科学实验室中加入实地训练设施（FTF，即学校）。你可以借助空间站与行星基地，让宇航员随着时间接受训练。

s: Hi Visitors , this is my first planet pack very WIP and still being worked on, Add one planet very far away from Eeloo, Called Xamion it has four moons, Ariel Rostea Vagroth Lumina. This first release is the Dev release and WILL BE UPDATED.
zh: 各位访客好，这是我第一个星球包，完成度很低且仍在制作中。它在远离 Eeloo 的地方添加了一颗行星，名为 Xamion，拥有四颗卫星：Ariel、Rostea、Vagroth、Lumina。本次首发为开发版，将会更新。

s: MouseFlyer is a lightweight mouse-aim flight controller for Kerbal Space Program 1, built for aircraft. It lets you fly with precise mouse steering, clean keyboard blending, and an in-game HUD without complex control setup.
zh: <<M0>> 是面向《坎巴拉太空计划》1 的轻量级鼠标瞄准飞行控制器，专为飞机设计。它能让你以精确的鼠标操纵、流畅的键盘混合输入和游戏内 HUD 飞行，无需复杂的控制设置。

s: This is something I made for placing RCS thrusters in the right positions in the first try without having to go back and forth between the VAB and the hacked gravity launchpad.  Features: Display thrust and torque forces caused by RCS or engines. Delta V readout for RCS. Dry center of mass marker. Average center of mass marker. Ability to resize editor's overlay markers. Display total mass of resources.
zh: 这是为了让 RCS 推进器一次就摆到正确位置而做的，不必在 VAB 与作弊重力发射台之间来回折腾。功能：显示 RCS 或发动机产生的推力与力矩；RCS 的 Δv 读数；干质心标记；平均质心标记；可调整编辑器叠加标记的大小；显示资源总质量。

s: this mod adds 2 new missiles to the game that are extreamly overpowered to avoid having more than 8 missiles on a fighter and to avoid missile spam. Translation: haha heavy missile go frrrrrrrrrrrrrr boooooom wooosh! Required mods: "BDArmory" or "BDArmory for Runway Project". ---------------------------------------------  this mod is for ksp 1.9.1 and 1.8.1
zh: 本 mod 为游戏加入 2 种新导弹，它们极其强力，以免战斗机挂载超过 8 枚导弹，也避免导弹刷屏。翻译：哈哈，重型导弹呼呼呼呼呼——轰——嗖！必需 mod：“BDArmory”或“BDArmory for Runway Project”。——————————— 本 mod 适用于 ksp 1.9.1 与 1.8.1

s: This mod is designed to add rings to Dres, just like ksp2, it can also add a Moon（Fres） to Dres (optional), just like Fissure in Afterkerbin, this mod has many bugs , is still being tested and does not represent the final version
zh: 本 mod 为 Dres 添加环形结构，就像 ksp2 那样；还可选择为 Dres 添加一颗卫星（Fres），就像 Afterkerbin 中的 Fissure。本 mod 有诸多 bug，仍在测试中，不代表最终版本。

s: Kerbal remake of Dr. White's concept design of a warp capable space vessel using Dr. Alcubierre's theory on bending space-time, effectively circumventing Einstein's law of relativity. This mod continues the work RoverDude, Stevie_D and Sophia. This mod requires RoverDude's Alcubierre Drive (standalone)
zh: 以 Dr. White 的概念设计为基础，用 Dr. Alcubierre 的时空弯曲理论重制的坎巴拉版曲速飞船，从而有效绕过爱因斯坦相对论定律。本 mod 延续 <<M0>>、Stevie_D 与 Sophia 的工作。本 mod 需要 <<M0>> 的 Alcubierre Drive（独立版）。

s: Customizable fuel resources added to Stock, B9, and Procedural Wings by Tortoise. The intention of this is to improve weight & balance, reduce craft size, and increase aesthetics. Supports all stock fuel types, ability to modify in VAB/SPH.
zh: 为原版、B9 以及 Tortoise 的 Procedural Wings 添加可自定义的燃料资源。目的是改善重量与平衡、缩小飞行器体积并提升美观度。支持所有原版燃料类型，可在 VAB/SPH 中修改。

s: Bored of yelling the launch countdown yourself ?  Do you find the launch sequence a little ... lifeless ?  So here comes an enhancement for your launch clamps : an authentical launch countdown brought to you by Athlonic Electronics.
zh: 还在自己喊发射倒计时吗？觉得发射流程有点……毫无生气？那么这款发射支架增强来了：由 Athlonic Electronics 为你带来逼真的发射倒计时。

s: his plugin sends/receives data packets over the serial port, which should make it much easier for people wanting to build hardware (like arduino stuff) for KSP but can't be bothered with making plugins as well.
zh: 本插件通过串口收发数据包，让想为 KSP 自制硬件（比如 Arduino 之类）却不愿再写插件的人轻松许多。

s: This plugin will allow you to add or remove crew from parts while on the launch pad or transfer crew between parts in the same vessel. You can also edit/add custom crew members in your available crew roster provided that they are not part of an active flight (or dead).
zh: 本插件允许你在发射台上为部件增删乘员，或在同一飞行器的部件之间转移乘员。你还可以编辑/添加可用乘员名单中的自定义乘员，前提是他们不在执行中的飞行任务里（或已死亡）。

s: Adds a new Material Science Pod part. The pod collects the same experiment as the larger Material Science Bay, but it's resized, but somewhat heavier than a goo to be mounted opposite a Mystery Goo Container.﻿
zh: 新增一个材料科学舱部件。该舱可收集与更大的材料科学舱相同的实验，但尺寸经过调整，且比一个黏菌略重，便于安装在神秘黏菌容器的对侧。

s: this mod adds 4 new missiles to the game that are extreamly overpowered to avoid having more than 8 missiles on a fighter and to avoid missile spam. Translation: haha heavy missile go frrrrrrrrrrrrrr boooooom wooosh! Required mods: "BDArmory" or "BDArmory for Runway Project". ---------------------------------------------  this mod is for ksp 1.8.1+
zh: 本 mod 为游戏添加 4 种新导弹，它们极其强力，以限制一架战斗机挂载超过 8 枚导弹，并避免导弹刷屏。翻译：哈哈重型导弹走起 frrrrrrrrrrrrrr 轰——咻！必需 mod：“BDArmory”或“BDArmory for Runway Project”。--------------------------------------------- 本 mod 适用于 KSP 1.8.1+

s: Larger missions deserve larger parts! The Taurus HCV pack includes the 3.75m 7 seat command pod, a very large science lab, an 8 Kerbal crew container, a pair of engines, and various other extra large parts.
zh: 更大的任务值得更大的部件。Taurus HCV 包包含 3.75m 七座指令舱、一个超大型科学实验室、一个 8 名 Kerbal 乘员容器、一对发动机以及其他各种超大部件。

s: Following the great work done by Angel-125, Rubber Ducky, and Raven, CactEye is a plugin and set of parts that allow for modular orbital telescopes. CactEye telescopes feature a fully-functional science system, and are upgradeable/serviceable (primarily through Kerbal Inventory System). Orbital telescopes also now become fundamental to discovering asteroids.
zh: 在 Angel-125、Rubber Ducky 和 Raven 的出色工作基础上，<<M0>> 是一个插件及一套部件，可实现模块化轨道望远镜。<<M0>> 望远镜具备功能完整的科学系统，并可升级与维护（主要通过 Kerbal Inventory System）。轨道望远镜如今也成为发现小行星的关键。

s: Create, Manage, add Labels and Capabilities to your own Rocket Designs by Drag&Drop them similarly to how it works with stock subassemblies. But much better. Compatible with Stock, RP-1 and everything. Don't forget: to save your design, just drag&drop onto the Save icon
zh: 像原版子组件那样通过拖放来创建、管理自己的火箭设计，并为其添加标签与能力。但好用得多。兼容原版、<<M0>> 以及一切。别忘了：要保存设计，只需拖放到保存图标上。

s: The major part of RSS-Origin, which adds plenty of asteroids, asteroid moons, comets, moons of gas/ice giants, dwarf planets, dwarf planet moons, and interstellar objects into real solar system, currently 198 in total. (dozens more in the future). This is the core pack
zh: RSS-Origin 的主要部分，将大量小行星、小行星卫星、彗星、气态与冰巨行星的卫星、矮行星、矮行星卫星以及星际天体加入真实太阳系，目前共 198 个。（未来还将增加数十个）。这是核心包。

s: Adds an automatic constant-speed variable-pitch propeller governor to KSP1 Breaking Ground robotic rotors. It adjusts propeller blade pitch to maintain a target RPM while providing fast response and anti-stall protection for DLC propeller aircraft, including counter-rotating and coaxial setups.
zh: 为 <<M0>> Breaking Ground 机械转子添加自动恒速变距螺旋桨调速器。它调节桨叶桨距以维持目标转速，同时为 DLC 螺旋桨飞机提供快速响应与防失速保护，包括对转与共轴布局。

s: The Vulture Star is a main sequence star similar but more massive to Kerbol. It holds 6 planets, all with individual backstories. The Vulture System is my first ever full Kerbal Space Program project, taking about a month to complete.
zh: Vulture Star 是一颗主序星，与 Kerbol 相似但质量更大。它拥有 6 颗行星，每颗都有各自的背景故事。Vulture System 是我第一个完整的 Kerbal Space Program 项目，耗时约一个月完成。

s: The Verse - Calling All Browncoats, Located approximately 20 Light Years from Kerbol, a small collection of stars have been identified. A new System has been found, and has now been named 34Tauri(2020).
zh: The Verse —— 呼叫所有 Browncoats。在距 Kerbol 约 20 光年处，已辨识出一小群恒星。一个全新的星系被发现，现命名为 34Tauri(2020)。

s: Ever forgotten to include reaction wheels on your ion probe and been completely helpless to control it? Having trouble controling your 75% SRB launch? Why not add GIMBAL! This mod adds one degree of gimballing to all engines, from launch escape systems and SRBs to xenon engines.
zh: 是否曾忘记给离子探测器装动量轮，结果完全无法控制？是否难以控制 75% 固体助推器的发射？为何不试试万向节。本 mod 为所有发动机添加 1 度万向偏转，从发射逃逸系统和固体助推器到氙气发动机。

s: This mod adds re-designed parts from the Large Structural Components Addon (created by myself in 2013) to the game.  Each part is available in Career mode and can be unlocked via the tech tree, the parts mainly being contained under the Specialized Construction node.  There are also a few new parts, not belonging to the original pack and have been designed to work with TAC Life Support, and Kerbal Inventory System.
zh: 本 mod 将大型结构组件扩展包（由我本人于 2013 年制作）中重新设计的部件加入游戏。每个部件在生涯模式中可用，并可通过科技树解锁，这些部件主要位于专业建造学节点下。此外还有少数不属于原包的新部件，设计上与 TAC Life Support 和 Kerbal Inventory System 配合使用。

s: QuarterRSS is a mod that uses the great work from NathanKell and creates our Real Solar System at 1/4 the size. QuarterRSS is still 2.5 times larger than stock KSP and provides a huge challenge to players, but can be achieved with stock parts.
zh: <<M0>> 是一个利用 <<M1>> 出色成果的 mod，以 1/4 的比例构建我们的真实太阳系。<<M0>> 仍比原版 KSP 大 2.5 倍，对玩家是巨大挑战，但用原版部件即可完成。

s: Ever played around with the WWI firespitter parts and got frustrated with how hard it is to make a replica with them? They look like the perfect parts, but there's just not enough variety to make that one Central powers fighter look different from the rest, and you don't really want to resort to stock parts. Well, look no further! This pack was made for you!
zh: 是否玩过一战 Firespitter 部件，并为难以用它们做出仿制品而烦恼？它们看起来是完美的部件，但种类不够多，无法让某架同盟国战斗机与其余机型区分开来，而你又不愿退而使用原版部件。那么不必再找了。这个包就是为你准备的。

s: StockPlugins is several ModuleManager config files which adds the possibility to use a plugin without the additional parts. (StockPlugins support Engineer, KerbalEngineer, KerbalGPS, MechJeb, Protractor and Telemachus)
zh: <<M0>> 是若干 <<M1>> 配置文件，使得无需额外部件也能使用插件。（<<M0>> 支持 Engineer、<<M2>>、<<M3>>、<<M4>>、Protractor 和 Telemachus）

s: This mod adds Firespitter Texture Switch configs to the stock Rockomax parts and gives you an opportunity to make an SLS look like it does in recent pictures (with an unpainted core and stripes on the SRBs) without tediously clipping orange tanks together, originally by forum user nothke
zh: 本 mod 为原版 Rockomax 部件添加 Firespitter 贴图切换配置，让你无需繁琐地拼接橙色燃料罐，就能让 SLS 看起来像近期照片中的样子（芯级不涂装、固体助推器带条纹），原作者为论坛用户 nothke。

s: Better tourism! A richer tourism experience than stock.  Take tourists to space and to visit the stations and bases that you've already created. Build new tourist attractions like the space casino mega-project.  15 new contracts for tourism.
zh: 更好的旅游业。比原版更丰富的旅游体验。带旅行者上太空，参观你已建成的空间站与基地。建造新的旅游景点，例如太空赌场超级工程。15 个新的旅游合同。
