s: ever fancied a kerbin wide city network (planned) or smashing up more than just ksc (planned but im buggered if i know how ill do it!) or  just trying to fly through narrow buildings and around tight corners for the hell of it? well we have the city for you
zh: 是否曾想要一个覆盖整个 Kerbin 的城市网络（计划中），或者撞毁的不只是 KSC（计划中，但我实在不知道怎么实现），又或者只是想找刺激，穿过狭窄的建筑、绕过逼仄的拐角？那么这个城市就是为你准备的。

s: HalfRSS is a mod that uses the great work from NathanKell and creates our Real Solar System in a smaller scale in KSP. At half the size of the RSS, HalfRSS is still 5 times larger than stock KSP and provides a huge challenge to players, but can be achieved with stock parts. I always loved the idea of playing in our Real Solar System, but I am not a good enough player to be able to accomplish that on the grand RSS scale.
zh: <<M0>> 是一个模组，利用 <<M1>> 的出色成果，在 KSP 中以较小比例创建我们的真实太阳系。<<M0>> 的尺寸是 RSS 的一半，但仍比原版 KSP 大 5 倍，为玩家提供了巨大挑战，不过可以用原版部件完成。我一直喜欢在真实太阳系中游玩的设想，但我水平不够，无法在宏大的 RSS 规模下实现。

s: For most fusion engines (and reactors) in FarFutureTechnologies: Introduces deuterium-tritium (D-T) fusion as an option. Given the scarcity of helium-3, I’ve opted to use tritium (produced in nuclear reactors) to sustain fusion operations on alien bases—ensuring players can still leverage fusion engines off-world. For balance, D-T fusion has lower specific impulse and requires lead (Pb) to shield against intense neutron radiation.
zh: 适用于 <<M0>> 中的大多数聚变引擎（及反应堆）：新增氘-氚（D-T）聚变选项。鉴于氦-3 稀缺，我选择使用氚（由核反应堆生产）来维持外星基地上的聚变运行，确保玩家在异星也能使用聚变引擎。出于平衡考虑，D-T 聚变的比冲较低，且需要铅（Pb）来屏蔽强烈的中子辐射。

s: A planet mod that takes place after the Kerbol system has died. Kerbals have escaped to another star system. Beyond Home adds a unique suite of over 28 planets each with their own high quality visuals.
zh: 一个设定在 Kerbol 星系消亡之后的星球 mod。坎巴拉人已逃往另一个恒星系。Beyond Home 添加了超过 28 颗独特的星球，每颗都拥有各自的高质量视觉效果。

s: This mod provides a single gun, based on H/PJ38 onboard 052D Class destroyer of PLAN, which shoots fireworks instead of cannon shells, it would give you a brand new choice for your celebrations. (Warranty void if used on battle field)
zh: 本 mod 提供一门火炮，基于中国人民海军 052D 型驱逐舰上的 H/PJ38，它发射的是烟花而非炮弹，为你的庆典提供全新选择。（战场上使用概不保修）

s: Our researchers were digging in the Kerbal History of Space Flight and they tumbled over some long forgotten parts.  Thanks to the work of our researchers and engineers here are the old mostly abandoned parts from early KSP Versions.
zh: 我们的研究人员在挖掘坎巴拉航天史时，偶然翻出了一些被长久遗忘的部件。多亏了我们的研究人员和工程师，这里是来自早期 KSP 版本的、大多已被废弃的老部件。

s: Complex mods are incompatible with Luna Multiplayer. LunaCompat adds compatibility patches for various mods via LMP part module configurations and Harmony patches. Patches are only applied to mods added to the modlist. Check the repository to see the full list of supported mods.
zh: 复杂 mod 与 Luna Multiplayer 不兼容。<<M0>> 通过 LMP 部件模块配置与 Harmony 补丁为各种 mod 添加兼容补丁。补丁仅应用于已加入 mod 列表的 mod。请查看仓库以了解受支持 mod 的完整列表。

s: A rocket-sized wristwatch, for all your orbital time-keeping needs! The very simple RocketWatch mod contains a single part and plugin. When the game detects that the active craft has the RocketWatch part on it, it adds a small window just beneath the Mission clock, which shows the current real-world time.
zh: 火箭尺寸的手表，满足你所有的轨道计时需求！极简的 <<M0>> mod 仅包含一个部件和一个插件。当游戏检测到当前飞行器装有 <<M0>> 部件时，会在任务时钟下方添加一个小窗口，显示当前现实世界时间。

s: Add some drama to your rough landings! CollisionFX-ReUpdated adds sparks and dust, with sound and lighting effects when you collide or scrape your craft. Landing gear also has a rubbery screech on contacting the ground.
zh: 为你的粗暴着陆增添一些戏剧性！<<M0>>-<<M1>> 在飞行器碰撞或擦地时添加火花与尘土，并带有音效与光照效果。起落架接触地面时还会发出橡胶摩擦的尖啸声。

s:
Craft Manager is a replacement for the stock craft list in the editors that adds a bunch features the stock list lacks and opens much faster.
Search, Sort and Organize your craft, view and load craft from any save, move/copy them between saves, transfer them between editors, load your subassemblies in the same interface.
Craft can be tagged with custom tags which you can manually assign. Tags can also be given a rule so they also auto associate with craft.
zh:
Craft Manager 是编辑器中原版飞行器列表的替代品，添加了原版列表所缺少的众多功能，且打开速度快得多。
搜索、排序与整理你的飞行器，查看并加载任意存档中的飞行器，在存档之间移动/复制它们，在编辑器之间转移，并在同一界面中加载你的子装配。
飞行器可用自定义标签手动标记。标签还可设定规则，从而自动与飞行器关联。

s: A contract pack recreating almost all real-life missions that were actually flown, currently up until 1967 and the most exciting missions going into the 70s. This is the 'light' variety of the Stock version of this mod.
zh: 一个合同包，重现几乎所有实际执行过的真实任务，目前涵盖至 1967 年，以及进入 70 年代最激动人心的那些任务。这是该 mod 原版版本的“轻量”变体。

s: CLEP is a professional lunar exploration mod for Kerbal Space Program, focusing on Chinese Lunar Exploration series missions.This mod covers Chang’e-4 (or Chang’e-3), Chang’e-6 (or Chang’e-5) and the upcoming Chang’e-7 probe
zh: CLEP 是坎巴拉太空计划的一款专业探月 mod，聚焦中国探月工程系列任务。本 mod 涵盖嫦娥四号（或嫦娥三号）、嫦娥六号（或嫦娥五号）以及即将到来的嫦娥七号探测器。

s: A mission-driven career overhaul. Complete milestones to unlock parts, spend science on optional upgrades. Free parts, tight building limits, no stock strategies. Feedback welcome! Requires Module Manager, Contract Configurator, and Custom Barn Kit.
zh: 以任务驱动的生涯模式大改。完成里程碑以解锁部件，将科学点用于可选升级。部件免费、建造限制严格、无原版策略。欢迎反馈！需要 Module Manager、Contract Configurator 和 Custom Barn Kit。

s: A set of cloned configuration files from stock jet engine parts that use oxidizer only, and a new resource configuration found hypothetically in Eve's atmosphere: "Explodium Vapour" evaporated from Eve's Explodium Sea. This vapour may also be present on other planets in popular planet packs.
zh: 一组从原版喷气引擎部件克隆而来的配置，仅使用氧化剂；以及一种设想存在于 Eve 大气中的新资源：“Explodium Vapour”，由 Eve 的 Explodium 海蒸发而来。这种蒸汽也可能存在于热门星球包中的其他星球上。

s: Powerful stockalike parts for aircraft enthusiasts, with strong focus on Modern Airliners and General Aviation. And Helicopters!  It continues development for the praised A+ originally by blackheart_612.
zh: 面向飞机爱好者的强力原版风格部件，重点聚焦现代客机与通用航空。还有直升机！本 mod 延续了最初由 blackheart_612 打造、广受赞誉的 A+ 的开发。

s: This is a collection of ribbons that you can assign to your Pilots to differentiate their qualifications and expertise for Role-Playing purposes. PLEASE NOTE: Final Frontier is required for this ribbon pack.
zh: 这是一组勋表，可分配给飞行员，以区分他们的资质与专长，用于角色扮演。请注意：此勋表包需要 Final Frontier。

s: (**Requires Firespitter**) Lionhead Aerospace Circular Solar Panels. They come in default Black, but can be changed to Blue. To change color, go in: VAB or SPH, when a solar panel is placed on a craft, right-click and you will get options to change colors. Make sure the solar panel is extend, so you can see the color change.
zh: （**需要 Firespitter**）Lionhead Aerospace 圆形太阳能板。默认黑色，但可改为蓝色。要更改颜色：在 VAB 或 SPH 中，将太阳能板放到飞行器上后右键单击，即可看到更改颜色的选项。请确保太阳能板已展开，这样你才能看到颜色变化。

s: Sendemia is a mod that adds a fun system of three moons and a ring. Sendemia: A yellowish tylo-like world with a pink streak. Magnone: Not much to say about it, except it looks cool. Beppy: Bumpy yellow moon that provides a moderate challenge. Abagotia: Mini-Minmus. This is my first mod. Please contact me with any bugs on discord. Info in read me file.
zh: Sendemia 是一个 mod，添加了由三颗卫星和一道星环组成的有趣星系。Sendemia：一颗带粉色条纹、类似 Tylo 的淡黄色星球。Magnone：没什么好说的，就是看起来很酷。Beppy：凹凸不平的黄色卫星，提供中等难度的挑战。Abagotia：迷你 Minmus。这是我的第一个 mod。如有任何 bug，请在 Discord 上联系我。详情见 readme 文件。

s: This is a mod featuring a Shuttle EVA Suit derivative made by me.(Classic Suit).  ///  I need to credit ACIsabelle as I took the base of the suit and visor from her. /// TEXTUREREPLACER REQUIRED (NOT INCLUDED)
zh: 这是一个包含由我制作的航天飞机 EVA 宇航服衍生版的 mod。（经典套装）。/// 我需要感谢 ACIsabelle，因为我从她那里取得了宇航服与面罩的基础。/// 需要 TEXTUREREPLACER（未包含）

s: Replaces KSP's stock science-experiment loop with an actual exoplanet survey program. Select a real star from an exoplanet.eu-derived catalog, choose an instrument appropriate to its brightness and detection method, and extract a signal from simulated, photon-noise-limited data exactly the way an observational astronomer would. Includes transit timing variations (TTV), the Rossiter-McLaughlin effect, and a career-mode instrument-acquisition economy.
zh: 将 KSP 原版的科学实验循环替换为真正的系外行星巡天计划。从基于 exoplanet.eu 的星表中选取一颗真实恒星，根据其亮度与探测方法选择合适的仪器，并像观测天文学家那样从模拟的光子噪声受限数据中提取信号。包含凌星时间变化（TTV）、Rossiter-<<M0>> 效应，以及生涯模式下的仪器采购经济系统。

s: The Kemini Research Program is a set of small orbital experiments inspired by real experiments run during the Gemini missions. No additional equipment is required - simply install an experiment in the capsule and run it once in orbit.
zh: Kemini 研究计划是一组小型轨道实验，灵感来自双子座任务中进行的真实实验。无需额外设备——只需在舱内安装一个实验，并在轨道上运行一次。

s: A narrative campaign mod for Kerbal Space Program built on the Contract Configurator framework. Red Frontier augments KSP's open universe with a structured space program. With missions that build on each other, characters who comment on your progress, and infrastructure that persists and matters.  Chapter 1 takes you from first orbit to a self-sustaining operation in the Duna system.
zh: 基于 Contract Configurator 框架构建的 KSP 叙事战役 mod。Red Frontier 以结构化的太空计划充实 KSP 的开放宇宙。任务环环相扣，角色会对你的进展发表评论，基础设施持久存在且举足轻重。第一章将带你从首次入轨一路走到在 Duna 星系建立自给自足的运营。

s: While most UI elements are scalable by default, the Map icons and ther labels (the orbit apoapsis for example) are not, that makes the game almost unplayable at high resolutions. This Mod scales those things using the stock UI Scale setting.
zh: 虽然大多数 UI 元素默认可缩放，但地图图标及其标签（例如轨道远地点）无法缩放，这使游戏在高分辨率下几乎无法游玩。本 Mod 使用原版 UI 缩放设置来缩放这些元素。

s: Asteroid Spawn Limiter is a simple mod for Kerbal Space Program that prevents the game from spawning excessive asteroids. It ensures a cleaner solar system and helps reduce performance impact by capping the number of untracked asteroids generated over time.
zh: Asteroid Spawn Limiter 是一个简单的 KSP mod，可防止游戏生成过多小行星。它通过限制随时间生成的未追踪小行星数量，确保太阳系更干净，并有助于降低性能影响。

s: Back in KSP 0.19, developers NovaSilisko and HarvesteR proposed a resource system that included Propellium, Oxium, Nitronite, Water, Blutonium, Hexagen, and Zeonium that ultimately converted into the resources we know today as LiquidFuel, Oxidizer, MonoPropellant, and XenonGas. You can see their concept image here: i.imgur.com/08hdJyj.png This play mode is inspired by their vision and adds some additional resources and converters to round out your templates.
zh: 早在 KSP 0.19 时，开发者 <<M0>> 和 <<M1>> 就提出了一套资源系统，包括 Propellium、Oxium、Nitronite、Water、Blutonium、Hexagen 和 Zeonium，它们最终演变成了我们今天所熟知的 <<M2>>、氧化剂、<<M3>> 和 <<M4>>。你可以在这里看到他们的概念图：<<M5>> 本游玩模式受其构想启发，并添加了一些额外的资源和转换器，以完善你的模板。

s: A from-scratch successor to OCISLY for streaming KSP camera feeds.  Uses hardware H.264 for Linux and streams over WebRTC. Uses Hullcam VDS filters and camera capabilities. Features a TypeScript SDK for embedding streams wherever you like.
zh: 从零开始打造的 OCISLY 继任者，用于串流 KSP 摄像头画面。在 Linux 上使用硬件 H.264 编码，并通过 <<M0>> 串流。支持 Hullcam VDS 滤镜与摄像头功能。提供 <<M1>> SDK，可将画面流嵌入任意位置。

s: Space Weather And Atmospheric Orbital Decay (SWAOD) is a KSP mod that introduces orbital decay mechanics. It simulates the effect of atmospheric drag on vessels (both loaded and unloaded) and integrates with the Kerbalism mod to simulate intensified orbital decay effects during solar storms.
zh: 空间天气与大气轨道衰减（SWAOD）是一个为 KSP 引入轨道衰减机制的 mod。它模拟大气阻力对飞行器（无论是否加载）的影响，并与 Kerbalism mod 集成，以模拟太阳风暴期间加剧的轨道衰减效应。

s: If parts are placed in a CCK category, it usually also appeared in the original category. This patch hide all CCK-parts from the original categories. CPT give new titles considering the No Duplicates, so it is recommended. The mod was separated, because it has one disadvantage: parts what was hided from their original categories are not available in the search.
zh: 如果部件被放入 CCK 分类，它通常也会出现在原分类中。此补丁会从原分类中隐藏所有 CCK 部件。CPT 会遵循无重复原则给出新标题，因此推荐搭配使用。该 mod 被单独拆分出来，是因为它有一个缺点：从原分类中隐藏的部件无法通过搜索找到。

s: Small surface attachable part, that allow you change direction of main control axis (or just a cheapest remote control) also SAS, Reaction wheel, Battery and Science storage  ( Old name Control From Here )
zh: 小型表面附着部件，可让你改变主控制轴的方向（也可用作最廉价的遥控装置），同时具备 SAS、动量轮、电池和科学储存功能（旧名 Control From Here）

s: Copied Planetoid Mod uses a number of copies of Gilly to make the Kerbin system more realistic by replacing Ike with two copies of Gilly, and moving Ike into an orbit similar to 4 Vesta, and adding two Gilly copies in orbits equivalent to 2 Pallas and 10 Hygiea.
zh: Copied Planetoid Mod 使用多份 Gilly 副本让 Kerbin 星系更贴近现实：用两个 Gilly 副本替代 Ike，把 Ike 移入类似 4 Vesta 的轨道，并添加两个处于 2 Pallas 和 10 Hygiea 等效轨道的 Gilly 副本。

s: There were many mods or parts that were modeled in years, models or mods that were left alone and never got updated after their original publishing, thankfully, their licensing were open and let others take their job and continue their awesome works. So, here is a nice mod to have specially if you are interested into rings and stations
zh: 多年来有许多 mod 或部件模型在最初发布后便被搁置、再无更新；所幸它们的许可开放，允许他人接手并延续这些出色的作品。因此，如果你对环形结构和空间站感兴趣，这个 mod 值得拥有

s: MKS introduces a series of parts specifically designed to provide self-sustaining life support for your Kerbals. While the parts will function without a life support mod, the design is centered around providing an appropriate challenge where players will weigh the costs, risks, and rewards of supplying missions exclusively with carried life support supplies, or in making the investment in a permanent colony. That being said, this is not just a single greenhouse part (although food production is part of the mod). Rather, it brings an entire colonization end-game to KSP in a fun and challenging way.
zh: MKS 引入了一系列专为 Kerbal 提供自给自足生命保障而设计的部件。这些部件在没有生命保障 mod 的情况下也能运作，但其设计核心在于提供恰当的挑战：玩家需权衡仅靠携带的生命保障补给维持任务，还是投资建设永久殖民地，各自的成本、风险与回报。话虽如此，这并不只是一个温室部件（尽管食物生产也是其中一部分），而是以有趣且富有挑战性的方式为 KSP 带来了完整的殖民终局。

s: Adds the pursuit of gold and an extremely rare resource called Unobtainium to the game! Mine either of these heavy resources for fun and profit! A great alternative to contract spam! Eight new parts and and additional functionality to several stock parts in Kerbal Space Program.
zh: 为游戏加入了黄金开采以及一种名为 Unobtainium 的极稀有资源。开采这两种沉重资源，既能取乐又能获利。是替代合同刷屏的绝佳选择。包含八个新部件，并为 KSP 的若干原版部件增添了额外功能。

s: This pack currently adds over 600... yes you read correctly... over 600 contracts to the base game following the historic progression of both NASA and its Russian counterparts, each mission has been made into a contract for the game. This version is for non RSS/RO KSP
zh: 此包目前为基础游戏添加了超过 600……你没看错……超过 600 个合同，遵循 NASA 及其苏联对应机构的史实进程，每个任务都被制作成游戏中的合同。此版本适用于非 RSS/RO 的 KSP。

s: CactEye is a plugin and set of parts that allow for modular orbital telescopes. CactEye telescopes feature a fully-functional science system, and are upgradeable/serviceable (primarily through Kerbal Inventory System). Orbital telescopes also now become fundamental to discovering asteroids.
zh: <<M0>> 是一个插件及部件包，提供模块化轨道望远镜。<<M0>> 望远镜具备完整可用的科学系统，并且可升级/可维护（主要通过 Kerbal Inventory System）。轨道望远镜现在也成为了发现小行星的关键。

s: Ever wondered why the sunlight is so dull? Try this! It amps up the sunlight intensity and disables ambient lighting (Good luck fumbling about in the dark!) Now everything looks exactly why the Nasa pictures with super bright lit areas and pitch black in the shade. (Requires Kopernicus.)
zh: 想知道为什么阳光如此暗淡吗？试试这个！它会增强阳光强度并禁用环境光（祝你在黑暗中摸索顺利！）现在一切看起来就像 NASA 照片一样，亮部极亮，阴影处漆黑。（需要 Kopernicus。）

s: An observational astronomy mod: real telescopes photographing planets, moons, nebulae and galaxies onto real detector models, plus an exoplanet survey with transit and radial-velocity pipelines against a real star catalog.
zh: 一个观测天文学模组：真实望远镜将行星、卫星、星云和星系拍摄到真实探测器模型上，并基于真实星表进行系外行星巡天，包含凌星与径向速度管线。

s: A contract pack recreating almost all real-life missions that were actually flown, currently up until 1967 and the most exciting missions going into the 70s.. This version is for users of Stock and any other non-RSS planet pack.
zh: 一个合同包，重现几乎所有实际执行过的真实任务，目前涵盖至 1967 年，以及进入 70 年代最激动人心的任务。此版本适用于原版及任何其他非 RSS 行星包用户。

s: Nuke TinyParts (NTP)  Tiny Parts and Other Useless Junk 'A pack containing half meter, tanks, engines, rcs, various adapters and decouplers as well as other miscellaneous parts of my design. Most of the parts feature normal maps, and engines have overheat effects.
zh: Nuke <<M0>> (NTP) 微型部件及其他无用杂物 “一个包含半米部件、储罐、发动机、RCS、各种转接器和分离器，以及我设计的其他杂项部件的包。大多数部件带有法线贴图，发动机具有过热效果。”

s: Automatically sets AutoStrut modes for you in the editor as you build your vessel. Includes compatibility for Infernal Robotics, FAS will not set AutoStrut mode if the part is attached to an IR module.
zh: 在编辑器中建造飞行器时自动为你设置 <<M0>> 模式。包含对 Infernal Robotics 的兼容性；如果部件连接到 IR 模块，FAS 将不会设置 <<M0>> 模式。

s: This patch changes most known nuclear thermal rocket engines (stock and modded) to use liquid hydrogen instead of stock liquid fuel. Having a mod that provides matching tanks (like Near Future Propulsion) is recommended.
zh: 此补丁将大多数已知核热火箭发动机（原版与模组）改为使用液氢，而非原版液体燃料。建议安装提供匹配储罐的模组（如 Near Future Propulsion）。

s: KSP Interstellar Extended (KSPI-E) is a plugin for Kerbal Space Program, designed to encourage bootstrapping toward ever more advanced levels of technology as well as utilizing In-Situ resources to expand the reach of Kerbal civilization. KSP Interstellar Extended aims to continue in Fractals original KSPI vision in providing a realistic road to the stars.
zh: KSP Interstellar Extended (KSPI-E) 是 Kerbal Space Program 的一个插件，旨在鼓励逐步迈向更先进的技术水平，并利用原位资源扩展 Kerbal 文明的触达范围。KSP Interstellar Extended 致力于延续 Fractals 原版 KSPI 的愿景，提供一条通往星空的真实之路。

s: Personally I've been pretty annoyed that the spaceplane pieces (and a number of other parts) don't all have matching colors or textures. They have a base white coat which is used for all splaceplane parts, but there are about five different shades that are used for wing trims. SO..... rather then complaining about it, I'm going to try and solve it.
zh: 我个人一直很烦恼，空天飞机部件（以及许多其他部件）的颜色或纹理并不完全匹配。所有空天飞机部件都有一层基础白色涂层，但机翼饰条使用了大约五种不同色调。所以……与其抱怨，我打算试着解决它。

s: A collection of flags from modern Chinese history. Includes flags from the Qing Dynasty, Tibet, the Republic of China, and the People's Republic of China plus the special administrative regions. I added extra flags like military flags, party flags, and revolutionary flags.
zh: 一组来自中国近代史的旗帜。包括清朝、西藏、中华民国和中华人民共和国的旗帜，以及特别行政区旗帜。我还添加了军旗、党旗和革命旗帜等额外旗帜。

s: The second expansion pack adds new science-collecting equipment to deploy on your missions, surface features to be investigated scattered across distant planets, and a wealth of new robotic parts for players to test their creativity with
zh: 第二个扩展包新增了可在任务中部署的科学收集设备、散布在遥远行星上可供调查的表面特征，以及大量新的机器人部件，供玩家发挥创造力。

s: This is a KSP mod that replicates the CST-100 spacecraft. The Boeing CST-100 Starliner (Crew Space Transportation-100) is a crew capsule manufactured by Boeing as its participation in NASA's Commercial Crew Development (CCDev) program. Its primary purpose is to transport crew to the International Space Station (ISS) and to private space stations such as the proposed Bigelow Aerospace Commercial Space Station.
zh: 这是一个复刻 <<M0>> 航天器的 KSP mod。波音 <<M0>> Starliner（载人空间运输-100，Crew Space Transportation-100）是波音公司为参与 NASA 商业载人发展（CCDev）计划而制造的载人飞船。其主要用途是将乘员运送至国际空间站（ISS），以及 Bigelow Aerospace 商业空间站等私人空间站。

s: With the stock editor now supporting custom filters in a reasonable way, creating more and better filters is the next logical step. However, the requirement for categories to be managed via code is just a terrible idea. Not to mention that there is no easy way to be compatible with anyone else. Filter extensions allows the usage of .cfg files to create, edit, or delete all categories and sub-categories. It uses standard config files, and as such patches can be applied, and dependencies allowed for using Module Manager.
zh: 原版编辑器如今已能以合理方式支持自定义筛选器，因此制作更多、更好的筛选器是顺理成章的下一步。然而，要求通过代码来管理分类实在是个糟糕的主意，更不用说这样做很难与他人保持兼容。Filter Extensions 允许使用 .cfg 文件创建、编辑或删除所有分类与子分类。它采用标准配置文件，因此可以应用补丁，并可借助 Module Manager 声明依赖。

s: A standalone warp drive mod inspired by Star Trek and RoverDude's Standalone Alcubierre Warp Drive.  The drive requires at least two parts to operate.  The current WIP release contains two modified stock parts as test articles, and a test craft, the plugin itself, and the source code.
zh: 一个独立曲速引擎 mod，灵感来自《星际迷航》以及 <<M0>> 的独立 Alcubierre 曲速引擎。该引擎至少需要两个部件才能运作。当前开发中版本包含两个作为试验件的原版部件改装、一艘试验飞船、插件本体以及源代码。

s: Have you ever wanted to explore the nearest stars in KSP while grounded to realistic planets? Now you can! Distant skies seeks to add Dozens of interpretations of real life systems, eventually getting to distant star systems!
zh: 你是否曾想在 KSP 中探索最近的恒星，同时又要立足于真实的行星？现在可以了。Distant Skies 旨在加入数十种对现实恒星系的诠释，最终延伸至遥远的恒星系统。

s: Sorts all parts (including DLC) within their original categories in a logical and elegant way. Never again will you have to search for ANY part (fuel tanks, wings, adaptors, engines), as you will instantly find it without wasting any time. Never again you will have to scroll down to find a similar part as it will already be next to the one you used.
zh: 以合理而优雅的方式在原分类中对所有部件（含 DLC）排序。你再也无需搜索任何部件（燃料罐、机翼、转接件、发动机），即刻就能找到，不必浪费时间；也再不用向下滚动去找相似部件，因为它就在你用过的那个旁边。

s: The plugin search for folders starting with "arch_" in the KSP stock Ships folder (the one where the folder "Script" of kOS lives), it makes a list of those folders and you can now change between them at wild. It's possible also to create new archive folders on demand. kOS will do the rest as is always looking for changes in the "Schips/Script" folder.
zh: 该插件会在 KSP 原版 Ships 文件夹（即 kOS 的 "Script" 文件夹所在处）中搜索以 "arch_" 开头的文件夹，列出这些文件夹，之后你便可随意在它们之间切换。也可以按需新建归档文件夹。其余工作由 kOS 完成，因为它始终会监测 "Schips/Script" 文件夹的变化。

s: Career for Realism Overhaul. Do not select/install this directly, instead select the RP-1 Express Install and let it install this automatically unless you know what you're doing and can fix it yourself.
zh: Realism Overhaul 的生涯模式配置。请勿直接选择/安装此项，而应选择 <<M0>> 快速安装，让它自动安装；除非你清楚自己在做什么并能自行修复。

s: Real Solar System moves KSC from Kerbin to Earth. Little Green Men From Mars moves the KSC from Kerbin to... MARS. The red one. Sol-4. Not the blue one. The Kerbals are not happy about this mixup either.
zh: Real Solar System 把 KSC 从 Kerbin 搬到了地球。Little Green Men From Mars 则把 KSC 从 Kerbin 搬到了……火星。那颗红色的。<<M0>>。不是蓝色的那颗。小绿人们对这桩错乱同样很不满意。

s: It always annoys me that I have to put my eva reports into my spacecraft to send science to KSC so I made this tiny mod that lets you transmit Eva reports as long as you are in 10km of a spacecraft with an omni antenna
zh: 我一直很烦必须把 EVA 报告放进飞船才能把科学数据传回 KSC，于是做了这个小型 mod：只要你在配备全向天线的飞船 10 km 范围内，就能传输 EVA 报告。

s: The World Beyond adds 100 celestial bodies into a cluster far away from the stock system. This download contains the entire mod with visuals, please visit the forum thread for more installation options.
zh: The World Beyond 在原版星系之外的一处星团中加入了 100 个天体。本下载包含带有视觉效果的完整 mod，更多安装选项请访问论坛帖。

s: The major part of RSS-Origin, which adds plenty of asteroids, asteroid moons, comets, moons of gas/ice giants, dwarf planets, dwarf planet moons, and interstellar objects into real solar system, currently 200 in total. (dozens more in the future). This is the core pack
zh: RSS-Origin 的主体部分，为真实太阳系加入大量小行星、小行星卫星、彗星、气态/冰巨星的卫星、矮行星、矮行星卫星以及星际天体，目前共 200 个（未来还将增加数十个）。这是核心包。

s: This mod adds several large parts designed to be integrated into a permanent space station: the Science Lab, the Zoology Bay, the Cyclotron, and the Spectrometron. These heavy parts provide facilities for performing experiments. Experiments are held in small, light pods that you can dock with your space station, execute, and bring back to the surface for Science points. The Spectrometron uses the Cyclotron to analyze Surface Samples that you've brought into orbit, and allows you to transmit the data home for full value. In addition, there are tanks for storing Kibbal for the Zoology Bay.
zh: 本 mod 加入若干设计用于集成到永久空间站的大型部件：科学实验室、动物舱、回旋加速器和光谱仪。这些重型部件提供进行实验的设施。实验容纳在小型轻质舱体中，你可以将其对接至空间站、执行实验，再带回地表换取科学点。光谱仪利用回旋加速器分析你带上轨道的表面样本，并可将数据传回地面以获得全额收益。此外还有为动物舱储存 Kibbal 的储罐。

s: This pack includes 18 objects for the Cassini–Huygens mission: Masursky | Hyperion | Phoebe | Janus | Epimetheus | Helene | Telesto | Calypso | Atlas | Prometheus | Pandora | Pan | Methone | Pallene | Polydeuces | Daphnis | Anthe | Aegaeon.
zh: 本包包含卡西尼-惠更斯任务的 18 个天体：Masursky | Hyperion | Phoebe | Janus | Epimetheus | Helene | Telesto | Calypso | Atlas | Prometheus | Pandora | Pan | Methone | Pallene | Polydeuces | Daphnis | Anthe | Aegaeon。

s: This pack includes 20 Comets and 1 Comet moon: 1P/Halley | 2P/Encke | 6P/d'Arrest | 8P/Tuttle | 9P/Tempel 1 | 10P/Tempel 2 | 19P/Borrelly | 21P/Giacobini–Zinner | 26P/Grigg–Skjellerup | 29P/Schwassmann–Wachmann 1 | 46P/Wirtanen | 67P/Churyumov–Gerasimenko | 81P/Wild 2 | 103P/Hartley 2 | 153P/Ikeya–Zhang | 311P/PanSTARRS, Companion of 311P.
zh: 本包包含 20 颗彗星和 1 颗彗星卫星：1P/Halley | 2P/Encke | 6P/d'Arrest | 8P/Tuttle | 9P/Tempel 1 | 10P/Tempel 2 | 19P/Borrelly | 21P/Giacobini–Zinner | 26P/Grigg–Skjellerup | 29P/Schwassmann–Wachmann 1 | 46P/Wirtanen | 67P/Churyumov–Gerasimenko | 81P/Wild 2 | 103P/Hartley 2 | 153P/Ikeya–Zhang | 311P/PanSTARRS，以及 311P 的伴星。

s: Ever wished you were somewhere else instantly. With the Kerbin Science Foundry faster than light (FTL) drive you can! Just spin it up to create an instant reality dysfunction that might, just might transport you instantly to another point in space.
zh: 是否曾希望自己能瞬间抵达别处？有了 Kerbin Science Foundry 的超光速（FTL）引擎，你就能做到。只需让它加速旋转，制造一次瞬时的现实紊乱，也许、仅仅是也许，就能把你瞬间传送到太空中的另一个位置。

s: This is a mod that adds a new ringed planet, Donbrek, and its moon, Dowa. Donbrek is a desert planet with a habitable north and south poles while Dowa is a small ocean world with an oxygenless atmosphere.
zh: 这是一个添加了新的带环行星 Donbrek 及其卫星 Dowa 的 mod。Donbrek 是一颗南北极宜居的沙漠行星，而 Dowa 则是一个拥有无氧大气的小型海洋世界。

s: A fork of TriggerAu's Transfer Window Planner mod. Instead of assuming an equatorial orbit with a plane change in the ejection burn, this version shows the required parking orbit plane such that the ejection burn is purely prograde. This can save a lot of Δv when the planes of the departure and destination body are not exactly the same as that of the departure body's equator.
zh: <<M0>> 的 Transfer Window Planner mod 的分支版本。本版本不假设在赤道轨道上通过出发点火进行平面变更，而是显示所需的停泊轨道平面，使出发点火完全为顺行方向。当出发天体与目标天体的轨道平面与出发天体赤道面不完全相同时，这可以节省大量 Δv。

s: A small add-on adding TestFlight support for stock and modded parts, providing them success/failure chances (including engine reliability and ignition chance) and different failure modes depending on the engine type.
zh: 一个小型附加组件，为原版与 mod 部件添加 <<M0>> 支持，为其提供成功/失败概率（包括引擎可靠性与点火概率），并根据引擎类型提供不同的故障模式。

s: Add two spawn points near the KSC Shore: on the water surface for boats and underwater for submarines.  I couldn't resist and have added few objects on the shore, also you can find new underwater anomalies on the Kerbin. Requres Kerbal-Konstruct.
zh: 在 KSC 海岸附近添加两个出生点：水面用于船只，水下用于潜艇。我忍不住在岸边也加了几个物体，此外你还能在 Kerbin 上找到新的水下异常点。需要 Kerbal-Konstruct。

s: This mod adds many new surprises, requires Kopernicus as it also is a planet pack. Other than that, it is completely standalone. For KSP 1.7. Is also a planet pack. Even includes realistic parts to remedy the realism aspect of the mod. Includes: Realistic batteries, Real Fuels (although without cryogenic properties) and other miscellaneous parts!
zh: 此 mod 添加了许多新惊喜，需要 Kopernicus，因为它同时也是一个行星包。除此之外，它完全独立运行。适用于 KSP 1.7。它同时也是一个行星包。甚至包含写实部件，以弥补本 mod 的写实性。包含：写实电池、真实燃料（Real Fuels）（但不含低温特性）以及其他杂项部件。

s: A part of RSS-Origin, which overhauls some RSS celestials with more accurate, more realistic and higher res textures and topography, since some of original RSS textures are unrealistic in color, topo and other stuff. This is the configs pack.
zh: RSS-Origin 的一部分，用更精确、更写实、更高分辨率的贴图与地形重制了部分 RSS 天体，因为原版 RSS 的一些贴图在颜色、地形等方面不够写实。本包为配置包。

s: A.K.A. MPE. This one's for the little guys! Originally by Exo, this planet pack adds 22 new bodies to the Kerbol system to explore based on real-world asteroids and dwarf planets. Features hand-drawn maps, biomes, and precious, PRECIOUS science.
zh: 又名 MPE。这个是为小家伙们准备的。最初由 Exo 制作，这个行星包基于现实中的小行星与矮行星，为 Kerbol 星系添加了 22 个新天体供探索。特点包括手绘地图、生物群系，以及珍贵、非常珍贵的科学。

s: TweakScale lets you change the size of a part. Not just that, but it will figure out how much fuel is in the resized part. And if it's an engine, it will become more powerful by scaling it bigger, or weaker by scaling it smaller.
zh: <<M0>> 可让你改变部件的大小。不仅如此，它还会计算改变尺寸后部件内的燃料量。如果该部件是引擎，放大后推力会更强，缩小后则更弱。

s: Do you fly Mk3 spaceplanes and need to haul lots of stuff into space?  The Kerbal Inventory System (KIS) from the brilliant team of KospY and Winn75 provides a framework for doing just that.  However, you have to attach containers to the outside of your spaceplane, which is not very aerodynamic.   To answer this demand, RocketWorks has developed three KIS Containers that fit inside the Mk3 CRG Cargo Bays: Mk3 KIS Small Container (5000L), Mks3 KIS Medium Container (10000L), Mk3 KIS Long Container (20000L).  You can, of course, install upto four Small Containers inside the CRG-100 Cargo Bay.  To install a Container in a Cargo Bay, first place a Mk3 KIS Mount on the floor of the Cargo Bay.  This Mount is a ruggedized version of the KospY/Winn75 KIS "SM-62 Container mount".  It has been enlarged strengthened to handle the additional stresses of the new containers.  Then, drop a Container on to the mount.  Right-click the KIS container and load-up whatever you need to haul into space.
zh: 你驾驶 Mk3 太空飞机，需要把大量物资送入太空吗？由 <<M0>> 和 <<M1>> 组成的出色团队开发的 Kerbal Inventory System（KIS）为此提供了框架。然而，你必须把容器挂在太空飞机外部，这会影响气动性能。为满足这一需求，<<M2>> 开发了三种可装入 Mk3 CRG 货舱的 KIS 容器：Mk3 KIS 小容器（5000L）、<<M3>> KIS 中容器（10000L）、Mk3 KIS 长容器（20000L）。当然，你可以在 <<M4>> 货舱内安装最多四个小容器。要在货舱内安装容器，首先在货舱地板上放置一个 Mk3 KIS 安装座。该安装座是 KospY/Winn75 的 KIS“<<M5>> 容器安装座”的加固版本，经过放大与加强，以承受新容器带来的额外应力。然后，将一个容器放到安装座上。右键点击 KIS 容器，装载你需要送入太空的任何物资。

s: This add-on creates a log file by hooking into the logger callbacks in Unity and is able to extract more value from the available information. Assists in finding issues that you might not even be aware of and might be able to find any pesky add-on(s) that might be causing your issues. For Kerbal Space Program.
zh: 此附加组件通过挂接 Unity 的日志回调来生成日志文件，并能从可用信息中挖掘出更多价值。它有助于发现你甚至尚未察觉的问题，还可能找出任何正在给你添麻烦的附加组件。适用于 Kerbal Space Program。

s: This pack includes 13 TNOs with diameter > 500km and 7 moons: Varuna, Varuna II | Aya | Uni, Tinia | Salacia, Actaea | Varda, Ilmarë | Máni | 2012 VP113 | 2017 OF201 | Ixion | Achlys, S/2005 (208996) 1 | Gǃkúnǁʼhòmdímà, Gǃòʼé ǃHú | Dziewanna | Chiminigagua, S/2018 (532037) 1.
zh: 此包包含 13 颗直径大于 500km 的海外天体（TNO）和 7 颗卫星：Varuna、Varuna II | Aya | Uni、Tinia | Salacia、Actaea | Varda、Ilmarë | Máni | 2012 <<M0>> | 2017 <<M1>> | Ixion | Achlys、S/2005 (208996) 1 | Gǃkúnǁʼhòmdímà、Gǃòʼé ǃHú | Dziewanna | Chiminigagua、S/2018 (532037) 1。

s: KSP post-processing. Simple as that. No need for something like ReShade, when there's KS3P to provide dedicated, entirely configurable post-processing effects, often without any noticeable performance impact.
zh: KSP 后期处理。就这么简单。既然有 <<M1>> 提供专用的、完全可配置的后期处理效果，且通常没有明显性能影响，就无需 <<M0>> 之类的东西。

s: Plod was so amazing, they had to make another one! Plod II is similar to the original Plod, but with more moons, more colors, and even more destinations to explore. Plod II is the ultimate must have for all Plod enthusiasts!
zh: Plod 如此惊艳，于是他们又做了一个。Plod II 与原版 Plod 相似，但拥有更多卫星、更多色彩，以及更多可探索的目的地。Plod II 是所有 Plod 爱好者的终极必备之选。

s: Are you tired of not having Scott Manley in game? Are you tired of not looking at his pretty face while you playing KSP? ENOUGH! NOW YOU CAN LOOK AT HIM AS MUCH AS YOU WANT! Download our Scott Manley Head Pack today and get 50% more Scott!!!
zh: 你是否厌倦了游戏中没有 Scott Manley？是否厌倦了玩 KSP 时看不到他那张漂亮的脸？够了。现在你可以随心所欲地看他。立即下载我们的 Scott Manley 头像包，获得多 50% 的 Scott。

s: Bird is a mod for﻿ better﻿ warp-to-morning functionality﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿. Currently, it modifies the warp-to-morning feature such that warp ends five minutes before sunrise, taking the space center latitude into account (not relevant for stock Kerbin, but relevant for any planet mod that fakes axial tilt
zh: Bird 是一个用于改进“时间加速至早晨”功能的 mod。目前，它修改了该功能，使时间加速在日出前五分钟结束，并考虑航天中心的纬度（对原版 Kerbin 无关紧要，但对任何伪造自转轴倾角的行星 mod 都很有用

s: Adds wind to the game. It opens a dialog box where you can set wind direction and speed. Inspired by KerbalWeatherSystem by silverfox8124. But this is much simpler, omitting the actual weather simulation.
zh: 为游戏添加风。它会打开一个对话框，你可以在其中设置风向和风速。灵感来自 silverfox8124 的 <<M0>>。但本 mod 简单得多，省略了实际的气象模拟。

s: Allows you to open a new window (on a separator monitor) to display the map view, using two separate copies of the game. One copy should install the client, the other (your main game) should install the server. All other mods should be the same.
zh: 允许你使用两份独立的游戏副本，打开一个新窗口（位于副显示器上）来显示地图视图。一份副本安装客户端，另一份（你的主游戏）安装服务端。其他所有 mod 应保持一致。

s: This mod is designed to add rings to Dres, just like ksp2, it can also add a satellite to Dres (optional), just like Fissure in Afterkerbin, this mod has bugs such as inaccurate lightmaps, is still being tested and does not represent the final version
zh: 此 mod 旨在为 Dres 添加环形，就像 KSP2 那样；它还可以为 Dres 添加一颗卫星（可选），就像 Afterkerbin 中的 Fissure 那样。此 mod 存在光照贴图不准确等 bug，仍在测试中，不代表最终版本。

s: NT Chinese Aerospace Pack or NCAP is a mod created for Kerbal Space Program to add Chinese rockets and spacecraft to the game. So far, this mod including: longmarch 2F, longmarch6, longmarch6A, longmarch7, Chinese Tianhe Space station, Tianwe-1 and Yuanzheng-3.
zh: NT Chinese Aerospace Pack（NCAP）是一个为 Kerbal Space Program 制作的 mod，为游戏添加中国火箭与航天器。目前，该 mod 包含：长征二号 F、长征六号、<<M0>>、长征七号、中国天和空间站、天问一号和远征三号。

s: A space program based on NASA and Boeing proposals for future missions. Part models from a wide variety of authors have been licensed, and new original models made, then combined with all new textures, sizes and configurations, to create craft files depicting the proposed missions. This project is modeled at 75% real scale.
zh: 一个基于 NASA 与波音未来任务提案的航天计划。来自众多作者的部分模型已获授权，并制作了新的原创模型，再结合全新的贴图、尺寸与配置，创建出描绘这些提案任务的飞行器文件。该项目按真实比例的 75% 建模。

s: Outer Planets Mod is a mod that expands the outer edges of the Kerbol system, to create something akin to the real Solar System's. It adds Kerbalized versions of Saturn, Uranus, Neptune and Pluto, just like real-life. these faraway planets and moons provide a challenge rarely encountered in Kerbal Space Program. You'll have to figure out new transfer windows, provide your spacecraft with more Delta-V and be ready to travel years or even decades.
zh: Outer Planets Mod 扩展了 Kerbol 星系的外缘，营造出类似真实太阳系的结构。它添加了 Kerbal 化版本的土星、天王星、海王星和冥王星，正如现实中的那样。这些遥远的行星与卫星带来了 Kerbal Space Program 中罕见的挑战。你需要找出新的转移窗口，为航天器提供更多 Δv，并做好飞行数年甚至数十年的准备。

s: A simple ModuleManager patch that eliminates crew requirements for manned vessels and/or the need to attach an unmanned probe to your spacecraft. Useful for automatic launches and docking of space station modules, rescue missions etc. Requires ModuleManager.
zh: 一个简单的 <<M0>> 补丁，可免除载人飞船的乘员需求，和/或免去为航天器附加无人探测器的需要。适用于自动发射与空间站舱段对接、救援任务等。需要 <<M0>>。

s: Inspired by the NASA mission LADEE. The objective of LADEE was to investigate the mysteries of the lunar atmosphere and the question of levitated lunar dust. It carried a scientific instrument called the Lunar Dust Experiment (LDEX). This instrument was an impact ionization dust detector. In this way it was possible to measure the density of dust particles.
zh: 灵感来自 NASA 的 LADEE 任务。LADEE 的目标是探究月球大气的奥秘以及悬浮月尘问题。它搭载了一台名为月球尘埃实验（LDEX）的科学仪器。该仪器是一台撞击电离式尘埃探测器，借此可以测量尘埃颗粒的密度。

s: Early Bird is a mod for better warp-to-morning functionality. Currently, it modifies the warp-to-morning feature such that warp ends five minutes before sunrise, taking the space center latitude into account (not relevant for stock Kerbin, but relevant for any planet mod that fakes axial tilt
zh: Early Bird 是一个改进“加速至清晨”功能的 mod。目前它会修改该功能，使时间加速在日出前五分钟结束，并考虑航天中心所在纬度（对原版 Kerbin 无影响，但对任何伪造轴倾角的天体 mod 有效

s: Includes 2 spotlight parts that are controlled via Light tracking module.  Spotlights can be manually positioned or set to track a target.  Supports Color, Intensity, Range, and cone size changes in flight.
zh: 包含 2 个聚光灯部件，由 Light tracking 模块控制。聚光灯可手动定位，也可设为跟踪目标。支持在飞行中调整颜色、强度、范围和锥头尺寸。

s: Uses an embedded copy of Kerbal Engineer's vessel simulator to determine the TWR of each stage, then adjusts the sizes of tanks from Procedural Parts to fit a user-specified TWR. Also sets top and bottom diameters to match attached parts, matches the fuel tank type to the attached engine, and allows the user to change the default texture. All such features can be toggled at the part level with tweakables or at the system level via a button in the stock toolbar.
zh: 内置 Kerbal Engineer 的飞行器模拟器，用于计算各级的 TWR，然后调整 Procedural Parts 贮箱的尺寸以符合用户指定的 TWR。还会将上下直径设为与相连部件匹配，将燃料箱类型与相连的发动机匹配，并允许用户更改默认贴图。上述功能均可在部件层级通过可调参数切换，或通过原版工具栏中的按钮在系统层级切换。

s: A “stick it where you like it” command unit, prone to homicidal episodes, good to attach on secondary payloads or whatever you want to control. No reaction wheel, sensitive to bad remarks about it’s single red eye! Now with KAS!
zh: 一个“想贴哪就贴哪”的控制单元，偶有暴走倾向，适合安装在次级载荷或任何你想控制的东西上。无动量轮，对关于它那只独眼的恶意评论很敏感。现已支持 KAS。

s: Kerbal Life Science is a collection of multi-step experiments inspired by real-world ISS science experiments. To run experiments, you have to launch laboratories, equipment, and the experiments themselves and perform some assembly in-orbit before the experiments can be run. The idea is to run the experiments in the background while you do other missions.
zh: Kerbal Life Science 是一组受国际空间站真实科学实验启发的多步骤实验。要运行实验，必须先发射实验室、设备与实验本体，并在轨完成部分组装后才能开始实验。其理念是让实验在后台运行，同时你可以执行其他任务。

s: What does this mod do? This mod (currently) creates a log file at GameData/ExceptionDetectorUpdated/Log which you will find more helpful than the other logs available to you.  This mod hooks into the logger callbacks in Unity, and is able to extract a little more value from the available information.  For modders: Find what issues you may be causing, perhaps more quickly  For non-modders: You might be able to find that one pesky mod that is causing you problems.
zh: 这个 mod 做什么？该 mod（目前）会在 GameData/ExceptionDetectorUpdated/Log 生成日志文件，比你能找到的其他日志更有帮助。该 mod 挂接 Unity 的日志回调，能从已有信息中多提取一些价值。对 mod 作者：更快找出你可能造成的问题。对普通玩家：也许能找出那个一直捣乱的 mod。

s: Adds a button in the Tracking Station to set a ship's orbit. If you are with 1% (configurable) of your target orbit, you can simply push the button to set the orbit's semi-major axis to exactly what you want, so it won't drift out of alignment as you time warp.
zh: 在跟踪站添加一个按钮，用于设定飞船的轨道。若你与目标轨道的误差在 1%（可配置）以内，只需按下按钮即可将轨道半长轴精确设为你想要的值，这样在时间加速时就不会漂移失准。

s: On Demand Fuel Cells (ODFC) is a plugin to support fuel cells that only generate power when it is needed, thereby saving precious fuel. Simulates fuel cells in Kerbal Space Program (KSP), and do a better job of it than stock's use of a resource converter.  The main difference is it only generates electricity when it's really needed (batteries almost empty), and otherwise lets electricity of a craft float up and down, as it might in a solar powered vehicle when the sun is eclipsed by another celestial body.  It also allows fuel cells to generate byproducts, aimed at supporting life support mods like TACLS.
zh: On Demand Fuel Cells（ODFC）是一个支持按需发电燃料电池的插件，仅在需要时发电，从而节省宝贵的燃料。它在 KSP 中模拟燃料电池，效果优于原版使用资源转化炉的做法。主要区别在于它只在真正需要时（电池几乎耗尽）才发电，其余时候让飞行器的电量自然浮动，就像太阳能飞行器在太阳被其他天体遮挡时那样。它还允许燃料电池产生副产品，以支持 TACLS 等生命维持 mod。

s: The URM Parts Pack contains everything needed to construct the URM-1 based Angara space-launch vehicles in multiple configurations with added access to a variety of high performance lift, insertion and orbital maneuvering engines from the Nositel, Proton, Onega and Angara systems.
zh: URM 部件包包含建造基于 <<M0>> 的安加拉系列运载火箭所需的全部部件，支持多种构型，并额外提供来自 Nositel、Proton、Onega 和 Angara 系统的高性能起飞级、入轨级和轨道机动发动机。

s: A set of parts to help you in the construction of large interplanetary spacecraft. Includes MM patches for CTT, USI-LS and Snacks! It currently includes a 2.5m foldable centrifuge, 2.5m and 3.75m hubs for building stations, and inline 3.75m solar panels.
zh: 一组用于建造大型行星际飞船的部件。包含针对 CTT、USI-LS 和 Snacks 的 MM 补丁。目前包括 2.5m 可折叠离心舱、用于建造空间站的 2.5m 与 3.75m 枢纽，以及 3.75m 直列式太阳能板。

s: Ever wished you where somewhere else instantly. With the Kerbin Science Foundry faster than light (FTL) drive you can! Just spin it up to create an instant reality dysfunction that might, just might transport you instantly to another point in space.
zh: 是否曾希望自己能瞬间抵达别处。有了 Kerbin Science Foundry 的超光速（FTL）引擎，你就能做到！只需将其启动，制造一次瞬间的现实紊乱，也许、仅仅是也许，就能把你瞬间传送到太空中的另一个位置。

s: The bears needed something more durable to bare their mass. The Bear Landing Leg LT-B was designed to handle this problem. Once deployed, the bear paw shaped landing legs are built to handle heavy loads. This landing leg is more durable and built like a bear.
zh: 熊需要更耐用的东西来承载它们的质量。Bear Landing Leg LT-B 正是为解决这一问题而设计。展开后，熊掌形着陆支架可承受重载。这款着陆支架更耐用，坚固如熊。

s: I made a crude Waterfall patch for this mod (including RCS) that uses Mk2 Expansion's Waterfall configs, so I guess you'll need Mk2 Expansion for it to work; I also made an RCS Waterfall config for this mod, but the M2X_ACSBlister doesn't have one because I don't know which RCS template suits it.
zh: 我为这个 mod 做了一个粗糙的 Waterfall 补丁（包括 RCS），它使用了 Mk2 Expansion 的 Waterfall 配置，所以大概需要安装 Mk2 Expansion 才能生效；我也为这个 mod 做了一个 RCS Waterfall 配置，但 <<M0>> 没有，因为我不知道哪种 RCS 模板适合它。

s: A simple ModuleManager plugin that eliminates crew requirements for manned vessels and/or the need to attach an unmanned probe to your spacecraft. Useful for automatic launches and docking of space station modules, rescue missions etc. Requires ModuleManager
zh: 一个简单的 <<M0>> 插件，可免除载人飞船的乘员要求，和/或无需为飞船附加无人探测核心。适用于自动发射与空间站舱段对接、救援任务等。需要 <<M0>>

s: When is is it time for science?    Who knows! The game provides no feedback when you've crossed a biome barrier, a new crew report is available or when you've forgotten to run a goo experiment. Wouldn't it be cool to stop guessing?
zh: 何时该做科学？谁知道呢！当你越过生态群系边界、有新的乘员报告可用，或是忘了做黏液实验时，游戏都不会给出任何提示。能不再靠猜，岂不是很棒？

s: Creates a cloned Goliath Jet Engine with it's max thrust set to to 800kN, which is 2.5 times more thrust than stock, but at the cost of increased fuel consumption. Great add-on for heavy transport planes!
zh: 创建一个克隆版 Goliath 喷气发动机，最大推力设为 800kN，是原版推力的 2.5 倍，但代价是燃料消耗增加。是重型运输机的绝佳配件。

s: This pack includes 13 NEOs with diameter > 2km and 6 moons: Eros | Ganymed | Florence, S/2017 (3122) 1, S/2017 (3122) 2 | Don Quixote | 2001 SN263, S/2008 (153591) 1, S/2008 (153591) 2 | Geographos | Daedalus | Phaethon | Toutatis | Heracles, S/2011 (5143) 1 | Ra-Shalom | Cruithne | Atira, S/2017 (163693) 1.
zh: 本包包含 13 颗直径大于 2km 的近地天体（NEO）和 6 颗卫星：Eros | Ganymed | Florence, S/2017 (3122) 1, S/2017 (3122) 2 | Don Quixote | 2001 <<M0>>, S/2008 (153591) 1, S/2008 (153591) 2 | Geographos | Daedalus | Phaethon | Toutatis | Heracles, S/2011 (5143) 1 | Ra-Shalom | Cruithne | Atira, S/2017 (163693) 1。

s: Here are some fairings to change the everyday lifestyle of people. This includes KW style fairings which comes in two shapes:  The Cone-Egg hybrid and Titan Fairing. It also includes Long March Fairing and Atlas Fairings (which pretty much uses KW interior).
zh: 这里有一些整流罩，能改变人们日常的使用方式。包括两种形状的 KW 风格整流罩：锥头-蛋形混合罩与 Titan 整流罩。还包括长征整流罩和 Atlas 整流罩（基本沿用 KW 的内部结构）。

s: Fast. Just Go Fast. This addon is designed to help Sci-fi enthusiasts to create crafts of their dreams. There is no limit with both an integrated Hyperdrive engine and a inline Hyperdrive inline engine. The mod adds overpowered propulsion systems, ION blocks, high performance reaction wheels and additional miners.
zh: 快。就是要快。这个附加包旨在帮助科幻爱好者打造梦想中的飞行器。无论是内置式超空间引擎还是串联式超空间引擎，都没有限制。该 mod 添加了超规格的推进系统、离子模块、高性能动量轮以及额外的采矿设备。

s: A stock rebalance of the science lab as well as two new lab parts, designed to expand the range of labs that different missions may use, in a stock-alike aesthetic, primarily done with varying the data-to-transmission value per lab.
zh: 对原版科学实验室进行平衡调整，并新增两个实验室部件，旨在拓展不同任务可用的实验室范围，外观保持与原版一致，主要通过为每个实验室设置不同的数据-传输比值来实现。

s: This mod provides a training system (school) for your kerbalnauts by adding a Field Training Facility (FTF) into all science labs. You can train your kerbalnaut(s) over time with space stations and planetary bases.
zh: 该 mod 为你的宇航员提供了一套培训系统（学校），在所有科学实验室中加入现场训练设施（FTF）。你可以利用空间站和行星基地对宇航员进行长期培训。

s: A standalone warp drive mod inspired by Star Trek and RoverDude's Standalone Alcubierre Warp Drive.  The drive requires at least two parts to operate.  The current WIP release contains two modified stock parts as test articles, a test craft, the Phoenix warpship, the Enterprise-era Shuttlepod, and the NX-class starship and it's Refit version, the plugin itself, and the source code.
zh: 一个独立的曲速引擎 mod，灵感来自《星际迷航》和 <<M0>> 的独立 Alcubierre 曲速引擎。该引擎至少需要两个部件才能运作。当前 WIP 版本包含两个作为试验件的改装原版部件、一架试验飞行器、Phoenix 曲速飞船、进取号时代的穿梭舱、NX 级星舰及其改装版、插件本体和源代码。

s: A colonization and production system that encourages building a variety of ship types - space stations, rovers, transports and, of course, landed bases.  It also creates a progression system outside of the science grind.  It includes a very simple life-support system, and so should not be used in mods with life support systems.
zh: 一套殖民与生产系统，鼓励建造多种类型的载具——空间站、漫游车、运输船，当然还有着陆基地。它还提供了一套独立于科学刷取之外的进度系统。其中包含非常简单的生命维持系统，因此不应与其他带生命维持的 mod 一同使用。

s: Adds a working observatory to KSP, alongside the stock science system rather than in place of it. Photograph anything in the sky, from moons to galaxies, through real named telescopes (a PlaneWave astrograph, the VLT, a launchable space telescope) onto real detector models, and get FITS files that calibrate and stack in real astronomy software. Or run an actual exoplanet survey: select a real star from an exoplanet.eu-derived catalog, choose an instrument suited to its brightness and detection method, and extract a signal from simulated, photon-noise-limited data. Includes transit timing variations (TTV), the Rossiter-McLaughlin effect, and a career-mode instrument-acquisition economy. Everything works out of the box; the optional sky data (Gaia star field, dust, galaxies and their images) is downloaded by tools/get_sky_data_compact.py or tools/get_sky_data_complete.py, and is not required.
zh: 为 KSP 添加一座可运作的天文台，与原有科学系统并存，而非取代它。通过真实命名的望远镜（<<M0>> 天体照相仪、VLT、可发射的太空望远镜）拍摄天空中的任何目标，从卫星到星系，成像于真实的探测器模型上，并获得可在真实天文软件中校准与叠加的 FITS 文件。或者进行一次真正的系外行星巡天：从源自 exoplanet.eu 的星表中选取一颗真实恒星，选择适合其亮度和探测方法的仪器，从受光子噪声限制的模拟数据中提取信号。包含凌星时刻变化（TTV）、Rossiter-<<M1>> 效应，以及生涯模式下的仪器采购经济系统。一切开箱即用；可选的星空数据（Gaia 星场、尘埃、星系及其图像）由 tools/get_sky_data_compact.py 或 tools/get_sky_data_complete.py 下载，并非必需。

s: Uses the stock vessel simulator to determine the TWR of each stage, then adjusts the sizes of tanks from Procedural Parts to fit a user-specified TWR. Also sets top and bottom diameters to match attached parts, matches the fuel tank type to the attached engine, and allows the user to change the default texture. All such features can be toggled at the part level with tweakables or at the system level via a button in the stock toolbar.
zh: 使用原版飞行器模拟器计算每一级的 TWR，然后调整 Procedural Parts 油箱的尺寸，以符合用户指定的 TWR。还会将顶部与底部直径设为与相连部件匹配，使油箱类型与相连发动机匹配，并允许用户更改默认贴图。所有这些功能都可以在部件层面通过可调参数开关，或在系统层面通过原版工具栏中的按钮开关。

s: Turn your Kerbal society into a Type 1 Civilization by adding civilian exploration! Your agency as research goes on gains the ability to have civilians take part on your exploration, ultimately letting you recruit new crew members from the population (the motivation for taking civilians with you).
zh: 通过加入平民探索，将你的 Kerbal 社会转变为 I 型文明。随着研究推进，你的航天机构将获得让平民参与探索的能力，最终可以从人口中招募新乘员（这也是携带平民同行的动机）。

s: Add 6 new antennas for CommNet, filling a niche in the transmission ranges: direct 5M, relay 32M, relays 7G and 25G, direct and relay 500G. Also include a plugin, what enhanced antennas info panel in the VAB/SPH.
zh: 为 <<M0>> 添加 6 个新天线，填补传输距离上的空缺：直连 5M、中继 32M、中继 7G 与 25G、直连与中继 500G。另含一个插件，可增强 VAB/SPH 中的天线信息面板。

s: GTIndustries (GTI) have spend their entire budget on R&D. The results are four new products (plugins).  -- GTI MultiModeEnginesFX --  GTI MultiModeEngines -- GTI MultiModeIntakes -- GTI MultiModeConverter
zh: GTIndustries（GTI）将全部预算投入研发，成果是四个新产品（插件）。—— GTI <<M0>> —— GTI <<M1>> —— GTI <<M2>> —— GTI <<M3>>

s: this is a mod that adds an extra RTG which will produce electricity AND Nuclear radiation, where i built fuel tanks for which can contain it, and an extra nuclear engine BUT WARNING!! this RTG will produce insane amounts of heat, so be sure to take radiators with you!
zh: 这个 mod 添加了一种额外 RTG，既发电又产生核辐射，为此我还制作了可容纳它的燃料箱，以及一台额外的核发动机。但请注意：这种 RTG 会产生极高的热量，务必带上散热器。

s: Kerbol System Renewed is a mod that moves around stock celestial bodies to be similar to our solar system, including changing the orbital inclination of planets and eccentricity for a more true to life and challenging experience. In this process i've had the need to implement a new gas giant beyond Jool to better accommodate the already existing celestials bodies.
zh: Kerbol System Renewed 是一个调整原版天体的 mod，使其更接近我们的太阳系，包括修改行星的轨道倾角和偏心率，带来更真实、更具挑战性的体验。在此过程中，我需要在 Jool 之外加入一颗新的气态巨行星，以更好地安置已有的天体。

s: Adds a numeric keypad lock to every command part - probe cores and crewed pods alike. Set a code in the VAB, engage the lock, and the craft will not pitch, roll, yaw, throttle, stage or fire an action group until somebody types the code back in. Crew cannot EVA out, nobody can board in, and the vessel cannot be recovered or terminated without the PIN unless it is parked on a launch pad or runway. One craft has one lock and one PIN however many command parts it carries. The two Aegis buttons stay reachable in the part menu while locked, so a craft can always be opened again. Attached by ModuleManager, so it covers modded command parts as well as stock ones.
zh: 为每个指令部件——探测核心与载人舱皆同——添加数字键盘锁。在 VAB 中设定密码并启用锁定后，在有人重新输入密码之前，飞船不会俯仰、滚转、偏航、调节节流阀、分级或触发动作组。乘员无法 EVA 出舱，任何人无法登船；除非停放在发射台或跑道上，否则没有 PIN 就无法回收或终止飞船。无论飞船装有多少个指令部件，一艘飞船只有一把锁和一个 PIN。锁定期间，部件菜单中的两个 Aegis 按钮仍可使用，因此飞船总能重新解锁。以 <<M0>> 方式挂载，因此原版与 mod 指令部件均适用。

s: This SETI version of the ProbeControlEnabler retains the integrated omni antennas (SETIrebalance) for manned command pods. Probe core integrated omni antennas still do not work (needs changes to RemoteTech, see RemoteTech github issue tracker). It was inspired by the MM config from Felger.
zh: 这个 SETI 版本的 <<M0>> 保留了载人指令舱内置的全向天线（SETIrebalance）。探测核心内置的全向天线仍然无效（需要修改 <<M1>>，参见 <<M1>> 的 GitHub 问题追踪）。其灵感来自 Felger 的 MM 配置。

s: BlueSteel is a small parts mod which adds several parts inspired by the British Avro Z101 Blue Steel concept, designed in 1961. The mod also includes parts to make the Avro 730 / 731 Spyplane concept, planned to replace V-Bomber ~1957.
zh: <<M0>> 是一个小型部件 mod，添加了若干受 1961 年设计的英国 Avro <<M1>> 蓝钢方案启发的部件。该 mod 还包含可用于制作 Avro 730 / 731 侦察机方案的部件，该方案原计划约 1957 年取代 V 型轰炸机。

s: NT Chinese Aerospace Pack or NCAP is a mod created for Kerbal Space Program to add Chinese rockets and spacecraft to the game. So far, this mod including: longmarch 2F, longmarch6, longmarch6A, longmarch7, Chinese Tianhe Space station and Yuanzheng-3.
zh: NT Chinese Aerospace Pack（NCAP）是为 Kerbal Space Program 制作的 mod，为游戏添加中国火箭与航天器。目前包含：长征二号 F、长征六号、<<M0>>、长征七号、中国天和空间站以及远征三号。

s: AsteroidCometCleaner is a simple KSP mod that automatically removes excess untracked asteroids and comets from the game, keeping the number of each under control to reduce save bloat and improve performance. Tracked objects are never deleted.
zh: <<M0>> 是一个简单的 KSP mod，会自动移除游戏中多余的未追踪小行星和彗星，控制各自的数量，以减少存档膨胀并提升性能。已追踪的天体永远不会被删除。

s: This mod is designed to add rings to Dres, just like ksp2, it can also add a Moon（Fres） to Dres (optional), just like Fissure in Afterkerbin, this mod has bugs such as inaccurate lightmaps, is still being tested and does not represent the final version
zh: 此 mod 为 Dres 添加环形，如同 KSP2；还可选择为 Dres 添加一颗卫星（Fres），如同 Afterkerbin 中的 Fissure。该 mod 存在光照贴图不准确等问题，仍在测试中，不代表最终版本。

s: Originally by Exo, this planet pack adds 16 new bodies to the Kerbol system to explore based on real-world asteroids and dwarf planets. Features hand-drawn maps, biomes, and precious, PRECIOUS science.
zh: 本行星包原由 Exo 制作，在 Kerbol 星系中添加了 16 个可供探索的新天体，均基于现实中的小行星与矮行星。特色包括手绘地图、生物群系，以及宝贵的科学。

zh:

必须阅读论坛首页的正确说明：

s: Hides any tech tree nodes that don't have parts. Also reassigns parent node connections so that non-empty nodes have only non-empty parents. To be used with modded tech trees (v0.7 does not yet support the ETT).
zh: 隐藏所有没有部件的科技树节点。同时重新指定父节点连接，使非空节点的父节点也非空。用于 mod 科技树（v0.7 尚不支持 ETT）。

s: Add some drama to your rough landings! Collision FX-ReUpdated adds sparks and dust, with sound and lighting effects when you collide or scrape your craft. Landing gear also has a rubbery screech on contacting the ground!
zh: 为你的粗暴着陆增添戏剧性。Collision FX-<<M0>> 会在飞船碰撞或擦碰时添加火花与尘土，并带有音效和光照效果。起落架触地时还会发出橡胶般的刺耳声。

s: Take Command enhances the External Command Seat so you can now assign crew to it from within the VAB/SPH just like any other command module. Just add one or more command seats to your ship, assign crew as usual, and launch! Your Kerbal crew will automatically spawn and jump into their assigned seats.
zh: Take Command 增强了外部指令座椅，现在你可以像对待其他指令舱一样，在 VAB/SPH 中为其指派乘员。只需在飞船上添加一个或多个指令座椅，照常指派乘员，然后发射。你的 Kerbal 乘员会自动生成并跳入指派的座椅。

s: TR-2PL is the modified version of TR-2L.  Instead of sticking to the car body with surface attachment, now it is nodal stack (the green circle thing).  So the car can travel much faster without worrying it falling apart.
zh: <<M0>> 是 <<M1>> 的修改版。它不再通过表面附着粘在车身上，而是采用节点堆叠（就是那个绿色圆圈）。因此车辆可以行驶得更快，不必担心散架。

s: This mod is designed to allow you to keep any number of notes with a vessel, and also to keep a mission log.  There is an Autolog setting which, when enabled, will have the mod add log entries for specific types of events
zh: 此 mod 让你可以为飞船保存任意数量的笔记，并记录任务日志。其中有一个自动日志设置，启用后 mod 会为特定类型的事件添加日志条目。

s: EXPERIMENTAL: Use at your own risk at this time. This is a SETI config for CustomBarnKit, increasing the number of building upgrade levels and tweaking unlocks (eg action groups available from the start). Especially balanced for SETIrebalance mod pack.
zh: 实验性：目前使用风险自负。这是 <<M0>> 的 SETI 配置，增加了建筑升级等级数量并调整了解锁内容（例如动作组从一开始就可用）。特别针对 SETIrebalance mod 包平衡。

s: This is a very basic mod with one function, to replace the stock KSP displays of times and dates with an approach better suited for RSS players.  This includes things like showing calendar dates rather than awkward formats like 'Year 5, Day 200'.
zh: 这是一个非常基础的 mod，只有一个功能：用更适合 RSS 玩家的方式替换 KSP 原版的时间与日期显示。例如显示日历日期，而不是第 5 年、第 200 天这种别扭格式。

s: A standalone warp drive mod inspired by Star Trek and RoverDude's Standalone Alcubierre Warp Drive.  The drive requires at least two parts to operate.  The current release contains two modified stock parts as test articles, a test craft, the Phoenix warpship, the Enterprise-era Shuttlepod, and the NX-class starship and it's Refit version, the Constitution-class starship with my own little spin, and the Constitution-Refit exactly as it appears in the films, the plugin itself, and the source code.
zh: 受《星际迷航》与 <<M0>> 的 Standalone Alcubierre Warp Drive 启发的独立曲速引擎模组。该引擎至少需要两个部件才能运作。当前版本包含两个作为测试件的原版修改部件、一艘测试飞船、凤凰号曲速飞船、企业号时代的穿梭舱、NX 级星舰及其改装版、带有我个人小幅改动的宪法级星舰，以及与电影中完全一致的宪法级改装版、插件本体和源代码。

s: Kerbal Weather Project - Lite is pared down version of the original weather and climate mod for KSP. In KWP-Lite, weather and climate data from the Model for Prediction Across Scales (MPAS) were incorporated into KSP gameplay. KWP-Lite includes a reduced resolution global Hourly climatology from MPAS allowing players to experience diurnal and spatial variations in atmospheric conditions. In addition, one year of point weather data from MPAS is provided at Kerbin launch sites, allowing players to experience dynamic weather conditions that change daily. KWP-Lite features a text-based GUI showing remote sensing weather data (in space) and in situ weather data (in the atmosphere).
zh: Kerbal Weather Project - Lite 是 KSP 原天气与气候模组的精简版。在 KWP-Lite 中，来自跨尺度预测模型（MPAS）的天气与气候数据被融入 KSP 玩法。KWP-Lite 包含 MPAS 提供的降低分辨率全球逐时气候学数据，让玩家体验大气条件的昼夜与空间变化。此外，Kerbin 发射场还提供 MPAS 为期一年的单点天气数据，让玩家体验逐日变化的动态天气条件。KWP-Lite 提供一个基于文本的 GUI，显示遥感天气数据（太空中）与原位天气数据（大气内）。

s: kRPC allows you to control the game from external programs. It comes with client libraries for several popular languages including Python, C++, C#, Java and Lua. Programs communicate with the game over a TCP/IP connection, and can be configured to work on just the local machine or even over the wider internet.
zh: kRPC 允许你通过外部程序控制游戏。它附带多种流行语言的客户端库，包括 Python、C++、C#、Java 与 Lua。程序通过 TCP/IP 连接与游戏通信，可配置为仅在本地机器上工作，甚至可通过更广泛的互联网工作。

s: System Heat revamps the Core Heat system used in stock KSP to drive drills and harvesters with a new, more powerful system. This core package does not make changes to the base game - install other SystemHeat packs to change drills, converters and the like to use Systemheat
zh: System Heat 重制了原版 KSP 中用于驱动钻头与采集器的核心热系统，以新的更强大系统替代。此核心包不会改动基础游戏——请安装其他 <<M0>> 包，使钻头、转换器及类似部件使用 SystemHeat。

s: This is a salyut mod for the DOS & OPS style stations. It contains fully functional replicas of Salyut 1, 4, 6 and 7. It also now contains Almaz 2, 3 and 5, as well as Soyuz 7K-T, 7K-OKA, 7K-OKP 7K-T-AF and Progress 7K-TG, and Vostok and Voskhod spacecraft, and TKS/VA spacecraft
zh: 这是一个面向 DOS 与 OPS 风格空间站的礼炮号模组。它包含礼炮 1、4、6、7 号的完整功能复制品。现在还包含 Almaz 2、3、5 号，以及联盟 7K-T、7K-OKA、7K-OKP、7K-T-AF 与进步 7K-TG 飞船，东方号与上升号飞船，以及 TKS/VA 飞船。

s: Bi-operational Nuclear Thermal Rocket engine; Clones the Stock LV-N engine and adds an additional mode of operation that uses an oxidizer-injected afterburner for more thrust in atmospheric environments at the expense of a lowered ISP. Special thanks to: Mecripp and sebi.zzr for their help and contribution.
zh: 双模式运作的核热火箭发动机；复制原版 LV-N 发动机，并增加一种额外运作模式，使用注入氧化剂的加力燃烧室，在大气环境中提供更高推力，代价是比冲降低。特别感谢 Mecripp 与 sebi.zzr 的帮助与贡献。

s: OldPartsRevived: An unofficial continuation of the 'OldPartsRedux' and 'Kerbal Historical Institute' mods, made by @TriggeredSnake and @blspblackdeath, respectively.  More parts, more organization, more versions, more nostalgia!
zh: <<M0>>：'OldPartsRedux' 与 'Kerbal Historical Institute' 模组的非官方延续，分别由 @<<M1>> 与 @blspblackdeath 制作。更多部件、更有序的分类、更多版本、更多怀旧感。

s: This mod adds a new PartModule similar to that of Squad's FlagDecal; the PatchDecal.  It works in a similar way to the FlagDecal module with a few extras: It allows you select through multiple images (within the VAB/SPH) in its Asset folder and use one as a mission patch, cool eh?
zh: 此模组新增了一个类似于 Squad 的 <<M1>> 的新 <<M0>>；即 <<M2>>。它的工作方式与 <<M1>> 模块相似，并有一些额外功能：允许在 VAB/SPH 中从 Asset 文件夹的多张图片中选择一张作为任务徽章，很酷吧？

s: KISS is a small plugin for KSP that provides an improved "Save game as..." mechanic while in flight. KISS allows you to overwrite or create a variation of a previous quicksave without the need to memorize quicksave names and without having to type the full name every time!
zh: KISS 是一个小型 KSP 插件，在飞行中提供改进的“另存游戏为……”机制。KISS 允许覆盖先前的快速存档或创建其变体，无需记住快速存档名称，也无需每次输入完整名称。

s:
High quality galaxy skybox, based on Rareden's Real 8k textures.

Images were compressed by NoSyMe using Police Grade Image Compression Software for an 88.6% size reduction with only 1.2% quality loss.  See: http://forum.kerbalspaceprogram.com/index.php?/topic/78778-raredens-real-8k-skybox-for-texture-replacer/&do=findComment&comment=2218500
zh: 高质量银河天空盒，基于 Rareden 的 Real 8k 纹理。图像由 <<M0>> 使用 Police Grade Image Compression Software 压缩，体积减小 88.6%，质量仅损失 1.2%。参见：<<M1>>

s: Installs the handcrafted SOL campaign catalog for Custom Science Contracts. Select this profile only for a game using the SOL planet pack; it references bodies such as Earth, Moon, Mars, Jupiter and Saturn.
zh: 为 Custom Science Contracts 安装手工制作的 SOL 战役目录。仅在使用 SOL 行星包的游戏中选择此配置；它会引用地球、月球、火星、木星和土星等天体。

s: RSSLSE is an addon to RSS & KSCSwitcher that adds just over 200 more launch sites to Earth. All are fictional, all are interesting in their own right. The ones close to the Poles are a bit glitchy; but I kept them anyway for your entertainment. Enjoy!! Drag the RSSLSE folder into GameData to install. Requires RSS & KSCSwitcher
zh: RSSLSE 是 RSS 与 KSCSwitcher 的扩展，为地球新增略多于 200 个发射场。所有发射场均为虚构，且各有其趣味。靠近两极的发射场有些小故障；但我仍保留它们以供娱乐。祝玩得开心。将 RSSLSE 文件夹拖入 <<M0>> 即可安装。需要 RSS 与 KSCSwitcher。

s: I think that a lot of us agree that its the little details in games that make the biggest difference. With that in mind myself and Rob Forrest have set out to make a mod pack with all the little things that you dont see in the game. While this pack is mostly oriented towards an RP that we a part of and as such will feature mostly military related items, we will take requests for non military things as well and will respond to as many as possible. So let us know what you think so far and what you think should be included in the future. Thanks for your support and enjoy!
zh: 我认为很多人都同意，游戏中真正带来最大差别的是那些小细节。有鉴于此，我和 Rob Forrest 开始制作一个包含游戏中你见不到的各种小物件的模组包。虽然此包主要面向我们参与的一个角色扮演项目，因此大多为军事相关物品，但我们也会接受非军事物品的请求，并尽可能多地回应。所以请告诉我们你目前的看法，以及你认为未来应包含什么。感谢支持，祝玩得开心。

s: This is a merged and updated version of the TurboNiso mod Stockalike parts for useful esthetics.  Tags have been added to all parts, errors corrected, some nodes updated.  See the Changelog.txt for all the changes I've made
zh: 这是 <<M0>> 模组“Stockalike 实用美化部件”的合并更新版。已为所有部件添加标签，修正错误，并更新部分节点。我所做的全部改动请参见 <<M1>>。

s: Kerbal Weather Project (KWP) is a groundbreaking weather and climate mod for KSP. In KWP, weather and climate data from the Model for Prediction Across Scales (MPAS) were incorporated into KSP gameplay. KWP includes a global Hourly climatology from MPAS enabling players to experience diurnal and spatial variations in atmospheric conditions. In addition, point weather data from MPAS is provided at Kerbin launch sites, allowing payers to experience dynamic weather conditions that change daily. KWP features a text-based GUI showing remote sensing weather data (in space) and in situ weather data (in the atmosphere).
zh: Kerbal Weather Project (KWP) 是 KSP 的一款开创性天气与气候 mod。KWP 将跨尺度预测模型（MPAS）的天气与气候数据融入 KSP 玩法。KWP 包含来自 MPAS 的全球逐小时气候数据，让玩家体验大气条件的昼夜与空间变化。此外，MPAS 的点位气象数据被提供于 Kerbin 发射场，使玩家体验逐日变化的动态天气条件。KWP 提供基于文本的 GUI，显示遥感气象数据（太空中）与原位气象数据（大气中）。

s: Integrates InterstellarFuelSwitch (as appropriate) into both Stock & Mod Fueltanks. If any of various compatible mods (noted in mod summary) are installed, further integration is applied. Each portion is independent of the others, and each is crafted to avoid conflicts.
zh: 将 <<M0>>（视情况）集成到原版与 mod 燃料箱中。若安装了各种兼容 mod（见 mod 摘要）中的任意一个，则会应用进一步集成。各部分相互独立，且均经过精心设计以避免冲突。

s: WarpShip is an update and expansion of the IXS Enterprise, focusing on updating everything to work properly in the current version of KSP, adding some futuristic functionality while maintaining good integration with stock parts, and creating some new gameplay options but not adding too much complexity to the game.
zh: <<M0>> 是 IXS Enterprise 的更新与扩展，重点在于把所有内容更新至可在当前 KSP 版本中正常运行，加入一些未来风格功能，同时保持与原版部件的良好集成，并创造一些新玩法选项，但不会给游戏增加过多复杂度。

s: Tired of your monopropellant rockets being left out in the sound department? This adds a sound effect when firing RCS engines, varying in pitch and intensity with monopropellant usage. It can be useful to tell just how much SAS is burning through your reserves without even a glance.
zh: 你的单组元推进剂火箭在音效方面被冷落了吗？为 RCS 发动机点火添加音效，音调与强度随单组元推进剂用量变化。无需查看即可判断 SAS 消耗了多少储备。

s: Add 6 new antennas for CommNet, filling a niche in the transmission ranges: direct 5M, relay 32M, relays 7G and 25G, direct and relay 500G. Also include a little plugin, what shows a combinability exponent in the VAB/SPH
zh: 为 <<M0>> 添加 6 根新天线，填补传输距离区间的空白：直连 5M、中继 32M、中继 7G 与 25G、直连与中继 500G。还包含一个小型插件，可在 VAB/SPH 中显示组合指数。

s: PersistentThrust is a plugin that allows propulsion systems to operate during timewarp. The plugin includes a new solar sail part and module that allows a spacecraft to be propelled only by sunlight. It also adds a module with a patch to the stock ion engine that allows engines to thrust during timewarp.
zh: <<M0>> 是一款允许推进系统在时间加速期间运行的插件。该插件包含新的太阳帆部件与模块，使航天器可仅由阳光推进。它还通过补丁为原版离子发动机添加模块，使发动机可在时间加速中产生推力。

s: Technically based on Pawskers Inc, the point of this project will mostly be to add engines and mechanics I want to see in the game, or in my own fashion. So while I will focus on filling gaps with other mods, there will be overlap.
zh: 技术上基于 Pawskers Inc，本项目的主要目的是添加我希望在游戏中看到的发动机与机制，或按我自己的方式实现。因此，虽然我会专注于填补其他 mod 留下的空白，但也会存在重叠。

s: Adds a 'ThermalPaint' resource that you can add to any part by right-clicking the part within the VAB or SPH and using the appropriate slider. Adding more helps with re-entry heating and high-speed atmospheric travel heating, but it does weight quite a lot.
zh: 添加 'ThermalPaint' 资源，可在 VAB 或 SPH 中右键点击任意部件并使用相应滑块来添加。添加更多有助于应对再入加热与高速大气飞行加热，但重量相当大。

s: The first Proton rocket was launched in 1965 and the launch system is still in use as of 2014, which makes it one of the most successful heavy boosters in the history of spaceflight. All Protons previously were built at the Khrunichev plant in Moscow but now OLDD are in action too.
zh: 首枚质子号火箭于 1965 年发射，该发射系统截至 2014 年仍在使用，这使其成为航天史上最成功的重型助推器之一。此前所有质子号均由莫斯科赫鲁尼切夫工厂制造，但现在 OLDD 也参与其中。

s: 200 light years from Earth, a huge ring revolves around its lonely star. The inner surface hosts a biosphere millions of times the area of Earth's, but otherwise similar in its distance to its sun, spin gravity, and even its day-night cycle, thanks to enormous 'shadow squares' selectively blocking the sun. Now you can observe this incredible artifact from your favorite Kerbal vessel!
zh: 距地球 200 光年处，一个巨大的环围绕其孤独的恒星旋转。其内表面承载着面积达地球数百万倍的生物圈，但在与恒星的距离、自转重力甚至昼夜周期方面与地球相似，这得益于巨大的“阴影方块”选择性遮挡恒星。现在你可以从你最喜爱的 Kerbal 航天器上观察这一不可思议的造物。

s: SelectRoot allows you to select a part on your vessel to become the new root part. As if you rebuilt your craft starting with that part. Best used with your favorite subassembly loader!
zh: <<M0>> 可让你选择飞船上的某个部件作为新的根部件，就像以该部件为起点重新搭建飞船一样。最适合配合你喜欢的子装配加载器使用。

s: This mod provides a simple module which lets you have two active animations in the same part working at the same time.
zh: 本 mod 提供一个简单模块，让同一部件中的两个动画同时播放。

s: Add or replace biomes to any celestial body in KSP
zh: 为 KSP 中任意天体添加或替换生态群系

s: Makes docking less crazy, more subtle and challenging
zh: 让对接不再失控，更细腻也更具挑战性

s: ALPHA BUILD. A statics content pack for KERBAL KONSTRUCTS
zh: ALPHA 版本。KERBAL KONSTRUCTS 的静态设施内容包

s: Completely Custom planetary system mod for Kerbal Space Program, adding the new system - The Postverta-Porrima System, located in the Messier 81 galaxy.
zh: 完全自定义的 KSP 行星系 mod，新增 Postverta-Porrima 星系，位于 Messier 81 星系。

s: This mod will bring all of the Chinese Human Spaceflight vehicles to KSP.
zh: 本 mod 将中国载人航天的全部载具带入 KSP。

s: Gameplay mod for RP-1 (KSP/RSS/RO) focussing on reputation and crew members.
zh: 面向 <<M0>>（KSP/RSS/RO）的玩法 mod，专注声望与乘员。

s: Adds motor sound effects to the four stock motorized rover wheels.
zh: 为四个原版有动力漫游车车轮添加电机音效。

s: A planet with a very bumpy surface full of mountains
zh: 一颗表面崎岖、遍布山脉的行星

s: Edit your Curves to Amaze your friends and family.
zh: 编辑你的曲线，让亲友惊叹。

s: Real Exoplanets (REX) is planet pack that adds several confirmed exoplanets into KSP
zh: Real Exoplanets（REX）是一个行星包，为 KSP 添加若干已确认的系外行星

s: Kerbal Checklists is a simple and efficient in-game checklist system for Kerbal Space Program (KSP)
zh: Kerbal Checklists 是为 KSP 提供的简单高效的游戏内检查单系统

s: Allows to search crafts in VAB/SPH by name, add tags to them, archive etc.
zh: 可在 VAB/SPH 中按名称搜索飞行器、为其添加标签、归档等。

s: Spolszczenie Kerbal Space Program 1.3.0 (Alpha 1.27)
zh: KSP 1.3.0 波兰语本地化（Alpha 1.27）

s: A multifunction spacewalk chair to make working in space easier.
zh: 多功能太空行走座椅，让太空作业更轻松。

s: This mod adds the large rocky planet Aphrim and its moons, between Dres and Duna.
zh: 本 mod 在 Dres 与 Duna 之间添加大型岩石行星 Aphrim 及其卫星。

s: This mod is still in development, so there will probably be something that will change in the future
zh: 本 mod 仍在开发中，因此将来可能还会有一些改动

s: This mod can rename the sun to kerbol, okay, that's the synopsis
zh: 本 mod 可以把太阳改名为 Kerbol，好了，简介就是这样

s: ColdJ's stockalike B-52 StratoFortress with an X-15 and a D-21
A library of small functions for use by mods
zh: 供其他 mod 使用的小型函数库

s: Ion Engines in time warp, Atmospheric decay in time warp, simple N-Body dynamics
zh: 时间加速下的离子引擎、时间加速下的大气衰减、简单的 N 体动力学

s: Tired of "Explodium Sea" everywhere?  Add new biomes to our favorite purple planet.
zh: 厌倦了到处都是“Explodium 海”？为我们最爱的紫色行星添加新的生态群系。

s: Adds sound alerts that trigger during dangerous circumstances.
zh: 在危险情况下触发声音警报。

s: Mods that require KSPBurst can run with this alone, but this does not improve performance unless the burst compiler is also installed.
zh: 依赖 KSPBurst 的 mod 可仅靠本项运行，但除非同时安装 burst 编译器，否则性能不会提升。

s: In-Flight Common Action Grouping
zh: 飞行中通用动作组

s: Some basic platform and block assets for off world colonies
zh: 用于地外殖民地的一些基础平台与方块资产

s: Remembers camera mode between scene switches so you will not end up with AUTO every time. (Now under Lisias management)
zh: 在场景切换之间记住相机模式，避免每次都变成 AUTO。（现由 Lisias 维护）

s: Scatterer's default sunflare. If you're not sure which one to pick, pick this.
zh: Scatterer 的默认太阳耀斑。如果你不确定选哪个，就选这个。

s: Want difficult challenges for planes?
zh: 想为飞机寻找高难度挑战？

s: A simple Module Manager config that adds a heat shield and ablator to the Mk1 Command Pod.
zh: 一个简单的 Module Manager 配置，为 Mk1指令舱添加隔热罩和烧蚀剂。

s: This module solves incorrect startup states without fighting stock modules like ModuleAnimateGeneric or ModuleDeployableSolarPanel.
zh: 本模块可解决启动状态不正确的问题，且不会与 <<M0>> 或 <<M1>> 等原版模块冲突。

s: Parts inspired by historical British rockets
zh: 灵感源自英国历史火箭的部件

s: Add Ballast water tanks and compressor to allow you build real-like submarines,use a pre-loaded tank to simulate your payload, and/or change your weight in flight
zh: 添加压载水舱和压缩机，让你建造逼真的潜艇，用预装水舱模拟载荷，或在飞行中改变重量

s: Tech Tree that starts unmanned and progresses realistically through the years.
zh: 从无人起步、随年代逐步推进的真实科技树。

s: Texture pack to provide racial and gender diversity to kerbonauts. Requires TextureReplacer.
zh: 为宇航员提供种族与性别多样性的贴图包。需要 <<M0>>。

s: This package contains a bunch of utility methods for general use to modders.
zh: 本包含有一批供 mod 作者通用的小工具方法。

s: Configurable hotkeys for stock functions that don't have any (Brakes toggle, direct SAS modes), plus AtmosphereAutopilot, MechJeb2 and NavUtilities shortcuts.
zh: 为没有快捷键的原版功能（刹车开关、直接 SAS 模式）提供可配置热键，另有 <<M0>>、<<M1>> 和 <<M2>> 快捷方式。

s: 52 more of the "best" bodies from CharonSSS's amazing RSS-Origin Celestial Pack
zh: <<M0>> 出色的 RSS-Origin Celestial Pack 中另外 52 个“最佳”天体

s: A flag for your craft with an 'S' graphic and a rocket.
zh: 带有“S”图案和火箭的飞船旗帜。

s: Bascily Valor Planet Pack but from me
zh: 基本上就是 Valor Planet Pack，但由我制作

s: A set of configs for SSPX to add TU Recolor compatibility
zh: 为 SSPX 提供的一组配置，添加 TU Recolor 兼容

s: this mod gives you complete control of time in KSP
zh: 本 mod 让你完全掌控 KSP 中的时间

s: An add-on DLC for MoarActionables
zh: <<M0>> 的附加 DLC

s: Tiny mod that changes the cost, mass, thrust etc.  to make the game more realistic.
zh: 小型 mod，调整成本、质量、推力等，让游戏更真实。

s: Appends numbers to any launches after the first
zh: 为首次之后的每次发射追加编号

s: Identifies internals spaces that are connected together within a vessel.
zh: 识别飞船内部相互连通的内部空间。

s: More tweakability for steerable wheels & landing gear.
zh: 为可转向车轮和起落架提供更多可调参数。

s: These are Kerbal versions of NASA rockets. Currently there are almost 200 parts in this pack and they give you a wide range of options.
zh: 这些是 NASA 火箭的 Kerbal 版本。目前这个包里有近 200 个部件，提供丰富的选择。

s: Stockalike Astra Rocket 3.0 Transporter Erector
zh: 原版风格的 Astra Rocket 3.0 运输起竖车

s: Reworked Stock System is a modification that improves stock system by adding new objects and changing terrain of existing ones.
zh: Reworked Stock System 是一个改进原版星系的 mod，添加新天体并改变现有天体的地形。

s: Takes the "Jettison Tank Contents" button from the ore tanks, and adds it to all fuel tanks.
zh: 把矿石储罐上的“抛弃储罐内容物”按钮移植到所有燃料储罐上。

s: New parts for rovers and other ground vehicles.
zh: 用于漫游车及其他地面车辆的新部件。

s: An addon for sorting Kerbals alphabetically.
zh: 按字母顺序排列 Kerbal 的附加组件。

s: 3D informational display of current vessel
zh: 当前飞船的 3D 信息显示

s: Export KSP Flight Data to a CSV file
zh: 将KSP飞行数据导出为CSV文件

s: Red, Green, Blue, and Orange lasers for the Star Wars fans!
zh: 为星球大战粉丝准备的红、绿、蓝、橙四色激光

s: A mod for Kerbal Space Program that adds basic antenna capability to all stock or mod command parts.
zh: 为KSP中所有原版或mod指令部件添加基础天线功能的mod。

s: Waterfall configs for mods that don't have them out of the box
zh: 为未自带Waterfall配置的mod提供配置

s: An alternative UI for Textures Unlimited designed for colouring large numbers of parts simultaneously.
zh: Textures Unlimited的替代UI，可同时为大量部件上色。

s: A continuation of BahamutoD's Vessel Mover.
zh: 延续<<M0>>的Vessel Mover。

s: This is a fan-made MOD. Inspired by the official 20th anniversary plan. This mod includes a Spear of Longinus and a flag of Nerv.
zh: 这是一个粉丝制作的MOD，灵感来自官方20周年企划。包含朗基努斯之枪和Nerv旗帜。

s: A small mod that adds 2.5m, 3.75m, and 5m fairings for Tantares. It needs ModuleManager and TantaresLV.
zh: 为Tantares添加2.5m、3.75m和5m整流罩的小型mod。需要<<M0>>和<<M1>>。

s: Create colonies using KK statics
zh: 使用KK静态模型建造殖民地

s: well it adds kraken attacks and a kerbal workforce
zh: 它添加了海妖攻击和坎巴拉劳动力

s: Small mod that allows Engineers to fix tires and landing gear at any level you want (default 1)
zh: 小型mod，允许工程师在任意等级修理轮胎和起落架（默认1级）

s: x64 aggressive texture compression to DXT1 and DXT5
zh: 对<<M0>>和<<M1>>进行x64激进纹理压缩

s: A collection of +part configs to add missing, or otherwise scaled parts to part mods that don't include them
zh: 一组+part配置，为缺少部件的mod补充缺失或缩放部件

s: A Work-In-Progress set of parts to replace various rocketry art assets with improved models and textures, intended to look at home with the fantastic aircraft assets that Porkjet has created.
zh: 一套仍在开发中的部件，用改进的模型和纹理替换各种火箭美术资源，风格与Porkjet创作的出色飞机资源相统一。

s: This mod adds a new dwarf planet called Pledna, a Kerbal analog to Sedna.
zh: 此mod添加一颗名为Pledna的矮行星，是Sedna的坎巴拉对应体。

s: This is the most comprehensive set of Sigma Dimensions configs available for KSP. Works for stock and all planet packs.

As this happens this mod will simply skip the newly updated mods and only add Inventory to mods that do not natively support it yet.
