s: This plugin will show you the memory usage of the running KSP installation
zh: 此插件会显示当前运行中的 KSP 安装的内存使用情况

s: This mod adds a basic Space Centre and a Landing pad for you to land on.
zh: 本 mod 添加一个基础航天中心和一座可供着陆的着陆台。

s: Additional relay antennas for Kerbal Space Program
zh: 为 Kerbal Space Program 添加的中继天线

s: This mod changes the color of Eve to make it more similar to Venus.
zh: 本 mod 改变 Eve 的颜色，使其更接近金星。

s: This mod adds many new surprises, requires Kopernicus as it also is a planet pack. Other than that, it is completely standalone. For KSP 1.7. Is also a planet pack.
zh: 本 mod 添加许多新惊喜，由于它同时也是一个星球包，需要 Kopernicus。除此之外完全独立。适用于 KSP 1.7。它同时也是一个星球包。

s: This is a branch of BDArmory with multiplayer support based on LMP.
zh: 这是 BDArmory 的一个分支，基于 LMP 提供多人游戏支持。

s: A re-imagining of the stock R.A.P.I.E.R. engine, with brand new art to match Porkjets fantastic style. It's a separate part from the stock version, but it has the same stats and is the same size.
zh: 对原版 R.A.P.I.E.R. 发动机的重新演绎，全新美术贴合 Porkjet 的出色风格。它是与原版分离的独立部件，但属性与尺寸相同。

s: This pack includes early Soviet probes such as Sputnik, Luna, Molniya and Polyot. Probes are meant to be used with my Soviet Rockets pack.
zh: 此包包含早期苏联探测器，如 Sputnik、Luna、Molniya 和 Polyot。探测器设计为与我的苏联火箭包配合使用。

s: Mod to automatically move fuel between tanks to return the Center of Mass to a preset position for that your vessel is perfectly balanced for RCS operations, or any other reason
zh: 该 mod 可自动在油箱之间转移燃料，将质心恢复到预设位置，使飞船在 RCS 操作或任何其他用途下保持完美平衡

s: This mod allows to process ore and xenon gas to the new resource "Iridium", which is very expensive. You can recover the vessel with Iridium, therefore Earn Money.
zh: 该 mod 可将矿石和氙气加工为新的资源“铱”，其价值非常高。你可以回收载有铱的飞船，从而赚取资金。

s: Shared library required by JPLRepo's mods
zh: JPLRepo 的 mod 所需的共享库

s: KerbalFX module for atmospheric ribbon condensation trails.
zh: 用于大气中带状凝结尾迹的 <<M0>> 模块。

s: A canal that links the oceans and allows naval circumnavigation of stock Kerbin
zh: 一条连接各海洋的运河，使原版 Kerbin 可以乘船环球航行

s: Preview the future of Kerbal kind
zh: 预览 Kerbal 种族的未来

s: Used and Refurbished Parts;  it's not old, it's a classic
zh: 二手与翻新部件；不是老旧，而是经典

s: This mod aims to expand the stock kerbol system with 2 more gas giants and lots of moons.
zh: 该 mod 旨在为原版 Kerbol 星系增添 2 颗气态巨行星和众多卫星。

s: Set of 3.75m parts that mimic MKS parts using models from SSPX.
zh: 一套 3.75m 部件，使用 SSPX 的模型模仿 MKS 部件。

s: Classic version of the kOS scriptable autopilot system.
zh: kOS 可编程自动驾驶系统的经典版本。

s: A joint release between Kartoffelkuchen and Raidernick combining our Cygnus and Antares mods.
zh: Kartoffelkuchen 与 Raidernick 的联合发布，整合了我们的 Cygnus 与 Antares mod。

s: Official Flag of the Rubber Duck Empire
zh: 橡皮鸭帝国的官方旗帜

s: Fixes and modifications for the Kerbal Space Program mod MRKI.
zh: 针对 KSP mod MRKI 的修复与修改。

s: Delete/Prune/Disable all MiniAVC
zh: 删除/清理/禁用所有 <<M0>>

s: Provides several new and exciting nuclear engines to use in your game in many size classes and technologies, such as gas-core reactors, nuclear aerospikes and multimode engines.
zh: 提供多种尺寸级别与技术的全新核发动机，如气芯反应堆、核气尖发动机和多模式发动机，供你在游戏中使用。

s: This System Heat config package changes zero boiloff cryogenic tanks to need cooling instead of power. WARNING: potentially vessel-breaking.
zh: 此 System Heat 配置包将零蒸发低温贮箱改为需要冷却而非供电。警告：可能导致飞船损坏。

s: Does the Rocket Equation annoy you ? Well this mod is made for you !
zh: 火箭方程让你烦恼吗？那么这个 mod 正适合你。

s: Make Map View a little more friendly.
zh: 让地图视图更友好一些。

s: A BDArmory addon, replicas of WWII naval & anti-naval weapons.
zh: BDArmory 扩展，二战海军及反舰武器的复刻。

s: Stationary/flyby camera, atmospheric audio effects, and more
zh: 固定/飞掠镜头、大气音效等

s: Adds parts inspired by NASA's Artemis missions including Orion & SLS Block 1 and 1B
zh: 添加受 NASA Artemis 任务启发的部件，包括 Orion 与 SLS Block 1 和 1B

s: Additional payment for a simulation, and planing is required before a real launch. A simplified KRASH and Kerbal Construction Time alike. No new GUI - used Kerbal Alarm Clock timers
zh: 模拟需额外付费，真实发射前需要规划。简化版 KRASH 与 Kerbal Construction Time 类功能。无新 GUI——使用 Kerbal Alarm Clock 计时器

s: Realistic mining chains for mod fuels. Electrolysis, Sabatier and more
zh: 针对 mod 燃料的真实开采链。电解、Sabatier 反应等

s: Agency folders shared by multiple SDHI-branded add-ons for Kerbal Space Program
zh: 多个 SDHI 品牌扩展共用的机构文件夹

s: Japris Stellar Neighborhood is a mod that mixes up the stock system and as of version 0.0 adds 2 star systems.
zh: Japris Stellar Neighborhood 是一个重新混合原版星系的 mod，自 0.0 版本起新增 2 个恒星系。

s: Allows unkerballed spacecraft to perform surface sampling experiments at comets and asteroids
zh: 允许无人飞船在彗星和小行星上进行表面采样实验

s: Create configs for parts which don't have ModuleCargoPart
zh: 为没有 <<M0>> 的部件创建配置

s: A collection of modules, agencies, flags, and resources for mod makers to use.
zh: 供 mod 制作者使用的一套模块、机构、旗帜和资源集合。

s: Replicas of various modern small real-life rockets
zh: 多种现代小型现实火箭的复刻

s: Engines that chug on the heat from any nearby compatible reactor and offer amazing thrust
zh: 利用附近兼容反应堆热量运转的发动机，可提供惊人的推力

s: Kip Engeneering Non-Androgynous Docking Port Set is an early set of docking ports that only work with the opposite gender and only when aligned.
zh: Kip Engeneering 非雌雄同体对接口套件是一套早期对接口，只能与相反类型的对接口对接，且必须对齐。

s: A continuation of the KSP story...launch from an unforgivingly cold world to explore a massive new solar system and uncover the secrets of the Precursor civilization.
zh: KSP 故事的延续……从一个严寒无情的世界发射，探索庞大的新恒星系，揭开先驱者文明的秘密。

s: MusicMute recompiled for KSP 1.1+
zh: 为 KSP 1.1+ 重新编译的 <<M0>>

s: Remake of SWE. (Srb Waterfall Effects)
zh: SWE（固体助推器 Waterfall 效果）的重制版

s: Adds some parts and Other Useless Crap, some of which are tiny
zh: 添加一些部件和其他无用杂物，其中部分很小

s: A larger pod, using a 2.5m top and 3.75m bottom, for larger craft.
zh: 更大的乘员舱，顶部 2.5m、底部 3.75m，适用于大型飞船。

s: A Custom Barn Kit config addon that increases Kerbal Space Center building levels to ten levels instead of the stock game's four. For Kerbal Space Program. Doesn't add more building models.
zh: Custom Barn Kit 配置扩展，将 KSC 建筑等级提升至十级，而非原版的四级。不新增建筑模型。

s: Puts Galileo's Planet Pack around the stock solar system
zh: 将 Galileo's Planet Pack 置于原版恒星系周围

s: A set of radially attached mounting points for increased flexibility with stack-only parts.  Including decoupling and fuel crossfeed functionality.
zh: 一组径向安装点，让仅限堆叠的部件更具灵活性。包含分离与燃料交叉供给功能。

s: Play a solo or cooperative randomized version of one or more supported games
zh: 以单人或多人的随机化方式游玩一个或多个受支持的游戏

s: Fancy nuclear engines for fun and profit
zh: 有趣又赚钱的精美核发动机

s: This mod converts all the stock fuel tanks and resource containers so that you can change the resource(s) they hold in Editor and in Flight.
zh: 该 mod 转换所有原版油箱和资源容器，使你能在编辑器和飞行中更改它们所装的资源。

s: Plays an animation when a part is staged
zh: 部件分级时播放动画

s: It's a tube.. and a hull... and a cargo bay... and a.. well, just about everything. And it is only 2 PARTS!!!
zh: 它是管道……也是船体……还是货舱……几乎什么都是。而且只有 2 个部件！

s: A Kerbal version of a F-104 Starfighter
zh: Kerbal 版的 <<M0>> 星际战斗机

s: My version of the Bubble Ship from the movie Oblivion. Now also the Drone and the Bike.
zh: 我制作的《遗落战境》电影中的泡泡飞船。现在还包括无人机和摩托。

s: Adding  ignitors service to engines. With additional resources needing to be ignited
zh: 为发动机添加点火器服务。需要额外的资源才能点火。

s: CONTARES (Version 1.8.8 shaken and not stirred)
zh: CONTARES（1.8.8 版，摇匀不搅拌）

s: This is a blue tufx config that works on most planets
zh: 这是一个蓝色 TUFX 配置，适用于大多数行星。

s: Kerbal personalisation, IVA suits on Kerbin and texture replacement and improvements.
zh: 坎巴拉人个性化、Kerbin 上的 IVA 航天服，以及贴图替换与改进。

s: Telescope, habs and more to come
zh: 望远镜、居住舱以及更多内容敬请期待。

s: ROCapsules is a mod that takes the best versions of capsules available and uses them as the in-game models for Realism Overhaul parts.
zh: ROCapsules 是一个 mod，它采用现有最佳版本的太空舱，并将其作为 Realism Overhaul 部件的游戏内模型。

s: Provide a means to purchase fuel in orbit
zh: 提供在轨购买燃料的途径。

s: Allows you to remove asteroid mass and attach multiple reconfigurable storage tanks to the asteroid's surface.
zh: 允许你移除小行星质量，并将多个可重构贮箱安装到小行星表面。

s: Simple craft building capability in flight mode
zh: 在飞行模式下进行简单的飞行器建造。

s: Contains 107 flight contract missions from KSC to bases in the Kerbin Side Remastered mod.  Please check the README.md for dependencies
zh: 包含 107 个从 KSC 飞往 Kerbin Side Remastered mod 中各基地的飞行合同任务。请查看 README.md 了解依赖项。

s: Your kerbals will occasionally move seats to other seats in the craft
zh: 你的坎巴拉人会偶尔在飞行器内换到其他座位。

s: In-game scripting mod for KSP with Repl/Editor/Intellisense. Two scripting languages implemented: Lua and a custom JS/Ruby-like language.
zh: KSP 的游戏内脚本 mod，带有 Repl/编辑器/智能提示。实现了两种脚本语言：Lua 和一种类似 JS/Ruby 的自定义语言。

s: Dynamic, physics-inspired wingtip vortices that respond to aircraft behavior in flight.
zh: 动态的、受物理启发的翼尖涡流，会响应飞行中的飞机行为。

s: Adds docking targets and cameras for precision visual docking alignment
zh: 为精确的目视对接对准添加对接目标和摄像机。

s: Adds the Asteroid 33434 scottmanley to KSP. This is the real solar system edition
zh: 向 KSP 添加小行星 33434 scottmanley。这是真实太阳系版本。

s: The Hawker Sidley VTOL Harrier in Marines Colors
zh: 涂装为海军陆战队配色的 Hawker Siddeley VTOL Harrier。

s: Revamps Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus and Neptune with new 16k textures and independent bands
zh: 以新的 16k 贴图和独立条带重制木星、土星、天王星和海王星。

s: For the basic version of NathanKell's Real Solar System mod
zh: 用于 <<M0>> 的 Real Solar System mod 基础版本。

s: Antennas consume EC for supporting CommNet: EC is consumed always when extended; add new action: disable/enable static antennas - EC is consumed always when enabled.
zh: 天线为支持 <<M0>> 而消耗 EC：展开时始终消耗 EC；新增动作：禁用/启用固定天线——启用时始终消耗 EC。

s: First part of better dres, adds two cool rings
zh: 改进 Dres 的第一部分，添加两个漂亮的环形。

s: Spolszczenie Kerbal Space Program
zh: Kerbal Space Program 的波兰语本地化。

s: A modular, stackable, serviceable, & customizable satellite in a box!
zh: 一个模块化、可堆叠、可维护且可定制的盒装卫星！

s: The "best" 26 bodies CharonSSS's amazing RSS-Origin Celestial Pack
zh: <<M0>> 的精彩 RSS-Origin Celestial Pack 中“最佳”的 26 个天体。

s: A simple addon to display, store, and organize onscreen messages
zh: 一个简单的插件，用于显示、存储和整理屏幕消息。

s: Airplane parts for you to experiment with! From elevons to Open Rotor Turboprop engines, to even Nuclear Aerospikes!
zh: 供你实验的飞机部件！从升降副翼到开放式转子涡桨发动机，甚至还有核动力气尖发动机！

s: Live visual rig editor for EVA and IVA Kerbals in Kerbal Space Program
zh: 用于在 Kerbal Space Program 中实时编辑 EVA 和 IVA 坎巴拉人视觉骨架的工具。

s: Custom biomes data for the stock Kerbol system
zh: 原版 Kerbol 星系的定制生态区数据。

s: Quality of life patches designed alongside the OPX suite of mods
zh: 与 OPX 系列 mod 一同设计的体验优化补丁。

s: Adds maintenance missions to your Space Stations
zh: 为你的空间站添加维护任务。

s: A Renaming mod for some of your favorite Stock (and Modded!) parts to be like they were in KSP2!
zh: 一个重命名 mod，可让你喜爱的一些原版（以及 mod！）部件恢复成 <<M0>> 中的样子！

s: Inspired by shows and movies like Space: 1999 and Moon; the parts are big, boxy and in space (providing you get them out the atmosphere. You might want something like Extraplanetary launchpads)
zh: 灵感来自《太空：1999》和《月球》等影视作品；部件巨大、方正，且用于太空（前提是你得把它们送出大气层。你可能需要类似 Extraplanetary Launchpads 的东西）。

s: With this mod board key "B" works as a toggle. Once airlock or command seat reached your kerbal will automatically go in.
zh: 使用此 mod，按键“B”可作为开关。一旦到达气闸或指令座椅，你的坎巴拉人就会自动进入。

s: Rebalance the stock antennas to make relay antennas and networks required.
zh: 重新平衡原版天线，使中继天线和中继网络成为必需。

s: Dynamic CCTV system compatible with KAS
zh: 兼容 KAS 的动态 CCTV 系统。

s: Part pack to facilitate the building of permanent bases
zh: 便于建造永久基地的部件包。

s: A heavy-lift spaceplane fuselage designed to carry 2.5m parts
zh: 一种重型空天飞机机身，设计用于运载 2.5m 部件。

s: [ALPHA, BUGGY] A mod designed to add rings and moons to Neidon. (REQUIRES OPM)
zh: [ALPHA，有缺陷] 一个旨在为 Neidon 添加行星环和卫星的 mod。（需要 OPM）

s: System replacer and interstellar additions mod
zh: 星系替换与星际内容添加 mod。

s: A fork of [censored] Labs by _Augustus_ that removes all mention of [censored].
zh: 由 _Augustus_ 制作的 [已屏蔽] Labs 分支，移除了所有对 [已屏蔽] 的提及。

s: Kerbal Konstructs bases and client config for the Promised Worlds LMP server
zh: 用于 Promised Worlds LMP 服务器的 Kerbal Konstructs 基地和客户端配置。

s: Eve got it's share, why not Duna?
zh: Eve 都得到了它的份额，为什么 Duna 不行？

s: Beautiful Saturn-like gas giant for the Kerbol System with a Stock feel
zh: 为 Kerbol 星系添加具有原版风格的美丽类土星气态巨行星。

s: Additional files for Lazarus beyond GitHub's 2 GiB release asset limit
zh: Lazarus 的附加文件，超出 <<M0>> 的 2 GiB 发布资源限制。

s: Based on the proposal for Mars Direct. Extraplanetary lander and parts pack.
zh: 基于火星直击（Mars Direct）提案。行星际着陆器和部件包。

s: Create new bases and launch sites in KSP!
zh: 在 KSP 中创建新的基地和发射场！

s: Addon for Spectra. Adds Scatterer config to Minmus, replacing the default glow.
zh: Spectra 的附加组件。为 Minmus 添加 Scatterer 配置，替换默认辉光。

s: Makes Kerbals use Monopropellant for EVA fuel, meaning no more infinite EVA fuel.
zh: 让坎巴拉人使用单组元推进剂作为 EVA 燃料，意味着不再有无限的 EVA 燃料。

s: IVA portion of Starship Expansion Project
zh: Starship Expansion Project 的 IVA 部分。

s: A new tech tree, less grind, and more challenge.
zh: 全新的科技树，更少的重复劳动，更多的挑战。

s: This mod adds in a blue gas giant just past Duna with three moons and rings
zh: 此 mod 在 Duna 之外添加一颗带三颗卫星和行星环的蓝色气态巨行星。

s: The PEBKAC Industries LES (PKI-LES) is designed to more or less simulate the Apollo and Mercury LES's used in real life
zh: PEBKAC Industries LES（PKI-LES）旨在或多或少模拟现实中使用的阿波罗和水星逃生系统。

s: A simple mod to prevent accidental EVAs with some configurable options.
zh: 一个简单的 mod，通过若干可配置选项防止意外 EVA。

s: A plethora of new station parts in several size classes.
zh: 大量新空间站部件，涵盖多个尺寸级别。

s: Change all Convert-o-tron to the same setup. Base is one Unit ore, from one unit ore u get 2 LF, 2 Ox, 2.5 Mono or 5000 Xenon.
zh: 将所有转换器（Convert-o-tron）改为相同配置。基础消耗为 1 单位矿石，从 1 单位矿石可获得 2 LF、2 Ox、2.5 Mono 或 5000 氙气。

s: Replaces the stock system with a dying system that takes place in the early universe
zh: 将原版星系替换为一个发生在早期宇宙的垂死星系。

s: Adds Post-Apollo "Space Tug" parts from the Integrated Program Plan. Works well alongside Bluedog Design Bureau.
zh: 添加来自综合计划（Integrated Program Plan）的后阿波罗"太空拖船"部件。与 Bluedog Design Bureau 搭配良好。

s: Approach controller add-on module for KSP AtmosphereAutopilot
zh: 为 KSP <<M0>> 提供的接近控制器附加模块

s: A collection of Brazilian flags
zh: 一组巴西国旗

s: A compilation of parts to make user friendly, easy to use Space Shuttles.
zh: 一套部件合集，用于组装用户友好、易于操作的航天飞机。

s: This is a tool for﻿ those video makers who want just a bit more camera﻿ movement and orientation control﻿
zh: 这是一款为视频创作者打造的工具，可提供更多相机移动与朝向控制。

s: Take high resolution screenshots
zh: 拍摄高分辨率截图

s: Boxed parts designed to cluster easily like in RTS games and provide massive power and cooling for your colonies
zh: 箱式部件，便于像 RTS 游戏那样集群布置，为你的殖民地提供强大的电力与散热。

s: Lets you drag the navball somewhere more convenient.
zh: 可将导航球拖动到更方便的位置。

s: This mod modifies the Pathfinder mod to use the USI-LS mod for life support
zh: 此 mod 修改 Pathfinder，使其使用 USI-LS 提供生命保障。

s: Shiny Retro Cyber. A collection of Shiny things.
zh: 闪亮的复古赛博风格。一组闪亮之物。

s: A config only mod that lets you do everything under water you can do on land and more. 1.12.1 compat version slightly heavier.
zh: 纯配置 mod，让你在水下也能做到陆地上能做的一切乃至更多。1.12.1 兼容版本体积稍大。

s: A selection of Military Vehicle Chassis to aid construction.
zh: 精选军用车辆底盘，助力建造。

s: Automatically scale tanks from Procedural Parts to fit a specified TWR
zh: 自动缩放 Procedural Parts 的贮箱以匹配指定的 TWR

s: Robotic parts for your constructions
zh: 用于建造的机械部件

s: Actual Sites: Airports adds real runway locations to Real Solar System
zh: Actual Sites: Airports 为 Real Solar System 添加真实跑道位置

s: A pack of select parts for your aircrafting needs, including propellers, helicopter rotors, and more!
zh: 精选部件包，满足你的航空需求，包括螺旋桨、直升机旋翼等。

s: This add-on for the formidable "Chatterer" mod by Athlonic will currently add 510 new kerbalized chatter-files for your hearing pleasure.
zh: 这款附加包为 Athlonic 的强大 "Chatterer" mod 制作，目前会添加 510 个新的坎巴拉化闲聊音频文件，供你聆听。

s: This pack is made to expand on both stock-a-like and popular modded spaceplane parts!
zh: 此包旨在扩充原版风格与流行 mod 的航天飞机部件。

s: A Static of a 9 story Car Park with a spiral ramp.
zh: 一个九层螺旋坡道停车场的静态模型。

s: New bodies with heritage in MPE Revived and Outer Planets Expansion, now as their own optional pack.
zh: 源自 MPE Revived 与 Outer Planets Expansion 的新天体，现作为独立可选包。

s: Precise Maneuver (PM) plugin provides a window for more precise maneuver node editing.

s: Get out of your seat in IVA and float around your ship
zh: 在IVA中离开座位，在飞船内自由漂浮。

s: Outer Planets Expansion's additions and modifications to the trans-neidonian objects
zh: Outer Planets Expansion 对跨 Neidon 天体的新增与修改。

s: [OBSOLETED] Small cfg tweak to make stock rover wheels 3 times tougher. If you're tired of your stock rover wheels breaking every time it rolls over a pebble, then you'll love this mod!
zh: [已废弃] 一个小型 cfg 调整，让原版巡视器车轮的耐久度提升至三倍。如果你已厌倦原版车轮每次碾过小石子就损坏，那你会喜欢这个 mod。

s: An upgrade to Airplanes Plus that adds support for waterfall plumes on the afterburning jet engines in the mod.
zh: Airplanes Plus 的升级，为该 mod 中带加力的喷气发动机添加 Waterfall 尾焰支持。

s: Lite Blue reduces the number available templates and resources used. This is great for players new to Pathfinder and other WildBlue mods or for those that don't want a lot of complexity.
zh: Lite Blue 减少了可用模板数量与资源占用。非常适合 Pathfinder 及其他 <<M0>> mod 的新手，或不想太复杂的玩家。

s: A planet pack full of strange objects and alien surfaces. (THIS IS ONLY THE CONFIGS, SEE DESCRIPTION)
zh: 充满奇异天体与异星地表的行星包。（仅包含配置文件，详见说明）

s: Aurora Space Center is a mod that adds IRL/fictives buildings and launchpads!
zh: Aurora Space Center 是一个添加现实与虚构建筑及发射台的 mod。

s: This add a vapor vent mod using the RealPlume and SmokeScreen mod for visual effects.
zh: 该 mod 添加蒸汽排放口，使用 <<M0>> 与 <<M1>> mod 实现视觉效果。

s: A simple mod that deadens the game's audio as your ship goes into vacuum.
zh: 一个简单的 mod，在飞船进入真空时削弱游戏音频。

s: Manage action groups in flight
zh: 在飞行中管理动作组

s: Haystack ReContinued — Now you can find that lost ship you were looking for!
zh: Haystack <<M0>> —— 现在你可以找到那艘一直在找的失踪飞船了。

s: Allows the use of tiny attachment nodes in the VAB/SPH for easier snapping in situations where multiple larger nodes overlap.
zh: 允许在VAB/SPH中使用微型连接节点，在多个较大节点重叠时更易对接。

s: Engine ignition and throttles now work like real engines
zh: 发动机点火与节流阀现在如同真实发动机。

s: Fixes to Kerbal Space Program's Patched Conic Solver fixing encounter bugs
zh: 修复KSP拼接圆锥曲线求解器中的遭遇错误。

s: Grannus Expansion Pack as a primary star system, with Grannus as the central star and Nodens the home world
zh: 将 Grannus Expansion Pack 作为主星系，Grannus 为中心恒星，Nodens 为母星。

s: Wheel Tuner is a development/diagnostics utility for Kerbal Space Program 1.12.5 that lets you inspect and (optionally) tune wheel/landing-gear module values at runtime
zh: Wheel Tuner 是面向KSP 1.12.5的开发/诊断工具，可在运行时检查并（可选地）调整车轮/起落架模块数值。

s: Artemis Additions adds some of the most important SLS and Orion cameras to the Artemis Construction Kit mod.
zh: Artemis Additions 为 Artemis Construction Kit mod 添加若干最重要的 SLS 与 Orion 摄像机。

s: Re-Upload From Github (Author Himself)
zh: 从 GitHub 重新上传（作者本人）

s: moves fuel cells to earlier nodes
zh: 将燃料电池移至更早的科技节点。

s: Cruesoe Space Industries Tech Tree [WIP] - Unmanned before Manned Tech Tree, with [hopefully) logical progression.
zh: Cruesoe Space Industries 科技树 [开发中] —— 无人先于载人科技树，具有（希望如此）合理的进程。

s: This parts pack contains engines, tanks, and other part categories in three sizes that do not exist in stock KSP, namely 5m, 7.5m, and 10m.
zh: 该部件包包含原版KSP中不存在的三种尺寸——5m、7.5m 和 10m——的发动机、燃料箱及其他部件类别。

s: Adds the Delta II, III and IV rockets into the game, featuring highly detailed models and textures.
zh: 将德尔塔 II、III 和 IV 运载火箭加入游戏，拥有高细节模型与贴图。

s: Advanced Landing Capsule for Orbital Rendezvous by ASET
zh: ASET 出品的高级着陆舱，用于轨道交会。

s: An improved version of the stock maneuver node tool.
zh: 原版机动节点工具的改进版。

s: This pack is for the modders who create IVA’s for the aircrafts.
zh: 该包面向为飞行器制作IVA的 mod 作者。

s: A set of 1.875m parts to fill the gap between the basic and Rockomax size parts
zh: 一套 1.875m 部件，填补基础尺寸与 Rockomax 尺寸部件之间的空白

s: a common resource for several BD Armory addons
zh: 若干 BD Armory 附加组件共用的资源

s: Official GitHub of Exo's Minor Planets Expansion, where indev features and full builds can be found
zh: Exo's Minor Planets Expansion 的官方 <<M0>>，可获取开发中功能与完整构建

s: The common agency and flag files used by DKSalvage mods
zh: DKSalvage 系列 mod 共用的机构与旗帜文件

s: Realtime engine balancing, precise hovering control and VTOL autopiloting.
zh: 实时发动机平衡、精确悬停控制与 VTOL 自动驾驶。

s: In-game patch manager, makes adding/removing patches more friendly.
zh: 游戏内补丁管理器，让添加或移除补丁更方便。

s: Kronkus - A Kopernicus planet pack
zh: Kronkus——一个 Kopernicus 行星包

s: CONTARES (Version 1.8.7 Stars and stripes: comeback of manned space travel)
zh: CONTARES（1.8.7 版 星条旗：载人航天的回归）

s: Cargo parts, that can be placed inside Inventories in deflated state, and in the inflated state they are Inventories themselves, where other parts could be placed. Depends on SSPX
zh: 货舱部件，未充气状态可放入库存格中，充气后自身即为库存格，可放置其他部件。依赖 SSPX

s: A set of fuel tanks for containing Liquid Hydrogen. Also adds Liquid Hydrogen storage to most stock tanks
zh: 一组用于储存液氢的燃料罐。同时为多数原版燃料罐添加液氢储存

s: A (re)stockalike Dragonfly Quad-copter
zh: 一款（重制）原版风格的 Dragonfly 四旋翼飞行器

s: This mod adds the Black Arrow rocket and Prospero satellite. It is an update from The Barbed Wire's British rockets mod on Curse which is not compatible with 1.1.3.
zh: 本 mod 添加黑箭号火箭与 Prospero 卫星。它是 The Barbed Wire 在 Curse 上的英国火箭 mod 的更新版本，后者与 1.1.3 不兼容。

s: Lets you drag the altimeter somewhere more convenient
zh: 可将高度表拖到更方便的位置

s: Continuation of the QuizTech Aero Pack
zh: <<M0>> Aero Pack 的续作

s: Sol Textures for various Launchsites around Earth.
zh: 用于地球各地发射场的 Sol 纹理。

s: Probe body the way you want it.
zh: 按你想要的方式打造探测器主体。

s: Astrogator functionality in kOS.
zh: 在 kOS 中实现 Astrogator 功能。

s: Add MechJeb to all Command modules - if you want not to go to the R&D to unlock modules, they'll be enabled from the start
zh: 为所有指令舱添加 <<M0>>——若不想去 R&D 解锁模块，它们将在开局即启用

s: A huge and challenging tech tree. 204 technologies.
zh: 巨大且富有挑战性的科技树。204 项科技。

s: This mod adds code to display an unused stock particle effect for reentry, featuring a plasma trail and sparks.
zh: 本 mod 添加代码以显示原版未使用的再入粒子效果，包含等离子尾迹与火花。

s: Addon for Spectra. Adds Scatterer config to make Jool glow faintly on Laythe's atmosphere.
zh: Spectra 的附加组件。添加 Scatterer 配置，使 Jool 在 Laythe 大气层中发出微光。

s: MM configs to restock/procedural tanks for real-ish rockets
zh: 用于拟真火箭的 MM 配置，提供 ReStock 风格及程序化燃料罐

s: This project is on hold and was not updated until KSP 0.20 but still works and looks awsome
zh: 该项目已暂停，直到 KSP 0.20 都未更新，但仍可运行且外观出色

s: ScreenMessageHider is a mod that hides screen messages that don't normally get hidden, like time warp notifications, when you hide the UI with F2
zh: <<M0>> 是一个 mod，在用 F2 隐藏界面时，隐藏通常不会被隐藏的屏幕消息，例如时间加速提示

s: Soylent closes the life support cycle with an alagal microbiome - works with TAC & USI life support if they are installed.
zh: Soylent 通过藻类微生物组闭合生命保障循环——若安装了 TAC 与 USI 生命保障则兼容。

s: Modular note-taking GUI for mission planning and science tracking
zh: 用于任务规划与科学追踪的模块化笔记界面

s: BD Armory addon currently containing weapons made by Denel Dynamics and Denel Land Systems in South Africa.
zh: BD Armory 附加组件，目前包含南非 Denel Dynamics 与 Denel Land Systems 制造的武器。

s: SCANsat: Real Scanning, Real Science, Warp Speed!
zh: SCANsat：真实扫描，真实科学，加速倍率！

s: Wide-body, massive spaceplane fuselage including advanced engines
zh: 宽体大型航天飞机机体，含先进发动机

s: Draft (or rescue) your twitch viewers as in-game Kerbals!
zh: 将你的 Twitch 观众招募（或营救）为游戏内 Kerbal。

s: Kreate Kerbals in game, without any koding knowledge. (I spelled it with a 'k' for a reason)
zh: 无需任何编程知识即可在游戏内创建 Kerbal。（我用 K 拼写是有原因的）

s: A simple mod that toggles the game's music with a hotkey.
zh: 用热键切换游戏音乐的简易 mod。

s: A tech tree with more freedom and accessibility
zh: 更自由、更易上手的科技树

s: Small portable N.O.M.S. package
zh: 小型便携式 N.O.M.S. 套件

s: A modular patch suite that expands and enhances Kerbalism's realism, while integrating it more smoothly with other popular mods.
zh: 模块化补丁套件，扩展并增强 Kerbalism 的真实性，同时使其与其他热门 mod 更顺畅地整合。

s: Revamps Tylo and it's surface textures, and it's gravity!
zh: 重制 Tylo 及其表面纹理与重力。

s: Enables fuel switching and Kerbalism radioactivity in supported NTRs. Enables supported NTJs to have Kerbalism radioactivity and the features expected of a nuclear reactor
zh: 为支持的 NTR 启用燃料切换与 Kerbalism 放射性。使支持的 NTJ 具备 Kerbalism 放射性以及核反应堆应有的特性

s: Add launch sites on real airports locations (for Real Solar System & KSC Switcher)
zh: 在真实机场位置添加发射场（适用于 Real Solar System 与 KSC Switcher）

s: Overhaul of the stock Satellite contracts
zh: 全面重制原版卫星合同

s: A pack of ReStockalike solid kick motors.
zh: 一组 <<M0>> 固体助推发动机。

s: A series of nine rank ribbons based on the Enlisted Ranks of the US Army.
zh: 基于美国陆军士兵军衔的九种军衔绶带。

s: Chinese Wenchang Satellite Launch Center
zh: 中国文昌卫星发射中心

s: Prop pack used to accessorize and decorate IVA spaces
zh: 用于装饰美化 IVA 空间的物件包

s: Highlight struts and fuel lines in the VAB and flight; locate broken struts and fuel lines with much speed!
zh: 在 VAB 与飞行中高亮显示支柱和燃料管线；快速定位断裂的支柱与燃料管线。

s: SafeChute takes you out of time warp when your parachutes deploy, and also just above landing. You can restart time warp manually after SafeChute stops it.
zh: <<M0>> 会在降落伞展开时以及着陆前一刻退出时间加速。在 <<M0>> 停止加速后可手动重新开启。

s: DarkMultiPlayer is a multiplayer mod for KSP 0.25. It supports subspace-style (and master controlled warp) warping & career mode, with an easy-to-edit server database.
zh: <<M0>> 是适用于 KSP 0.25 的多人 mod。支持子空间式（以及主控时间加速）时间加速与生涯模式，服务器数据库易于编辑。

s: Rockets from The Martian by Andy Wier
zh: 来自 Andy Wier《火星救援》的火箭

s: Take Command lets you assign crew to External Command Seats from within the VAB/SPH, and have them spawn into their seats automatically at launch.
zh: Take Command 让你可在 VAB/SPH 中为外部指令座椅指派乘员，并在发射时自动就座。

s: space launch system realism mod
zh: 太空发射系统拟真 mod

s: OBSOLETED in KSP v1.3.1 --- A minor cfg tweak that fixes the Kerbal Seat to safely eject the occupant instead of flinging them overboard several meters.
zh: 已在 KSP v1.3.1 中废弃 --- 一个微小的 cfg 调整，修复 Kerbal 座椅使其安全弹出乘员，而不会把乘员甩出数米之外。

s: Because we don't want to see our sstos explode on the landing
zh: 因为我们不想看到自己的 SSTO 在着陆时爆炸

s: The AmpYear Power Manager makes electricity more manageable.
zh: <<M0>> 电力管理器让电力更易管理。

s: A quaternary star system with plenty of potential for expansion.  (Outdated, succeded by Linbol System Rebirth)
zh: 一个具有充足扩展潜力的四恒星系统。（已过时，由 Linbol System Rebirth 取代）

s: Introducing a simple, stock-alike lightweight 5-seat command pod. Capable of fully autonomous unmanned flight, and with included engine pods, capable of built-in Launch Escape, or Propulsive Landing.
zh: 引入一款简洁、原版风格的轻型 5 座指令舱。可全自主无人飞行，配合附带的发动机吊舱可实现内置发射逃逸或动力着陆。

s: Flags shared across PanzerLabs' mods
zh: <<M0>> 系列 mod 共用的旗帜

s: The texture pack of RSS-Origin RSSTexture&TopoRevamp. This is part 1 of the 16k version.
zh: RSS-Origin RSSTexture&<<M0>> 的贴图包。这是 16k 版本的第 1 部分。

s: Adds a new resource that you can mine and convert into fuels.
zh: 添加一种可开采并转化为燃料的新资源。

s: Core plugins needed by several packs.
zh: 多个整合包所需的核心插件。

s: This mod adds a planet just below Eve's orbit called Dustball, it is a hot desert planet with rings. Requires Kopernicus
zh: 本模组在 Eve 轨道内侧添加一颗名为 Dustball 的行星，是一颗带环的炎热沙漠行星。需要 Kopernicus。

s: Expands probe selection with new cores, new probe bus parts, mini satellite parts and a large quantity of antennas.
zh: 扩充探测器选择：新增核心、探测器主体部件、微型卫星部件以及大量天线。

s: Want to land a rocket like Elon Musk? Need somewhere to park it? This is the mod for you. Requires Kerbal konstructs
zh: 想像 Elon Musk 那样回收着陆火箭？需要地方停放？这就是你要的模组。需要 Kerbal Konstructs。

s: Time and Kerbal Dimensions in Space.
zh: 太空中的时间与 Kerbal 维度。

s: A Mod that aims to slowly creep up the number of Interstellar systems and planets.
zh: 一个旨在逐步增加星际星系与行星数量的模组。

s: Keep track of your electrical usage in the Editor and in Flight
zh: 在编辑器和飞行中追踪电量消耗。

s: ISRU scoop for Xenon,Argon and Hydrogen
zh: 用于氙、氩和氢的 ISRU 采集器。

s: This planet pack adds a planetary/solar system with a red dwarf, 4 planets and 4 moons.
zh: 该行星包添加一个红矮星系，包含 4 颗行星和 4 颗卫星。

s: A mod that adds three new Airbrakes. A fast-twitch control surface variant, a robust braking variant, and a re-entry rated variant with smart G-force throttling.
zh: 添加三种新型减速板：快速响应的控制面型、坚固的制动型，以及具备智能 G 力节流的再入专用型。

s: A complete overhall and update of the Space1999 packs by StinkyAce and MajorTom
zh: 对 <<M1>> 和 <<M2>> 制作的 <<M0>> 系列包进行全面重制与更新。

s: A planet system based off of a fictional story.
zh: 基于虚构故事的行星系。

s: Audio and visual feedback when a science experiment is available
zh: 科学实验可用时提供音效与视觉提示。

s: Real chemical propellants for stock engines while remaining simple.
zh: 为原版发动机提供真实化学推进剂，同时保持简洁。

s: Adds the ability to destroy multiple vessels quickly.
zh: 可快速销毁多个飞行器。

s: Gather science from KSC in one click
zh: 一键从 KSC 收集科学。

s: Kerbal Space Program Endurance Mod
zh: Kerbal Space Program Endurance 模组

s: An optional expansion for SpaceY Heavy Lifters that adds 7.5m parts among other enhancements.
zh: 为 <<M0>> Heavy Lifters 提供的可选扩展，新增 7.5m 部件及其他改进。

s: A fixed version of the stock RCS module
zh: 原版 RCS 模块的修复版本。

s: A real scale planet pack for Kerbal Space Program
zh: 适用于 Kerbal Space Program 的真实比例行星包。

s: This is a parts pack for Kerbal Space Program v1.2.2+, to recreate the glorious Eagle Transporter N° 3 from the 70's series "Space: 1999".
zh: 适用于 Kerbal Space Program v1.2.2+ 的部件包，用于重现 70 年代剧集《Space: 1999》中经典的 Eagle Transporter N° 3。

s: A Custom Barn Kit config addon that increases Kerbal Space Center buildings to ten levels instead of the stock game's four. For Kerbal Space Program. Doesn't add more building models.
zh: Custom Barn Kit 的配置附加组件，将 KSC 建筑提升至十级（原版为四级）。适用于 Kerbal Space Program。不添加新的建筑模型。

s: A stockalike CST-100 Starliner mod for Kerbal Space Program
zh: 适用于 Kerbal Space Program 的原版风格 <<M0>> Starliner 模组。

s: Now with working Snacks! Generator!
zh: 现已支持可用的 Snacks! 生成器。

s: This mod adjusts the specs on Making History engines and 2 stock engines with the goal of ensuring every engine has a unique niche.
zh: 本模组调整 Making History 发动机和 2 台原版发动机的参数，使每台发动机都有独特定位。

s: MQTT telemetry bridge for KSP 1.12.5. Publishes 18 vessel-state topics over MQTT for browsers, dashboards, ESP32s, Grafana, or any subscriber.
zh: 适用于 KSP 1.12.5 的 MQTT 遥测桥。通过 MQTT 发布 18 个飞行器状态主题，供浏览器、仪表盘、<<M0>>、Grafana 或任意订阅者使用。

s: Liquid Hydrogen fuel tanks and Liquid Hydrogen storage for most stock tanks
zh: 液氢燃料罐，并为大多数原版燃料罐添加液氢储存。

s: An electrical parts mod adding two streamlined radially attached parts: one RTG and one Fuel Cell.
zh: 电力部件模组，新增两个流线型径向安装部件：一个 RTG 和一个燃料电池。

s: This mod adds a smaller version of the stock airbrake, for times when the stock airbrake is too big and ugly.
zh: 本模组添加原版减速板的缩小版本，用于原版减速板过大且外观不佳的情况。

s: This mod will allow you to change the tech tree, including the creation of new tech nodes.
zh: 本模组可修改科技树，包括创建新的科技节点。

s: Inline greenhouses (models by zzz) supporting 1 and 3 kerbals. Works with TAC Life Support, without it, the parts just look cool on space stations. USI Life Support configs outdated at the moment.
zh: 内置式温室（模型由 zzz 制作），支持 1 名和 3 名 Kerbal。兼容 TAC Life Support；不装时这些部件在空间站上只是好看。USI Life Support 配置目前已过时。

s: EVE configs for snow on Kerbin and Laythe
zh: 为 Kerbin 和 Laythe 添加积雪的 EVE 配置。

s: Heavy Cargo Shuttle with Advanced Cockpit
zh: 配备先进驾驶舱的重型货运航天飞机。

s: Set of some Soviet parts missing in Making History DLC
zh: Making History DLC 中缺失的部分苏联部件合集。

s: Some very welcome patches for Airplane Plus.
zh: 为 Airplane Plus 提供的一些非常实用的补丁。

s: This changes the time that Sunrise is defined (an hour later than stock)
zh: 修改日出时间的定义（比原版晚一小时）。

s: Fixes weird grammar in contract view, makes it almost the Queen's proper English.
zh: 修正合同界面中奇怪的语法，使其接近标准英语。

s: This mod lets you hide orbits with the press of a single key and clears up the map view so you can concentrate on your mission.
zh: 本模组可用单个按键隐藏轨道，清理地图视图，让你专注于任务。

s: Everyone's favorite life support in everyone's favorite shape. The Mk2 body.
zh: 人人都爱的生命保障系统，配上人人都爱的外形：Mk2 机身。

s: New fusion powered nuclear thermal jet engine
zh: 新型聚变动力核热喷气发动机。

s: Additional mod support for Back In Black
zh: 为 Back In Black 提供额外模组支持。

s: Enables fuel switching in air-breathing engines. A very welcome companion to cryo rocket systems.
zh: 为吸气式发动机启用燃料切换。低温火箭系统的理想搭档。

s: Configs to add Tweakscale functionality to Making History Expansion. Requires Tweakscale Mod.
zh: 为 Making History 扩展添加 TweakScale 功能的配置。需要 TweakScale 模组。

s: A HEAVY WIP MOD that at some point will add many moons and stars
zh: 一个仍在重度开发中的模组，未来将添加众多卫星与恒星。

s: Sol Textures for the entire Saturn system!
zh: 覆盖整个土星系统的 Sol 贴图。

s: A complete set of flexible docking ports that allows for a limited amount of movement and rotation of the port, facilitating surface docking.
zh: 一整套柔性对接端口，允许端口有限度的移动与旋转，便于表面对接。

s: This mod is an addon for SpaceDust mod that expands list of harvestable resources.
zh: 本模组是 <<M0>> 的附加组件，扩充可采集资源列表。

s: Replace stock navball texture with something better!
zh: 用更好的纹理替换原版导航球纹理

s: Mod for Boat Parts that simulates hull breaches based on damage. Seawater will flood the part and parts that are submerged will be destroyed by increasing pressure at depthdf
zh: 适用于 Boat Parts 的 mod，根据损伤模拟船体破口。海水会灌入部件，浸没的部件会因随深度增加的压力而损毁

s: Fully featured Space Shuttle including boosters, external tank, MMU, and assorted payload mounting options as well as new texture options for the stock Mk3 cockpit, payload bays, and landing gears.
zh: 功能完整的航天飞机，包括助推器、外储箱、MMU 及多种载荷安装选项，并为原版 Mk3指令舱、载荷舱与起落架提供新纹理选项。

s: Hides any tech tree nodes that don't have parts. Also reassigns parent node connections so that non-empty nodes have only non-empty parents. To be used with the Community Tech Tree.
zh: 隐藏所有没有部件的科技树节点。同时重新分配父节点连接，使非空节点仅拥有非空父节点。需与 Community Tech Tree 配合使用。

s: A solar system orbiting a contact binary star
zh: 一个围绕接触双星运行的行星系

s: Adds the possibility to exit KSP at any time.
zh: 允许随时退出 KSP。

s: Adapted from silversliver's The Blue Drill this mod adds a drill capable of drilling Xenon from asteroids,  planetary surfaces and moons.
zh: 此 mod 改编自 silversliver 的 The Blue Drill，添加一种可从行星表面、卫星与小行星中钻取氙气的钻头。

s: These are antenna patches from @DeimosRast needed to update the AIES Aerospace mod for KSP 1.8.x and beyond
zh: 这些是来自 @<<M0>> 的天线补丁，用于将 AIES Aerospace mod 更新至 KSP 1.8.x 及更高版本

s: A plugin that allows you to create reminder alarms at future periods to help you manage your flights and not warp past important times
zh: 一款插件，可创建未来时间点的提醒闹钟，帮助你管理飞行，避免时间加速错过重要时刻

s: KerbalFX Impact Puffs adds engine plume-ground dust puffs for launch and landing, plus one-shot touchdown bursts on harder landings.
zh: <<M0>> Impact Puffs 为发射与着陆添加发动机尾焰扬尘，并在较重着陆时添加一次性触地扬尘。

s: The definitive collection of all of SilentVelcro's mods.
zh: <<M0>> 全部 mod 的权威合集。

s: kOS is a scriptable autopilot mod that allows you write small programs to automate specific tasks.
zh: kOS 是一款可编写脚本的自动驾驶仪 mod，可编写小型程序自动执行特定任务。

s: Mod extension to Niven's Ringworld mod to make parallax continued scattering objects available on the ringworld.
zh: Niven's Ringworld mod 的扩展，使 Parallax Continued 的散射物体可在环形世界上使用。

s: A huge and challenging tech tree. 206 technologies.
zh: 巨大且富有挑战性的科技树。206 项科技。

s: Slam a spacecraft into Dimorphos to change its orbit around Didymos
zh: 令航天器撞击 Dimorphos，以改变其环绕 Didymos 的轨道

s: Option install for Realism Overhaul, adds realistic plume expansion to engines.  See thread for currently configured engines.
zh: Realism Overhaul 的可选安装项，为发动机添加真实尾焰膨胀效果。当前已配置的发动机请见帖子。

s: Modifies the stock ISRU so you can mine water, oxygen, oxygen and liquid fuel, plus waste resources. Requires TACLS to work and I recommend MunSeeker Mk1 Greenhouse to grow food.
zh: 修改原版 ISRU，使其可开采水、氧气、氧气与液体燃料，以及废弃资源。需 TACLS 才能运作，并推荐使用 <<M0>> Mk1 Greenhouse 种植食物。

s: The OSE - Workshop is a new Part that is meant to be used together with Kerbal Inventory System (KIS). It allows you to create parts in flight.
zh: OSE - Workshop 是一种新部件，设计用于与 Kerbal Inventory System (KIS) 配合。它允许在飞行中制造部件。

s: Add KIS inventory to the command parts, 150 per kerbal. Help reduce part count
zh: 为指令部件添加 KIS 库存，每名 Kerbal 150。有助于减少部件数量

s: A plugin that lets you change the focus of the camera by pressing 'o' when hovering a part.
zh: 一款插件，悬停在部件上时按 'o' 可更改相机焦点。

s: RealChute is a complete rework of the stock parachute module to fix a few of it's inconveniences and get more realistic results out of parachutes!
zh: <<M0>> 是对原版降落伞模块的全面重制，修复若干不便之处，并使降落伞获得更真实的结果。

s: Add the small cost to the ElectricCharge.
zh: 为 <<M0>> 添加少量费用。

s: Mod adds Kerbal 1.11 stock Inventories to all 3rd party mod Command Pods, Station Hubs, and Bases
zh: 该 mod 为所有第三方 mod 的指令舱、空间站枢纽与基地添加 Kerbal 1.11 原版库存

s: Calculator plugin for Kerbal Space Program
zh: Kerbal Space Program 的计算器插件

s: Cruesoe Space Industries Tech Tree - Unmanned before Manned Tech Tree, with [hopefully) logical progression.
zh: Cruesoe Space Industries 科技树——无人先于载人科技树，具有（希望如此）合乎逻辑的进度。

s: With ksp 1.0.4, we received some new HOT updates: spaceplanes now explode very quickly during reentry.
zh: 在 KSP 1.0.4 中，我们收到了一些新的 HOT 更新：空天飞机现在会在再入时迅速爆炸。

s: A part of RSS-Origin, which replaces your skybox with a high-quality Milky Way background. This is the 32k res version
zh: RSS-Origin 的一部分，用高质量银河背景替换天空盒。此为 32k 分辨率版本

s: Chinese TianGong Science Space Station
zh: 中国<<M0>>科学空间站

s: A manned version of ASSET test vehicle (winged Mk1 command pod)
zh: ASSET试验飞行器的载人版本（带翼Mk1指令舱）

s: Adds VAB attachment for Shielded Docking Ports
zh: 为带防护罩的对接口添加 VAB 挂载能力

s: Stockalike VASIMR and argon tanks
zh: 原版风格 VASIMR 与氩气储罐

s: A new, more flexible contract monitoring window.
zh: 全新的、更灵活的任务监控窗口。

s: A KSP mod that increases the lift of a ModuleLiftingSurface when it's close to a surface.
zh: 一个 KSP mod，可在 <<M0>> 靠近表面时提升其升力。

s: Config files for part mods to support VABOrganizer
zh: 为部件 mod 提供的配置文件，用于支持 VABOrganizer

s: Japris Stellar Neighborhood adds almost a dozen new planets and moons to KSP, remakes the stock system and adds 2 new star systems to explore.
zh: Japris Stellar Neighborhood 为 KSP 添加近十颗新行星与卫星，重制原版星系，并新增 2 个可供探索的恒星系。

s: QuickRevert is a small plugin which adds the possibility to keep/pay the revert function.
zh: <<M0>> 是一个小型插件，可让“回退”功能得以保留或需要付费。

s: Provids trim pointers opposite the control axis pointers
zh: 提供与控制轴指示器方向相反的配平指示器

s: Kerbalism support for SystemHeat mod
zh: 为 <<M0>> mod 提供 Kerbalism 支持

s: Dynamic IVA Sound Effects, add drama to your IVAs and hear your ship's fuselage Shake, Rattle and Rumble !
zh: 动态 IVA 音效，为你的 IVA 增添戏剧感，可听到飞船机身的震动、咔嗒与轰鸣。

s: Moves stock parts around for an unmanned start and a more challenging early game. Works very well with stock tech tree and Community Tech Tree.
zh: 调整原版部件的科技位置，实现无人开局与更具挑战性的前期。与原版科技树和社区科技树配合良好。

s: Track celestial bodies before you can explore them
zh: 在能够探索天体之前先行追踪它们

s: This  mod adds parts for bases on other plantes. It includes Habitats, Greenhouses, Laborarory and many more.
zh: 该 mod 添加用于在其他行星建造基地的部件，包括居住舱、温室、实验室等。

s: Procedural Parts textures by MainSailor in a sci fi inspired look
zh: 由 <<M0>> 制作的 Procedural Parts 纹理，科幻风格

s: Basic set of parts meant to bring the all electric cannae drive technology to KSP!
zh: 一套基础部件，将全电 Cannae 驱动技术带入 KSP。

s: a simple texture pack for kerbalnauts
zh: 一个简单的宇航员纹理包

s: Keeps OPT Spaceplane Parts useful and relevant in today's KSP.
zh: 让 OPT Spaceplane Parts 在当今的 KSP 中依然实用、不过时。

s: Adorn your craft with your favourite cryptocurrency. To the mün!
zh: 用你最喜欢的加密货币装点你的飞船。向 mün 进发。

s: A Submarine with in-build ballast
zh: 带内置压载舱的潜艇

s: Replaces the EPL resource chain with one using the stock ISRU parts and resources.
zh: 使用原版 ISRU 部件与资源替代 EPL 的资源链。

s: This mod adds some late-game engines and tanks to the game. These parts are fusion-based or use advanced technologies.
zh: 该 mod 为游戏添加若干后期发动机与储罐，这些部件基于聚变或采用先进技术。

s: Provides fuel switching in the stock tanks, the stock jet engines, and expands CryoTanks options
zh: 为原版储罐与原版喷气发动机提供燃料切换，并扩展 <<M0>> 选项

s: Makes resource placement no longer random but fit to composition templates. Promotes cryofuel mods and planet pack to life support compatibility.
zh: 使资源分布不再随机，而是符合成分模板。提升低温燃料 mod 与行星包对生命支持系统的兼容性。

s: An alternative layout for the RP-1 Tech Tree
zh: <<M0>> 科技树的另一种布局

s: This mod adds methane rockets to KSP
zh: 该 mod 为 KSP 添加甲烷火箭

s: a profile that provides good visual effects
zh: 提供良好视觉效果的画面配置

s: Small stock-alike lights that sit flush for lighting up your stations, ships, and landing zones.
zh: 原版风格的小型嵌入式灯，用于照亮你的空间站、飞船与着陆区。

s: Adds the possibility to brake your vessel at launch.
zh: 可在发射时对飞船施加刹车。

s: When a docking port is selected as target, an additional red marker appears on your Navball, indicating the orientation of that docking port.
zh: 当选定的目标为对接口时，导航球上会额外显示一个红色标记，指示该对接口的朝向。

s: A set of Canadarm2 look-alike parts, for building your own robotic arms. Includes rotating joints, latching end effector and grapple fixture.
zh: 一套仿 <<M0>> 的部件，用于自行搭建机械臂。包含旋转关节、锁紧末端执行器与抓取固定装置。

s: Cetera's Suit Pack contains class-specific custom suits for all KSP stock classes and for all classes included in MKS.
zh: Cetera's Suit Pack 包含适用于 KSP 全部原版职业以及 MKS 中所有职业的专属定制宇航服。

s: Add a simple life support system based on Snacks!
zh: 添加一套基于 Snacks 的简单生命支持系统。

s: SimpleConstruction addon. Adds Mallet, Survey Stake, Recycler and turns Cupola module to Survey Station.
zh: <<M0>> 扩展。添加木槌、勘测桩、回收装置，并将穹顶舱模块变为勘测站。

s: Adds the possibility to use the RemoteTech mod without the additional parts.
zh: 可在不使用附加部件的情况下使用 <<M0>> mod。

s: Allows toggling EVA_ROTATE_ON_MOVE with LeftAlt-F
zh: 可用 <<M0>>-F 切换 EVA_ROTATE_ON_MOVE

s: Realistic effects mod for Realism Overhaul
zh: 为 Realism Overhaul 提供的真实效果 mod

s: Air﻿ Turbines that generate power﻿ from flowing﻿ air﻿
zh: 利用流动空气发电的空气涡轮机

s: Everyone's favorite life support in everyone's favorite shapes. The Mk2 and Mk3 body. Needs Deep Sky Core.
zh: 备受欢迎的生命支持系统，采用备受欢迎的造型：Mk2 与 Mk3 机身。需要 Deep Sky Core。

s: KPBS adds multiple parts for bases on other planets including Habitats, Greenhouses, Laboratories and much more. It also supports the major life support mods.
zh: KPBS 添加多种用于在其他行星建造基地的部件，包括居住舱、温室、实验室等，并支持主流生命支持 mod。

s: Every wanted to use Venus, Jupiter or even Uranus as your station or probe core. Well now you can use Uranus as a probe all you would like with Planetary Station Cores!
zh: 人人都想用金星、木星甚至天王星来做空间站或探测器核心。现在有了 Planetary Station Cores，你可以随意把天王星当作探测器使用。

s: NASA Tri-ATHLETE inspired robotics rover for KSP: Breaking Ground expansion
zh: 受 NASA Tri-ATHLETE 启发的机械探测车，适用于 KSP：Breaking Ground 扩展包

s: A simple expansion to the Sepratron part family.
zh: Sepratron 部件家族的简单扩展。

s: This pack includes 13 extra moons for Neptune: Nereid | Naiad | Thalassa | Despina | Galatea | Larissa | Proteus | Halimede | Psamathe | Sao | Laomedeia | Neso | Hippocamp.
zh: 本包为海王星添加 13 颗额外卫星：Nereid | Naiad | Thalassa | Despina | Galatea | Larissa | Proteus | Halimede | Psamathe | Sao | Laomedeia | Neso | Hippocamp。

s: Resizes and rearranges the Kerbal system to more closely resemble the Solar System
zh: 调整 Kerbal 星系的大小与布局，使其更接近太阳系

s: Allows you to offset your pod's center of mass to perform a lifting reentry
zh: 可偏移返回舱的质心，以进行升力再入

s: A red ringed world with a wine-dark sea, auroras, and its own moon, Selyn
zh: 一个红色环带世界，拥有酒暗色海洋、极光，以及自己的卫星 Selyn

s: Community-developed tech tree extension, with support for many mods.
zh: 由社区开发的科技树扩展，支持众多 mod。

s: A planet mod for Kerbal Space Program adding a black hole system.
zh: 为 Kerbal Space Program 添加黑洞星系的行星 mod。

s: A 75% "Mammoth", consisting of 3 Vectors in a 3.75m base. Mode switching for Elephant-Plume effects!
zh: 75% 大小的“Mammoth”，由 3 台 Vector 组成，底座直径 3.75m。可切换模式以获得 Elephant-Plume 效果。

s: Add countdown to launchpad like NASA countdown
zh: 为发射台添加类似 NASA 的倒计时

s: This mod contains miscellaneous parts created for personal use, challenges, upon request, or just don't fit with the other mods. Will be updated as new parts are made.
zh: 该 mod 收录各种杂项部件，为个人使用、挑战、应他人请求而制作，或只是与其他 mod 不搭。制作新部件后会持续更新。

s: Adds a "Loaded Mods" button to the main menu.
zh: 为主菜单添加“已加载 mod”按钮。

s: Radiator with animation and sound.
zh: 带动画与音效的散热器。

s: New Monopropellant stock fuel cell and fuel cells for every pod!  Dependencies: ModuleManager, L00NTools
zh: 全新的单组元推进剂原版燃料电池，以及适用于每个返回舱的燃料电池。依赖：<<M0>>、<<M1>>

s: QuickScroll is a small plugin which adds the possibility to scroll the parts pages, the categories and the filters on the editor with the mouse wheel and with keyboard shortcuts.
zh: <<M0>> 是一个小型插件，可用鼠标滚轮和键盘快捷键在编辑器中滚动部件页面、分类与筛选器。

s: This mod provides the player with a new line of probe models called the K-Sat series, with integrated power (storage and generation) as well as buildt in antennas.
zh: 该 mod 为玩家提供全新的 K-Sat 系列探测器型号，集成电力（储存与发电）并内置天线。

s: Adds an atmosphere to the lowlands of minmus
zh: 为 Minmus 的低地添加大气

s: A space-navigational aide for Kerbal Space Program
zh: Kerbal Space Program 的太空导航辅助工具

s: Adds other star systems in Real Solar System.
zh: 在 Real Solar System 中添加其他恒星系。

s: Explore several minor planets orbiting beyond Neidon!
zh: 探索环绕Neidon之外的数颗小行星！

s: Please use the other Hangar Extender mod, this is the wrong one
zh: 请使用另一个 Hangar Extender mod，这个不是正确的

s: Addon for kOS that enables interaction with elements of career mode like contracts, building upgrades, and the tech tree.
zh: kOS 扩展，可与生涯模式元素交互，例如合同、建筑升级和科技树。

s: Service Module and accessories designed specifically for use with the stock Mk1-2 Command Pod, vaguely resembling NASA's Orion MPCV. May or may not have a convincing stockalike appearance.
zh: 专为原版 Mk1-2指令舱配套设计的服务舱及附件，外形大致类似 NASA 的 Orion MPCV。是否具有令人信服的原版风格外观，见仁见智。

s: A simple fan club for the #1 kerbal, Jebediah.
zh: 为头号小绿人 Jebediah 设立的简易粉丝俱乐部。

s: Proximity gives an audio alarm and a visual display indicating distance from the planet surface (and depending on configuration, velocity towards it) during landing.
zh: Proximity 在着陆时提供声音警报和视觉显示，指示距星球表面的距离（并依配置显示朝向表面的速度）。

s: Adds the effects of the density, temperature and relative speed of the atmosphere to craft sounds.
zh: 使飞行器音效受大气密度、温度和相对速度的影响。

s: Shows whether climbing or descending by the color of the navball text
zh: 通过导航球文字颜色显示上升或下降

s: A mod that adds additional antenna compatible with both Remote Tech and Telemachus.
zh: 添加额外天线的 mod，兼容 Remote Tech 与 Telemachus。

s: A stock tech tree revolving around propeller planes and cars/boats first
zh: 以螺旋桨飞机和汽车/船只起步的原版科技树

s: Textures Unlimited recolours for Nice MKSeries Bodies (NMB)
zh: Nice MKSeries Bodies (NMB) 的 Textures Unlimited 重新配色

s: This mod adds landing legs for Starship
zh: 此 mod 为 Starship 添加着陆腿

s: KerbalFX AeroFX adds atmospheric ribbon condensation trails for suitable wing-like aircraft parts, driven by speed, air density, dynamic pressure, and maneuver load. Requires KerbalFX Core.
zh: <<M0>> <<M1>> 为合适的翼类飞机部件添加大气带状凝结尾迹，由速度、空气密度、动压和机动载荷驱动。需要 <<M0>> Core。

s: A balance mod that makes the game more realistic, adding additional challenges.
zh: 让游戏更真实的平衡性 mod，增加额外挑战。

s: Monero agent and flags for use in Kerbal Space Program.
zh: 用于 Kerbal Space Program 的 Monero 主题涂装与旗帜。

s: Plugin for modders to add more detailed sound effects to the game, featuring a robust Layering System for use of multiple sounds
zh: 供 mod 作者使用的插件，可为游戏添加更细致的音效，并具备支持多音效叠加的稳健分层系统

s: This is an add-on for BDArmory. It adds new weapons and parts.
zh: BDArmory 的扩展，添加新武器和部件。

s: Small Insignificant mod that I will keep developing as I learn to mod ksp, don't expect anything big soon.
zh: 一个无关紧要的小 mod，我会在学习 KSP mod 制作的过程中持续开发，短期内不必期待大内容。

s: This little tool allows you exchange funds for science and vice versa.
zh: 这个小工具可让你用资金兑换科学点，反之亦然。

s: Launch Sites Appended is a scenery pack for Kerbal Konstructs. Once installed it will either amend (if you have the Making History DLC) or add new launch sites to KSP.
zh: Launch Sites Appended 是 Kerbal Konstructs 的地景包。安装后将修改（若你有 Making History DLC）或向 KSP 添加新的发射场。

s: SmokeScreen is a plugin that build on the engine FX added in .23 and adds new features to them. Most of the features ideas comes from Nothke.
zh: <<M0>> 是一个基于 0.23 版本引入的发动机特效构建的插件，并为其添加新特性。大部分特性构想来自 Nothke。

s: This plugin will attempt to conserve fuel consumption by automatically toggling Fuel Cells on or off in accordance with a minimum and maximum threshold setting on the Fuel Cell's context menu.
zh: 此插件会依据燃料电池右键菜单中设置的最小与最大阈值自动开关燃料电池，以节省燃料消耗。

s: The pieces that hold everything else up.
zh: 支撑其余一切的结构件。

s: Make stuff shiny, plugin for modders
zh: 让部件闪闪发亮，供 mod 作者使用的插件

s: Replacement for stock engine particle FX
zh: 原版发动机粒子特效的替代品

s: A revival of an old planet pack that adds in multiple real-life solar systems.
zh: 旧行星包的重制版，添加多个现实中的恒星系。

s: A mod for KSP that allows you to create, edit, and delete Kerbals
zh: 允许创建、编辑和删除小绿人的 KSP mod

s: Mod for Kerbal Space Program: Simulation of wind and turbulence.
zh: Kerbal Space Program mod：模拟风与湍流。

s: An easy way to add notes to your log file, useful for debugging
zh: 向日志文件添加备注的简便方式，便于调试

s: Unofficial continuation of Superfluous Nodes, originally created by @Geonovast. Adds a plethora of nodes to a ridiculous amount of parts!
zh: Superfluous Nodes 的非官方续作，原作者 @Geonovast。为数量多得离谱的部件添加大量节点。

s: FRE is a set of realistics engines intended for use with Realism Overhaul. Includes Viking engines (Ariane I to IV), Vega engines, LE-7 and LE-5 Japan engines, and more!
zh: FRE 是一套面向 Realism Overhaul 的真实发动机。包含 Viking 发动机（Ariane I 至 IV）、Vega 发动机、<<M0>> 与 <<M1>> 日本发动机等。

s: Adds the possibility to go to an other scene from anywhere (VAB, SPH, Tracking Station ...).
zh: 可从任意位置（VAB、SPH、追踪站……）切换到其他场景。

s: Grannus Expansion Pack rescaled 2.5x
zh: Grannus Expansion Pack 2.5 倍缩放版

s: An expansion for stock and modded spaceplane parts!
zh: 原版与 mod 空天飞机部件的扩展。

s: A relatively simple mod that adds in parts for you to wage nuclear war.  Requires BD Armory
zh: 一个相对简单的 mod，添加用于发动核战争的部件。需要 BD Armory。

s: Adjust navball markers scale, colors, priorities, collapse behavior, afraid mouse cursor.
zh: 调整导航球标记的缩放、颜色、优先级、折叠行为以及标记躲避鼠标指针的行为。
